assets/voice-lines/ae9a5b9b871ef8552372..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ae9a5b9b871ef8552372..text: 你和我想的制作人不太一样。

assets/voice-lines/6e8484a6b44e2ea22c3f..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/6e8484a6b44e2ea22c3f..text: 想。但杯子离这张画远一点。

assets/voice-lines/acea2a955be1b80d2eab..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/acea2a955be1b80d2eab..text: 可能会很慢，也有不同意见。

assets/voice-lines/14043cd4109be91de5c0..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/14043cd4109be91de5c0..text: 今天最好的一张图，是这个。

assets/voice-lines/4b6ecad9254bd123987d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4b6ecad9254bd123987d..text: 也不用每次都赶最后一分钟。

assets/voice-lines/fe4053ec616a6c608d88..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/fe4053ec616a6c608d88..text: 我也想过，棚沿的坡度做得不错。

assets/voice-lines/b11ffdacd2c26dc7c346..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b11ffdacd2c26dc7c346..text: 好。路上那段，你可以只走路。

assets/voice-lines/2ead55cfdd8d7d67f0ad..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/2ead55cfdd8d7d67f0ad..text: 现在觉得，不一定非要画在纸上。

assets/voice-lines/77f5a22ff3a9f27549c2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/77f5a22ff3a9f27549c2..text: 现在从这里，也能看见那扇窗了。

assets/voice-lines/cd572b8de7b66c139d71..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/cd572b8de7b66c139d71..text: 林栀，又在给谁的植物看病？

assets/voice-lines/23ab0bff6472d9ffd2e3..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/23ab0bff6472d9ffd2e3..text: 来得正好。这一盆，还得等。

assets/voice-lines/4baa97108ee5f559c927..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/4baa97108ee5f559c927..text: 不用。你答应的事，我记得住。

assets/voice-lines/eba95530b728dae4c141..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/eba95530b728dae4c141..text: 所以今天终于能记得把它带回去。

assets/voice-lines/51231f2b6870c3e2b6e6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/51231f2b6870c3e2b6e6..text: 等一下，这朵花怎么越开越大了。

assets/voice-lines/876c7dddc63304b616f6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/876c7dddc63304b616f6..text: 这次橙子少了。下次我会记得。

assets/voice-lines/7373fd9479788e9605b5..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/7373fd9479788e9605b5..text: 可以。现在蛋糕可以正式分完了。

assets/voice-lines/12726e7a1cb2bc3fbe48..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/12726e7a1cb2bc3fbe48..text: 原来那几分钟，真的很安静。

assets/voice-lines/be64d9f34f9ae9062575..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/be64d9f34f9ae9062575..text: 嗯。月亮还在，可以慢一点。

assets/voice-lines/15f4dddc52ab982fb928..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/15f4dddc52ab982fb928..text: 今天不用看病，给它们搬家。

assets/voice-lines/60b69720d59e16102636..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/60b69720d59e16102636..text: 这句话，听起来像一个好的开始。

assets/voice-lines/cd04f134660bc7334da1..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/cd04f134660bc7334da1..text: 旁边吧。这样你也有地方坐。

assets/voice-lines/d1268a95ff1625bdee27..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/d1268a95ff1625bdee27..text: 不着急。名字可以一行一行写。

assets/voice-lines/032dbb6df1e26fa873a7..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/032dbb6df1e26fa873a7..text: 可这条街，什么时候真正没人呢？

assets/voice-lines/40eb493a2302c5d79329..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/40eb493a2302c5d79329..text: 晚安，沈屿。明天也在这里。

assets/voice-lines/b1f83038cc05e72336c0..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b1f83038cc05e72336c0..text: 好。这次可以不用带工作。

assets/voice-lines/cc43b375e52612fb5320..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/cc43b375e52612fb5320..text: 那今天的第一个镜头呢？

assets/voice-lines/4b7cc33743273a61a071..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4b7cc33743273a61a071..text: 你望着那株不太起眼的幼苗。

assets/voice-lines/bf8276daacc29893048b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bf8276daacc29893048b..text: 鼠标停在那两秒空白上。

assets/voice-lines/3d202c3b8e91975b9cba..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3d202c3b8e91975b9cba..text: 她认真听了听，忽然笑起来。

assets/voice-lines/5c432b9ae52b3e284627..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5c432b9ae52b3e284627..text: 她问你，这部片子最想留下什么。

assets/voice-lines/c052dccc56f52f44e58c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c052dccc56f52f44e58c..text: 你看了一眼仍然熄着的录音灯。

assets/voice-lines/226d38bf6294733e433e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/226d38bf6294733e433e..text: 鼠标停在那段并不热闹的声音上。

assets/voice-lines/bc7f3040f7be01d03be1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bc7f3040f7be01d03be1..text: 她问你，这一遍到底想留下什么。

assets/voice-lines/fedaf6a732ca54066d4a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fedaf6a732ca54066d4a..text: 她把记忆里的那杯水说得很慢。

assets/voice-lines/225594dd1f781411c446..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/225594dd1f781411c446..text: 她把杯子轻轻推回桌面中央。

assets/voice-lines/3940e450a921c8e7389a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3940e450a921c8e7389a..text: 她把复制件放到你的发言稿旁。

assets/voice-lines/1dcb02881639de8a0a9a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1dcb02881639de8a0a9a..text: 她轻轻碰了碰你尚未落下的手。

assets/voice-lines/a257ad9a28732d237453..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a257ad9a28732d237453..text: 她指了指桌上还空着的几张卡。

assets/voice-lines/2db9718976cff139bef5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2db9718976cff139bef5..text: 你每天都做这样的记录？

assets/voice-lines/256ca0854b070a6657e6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/256ca0854b070a6657e6..text: 接触不良，还是带子已经坏了？

assets/voice-lines/cc713fc6f8d4500ff779..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/cc713fc6f8d4500ff779..text: 这里的光，比预想的还早。

assets/voice-lines/a7315e82da6a4e37425b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a7315e82da6a4e37425b..text: 我想，把片头留给开门的声音。

assets/voice-lines/a7c25239b19406b91b56..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a7c25239b19406b91b56..text: 片尾还要多留一点时间。

assets/voice-lines/e1766e1dbfc7fa3cc71a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e1766e1dbfc7fa3cc71a..text: 我总觉得还缺一点重要的东西。

assets/voice-lines/205a3a0c2af453b081d7..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/205a3a0c2af453b081d7..text: 他们每天都从这里走过去。

assets/voice-lines/3b23b4c6f86916523580..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/3b23b4c6f86916523580..text: 新的一天，也该有新的声音。

assets/voice-lines/a09cfb41472ac28ae3af..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a09cfb41472ac28ae3af..text: 因为我终于肯让他们把话说完。

assets/voice-lines/26bd6d5b79039e541119..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/26bd6d5b79039e541119..text: 今天的最后一个镜头，不拍了。

assets/voice-lines/23deb46057b1004b0a3b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/23deb46057b1004b0a3b..text: 你原本以为我是什么样？

assets/voice-lines/05f8b1333715b1f68818..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/05f8b1333715b1f68818..text: 那今天不重讲。你想喝茶吗？

assets/voice-lines/5f57db947d487e8ca71e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5f57db947d487e8ca71e..text: 你以前也常在这里等人？

assets/voice-lines/6aa854fed4896890a112..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6aa854fed4896890a112..text: 建筑图里也会留下这些歪线吗？

assets/voice-lines/2eac991c505509c80ff1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2eac991c505509c80ff1..text: 这句也可以放进片子吗？

assets/voice-lines/dc565ae4a0b3b9176bd0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/dc565ae4a0b3b9176bd0..text: 那公开的采访，明天再录？

assets/voice-lines/6d888b50a1ebd48e6e54..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6d888b50a1ebd48e6e54..text: 这边里面一点，袖子不会湿。

assets/voice-lines/03400984b99aa970b018..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/03400984b99aa970b018..text: 你小时候等雨停，会不会着急？

assets/voice-lines/9dfbae4fa73d2f83955d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/9dfbae4fa73d2f83955d..text: 等小一点，我送你到工作室。

assets/voice-lines/155dc8464598fbedbcf5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/155dc8464598fbedbcf5..text: 再听一遍。不把想象当成结论。

assets/voice-lines/e35d7d1dd1d18a590d10..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e35d7d1dd1d18a590d10..text: 已经帮了很多。日期也能对照吗？

assets/voice-lines/0f828bf36de47974e8a5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0f828bf36de47974e8a5..text: 小时候的你，会满意这扇窗吗？

assets/voice-lines/2679b33c40dad04bf4dc..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2679b33c40dad04bf4dc..text: 她给你发的试听，你还没听完吧？

assets/voice-lines/78477ff0f03e7271ba97..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/78477ff0f03e7271ba97..text: 有人在现场拍过录像吗？

assets/voice-lines/e05f982e8a5aab737019..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e05f982e8a5aab737019..text: 收到。现场管理比制作人可靠。

assets/voice-lines/ec38c76b47d7ad89ec7d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ec38c76b47d7ad89ec7d..text: 一句都不满意，算不算写好了？

assets/voice-lines/e0eb65f9bf6cdfb80e0f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e0eb65f9bf6cdfb80e0f..text: 顺序不重要，一起写就行。

assets/voice-lines/8107d8b2e9bae00f8c60..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8107d8b2e9bae00f8c60..text: 连制作人会做什么都猜到了。

assets/voice-lines/6769a0b9155c52e0a07a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6769a0b9155c52e0a07a..text: 这一遍，先唱你最舒服的版本。

assets/voice-lines/5afcc3debe1608e5dcb1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5afcc3debe1608e5dcb1..text: 我尽量。手已经离开暂停键了。

assets/voice-lines/4c4245a17495ac3dff32..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4c4245a17495ac3dff32..text: 这首歌和母带无关，也很好听。

assets/voice-lines/47fd4975c933bd9ebb42..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/47fd4975c933bd9ebb42..text: 不是关于纪录片的，也可以？

assets/voice-lines/5b0ef6eda7be0c95e991..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5b0ef6eda7be0c95e991..text: 我以前会先把它当成没用的东西。

assets/voice-lines/5dd94b840090653a3ad2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5dd94b840090653a3ad2..text: 你以前也会写抓人的标题吗？

assets/voice-lines/c60138fea0a6866f7708..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c60138fea0a6866f7708..text: 我以为记者会一直被消息追着走。

assets/voice-lines/bc591bfc63dadb4220a5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/bc591bfc63dadb4220a5..text: 制作人不应该站在放映机旁吗？

assets/voice-lines/8f151f25a4100a8ad519..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8f151f25a4100a8ad519..text: 你连这种题都能这么快解决。

assets/voice-lines/54ea1b04eb56cb620d4a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/54ea1b04eb56cb620d4a..text: 最后这一遍。看完这一遍就关机。

assets/voice-lines/db082b66ced9b5e1233b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/db082b66ced9b5e1233b..text: 如果我只做到了“还不错”呢？

assets/voice-lines/5772fd80d33fde49105a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5772fd80d33fde49105a..text: 那这张应该先留在你这里。

assets/voice-lines/eb0260946743ec9a4e3a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/eb0260946743ec9a4e3a..text: 我还没拍近景。要不要换一块？

assets/voice-lines/893e305118e66fd5f924..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/893e305118e66fd5f924..text: 我没有要证明失手比做好更珍贵。

assets/voice-lines/14fbc0b66630a60639c7..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/14fbc0b66630a60639c7..text: 这份，最后会变成店里的新品吗？

assets/voice-lines/3ce9adb9d3e5454f184a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/3ce9adb9d3e5454f184a..text: 拍不好就觉得，好像不够喜欢。

assets/voice-lines/6b246e55801767fa6124..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6b246e55801767fa6124..text: 抱歉，导出多花了十分钟。

assets/voice-lines/ce52f729a705e2bd9252..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ce52f729a705e2bd9252..text: 先坐下。剩下的我帮你收。

assets/voice-lines/149686f39c678ac5bb12..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/149686f39c678ac5bb12..text: 下次换我准备。你只要来。

assets/voice-lines/ba7a1d3541d6e411f5b7..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ba7a1d3541d6e411f5b7..text: 你选。今晚先告诉我片名。

assets/voice-lines/e5858d5ead6b597a0b11..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e5858d5ead6b597a0b11..text: 我怕导出之后又看见新的问题。

assets/voice-lines/8574593840cb0b3c8223..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8574593840cb0b3c8223..text: 想出去走几步吗？就到楼下。

assets/voice-lines/e914383d45bc47eb03b9..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e914383d45bc47eb03b9..text: 看见了。要蹲下来才看得清。

assets/voice-lines/0bba18d37c8a2d16095a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0bba18d37c8a2d16095a..text: 好。布场前，我们一起确认。

assets/voice-lines/5c7ea5ef420f4a106492..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5c7ea5ef420f4a106492..text: 这一杯喝完，我们再去迎接明天。

assets/voice-lines/46611f9410251209a25a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/46611f9410251209a25a..text: 等大家都到了再安排我的位置。

assets/voice-lines/b7db3bda15d6ec794de8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b7db3bda15d6ec794de8..text: 这一项，开场以前我自己打勾。

assets/voice-lines/fef32c896c684ce49910..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/fef32c896c684ce49910..text: 你平时开播，也会先想这么多吗？

assets/voice-lines/bc66bcdbc843c5d48e0e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/bc66bcdbc843c5d48e0e..text: 我在确认它还是插着的。

assets/voice-lines/340f1a6d9f70ff9070c2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/340f1a6d9f70ff9070c2..text: 你准备在暖场里说什么？

assets/voice-lines/7ab60c6b91a3d653701a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7ab60c6b91a3d653701a..text: 这样会不会少一点戏剧性？

assets/voice-lines/2bdc846df896880c0d3c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2bdc846df896880c0d3c..text: 原来你说把人画进来，是这样的。

assets/voice-lines/af3129ec89b02f8b1cbd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/af3129ec89b02f8b1cbd..text: 首映之后，还能带我上去看看吗？

assets/voice-lines/b9027340c0cfce6cf0bd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b9027340c0cfce6cf0bd..text: 你平时下播以后，会先做什么？

assets/voice-lines/8e5c23bfcb0ee62d1e8a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8e5c23bfcb0ee62d1e8a..text: 这一遍，我也想好好看完。

assets/voice-lines/4d4f20f8a4f71a34a867..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4d4f20f8a4f71a34a867..text: 谢谢您。也谢谢大家愿意来。

assets/voice-lines/96f72351b028051b9aa6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/96f72351b028051b9aa6..text: 是我们写过标签的那一株？

assets/voice-lines/4fe0a882b05c1b406989..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4fe0a882b05c1b406989..text: 那谁来确认有没有少一个人？

assets/voice-lines/e17223ad23e69db52f53..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e17223ad23e69db52f53..text: 要不要再拍一张整齐一点的？

assets/voice-lines/406d1bcf7b1ea4358927..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/406d1bcf7b1ea4358927..text: 那这次，给每个人都分一点。

assets/voice-lines/eed4912d731f5b262030..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/eed4912d731f5b262030..text: 这一张，工作室也要留一份。

assets/voice-lines/0fa1c88922421960421b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0fa1c88922421960421b..text: 嗯。也把自己放进这一天里。

assets/voice-lines/6d17040233a295186a53..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6d17040233a295186a53..text: 先不拍。想认真说一次早安。

assets/voice-lines/238b6497efd748ce5c11..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/238b6497efd748ce5c11..text: 可以。那一页，比昨天清楚很多。

assets/voice-lines/bbd1fe53b785ada54478..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/bbd1fe53b785ada54478..text: 您还记得，原本准备在哪里放吗？

assets/voice-lines/cffaf145e1813ed4c490..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/cffaf145e1813ed4c490..text: 那我也先把笔放回包里。

assets/voice-lines/09ef846434f3e85dacc8..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/09ef846434f3e85dacc8..text: 不太会。所以今晚算练习。

assets/voice-lines/d9d2c0df75bb0a179db9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d9d2c0df75bb0a179db9..text: 现在你说。今天哪一段最难剪？

assets/voice-lines/8abaf601a3329c48ca35..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/8abaf601a3329c48ca35..text: 可以。你也写进邀请名单。

assets/voice-lines/1c79ff01a3aef133764a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1c79ff01a3aef133764a..text: 这下不用讨论谁拿哪一块了。

assets/voice-lines/479fb1f3196e465095d2..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/479fb1f3196e465095d2..text: 嗯。今天不是你一个人在等开机。

assets/voice-lines/4dfdcd794669d0d475e1..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/4dfdcd794669d0d475e1..text: 看出来了。它也很努力地保持着。

assets/voice-lines/347f6a1bf24d8d560c26..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/347f6a1bf24d8d560c26..text: 这句不用给直播间，给我就好。

assets/voice-lines/a77e01282bd98617d329..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/a77e01282bd98617d329..text: 好。这个通知，我现在就收到。

assets/voice-lines/e64ac01d2eae59181368..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e64ac01d2eae59181368..text: 不用隔这么远。我就在你旁边。

assets/voice-lines/d571467d44626ea18b5c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/d571467d44626ea18b5c..text: 这个歪太阳不是我画的吧？

assets/voice-lines/fbc44f6fc5d5a5764940..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/fbc44f6fc5d5a5764940..text: 我还以为你那时候嫌我总唱慢。

assets/voice-lines/a45ea921cca50df34093..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a45ea921cca50df34093..text: 那就并排。像这两把椅子。

assets/voice-lines/43ea5206cfab5f5d4eaf..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/43ea5206cfab5f5d4eaf..text: 我有个很不专业的评价。

assets/voice-lines/361a9e1f78ee9d310d9e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/361a9e1f78ee9d310d9e..text: 同意。歌也是来听他们说话的。

assets/voice-lines/89d1704fa6ff6c277628..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/89d1704fa6ff6c277628..text: 不录。不用站起来，也不必找调。

assets/voice-lines/33a3ab35c1ffc5a11ac9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/33a3ab35c1ffc5a11ac9..text: 这一小段，终于有地方坐了。

assets/voice-lines/b2b668a695f894794743..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b2b668a695f894794743..text: 也是今晚有人听见的人。

assets/voice-lines/7c03c538bf7ed6029703..speaker: chen-yi
assets/voice-lines/7c03c538bf7ed6029703..text: 树没事就好。它活着，以后总有人能看见花。

assets/voice-lines/dab2132f2db37ac9bb96..speaker: grandma-mei
assets/voice-lines/dab2132f2db37ac9bb96..text: 那是我画的。你画的是旁边那条尾巴。

assets/voice-lines/686c4b6d89d1d02e6878..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/686c4b6d89d1d02e6878..text: 会。所以我想再听听街坊的意见。你愿意一起吗？

assets/voice-lines/8910f95530110528d57d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8910f95530110528d57d..text: 会说“这是很好的情绪点”，然后让我再讲一遍。

assets/voice-lines/14bfda683a090abfebdb..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/14bfda683a090abfebdb..text: 那先留着原始声音。能不能对上，回去慢慢比。

assets/voice-lines/b744a43ba23f9ee01247..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b744a43ba23f9ee01247..text: 你说“等一会儿”的时候，真的会等。

assets/voice-lines/49a3500db2cf6e4014e6..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/49a3500db2cf6e4014e6..text: 把日期写上吧。以后再听，就知道是今天。

assets/voice-lines/580fbbc5a235613ef514..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/580fbbc5a235613ef514..text: 好。愿意入镜的，我们之后单独确认。

assets/voice-lines/9718a79a5c3ac79cdcd0..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/9718a79a5c3ac79cdcd0..text: 受访者。我也在这里长大，不能只替别人提问题。

assets/voice-lines/4fa20baa896753b6fa41..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4fa20baa896753b6fa41..text: 我准备了答案，后来发现太像项目汇报。

assets/voice-lines/2395aa823464d6594719..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/2395aa823464d6594719..text: 明天吧。今天已经说了一件很重要的事。

assets/voice-lines/d11ed3057576298d53d3..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d11ed3057576298d53d3..text: 数据都收好了。这十分钟，可以不用算成赶路吗？

assets/voice-lines/0b2dc0c34d0b8b6b3248..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0b2dc0c34d0b8b6b3248..text: 你也是。包不用一直抱着，旁边的凳子是干的。

assets/voice-lines/e1ee8b1487eb1524e208..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e1ee8b1487eb1524e208..text: 不了。今天有人一起等，数乱也不用从头开始。

assets/voice-lines/f5796b2caa51670304f3..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/f5796b2caa51670304f3..text: 也许只是到时间了。钟楼以前每天傍晚会试报时。

assets/voice-lines/ecbc203b00bc3d247453..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ecbc203b00bc3d247453..text: 嗯。别因为过去还有空白，就错过现在约好的事。

assets/voice-lines/91086613ce0342f28e5e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/91086613ce0342f28e5e..text: 过来一点。窗前的位置，不是只够摄影机站。

assets/voice-lines/8bfea9a437dcb9dc1a7d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8bfea9a437dcb9dc1a7d..text: 你可以站在旁边。看得见我，也看得见窗。

assets/voice-lines/94f015ba5c7c8a97bb9e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/94f015ba5c7c8a97bb9e..text: 可能会问，为什么还没把窗边的人画进去。

assets/voice-lines/df6e7112ce8172453420..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/df6e7112ce8172453420..text: 记进正式清单吧。这一条，我同意。

assets/voice-lines/41057ee51e88de233720..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/41057ee51e88de233720..text: 晴川街坊共同修订。你真的把每个人都写上了。

assets/voice-lines/11128c636b4787fe0ca1..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/11128c636b4787fe0ca1..text: 不用证明你能等多久。按约好的时间来，我就会在。

assets/voice-lines/7e90714e07d1f816f200..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/7e90714e07d1f816f200..text: 文件已经确认过了。现在你在等什么？

assets/voice-lines/329ae68aace09fb74c18..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/329ae68aace09fb74c18..text: 可以。那天不带测量本，也不临时补一场采访。

assets/voice-lines/09c6408f62d78d6ffde8..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/09c6408f62d78d6ffde8..text: 也看看你。上次你一直在看窗，没发现我等你转头。

assets/voice-lines/847d910dcd0f6654e78f..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/847d910dcd0f6654e78f..text: 这次谁都不许饿着唱。结束后，一人一小块面包。

assets/voice-lines/b393d12788aafc77f415..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b393d12788aafc77f415..text: 不用藏。我在街对面看见你这盏灯很久了。

assets/voice-lines/0a6490200baf595505cf..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0a6490200baf595505cf..text: 开门以后。今天别再为了赶早，把今晚熬没了。

assets/voice-lines/b45e2b3b213bfa4aff53..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b45e2b3b213bfa4aff53..text: 先承认它有自己的速度。再给我也留一点。

assets/voice-lines/a19d414c34e274a5119c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a19d414c34e274a5119c..text: 价目表是给客人挑的。你刚才问的，是我喜欢什么。

assets/voice-lines/63789208258d39db51b0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/63789208258d39db51b0..text: 可以。别又把它写成“江月老师推荐的街区美食”。

assets/voice-lines/70357f8be7b2acd78a40..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/70357f8be7b2acd78a40..text: 刚才那几分钟，也算今天的拍摄吗？

assets/voice-lines/04f98e86799183898911..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/04f98e86799183898911..text: 本来是。后来想想，我今天也还没吃午饭。

assets/voice-lines/03609b97241bb9d9937d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/03609b97241bb9d9937d..text: 我总说你别忘了，自己忙起来也一样。

assets/voice-lines/56f0c50a4f5e8114acff..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/56f0c50a4f5e8114acff..text: 嗯。看你的样子，现在也终于像来吃饭的了。

assets/voice-lines/c018de4a6eea73fbf510..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c018de4a6eea73fbf510..text: 你可以笑。不是每一次试做都要替我找好听的名字。

assets/voice-lines/3c55cf327e1770be8edb..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/3c55cf327e1770be8edb..text: 我知道。只是偶尔有人看见我想办法，也很好。

assets/voice-lines/66c0297510a2d55cbebd..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/66c0297510a2d55cbebd..text: 那部片子的结束，还是这块蛋糕的结束？

assets/voice-lines/de4b3c2408c04e82593c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/de4b3c2408c04e82593c..text: 嗯。后来会把喜欢吃的那一口，也等得没心情吃了。

assets/voice-lines/d32be964453de3d4d884..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d32be964453de3d4d884..text: 好。画面没有说完的地方，你自己知道，也可以。

assets/voice-lines/ea981f0c74d9e31911bb..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ea981f0c74d9e31911bb..text: 那给桌边留个位置，我有时也想坐在那里。

assets/voice-lines/dfff4f0a11c4e5fd74c3..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/dfff4f0a11c4e5fd74c3..text: 不是。是想在你也坐下的时候，看得见你。

assets/voice-lines/ec8755f9b138f6b30c96..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ec8755f9b138f6b30c96..text: 你提前说过。我也刚忙完，不用站在门口罚自己。

assets/voice-lines/bbaed365b5e6b38b65e5..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/bbaed365b5e6b38b65e5..text: 你说会来，我就没把它算成剩下的。

assets/voice-lines/408cd7071f10c706312d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/408cd7071f10c706312d..text: 会。但有时也想听见一句，先坐下。

assets/voice-lines/1d1b757c6f340fef10fe..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1d1b757c6f340fef10fe..text: 这次，我不用自己找能坐的地方了。

assets/voice-lines/8346ee4862da2b84629a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/8346ee4862da2b84629a..text: 不是听不清。你刚才一直抓着杯子，水都没喝。

assets/voice-lines/76c2912c9f7ee261777e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/76c2912c9f7ee261777e..text: 嗯。也记下你喜欢的地方，不要只列问题。

assets/voice-lines/507851e84309d649231d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/507851e84309d649231d..text: 我还没想好。你可以把选片的时间，也留给我。

assets/voice-lines/f322d961f2001e368a80..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/f322d961f2001e368a80..text: 提醒你清单做完以后，真的可以结束。

assets/voice-lines/c2a28591845475d31e2b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c2a28591845475d31e2b..text: 你要是很想拍，可以。不过我更想先和你一起看见。

assets/voice-lines/ebd1eaa3195dd0ca5b27..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ebd1eaa3195dd0ca5b27..text: 等一下。你的衣角，刚才搬设备时卷起来了。

assets/voice-lines/2af4b7cfa436ebaac2e7..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/2af4b7cfa436ebaac2e7..text: 那先看我们。看见谁，就想一句你今天想说的话。

assets/voice-lines/9044ad14ece51ce6680f..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/9044ad14ece51ce6680f..text: 当然。不过你那一份，要自己坐下来吃完。

assets/voice-lines/ddbcacd46339d3f467b1..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ddbcacd46339d3f467b1..text: 看见了吗？靠墙那盆，最小的那一朵。

assets/voice-lines/51c277b0e363c3caf6e3..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/51c277b0e363c3caf6e3..text: 可以提前庆祝今天。今天也不是练习。

assets/voice-lines/4e2229f401f7c7809be7..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/4e2229f401f7c7809be7..text: 那我已经想好一部了。明天再告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/391050beb3fe4d6e8111..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/391050beb3fe4d6e8111..text: 听见了？不止我一个人记得那把椅子。

assets/voice-lines/a5fa3e55636bbed5cf1d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a5fa3e55636bbed5cf1d..text: 那株树没开花的冬天，是她每天来给温室添一盏灯。

assets/voice-lines/a321b05ad38f9428d147..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a321b05ad38f9428d147..text: 会。新芽已经不是那天的颜色了，得重新给你看。

assets/voice-lines/f8f8f3b0a04752ceb739..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f8f8f3b0a04752ceb739..text: 这样更好。别急着用我们的解释，把她的话盖过去。

assets/voice-lines/9926229fcb97d4860f8f..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/9926229fcb97d4860f8f..text: 会觉得你在认真学。不过现在，我也有一个问题。

assets/voice-lines/d08d4c249aa634b06e3c..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/d08d4c249aa634b06e3c..text: 饭快凉了。制作人准备什么时候吃？

assets/voice-lines/a7e9bb10b4b910e403a2..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a7e9bb10b4b910e403a2..text: 那温室门轴的那一声，怎么办？我昨天刚上过油。

assets/voice-lines/304b34b4dffe2f86916b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/304b34b4dffe2f86916b..text: 我想带你看一样东西。明天早一点，可以吗？

assets/voice-lines/eb5a2e3f09472b41d42d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/eb5a2e3f09472b41d42d..text: 还没开花。不过，新芽的颜色变了。

assets/voice-lines/c35baf5d89ddea7a68f6..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c35baf5d89ddea7a68f6..text: 那我在门口等你。这一次，你可以不用带摄影机。

assets/voice-lines/9176a7bbebf98b401c76..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/9176a7bbebf98b401c76..text: 也好。空白不是还没做到，是给新的事情留位置。

assets/voice-lines/3f65c929f0b1c3d03fe5..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3f65c929f0b1c3d03fe5..text: 关系很大。你总得先认识镜头里的东西。

assets/voice-lines/a119b370a6e595bdeb4f..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a119b370a6e595bdeb4f..text: 那就这里吧。下午的光温和，也不会被门碰到。

assets/voice-lines/95b18978a81d08ddd659..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/95b18978a81d08ddd659..text: 差不多。很多变化，等你想起要记，已经错过了。

assets/voice-lines/008558e69e99ce475f98..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/008558e69e99ce475f98..text: 纸质标签别放在热灯底下。字迹会褪得更快。

assets/voice-lines/d6ceba94ac772f3e6250..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/d6ceba94ac772f3e6250..text: 嗯。她修缮前总要听街坊说很久，有时比画图还久。

assets/voice-lines/c697e74a0b4041310010..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c697e74a0b4041310010..text: 名字可以晚一点。你要拍的那一天，不会等太久。

assets/voice-lines/dda1f8c3c09ab1cbc394..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/dda1f8c3c09ab1cbc394..text: 也不用一直跟着。工作时我会忘记有人在拍。

assets/voice-lines/78b16e00704e6aa0305e..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/78b16e00704e6aa0305e..text: 因为你发现，早晨不会按分镜表来。

assets/voice-lines/8de740d66c7202defd83..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8de740d66c7202defd83..text: 这一段，你为什么没剪掉？我的手挡住花了。

assets/voice-lines/335d6c2c1c7b39dcc8b5..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/335d6c2c1c7b39dcc8b5..text: 可以。不过看片子的茶，下次轮到我带。

assets/voice-lines/9dc191c5732cac23c692..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9dc191c5732cac23c692..text: 她侧过头，小声问你现在听见的和录音时是否一样。

assets/voice-lines/1ac4e4edc14d94d6538f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1ac4e4edc14d94d6538f..text: 倒计时还没开始，她轻声问你想到没有。

assets/voice-lines/66ba6d3334d8f2001ec0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/66ba6d3334d8f2001ec0..text: 她没有替你安排下一部影片，只问你想怎样过今天。

assets/voice-lines/45d6227e9811386c274c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/45d6227e9811386c274c..text: 她递给你一块空白标签，没有替你填日期。

assets/voice-lines/c06085956d691cb51633..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c06085956d691cb51633..text: 你接过那块标签，想好了要写的第一行。

assets/voice-lines/e134d39da3dc751e4b03..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e134d39da3dc751e4b03..text: 她把那张画转向你，窗边留着一小片空白。

assets/voice-lines/7cc5b3535638d48e7f37..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7cc5b3535638d48e7f37..text: 你终于听懂了，这场讨论并不是在争哪扇窗更漂亮。

assets/voice-lines/f4d80b44f9ca75de6b10..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f4d80b44f9ca75de6b10..text: 她问，不谈工作的时候，你通常会做什么。

assets/voice-lines/ac165027b6b752608683..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ac165027b6b752608683..text: 测试灯亮起，她先看了你一眼，才低头记数据。

assets/voice-lines/ac9e26e614d826f580d0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ac9e26e614d826f580d0..text: 她把手机和一边耳机递过来，问要不要现在对照。

assets/voice-lines/a2f715207f83b50255b1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a2f715207f83b50255b1..text: 许知夏想把封套上的字拍下来，又抬头看了看你。

assets/voice-lines/f09327ea38147346eecc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f09327ea38147346eecc..text: 她低下头，过了片刻，才把那页轻轻放平。

assets/voice-lines/ee6d1bcf735887807d75..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ee6d1bcf735887807d75..text: 回放里有一声走调的长音，也有几个人没忍住的笑。

assets/voice-lines/881047d8e54ddf74affb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/881047d8e54ddf74affb..text: 耳机里，她在“明天”前轻轻吸了一口气。

assets/voice-lines/f0bb03b84068f0c61e92..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f0bb03b84068f0c61e92..text: 天色暗了一点，她问这次合作最难的是什么。

assets/voice-lines/a021a52fdb8117c147ab..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a021a52fdb8117c147ab..text: 歌停在最后一个和弦上，她抬头等你的回答。

assets/voice-lines/84deb07d117ba12737c9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/84deb07d117ba12737c9..text: 她合上笔记本，先问你为什么这么想知道那一天。

assets/voice-lines/9620ad7226b66b6da827..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9620ad7226b66b6da827..text: 她把你的茶往近处推了一点，又指向窗边的书架。

assets/voice-lines/ca41cde9505397792e88..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ca41cde9505397792e88..text: 你把手停在那行小字旁，一时不知道先看哪里。

assets/voice-lines/905720a15fb0a3f59dad..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/905720a15fb0a3f59dad..text: 苏晚看向你，像在问这一刻要不要开始正式记录。

assets/voice-lines/81bd8dd0d4d591127af9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/81bd8dd0d4d591127af9..text: 你意识到，她在等你决定要怎样拍这一天。

assets/voice-lines/27c3dfd39438200b8955..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/27c3dfd39438200b8955..text: 苏晚没有接着提问，给你留了很长的一小段安静。

assets/voice-lines/e5482186126f23f410ec..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e5482186126f23f410ec..text: 她说完后笑了一下，眼神却还停在那条旧标题上。

assets/voice-lines/c918a8ef9704dd54a9fe..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c918a8ef9704dd54a9fe..text: 那一页仍然空着，足够容纳一个还没想好的答案。

assets/voice-lines/cfbb9a048a713f6d5e65..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cfbb9a048a713f6d5e65..text: 只剩两条待确认的内容，今晚却已经联系不到人。

assets/voice-lines/01e2a38057225ea9b2e1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/01e2a38057225ea9b2e1..text: 说到一半，你意识到，这一次她没有开录音。

assets/voice-lines/3c175b08688482176f14..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3c175b08688482176f14..text: 她把叉子递给你，没有先问影片改到了第几版。

assets/voice-lines/ca11c718fd9d6a666005..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ca11c718fd9d6a666005..text: 计时器还剩几分钟，她问你现在最想做什么。

assets/voice-lines/36d8acc7cfa8a5f11315..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/36d8acc7cfa8a5f11315..text: 走到门口，她又回头看了一眼那张提醒。

assets/voice-lines/b18e07a0252d7d800be5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b18e07a0252d7d800be5..text: 片子结束，工作室只剩风扇的声音。

assets/voice-lines/2f34104329dc22dc8b03..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2f34104329dc22dc8b03..text: 她指了指放在一旁的摄影机，等你自己决定。

assets/voice-lines/7f4352e00045208bbfc9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7f4352e00045208bbfc9..text: 修订清单只剩最后一项，你看了看时间。

assets/voice-lines/ee3f251d7ea2e376e1f9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ee3f251d7ea2e376e1f9..text: 远处钟楼的灯还亮着，她问你明天最想先做什么。

assets/voice-lines/9caf358a40e45a518ec7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9caf358a40e45a518ec7..text: 她把纸条按平，问你现在能不能先答应。

assets/voice-lines/85b2307f17403e0d269a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/85b2307f17403e0d269a..text: 她伸手扶住一张被风吹翻的回信卡，忽然笑了一下。

assets/voice-lines/94234d5cf7997d2defa8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/94234d5cf7997d2defa8..text: 她没有立刻把手机转向你，而是等你的回答。

assets/voice-lines/b892a6010cb5b4d47dd2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b892a6010cb5b4d47dd2..text: 她把最后一张名字贴好，忽然指了指你空着的衣袋。

assets/voice-lines/1a154692dd574fb304c7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1a154692dd574fb304c7..text: 你转过身。这一次，她没有把笑意藏到图纸后面。

assets/voice-lines/afae62fc3a5df2f209c3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/afae62fc3a5df2f209c3..text: 下播前，她问你想给镜头那边的人留什么。

assets/voice-lines/3f26bb29252e8baec0a6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/3f26bb29252e8baec0a6..text: 我怕漏掉谁。又怕写得太长，没人愿意看。

assets/voice-lines/61cd7386ef05bb7eeb9a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/61cd7386ef05bb7eeb9a..text: 原来不急着填满的时候，大家真的会愿意等。

assets/voice-lines/61c15c7a93b211d5e4dd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/61c15c7a93b211d5e4dd..text: 我记得明天是照常开放。你会在吗？

assets/voice-lines/340a9056fb5fa80fd8e0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/340a9056fb5fa80fd8e0..text: 我一直怕，拍下来以后，会和他们记得的不一样。

assets/voice-lines/0fb766ff0705e7602df5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0fb766ff0705e7602df5..text: 明天早一点，我去给它记新的日期。

assets/voice-lines/f543dbfdc1ba820796a2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f543dbfdc1ba820796a2..text: 好像什么都没变。又好像，不太一样了。

assets/voice-lines/286ca93670c0f7f57622..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/286ca93670c0f7f57622..text: 今天就修。先把已经答应的，认真做完。

assets/voice-lines/7f99d87afaa51b747277..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7f99d87afaa51b747277..text: 父亲留下的那句话，我好像终于知道从哪里开始了。

assets/voice-lines/63cea264d7418970f747..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/63cea264d7418970f747..text: 像是在介绍一群人，又不像认识他们。

assets/voice-lines/52466f34440b183cc70f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/52466f34440b183cc70f..text: 原来我最想保留的，是她回头看那一下。

assets/voice-lines/61f00c6ef54ed7228a43..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/61f00c6ef54ed7228a43..text: 你会不会觉得，我一直在问很笨的问题？

assets/voice-lines/e8dfbea1a8f930c86430..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e8dfbea1a8f930c86430..text: 这里还差一段转场。可能要等路上没人再拍。

assets/voice-lines/f69c92ac65387c56aa51..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f69c92ac65387c56aa51..text: 片子只有七分钟。谢谢大家愿意把这七分钟交给我。

assets/voice-lines/11ddd5f4e3a03483ee81..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/11ddd5f4e3a03483ee81..text: 这株还能养好吗？它看起来，比其他的都慢。

assets/voice-lines/c2f113b651e96cdef71a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c2f113b651e96cdef71a..text: 采访稿我会先给你看。现在不决定也没关系。

assets/voice-lines/ebd95aae95220658623b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ebd95aae95220658623b..text: 三脚架放在下面的空地。我只带录音机上去。

assets/voice-lines/3abd78f4d765783b702a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/3abd78f4d765783b702a..text: 这段录音叫“楼梯，午后”。不加形容词。

assets/voice-lines/c2d9e9129b5e8db7e6ec..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c2d9e9129b5e8db7e6ec..text: 我可以等。意见不同的部分，也先给当事人确认。

assets/voice-lines/0826d11a77b3a84c9d03..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0826d11a77b3a84c9d03..text: 这是受访者名单，还是负责人的签字？

assets/voice-lines/e80d99836cbed47c503d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e80d99836cbed47c503d..text: 那就从一个小问题开始。你最常坐在哪扇窗旁边？

assets/voice-lines/6e121b20111b54a5eeca..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6e121b20111b54a5eeca..text: 明白。我下次会准时到，不让你一直看门口。

assets/voice-lines/4b6dd14edd7691ceb9f1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4b6dd14edd7691ceb9f1..text: 工作室离这里十分钟。现在走来得及。

assets/voice-lines/14b0579a5d3d0697d7de..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/14b0579a5d3d0697d7de..text: 刚才确实想过，这个声音很适合转场。

assets/voice-lines/ba3575f3fbd6b8096702..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ba3575f3fbd6b8096702..text: 旧片里的人为什么一听钟响就抬头？

assets/voice-lines/bda598751c5e73be9583..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/bda598751c5e73be9583..text: 那明天先去做灯光测试。旧片的谜，按线索慢慢找。

assets/voice-lines/700f87668154bf23a8cf..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/700f87668154bf23a8cf..text: 拍摄说明写好了。今晚先看看光怎么落。

assets/voice-lines/cde28a62d43feb8dc0f9..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/cde28a62d43feb8dc0f9..text: 下次带两把椅子。站着看图太久，会累。

assets/voice-lines/0318e5470ada8043dd0a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0318e5470ada8043dd0a..text: 那我们呢？下一次见面，还在钟楼？

assets/voice-lines/67eda0d7ff29abf4cd3f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/67eda0d7ff29abf4cd3f..text: 很像。但不能只因为很像，就说它们是同一首歌。

assets/voice-lines/d449acb1bc7246f1cf04..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d449acb1bc7246f1cf04..text: 我还没正式介绍。我叫沈屿，拾光映像的制作人。

assets/voice-lines/4c72fcaa478074aaeb7e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4c72fcaa478074aaeb7e..text: 好。录音灯关着，你什么时候准备好再说。

assets/voice-lines/c136a9d44569983d6caf..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c136a9d44569983d6caf..text: 后来还是笑了。我们都笑了，设备也没受伤。

assets/voice-lines/a173866c3a93313b2eb4..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a173866c3a93313b2eb4..text: 这一遍很舒服。想留下一遍的时候，告诉我就好。

assets/voice-lines/b736d71054eddd3ea93e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b736d71054eddd3ea93e..text: 我想知道拍摄地点。你认识这扇窗吗？

assets/voice-lines/dc23ed44c80c1c62060c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/dc23ed44c80c1c62060c..text: 所以母带里的声音，不一定是一次正式演出。

assets/voice-lines/79be94f79b5e95d4d447..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/79be94f79b5e95d4d447..text: 大家不必看镜头。想唱就唱，想坐着听也可以。

assets/voice-lines/c0a0d2c45531e51b9769..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c0a0d2c45531e51b9769..text: 这次不用急着判断。先让耳朵休息一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/2d9000c0c678237264d6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2d9000c0c678237264d6..text: 那就把这一遍留下。也把刚才那几秒安静留下。

assets/voice-lines/a668579c39c7eade609a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a668579c39c7eade609a..text: 不急。这次我坐近一点，不站在摄影机后。

assets/voice-lines/5d98450bcf509918c051..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5d98450bcf509918c051..text: 那明天先约她。这首歌，今天先留在这里。

assets/voice-lines/144aa7c4257bfb6cf414..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/144aa7c4257bfb6cf414..text: 谢谢。照片上的报纸，能找到原件吗？

assets/voice-lines/aceeec2034a35f212803..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/aceeec2034a35f212803..text: 顾清禾查过维修单，拍摄应该在春末之后。

assets/voice-lines/c23bb0c5d083fc6688a3..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c23bb0c5d083fc6688a3..text: 我怕找到最后，还是只有几个零散的日期。

assets/voice-lines/e71113993b97f8c8997f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e71113993b97f8c8997f..text: 习惯了。你平时也会随手记别人说的话吗？

assets/voice-lines/9351f29138f9f7ff00d5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/9351f29138f9f7ff00d5..text: 找到了。钟楼西窗，这里有换过的窗扣。

assets/voice-lines/def894802e9b163f5663..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/def894802e9b163f5663..text: 今天的进度，可以写“找到一页”吗？

assets/voice-lines/5faa0531f50a7939cebd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5faa0531f50a7939cebd..text: 摄影机还没开。如果不想拍，我们也可以只听。

assets/voice-lines/e70f047a740992b6d140..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e70f047a740992b6d140..text: 那时候，大家排练完都在这里喝茶吗？

assets/voice-lines/2646998eb1216507b3f7..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2646998eb1216507b3f7..text: 刚才有点乱，第一组镜头最好整齐一点。

assets/voice-lines/86538ebfd44282b0c59d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/86538ebfd44282b0c59d..text: 节目单上的合唱，就是为那天准备的？

assets/voice-lines/f669e9f66e00f843ae08..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f669e9f66e00f843ae08..text: 所以片子不是为了参赛，也不是一份没人要的项目。

assets/voice-lines/da76883e2b359d47eac3..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/da76883e2b359d47eac3..text: 我可以拍照留档，再把原件还给您。

assets/voice-lines/e1a040cc77056f38bab8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e1a040cc77056f38bab8..text: “还没送出的街坊礼物”。比刚才安静很多。

assets/voice-lines/5431c2168ced0f2ccf2b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5431c2168ced0f2ccf2b..text: 你需要别人帮忙的时候，也会这么直接说吗？

assets/voice-lines/0b99ac5285b1bec05941..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0b99ac5285b1bec05941..text: 原来是这段。现在，想晚一点再说难的部分。

assets/voice-lines/dc9679b7260563532923..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/dc9679b7260563532923..text: 这一封只写着“祝你拍得顺利”，没有名字。

assets/voice-lines/4a611863af43dcd76cc9..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4a611863af43dcd76cc9..text: 我在片尾旁边标上拼音，导出前再查一次。

assets/voice-lines/c56c552bcfbac42d0e81..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c56c552bcfbac42d0e81..text: 我以为最后一遍校对，只需要找错别字。

assets/voice-lines/63756e67d4c91cc2ad13..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/63756e67d4c91cc2ad13..text: 饿不饿？我带了面包，刚才一直忘记拿出来。

assets/voice-lines/db26942c60f771074c1c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/db26942c60f771074c1c..text: 嗯。她说，纸袋里如果有两份，就不要一个人放凉。

assets/voice-lines/dd8f8b025c2040453423..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/dd8f8b025c2040453423..text: 有一点累。也有点怕片子还不够好。

assets/voice-lines/15fe4166b27eaec70b52..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/15fe4166b27eaec70b52..text: 那这个下午，我们不再回去对稿了。

assets/voice-lines/48abe9594bd8dbdb69b5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/48abe9594bd8dbdb69b5..text: 我没藏，只是这里还有一处没接顺。

assets/voice-lines/1d000ab7dd314a7c288e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/1d000ab7dd314a7c288e..text: 我怕大家期待的，比我能做出来的多。

assets/voice-lines/eb22cbaed3e71f98b93c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/eb22cbaed3e71f98b93c..text: 明天我去店里，帮你拍第一炉面包。你几点方便？

assets/voice-lines/98e7a54d3368b80119a6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/98e7a54d3368b80119a6..text: 我可以先拍你整理工具，或者再补一组揉面的特写。

assets/voice-lines/34aa3715b6c1730b0d5a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/34aa3715b6c1730b0d5a..text: 我总觉得，等的时候不做点什么，就会落下。

assets/voice-lines/6859617b42c5d3219008..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6859617b42c5d3219008..text: 你的回答，和店里那张长长的价目表不太一样。

assets/voice-lines/d6973a9d0c31107afd0b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d6973a9d0c31107afd0b..text: 那下次，我先问你想吃哪一家午饭。

assets/voice-lines/401585687d44f1e9101c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/401585687d44f1e9101c..text: 不算拍摄。不过算今天很好的一段。

assets/voice-lines/effff96238bc96778c70..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/effff96238bc96778c70..text: 那今天换我安排。想吃热汤，还是米饭？

assets/voice-lines/f21d8cf38735fea7b7d3..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f21d8cf38735fea7b7d3..text: 听起来，我们需要两张新的便利贴。

assets/voice-lines/fd64d1b72a3f06146715..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/fd64d1b72a3f06146715..text: 那我也记得，下次别一来就问你做了多少。

assets/voice-lines/001fa3e23726c5c9208e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/001fa3e23726c5c9208e..text: 因为花还没开。可你照顾它的样子，我想让人看见。

assets/voice-lines/85983c5fc1d5e96a36a3..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/85983c5fc1d5e96a36a3..text: 拿去剪辑，好像少了一个完整的结束。

assets/voice-lines/b6b1b8ae6e6aff7138fc..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b6b1b8ae6e6aff7138fc..text: 可能是我总想把每件好事都留下来。

assets/voice-lines/6a24ab84cfdddb441d8c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6a24ab84cfdddb441d8c..text: 你现在还会在送出去以前，想很多解释吗？

assets/voice-lines/41ab9e08b1a60883f24b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/41ab9e08b1a60883f24b..text: 给你留的。你说想看开门那一段，我把声音调好了。

assets/voice-lines/23a9021e17550990e5eb..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/23a9021e17550990e5eb..text: 你没有让我补拍的那些空白，我后来都记得。

assets/voice-lines/723df59cfd8593156d4c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/723df59cfd8593156d4c..text: 那再看一遍。看完不立刻改，我先把想法记下来。

assets/voice-lines/9150e0e7ff1e5be88817..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/9150e0e7ff1e5be88817..text: 现在等它走完，我们可以不用盯着它。

assets/voice-lines/40bc9bfd4068f261f015..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/40bc9bfd4068f261f015..text: 片子还没首映，我们好像先把庆祝提前了。

assets/voice-lines/2878402ad95b806fcd92..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2878402ad95b806fcd92..text: 首映结束，想再请你坐一次第一排。

assets/voice-lines/c56cf6806b24d2789b82..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c56cf6806b24d2789b82..text: 你挑的那部电影。没有修改意见，也不用写观后感。

assets/voice-lines/8e77b02ceb78664676b7..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8e77b02ceb78664676b7..text: 先确认投影，再核对名单。还有备用电池和回信卡。

assets/voice-lines/88f82522345f8cc27d93..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/88f82522345f8cc27d93..text: 你今天不是负责暖场吗？怎么连椅子也管？

assets/voice-lines/541fbcc9ff1677a63769..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/541fbcc9ff1677a63769..text: 这样可以。等你准备好，我们再一起试声音。

assets/voice-lines/184e3ac023b84e7a46a2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/184e3ac023b84e7a46a2..text: 以前那张邀请单上的人，今晚都能来吗？

assets/voice-lines/856a7ff086542fd23d3c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/856a7ff086542fd23d3c..text: 那这份迟到的礼物，今晚也不算全部送完。

assets/voice-lines/4b7478083be54e68db1d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4b7478083be54e68db1d..text: 大家好，我是沈屿，负责拍摄和剪辑。

assets/voice-lines/cd590bed30ad6bf39148..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/cd590bed30ad6bf39148..text: 也不是被叫来的。我答应了，会坐到大家身边。

assets/voice-lines/01b17e3ae4cb835bc26b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/01b17e3ae4cb835bc26b..text: 唐梨，去坐下吧。你的位置也留好了。

assets/voice-lines/fb11b392c505f5bdf775..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/fb11b392c505f5bdf775..text: 今天不采访你。你不用把每一句都写成工作纪要。

assets/voice-lines/96038533e281a0071f23..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/96038533e281a0071f23..text: 会。不过有些话，我只想记在脑子里。

assets/voice-lines/ab16129c9159c3250e6d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ab16129c9159c3250e6d..text: 当然。今天的第一个问题，已经问完了。

assets/voice-lines/2dc852cb67267470ab17..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/2dc852cb67267470ab17..text: 那现在给它留一格。用不用，等知道它是什么再说。

assets/voice-lines/1b6f582506c4cab9a1a4..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1b6f582506c4cab9a1a4..text: 我这杯就挺好。再浓一点，反而喝不出后面的甜味。

assets/voice-lines/efed0b3ac2a11ece9a56..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/efed0b3ac2a11ece9a56..text: 好。已经坐在这里，就不必每一分钟都朝答案走。

assets/voice-lines/7c2b11670c131cbbe05c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7c2b11670c131cbbe05c..text: 我们把未确认的地方留空，之后再一起核。

assets/voice-lines/44e8d6926e5443db9de5..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/44e8d6926e5443db9de5..text: 我也刚把它划掉。来，看看改后的这一行。

assets/voice-lines/4b2bc97824ec3a127df7..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4b2bc97824ec3a127df7..text: 好。先帮我把这一页按住，窗没关严。

assets/voice-lines/8f635d41508c3c0d0717..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/8f635d41508c3c0d0717..text: 这里先别听文字稿。把前后的声音放出来。

assets/voice-lines/00c7da57ef5a7a6afbdc..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/00c7da57ef5a7a6afbdc..text: 好。先不加解释性的音乐，让他的呼吸自己落下来。

assets/voice-lines/fa68d3682e04629be5ea..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/fa68d3682e04629be5ea..text: 那就不追着要署名。他已经给了能给的回应。

assets/voice-lines/48bda8331e6c0b3e7d89..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/48bda8331e6c0b3e7d89..text: 这两句不用再改成更积极的版本。接着说。

assets/voice-lines/507925f3b8c7816600cf..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/507925f3b8c7816600cf..text: 可以。它不是因为被我们说成完整，才值得被看见。

assets/voice-lines/b3e1bb98fd8c2f15eea5..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/b3e1bb98fd8c2f15eea5..text: 会多一点他们自己。对今天来说，已经很够了。

assets/voice-lines/5d861db50e8a876670bd..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/5d861db50e8a876670bd..text: 笔借我一下。我要把今天的座位号记住。

assets/voice-lines/ca56c7d2aacd58281d58..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/ca56c7d2aacd58281d58..text: 十秒。大家看这里，也可以看彼此。

assets/voice-lines/7a299dca033a7fdcbcfa..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/7a299dca033a7fdcbcfa..text: 可以再拍。但这张也留下，我喜欢。

assets/voice-lines/92679a0a9ff2b486308b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/92679a0a9ff2b486308b..text: 好。今天不赶着把每一分钟都变成热闹。

assets/voice-lines/924a052f079b41adc38f..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/924a052f079b41adc38f..text: 会想。有时想得太多，就忘了看看眼前真正有什么。

assets/voice-lines/e1d03cfb995325620805..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e1d03cfb995325620805..text: 现在先搬椅子。等开播的时候，我再认真紧张。

assets/voice-lines/1089a81bc0a17f273918..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1089a81bc0a17f273918..text: 他平时在镜头后面，今天难得被我叫到前面来。

assets/voice-lines/d2ff21668ff830af0860..speaker: uncle-lu
assets/voice-lines/d2ff21668ff830af0860..text: 隔壁小店的，喝了好多年。你们年轻人大概嫌它淡。

assets/voice-lines/f0249ba7516784214987..speaker: uncle-lu
assets/voice-lines/f0249ba7516784214987..text: 有时候。人多了就搬凳子出去，门口还不准挡着。

assets/voice-lines/3c54fe1481258af0c50c..speaker: uncle-lu
assets/voice-lines/3c54fe1481258af0c50c..text: 常来。总说不麻烦大家，最后自己搬得一头汗。

assets/voice-lines/4dfabb8c728de478b8fd..speaker: uncle-lu
assets/voice-lines/4dfabb8c728de478b8fd..text: 名字都对。那天的椅子，我还可以帮你们借。

assets/voice-lines/e942fb582d724266088f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e942fb582d724266088f..text: 他们刚才跟着那个拍子，轻轻点头了。

assets/voice-lines/90108c31c375fa1ec7cc..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/90108c31c375fa1ec7cc..text: 也要给自己留一点相信他们的时间。你今天做到了。

assets/voice-lines/6cbf174dee557c40f3c2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6cbf174dee557c40f3c2..text: 那就一起。今天我们都不赶下一遍。

assets/voice-lines/822d86f3f3eea01d5b27..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/822d86f3f3eea01d5b27..text: 你听过？我以为顾清禾只是让你来拍排练。

assets/voice-lines/66c3ef3ad19f1ed89826..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/66c3ef3ad19f1ed89826..text: 刚打开就被这阵风打断了。好吧，是我自己分心。

assets/voice-lines/d902cdb12b01d5b340e0..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/d902cdb12b01d5b340e0..text: 第一遍先别录。手指有点僵，给我找找状态。

assets/voice-lines/7f86331404f83febf8c1..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7f86331404f83febf8c1..text: 很不像一个说自己靠音乐生活的人，对吧？

assets/voice-lines/c9ef7180a092c02a6012..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c9ef7180a092c02a6012..text: 这题我会。先不管结尾，喜欢的地方总还记得。

assets/voice-lines/45685fe7558b93b9e91e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/45685fe7558b93b9e91e..text: 这个我想听。先听故事，歌名可以晚一点再问。

assets/voice-lines/df5a795ceb75067d0bfd..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/df5a795ceb75067d0bfd..text: 不算。它是我今天最想带回家的东西。

assets/voice-lines/4e665aa3a3f7733926c2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4e665aa3a3f7733926c2..text: 就唱两遍。有人要休息，我们今天就早点收。

assets/voice-lines/4e4290b08ef5e3ae5e68..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4e4290b08ef5e3ae5e68..text: 第一遍我带，第二遍谁记得哪句，就接哪句。

assets/voice-lines/1496ffda92ab96d221f5..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/1496ffda92ab96d221f5..text: 那我们一起准一点。错了，我会先笑你。

assets/voice-lines/7af31a676c740068ed4c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7af31a676c740068ed4c..text: 你这一下慢下来，我反而知道该在哪里换气。

assets/voice-lines/9613cd2a71522f85729d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/9613cd2a71522f85729d..text: 可以。那一拍不是忘词，是给下一句留门。

assets/voice-lines/569c46ee1d60ea572cdc..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/569c46ee1d60ea572cdc..text: 是你昨天说“也许再加半句”的时候，眼神太明显。

assets/voice-lines/f8fe10c7a39daccb73e9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f8fe10c7a39daccb73e9..text: 好像越想别出错，声音越不像自己。

assets/voice-lines/c9e179fd9993d0f22971..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c9e179fd9993d0f22971..text: 没有。第一次觉得“共同完成”不是一句客气话。

assets/voice-lines/5cae4d5a5f140b029291..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/5cae4d5a5f140b029291..text: 那以后别把每一句都写成旁白。你可以直接对我说。

assets/voice-lines/79d0d4e184c57575cef5..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/79d0d4e184c57575cef5..text: 还有一首，没写在今天的节目单里。你急着回去吗？

assets/voice-lines/2c07c36cec723b54ac1d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2c07c36cec723b54ac1d..text: 这是我上次排练失败之后写的。一直没唱给别人。

assets/voice-lines/2a99b5dca8867331bf29..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2a99b5dca8867331bf29..text: 谢谢。被你这么说，比被当成解谜线索高兴一点。

assets/voice-lines/ba779e41f90a02ade796..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ba779e41f90a02ade796..text: 不留在这里，留给你。是你的记忆，不是你的素材。

assets/voice-lines/b66fa90c8e236f02b8da..speaker: grandma-mei
assets/voice-lines/b66fa90c8e236f02b8da..text: 有过好几个写法。我记不清最后用了哪一个，别拿我的记性当定稿。

assets/voice-lines/e3c09e05f3f38c4ed1a4..speaker: grandma-mei
assets/voice-lines/e3c09e05f3f38c4ed1a4..text: 也可能是试唱。我们唱过很多遍，错了就再来，没人觉得那一遍白过。

assets/voice-lines/5efa05a40ceb5b456af5..speaker: grandma-mei
assets/voice-lines/5efa05a40ceb5b456af5..text: 可以试试。不过这是大家一起练的，还得问问其他还记得的人。

assets/voice-lines/5e536db8e51e5688a6bf..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/5e536db8e51e5688a6bf..text: 先确认开放区域和拍摄时间。画面里如果出现工人，也要问过他们。

assets/voice-lines/d060593ae3977306e1e0..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d060593ae3977306e1e0..text: 那就别只问他们记不记得。也问问，现在回来还有什么要做。

assets/voice-lines/78b446637f3e0f3e5c09..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/78b446637f3e0f3e5c09..text: 窗不会替人回答。不过我可以帮你找几个真正坐过这里的人。

assets/voice-lines/fabbca8e957f4cebf31f..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/fabbca8e957f4cebf31f..text: 窗台到地面的距离。现在的改造方案，多了一层地板。

assets/voice-lines/e7440d557e94882adf4d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e7440d557e94882adf4d..text: 没有。搬家时折了一下，铅笔断了。等找到新笔，已经不想再补。

assets/voice-lines/f832e3c3f2adf98750c8..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/f832e3c3f2adf98750c8..text: 可以。但先让我自己想一想，哪些是我记得的，哪些是后来听说的。

assets/voice-lines/19dd953b54e9c1c91483..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/19dd953b54e9c1c91483..text: 谢谢。不是每一件留下来的东西，都一定要变成拍摄素材。

assets/voice-lines/8776c53384ea74045999..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8776c53384ea74045999..text: 设备不要留在台阶上。回声可以录，来往的通道不能占。

assets/voice-lines/bb130b17536e09c0acbb..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/bb130b17536e09c0acbb..text: 旧扶手接缝。以前母亲听见这里响，就知道有人下来了。

assets/voice-lines/ccc92d0a24c994ce0dfd..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ccc92d0a24c994ce0dfd..text: 音量小一点。我想听见现在的楼梯，也想听见那时候的。

assets/voice-lines/6b6703c781e88c659473..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/6b6703c781e88c659473..text: 好。这里的风刚刚好，难得不用一坐下就开始核对尺寸。

assets/voice-lines/ec9b740adae36ee65d52..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ec9b740adae36ee65d52..text: 更多时候是别人等我。我总觉得，下一步再快一点，就不会让人等。

assets/voice-lines/4c570982203e4f6c42db..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4c570982203e4f6c42db..text: 最后要整理成能施工的尺寸。但整理之前，得知道这些线是谁画的。

assets/voice-lines/e47908a50d7b1dda6e6d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e47908a50d7b1dda6e6d..text: 这比替大家投票更有用。把理由留下，我们才能继续讨论。

assets/voice-lines/071ac4513e600de0b5f4..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/071ac4513e600de0b5f4..text: 所以明天我们再补上比例。今天先知道，为什么要画。

assets/voice-lines/94be3195414d85672be1..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/94be3195414d85672be1..text: 以前是西窗。现在常坐工作室的北窗，光不容易反到屏幕上。

assets/voice-lines/63ed9682dda5282d1ecc..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/63ed9682dda5282d1ecc..text: 还有咖啡店靠门的位置。坐在那里，你进来时我能先看见。

assets/voice-lines/38c296ff2148e3df129c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/38c296ff2148e3df129c..text: 那我们可以一起练。先把这杯喝完，不急着给这十分钟安排用途。

assets/voice-lines/c78bb1d8208e273cbe9c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/c78bb1d8208e273cbe9c..text: 听雨吧。不采样，不写旁白，也不用证明这场雨有什么特别。

assets/voice-lines/511dac85abd5f3fd64dd..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/511dac85abd5f3fd64dd..text: 会。总怕回家晚。母亲就让我数屋檐上的水滴，后来总是数乱。

assets/voice-lines/62cb63a1461a51ea1f4f..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/62cb63a1461a51ea1f4f..text: 这能确认窗的形状。声音的事，我不懂，不能帮你下判断。

assets/voice-lines/091b0c7d6564fc9f48ea..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/091b0c7d6564fc9f48ea..text: 维修单是春末。你这段画面里，窗扣已经换过，拍摄不会更早。

assets/voice-lines/48bdb724b8994161b132..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/48bdb724b8994161b132..text: 听着熟，但说不出在哪里。你可以问问许知夏，她常整理街区的老歌。

assets/voice-lines/956faaa0288cf8c91150..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/956faaa0288cf8c91150..text: 这只是测试。最后的颜色和密封还要验收，拍的时候记得说清楚。

assets/voice-lines/b6c53652fde2d0fd0981..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b6c53652fde2d0fd0981..text: 那下次就别总退到最后。你不是来借一束光，拍完就要走的人。

assets/voice-lines/b6176090659e834ee2da..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b6176090659e834ee2da..text: 好。但这一遍看完，把摄影机放下。我们也用自己的眼睛看一次。

assets/voice-lines/ab92a416dcd409c153f5..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ab92a416dcd409c153f5..text: 这张名单，明天给我一份吧。新的施工说明也该写得更清楚。

assets/voice-lines/c7ff8494c8672366d5ed..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/c7ff8494c8672366d5ed..text: 我今天没有补那条线。只是给它换了个不会折到的袋子。

assets/voice-lines/d33feee2b728ee0f76f4..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d33feee2b728ee0f76f4..text: 想给它留着。以后再看，就知道我不是从一开始就会画。

assets/voice-lines/02424298e9a77e51024b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/02424298e9a77e51024b..text: 给我们自己。公开的片子里，还是用我确认过的那一段采访。

assets/voice-lines/8a120a02e2b1be58f317..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8a120a02e2b1be58f317..text: 窗边吧。不是最亮的地方，但不会把那些很浅的铅笔线吃掉。

assets/voice-lines/8d6d69115ed82bde72d2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8d6d69115ed82bde72d2..text: 我给她发过试听邀请，她说下午在天台排练。你记得先问时间。

assets/voice-lines/a5e446f96fa1a6d8ff01..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/a5e446f96fa1a6d8ff01..text: 钟楼要等正式验收。我们可以先在茶摊见，不带图纸也可以。

assets/voice-lines/90d0e8202ffefd4a6366..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/90d0e8202ffefd4a6366..text: 嗯。图纸上的线修过很多遍，站在这里的人倒是第一次这样齐。

assets/voice-lines/7af07bcc2e5b9281e918..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/7af07bcc2e5b9281e918..text: 那我们不用再等它。紧张也可以一起往前走，不会把今晚变坏。

assets/voice-lines/22f533285e41888e11ab..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/22f533285e41888e11ab..text: 好。看完这一眼，我们就转回来。窗已经开好了，其他的交给银幕。

assets/voice-lines/14db2b2bffec12f53a5e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/14db2b2bffec12f53a5e..text: 我们也很高兴。现在你不用站在旁边证明自己有多忙，靠近一点就好。

assets/voice-lines/d044d0335ec168c36465..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d044d0335ec168c36465..text: 那就别再往后退。这里本来就有你的地方，我一直给你留着。

assets/voice-lines/0e41a427648bc314e405..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0e41a427648bc314e405..text: 拍完来吃蛋糕。我留了那块边缘有一点歪的，你说喜欢的味道也没改。

assets/voice-lines/78e82024b789648523d0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/78e82024b789648523d0..text: 我带了东西。先空出一点桌面，别让蛋糕坐在硬盘上。

assets/voice-lines/0810776b2e7fd9d0c3f8..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0810776b2e7fd9d0c3f8..text: 试做的。脱模时裂了一点，没拿去卖。我自己尝过了，味道很好。

assets/voice-lines/343b7553b3297344c29b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/343b7553b3297344c29b..text: 因为已经尝过了呀。要是只看着裂口，我今晚就吃不到喜欢的东西了。

assets/voice-lines/1dddf0dff3c0e8f530fa..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1dddf0dff3c0e8f530fa..text: 那就慢慢说。叉子也拿着，我可以听你说，蛋糕不用陪着一起干等。

assets/voice-lines/7ff5cbe9c809b2937700..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/7ff5cbe9c809b2937700..text: 那我也会坐在第一排，把“还不错”的地方认真看完。

assets/voice-lines/bf68ca04810f632e9b16..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/bf68ca04810f632e9b16..text: 可以拍真的要做的事。不过现在真的要做的，是给自己倒杯水。

assets/voice-lines/301f6de5f6876fd127bc..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/301f6de5f6876fd127bc..text: 我以前也是。面团还没醒好，就急着整形，最后反而要重来。

assets/voice-lines/18027119a082ed06c000..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/18027119a082ed06c000..text: 那你坐这里。我也想试试，等面包的时候，只等面包会怎么样。

assets/voice-lines/3ad22cdca8634d74e023..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/3ad22cdca8634d74e023..text: 米饭。不要替我选最省时间的那一家，我想坐下来吃。

assets/voice-lines/4b9bfad108ac03ac6b1d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/4b9bfad108ac03ac6b1d..text: 好。喊的时候直接一点，别用“顺便给你带了”假装自己没有在等。

assets/voice-lines/1b4048e2a0b170f1456d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1b4048e2a0b170f1456d..text: 那我先挑店。下次轮到你，只要别把午饭安排进采访的空档就行。

assets/voice-lines/4279890c22de5cb92d1b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/4279890c22de5cb92d1b..text: 我想让人看见这个转弯。原来准备得不一样，也可以继续做下去。

assets/voice-lines/73b695826831bb8d7548..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/73b695826831bb8d7548..text: 那我也不找新的盘子了。今天这块，趁它刚好吃的时候一起吃。

assets/voice-lines/3fef9437135e2d786ad0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/3fef9437135e2d786ad0..text: 我临出门才发现装饰塌了，一路都在想，该怎么解释才不会让人失望。

assets/voice-lines/428272ec06e7be68e42f..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/428272ec06e7be68e42f..text: 坐了。很拘谨，后来吃到最后一口，才发现自己那天也一直没吃饭。

assets/voice-lines/b357fabf5812c23200f6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b357fabf5812c23200f6..text: 那我会准时。要是路上看见月亮，也会记得带一句回来。

assets/voice-lines/676e71fa438da1ad9add..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/676e71fa438da1ad9add..text: 有不好我会说。但我坐在这里，不是为了让你一直猜我的表情。

assets/voice-lines/574a00453946567f4622..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/574a00453946567f4622..text: 等面团那一段。不是因为有我，是因为我想再坐着听一会儿那个声音。

assets/voice-lines/3bc5394863bcb6cf3d8e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/3bc5394863bcb6cf3d8e..text: 来。不过下一次，也可以看一点和你工作无关的东西。

assets/voice-lines/191611c48df64e251825..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/191611c48df64e251825..text: 会有的。我明天看今天的配方，也总会想到另一种办法。

assets/voice-lines/e33a3623033eb2b0ed26..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/e33a3623033eb2b0ed26..text: 你不是已经决定给大家看了吗？先把答应给他们的这一版，认真送到。

assets/voice-lines/bb3be23a1962418f85c4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/bb3be23a1962418f85c4..text: 好。我陪你看最后一遍，但不把“最后”变成每十分钟再说一次的话。

assets/voice-lines/5ed148def343269f54e4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/5ed148def343269f54e4..text: 想。小院里今天开了一朵很小的花，我还没来得及看。

assets/voice-lines/a4096d8a8506a78e685b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a4096d8a8506a78e685b..text: 那别只说给银幕听。站到他们面前的时候，我也会在。

assets/voice-lines/17fc0d26b56ef1047b2a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/17fc0d26b56ef1047b2a..text: 你想谢谢谁，就写谁。不必替观众先决定他们愿不愿意。

assets/voice-lines/295eae46ee7f5fa729a6..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/295eae46ee7f5fa729a6..text: 可以听她讲。不是所有东西，都要被你亲眼看过才算数。

assets/voice-lines/11380b0d2c826e3964ac..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/11380b0d2c826e3964ac..text: 陈姨问，明天温室还开不开门。她说有两个人想去看那株树。

assets/voice-lines/1b97bd8bb2ae23f91633..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/1b97bd8bb2ae23f91633..text: 我给你搬椅子。这次别站着点头，坐到他们真的能看见你的地方。

assets/voice-lines/9fc5ea55c859fadde619..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/9fc5ea55c859fadde619..text: 那记得把门口那颗螺丝也拧好。你第一次来的时候，就说要修。

assets/voice-lines/c6d2ec30e71b2669841b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c6d2ec30e71b2669841b..text: 好。新标签给你留着，今天的日期也还空着，正好一起写。

assets/voice-lines/76d64a2821a3bcd632ca..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/76d64a2821a3bcd632ca..text: 我带了饭。先别暂停，你刚才不是说想听我看完的感受？

assets/voice-lines/36cc133568fedb73ef85..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/36cc133568fedb73ef85..text: 你想讲他们过得多好，还是想知道他们的一天是什么样？

assets/voice-lines/f242c4fdad32de45c01a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f242c4fdad32de45c01a..text: 我陪你看。她想起那个人的时候，眼神已经在说话了。

assets/voice-lines/b1744673d1b034a96765..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b1744673d1b034a96765..text: 顾清禾明天会去钟楼。你去之前，先给她打个电话，别突然闯进工地。

assets/voice-lines/1b82646bac3fe7f43ee0..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/1b82646bac3fe7f43ee0..text: 去年冬天冻伤了根。现在能长出两片新叶，已经很努力了。

assets/voice-lines/19bc1f168cf727bac82a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/19bc1f168cf727bac82a..text: 可以。但别只写“长得慢”，也写上它今天做到了什么。

assets/voice-lines/525d21bd79e8aed9a382..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/525d21bd79e8aed9a382..text: 可以。以后看到这一页，就不会只记得它受伤的样子。

assets/voice-lines/a0260a31aba324cc183f..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a0260a31aba324cc183f..text: 先别急着开机。你答应送回去的空箱子，还在脚边呢。

assets/voice-lines/0a91627d27cb3097fd94..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0a91627d27cb3097fd94..text: 像旧钟楼的西窗。不过我不敢确定，顾清禾可能认得。

assets/voice-lines/ba6f2ffa1560b93fc1e7..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ba6f2ffa1560b93fc1e7..text: 因为东边没有高楼挡着。你可以站这边，但别踩那条软管。

assets/voice-lines/ea4f98d41c92f743fc1b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ea4f98d41c92f743fc1b..text: 那现在开机吧。等一下，托盘还没放稳，这也是真的。

assets/voice-lines/736829a7ea75ba1ed4b6..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/736829a7ea75ba1ed4b6..text: 那就明天再早一点。门轴有点响，我一直想给它上油。

assets/voice-lines/03561d5b2a135a79e657..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/03561d5b2a135a79e657..text: 它今天不适合留在门口吹风。我保证，它不会在观影时提问。

assets/voice-lines/8282903409cf3ffabe0e..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8282903409cf3ffabe0e..text: 开门吧。每天都做的事，原来被认真拍下来，是这样的。

assets/voice-lines/a81f90cfe3a64460bef2..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a81f90cfe3a64460bef2..text: 那我们一起看第二遍。你不需要一个人把所有问题都想完。

assets/voice-lines/784b5b6bf9857354d6ed..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/784b5b6bf9857354d6ed..text: 你关掉录制灯，先走过去介绍自己。陈姨看着摄像机，有一点不自在。

assets/voice-lines/7f91db55debd6b7f75ea..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7f91db55debd6b7f75ea..text: 你点头，把标签和那封旧信放在一起。一个属于过去，一个等着明天。

assets/voice-lines/b267d85efb53cc7af186..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b267d85efb53cc7af186..text: 你在拍摄计划上划掉了“上午登楼”。她看见了，轻轻点头。

assets/voice-lines/53faca9619b4f202dd90..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/53faca9619b4f202dd90..text: 她说得平静，你却把这句话认真记在了拍摄本的另一面。

assets/voice-lines/af1d98e6676d302ebae9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/af1d98e6676d302ebae9..text: 你把录音机放到许可的位置，没有为了声音更明显再去摇那段扶手。

assets/voice-lines/cd1c296480e57066b59a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cd1c296480e57066b59a..text: 你们在窗前的休息平台坐下，她终于把图纸放到膝上。

assets/voice-lines/a756e6e267555c49302f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a756e6e267555c49302f..text: 你画了几条并不整齐的线。她把尺子放在旁边，却没有急着纠正。

assets/voice-lines/8785cb70368c6c9567f4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8785cb70368c6c9567f4..text: 散会后，她收起两张图，把你画的那页歪线放到最上面。

assets/voice-lines/f6a516d490d2289329e5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f6a516d490d2289329e5..text: 你低头确认录音灯，晚了一拍才意识到，她没有在说一个泛泛的位置。

assets/voice-lines/371fddc559684e080e09..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/371fddc559684e080e09..text: 她把画袋递到你面前，问愿不愿意替它拍一张留档照。

assets/voice-lines/d1b7f7f0f1c6e1399501..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d1b7f7f0f1c6e1399501..text: 她笑着把一张干净的谱纸推给你，又从琴盒里翻出一支笔。

assets/voice-lines/0570ade3a8c2fca95707..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0570ade3a8c2fca95707..text: 她的肩膀松下来，拨了一下空弦。这一次没有急着从头证明自己。

assets/voice-lines/92c894dbe44708d02832..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/92c894dbe44708d02832..text: 标签背面露出一截淡蓝色铅笔线，像一扇只画到一半的窗。

assets/voice-lines/55e6250ff0bf8ef8bba3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/55e6250ff0bf8ef8bba3..text: 你在本子上写下第一个名字，又在后面留了一整页空白。

assets/voice-lines/cb445768224db4936bd0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cb445768224db4936bd0..text: 离开前，她给那条小尾巴拍了一张照片，单独存进自己的相册。

assets/voice-lines/f3df213dbf9fb39f06d3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f3df213dbf9fb39f06d3..text: 回程路上，她问你，当年的约定会不会已经来不及完成了。

assets/voice-lines/c568c2b7418db81010ab..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c568c2b7418db81010ab..text: 她把笔递给你。你接过来时，她没有松得太快，先确认你真的拿稳了。

assets/voice-lines/91584738179a73decd36..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/91584738179a73decd36..text: 你站到镜头边缘，她从琴颈后看你一眼，等你抬手才开始。

assets/voice-lines/c7fe724184def1a45762..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c7fe724184def1a45762..text: 她问你，暂时忘掉“写成歌词”，最想对片子里的人说什么。

assets/voice-lines/48f3b8cf43ead35d79e3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/48f3b8cf43ead35d79e3..text: 她哼到第二遍时，稍稍侧过身，等你把最后五个字念完。

assets/voice-lines/9875f464d68182165768..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9875f464d68182165768..text: 她在第六稿右上角写了日期，又把你的名字排在自己的名字前面。

assets/voice-lines/1591591dbe2e97f7047e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1591591dbe2e97f7047e..text: 你很小声地念了一遍。她没有打拍子，只在最后五个字和你一起开口。

assets/voice-lines/f1cb153bf1600c0f0c5a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f1cb153bf1600c0f0c5a..text: 你没有打开录音。她弹错一个音，自己笑了笑，很自然地接了下去。

assets/voice-lines/3afc75ceb3894635d24c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3afc75ceb3894635d24c..text: 你低头看了一眼杯沿。她记住的第一件事，竟然不是母带缺了哪一段。

assets/voice-lines/5bd4fdb81d8c952195a7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5bd4fdb81d8c952195a7..text: 她用一张透明纸描出还能辨认的部分，没有直接在原照片上添字。

assets/voice-lines/9186239684f3b54e28b1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9186239684f3b54e28b1..text: 你把这句话记下来，她却用笔帽轻轻碰了碰你的本子。

assets/voice-lines/8176d4a61968086b3d6e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8176d4a61968086b3d6e..text: 她拾起托盘，没有立即站回起点。晨光落在她带着土痕的指尖上。

assets/voice-lines/c90d3b06367f4b90f6cf..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c90d3b06367f4b90f6cf..text: 你记下这个约定。它比任何拍摄通告都短，却让明天有了确切的形状。

assets/voice-lines/d5882ae8fec7c900ad71..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d5882ae8fec7c900ad71..text: 你写完，才看见她的手机亮了几次。她都没有立刻拿起来。

assets/voice-lines/a423ae45593f38f48b05..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a423ae45593f38f48b05..text: 你们在安静里坐了一会儿。这次没有时间线替它计算值不值得。

assets/voice-lines/0b309781d1540d97e4f9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0b309781d1540d97e4f9..text: 你在名单末尾写下自己的名字。她看了一眼，拿笔在旁边补上苏晚。

assets/voice-lines/04dd9504cf19fc787f9c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/04dd9504cf19fc787f9c..text: 你把文件存好，正准备问下一个时间，苏晚却把笔记本推到一边。

assets/voice-lines/ae4f76e3e70d9e6c727d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ae4f76e3e70d9e6c727d..text: 门被轻轻敲了两下。你以为是楼下提醒关灯，伸手先调低了音量。

assets/voice-lines/c57e2f03aaa39b1681e4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c57e2f03aaa39b1681e4..text: 她低头看了一眼自己的手。过了好一会儿，才重新望向银幕。

assets/voice-lines/f9ab51fb9ea6055c0bda..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f9ab51fb9ea6055c0bda..text: 她替你整理了一下被相机带压住的衣领，没有把这一下也对准镜头。

assets/voice-lines/88bcc28531052986bb02..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/88bcc28531052986bb02..text: 你点点头。她重新看了一眼画面，确认备用机位后，把屏幕按暗。

assets/voice-lines/2a3477658ccb60fa1ffb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2a3477658ccb60fa1ffb..text: 她看了看你握着的播放遥控器。你的拇指停在按钮边，半天没有挪开。

assets/voice-lines/96a0a7a7bd266e3f745c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/96a0a7a7bd266e3f745c..text: 那今天先不拍。您愿意教我，怎样把窗开到合适的位置吗？

assets/voice-lines/62761e4ac650beaf9d7c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/62761e4ac650beaf9d7c..text: 可以。收件方式我们慢慢确认，没来的人也不急着替他们决定。

assets/voice-lines/050aef20ebe9bb6343c8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/050aef20ebe9bb6343c8..text: 平时都是我叫别人自然一点。轮到自己，反而不会了。

assets/voice-lines/fe3a61a8e078632b061c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/fe3a61a8e078632b061c..text: 在看照片。想把它放到工作室门口，和新的协力名单放在一起。

assets/voice-lines/a991dc991fcb237036be..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a991dc991fcb237036be..text: 想让大家听见各自原本的声音。面包店开门，也有很好听的一下。

assets/voice-lines/6d9da6aec89589f800ea..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6d9da6aec89589f800ea..text: 这部片子只是开始。我还想沿着那扇旧窗，去找母带后面的故事。

assets/voice-lines/bdd9deb9918d404c3fb1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/bdd9deb9918d404c3fb1..text: 先打电话。林栀提醒过，不能把施工现场当成可以随时进入的布景。

assets/voice-lines/ba4db59ffc862fe6ef64..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ba4db59ffc862fe6ef64..text: 我想补拍现在的样子，再和旧画面比较。需要提前做哪些准备？

assets/voice-lines/2aae7f9ff3124d4f39bd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2aae7f9ff3124d4f39bd..text: 父亲留下的母带没有拍完。我怕自己只是在追一张好看的旧照片。

assets/voice-lines/41e57ab21c2de15819ca..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/41e57ab21c2de15819ca..text: 两片新叶，颜色很浅。搬到街角的第一天。这样可以吗？

assets/voice-lines/1897843ece4ef402a6ca..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/1897843ece4ef402a6ca..text: 那我今天就开始拍。不是为了证明什么，先把今天留下来。

assets/voice-lines/706ccd550c5aaf82b8cd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/706ccd550c5aaf82b8cd..text: 母带里好像也有。我原来以为，是磁带损坏留下的杂音。

assets/voice-lines/14ad6592fc81837451d4..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/14ad6592fc81837451d4..text: 今天没有交稿倒计时。我们按约好的开放时间下去就行。

assets/voice-lines/830ed3bbcf954233f14c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/830ed3bbcf954233f14c..text: 我可以把每个人坐下和站起的视线记下来。只拍窗外，不拍人。

assets/voice-lines/c3b5a2d081b0a1514e42..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c3b5a2d081b0a1514e42..text: 那片子也拍修改的过程。不能只拍最后大家都点头的样子。

assets/voice-lines/6ab19baae11ddab61e0d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6ab19baae11ddab61e0d..text: 今天得到的都是“还不知道”。以前我会觉得项目没有进展。

assets/voice-lines/ed5d4bbe03e9e843b8b4..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ed5d4bbe03e9e843b8b4..text: 有些意见还没有完全一致，所以这一段的标题是“共同修订中”。

assets/voice-lines/c5c3744b259695f9ca99..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c5c3744b259695f9ca99..text: 还有施工和检查的人。只拍一束漂亮的光，解释不了它怎么来到这里。

assets/voice-lines/2b981808c57c325dc402..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2b981808c57c325dc402..text: 明天去找许知夏，问问母带里的旋律。今晚先把这一段好好收起来。

assets/voice-lines/d21cb266f1f7bab0960b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d21cb266f1f7bab0960b..text: 旧片子里只有这么一小段。你弹的后半句，是从哪里来的？

assets/voice-lines/47ac9041c96b42492ddf..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/47ac9041c96b42492ddf..text: 我上次接错了摄影机电源。林栀只问，要不要先看一下插口。

assets/voice-lines/7880dce7bbf3dcc5f939..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7880dce7bbf3dcc5f939..text: 先做备份。今天就算一帧也读不出来，至少别把它弄得更糟。

assets/voice-lines/483aff0a34f7f0fd2c60..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/483aff0a34f7f0fd2c60..text: 不能只拿着一张图，去问别人是不是记错了。先让他们讲。

assets/voice-lines/f1891a653f18f7fc19b1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f1891a653f18f7fc19b1..text: 这部片子叫《明天也在这里》。主题曲现在还没有名字。

assets/voice-lines/55a25f771d2543e055d6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/55a25f771d2543e055d6..text: 如果您愿意留，它刚刚好。也可以不公开，只给您带回去。

assets/voice-lines/6b1a3eec59337a42729d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6b1a3eec59337a42729d..text: 门开着，灯亮着。明天也在这里。这样会不会太普通？

assets/voice-lines/4b8fe6f2dedb772b1b36..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4b8fe6f2dedb772b1b36..text: 这句“明天”后面，留一点空白吧。像有人吸一口气，准备继续说。

assets/voice-lines/dc11906145e7ea4395c1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/dc11906145e7ea4395c1..text: 我们不必因为叫“正式”，就假装今天没有楼下。先听第一遍吧。

assets/voice-lines/01991359033e7bce43dd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/01991359033e7bce43dd..text: 这里音乐可以再轻一点。陈姨回头说话，我不想让她费力。

assets/voice-lines/f0b879ec2b198df011fc..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f0b879ec2b198df011fc..text: 最开心的，是副歌写完以后，你还想听我那句不太像唱歌的声音。

assets/voice-lines/a9debd7597fb4814a76c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a9debd7597fb4814a76c..text: 没关系，我还没按录制。我们重新来一次，你从那边走过来。

assets/voice-lines/102d7eb6f8a5b572faa4..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/102d7eb6f8a5b572faa4..text: 好。拍摄方案改一下：不要求你配合镜头，镜头跟着你。

assets/voice-lines/882ca88834438d41936e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/882ca88834438d41936e..text: 这句“所有人都在等”，还是写大了。我们还没联系到所有人。

assets/voice-lines/34f4fecf32ae2a21255b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/34f4fecf32ae2a21255b..text: 他说“我们都在等自己的名字”之前，其实想了很久。

assets/voice-lines/2336f2aacc500fd7754c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2336f2aacc500fd7754c..text: 留下原来的停顿。不是让大家替他难过，是不替他装作说得很轻松。

assets/voice-lines/cd7690fbf69a8960a8b6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/cd7690fbf69a8960a8b6..text: 怕只是事情太多、错过了时间，后来就一直没有重新开始。

assets/voice-lines/79623bda17820068d774..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/79623bda17820068d774..text: 今晚先去吃饭。后面还有很多工作，也不用在这一分钟全做完。

assets/voice-lines/bd737aa8c1e8fbf67eb5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/bd737aa8c1e8fbf67eb5..text: 调色还没完成，声音也有两处杂音。你可以直接说哪里不好。

assets/voice-lines/79bef83e9322cb4dafc2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/79bef83e9322cb4dafc2..text: 下一版不必等到完美。等我整理好今天的意见，就发给你。

assets/voice-lines/5d92741a5300240c2ff5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5d92741a5300240c2ff5..text: 这段可以接开门声。镜头不必把每个人都安排在正中央。

assets/voice-lines/1e80259d7550dc7ed5dc..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/1e80259d7550dc7ed5dc..text: 我希望他们先认得片子里的人，最后再看见我的名字。

assets/voice-lines/5e0d951a0ba2cb44ba61..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5e0d951a0ba2cb44ba61..text: 我想在放映前，说清楚旧片还没找全，也没有确认所有日期。

assets/voice-lines/f6c13dfe938cee78c9cc..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f6c13dfe938cee78c9cc..text: 可以。起点不用装作完整，但至少要知道，哪一块仍然是空白。

assets/voice-lines/17a70cd96bee6866310e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/17a70cd96bee6866310e..text: 档案室十点开门。还有二十分钟，可以先挑本你真正想看的书。

assets/voice-lines/6335677f6d2b42be4c5a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/6335677f6d2b42be4c5a..text: 茶在外面喝完了。我们从这一卷开始，你看版号，我看活动预告。

assets/voice-lines/9066a8f3d5eb777684a7..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/9066a8f3d5eb777684a7..text: 简单的事也可能花很久。找到以前，先别替它安排一个漂亮的结尾。

assets/voice-lines/d0b0a4bb0f8266010f3f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d0b0a4bb0f8266010f3f..text: 先核对日期和版号。下一页也要看，别让装订时串页把我们带错。

assets/voice-lines/49690af4af8df100362b..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/49690af4af8df100362b..text: 我陪你读。别让我们找了这么久的一页，只剩你最急着看见的那一句。

assets/voice-lines/af98b55e859d1096fd54..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/af98b55e859d1096fd54..text: 这里提到守钟人陆伯，活动名单里也有他。我们先问他愿不愿意聊。

assets/voice-lines/1d9fca575068e5da760d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1d9fca575068e5da760d..text: 记。它可能只说明桌椅借过一天，也可能帮我们把两次活动分开。

assets/voice-lines/6bad9528e0b8a0b3567c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/6bad9528e0b8a0b3567c..text: 我来说明拍摄范围。愿意说的再录，不愿意公开的，我们单独标出来。

assets/voice-lines/35d1d4a732352422c6de..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/35d1d4a732352422c6de..text: 正好让这壶茶放到第二泡。您刚才说，排练结束会有人搬椅子？

assets/voice-lines/d0e413a2213b0482a487..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d0e413a2213b0482a487..text: 我陪你一位位联系。有的人不方便来，也可以留一封回信。

assets/voice-lines/9491c26c7c6ee63a8f9a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/9491c26c7c6ee63a8f9a..text: 重新采访，重写。那篇没赶上原来的版面，但人还愿意接我的电话。

assets/voice-lines/2e8c7f05a235cf9f5ef7..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/2e8c7f05a235cf9f5ef7..text: 可以。不过先把电脑合上。我不想把它讲成一次值得宣传的成长。

assets/voice-lines/63b333e1b7f6ccfc442a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/63b333e1b7f6ccfc442a..text: 改成“有人还留着当年的邀请”。这样读，也一样能听见他们。

assets/voice-lines/e9c53042d09850a091ff..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/e9c53042d09850a091ff..text: 那就一起试着等两秒。你已经给他们看见了，为什么有人会停在这里。

assets/voice-lines/161b8fc30ddb4c3158f9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/161b8fc30ddb4c3158f9..text: 可以。不要因为我们喜欢这一版，就把另一个判断藏起来。听完再选。

assets/voice-lines/d0ff41064f184a2bd616..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d0ff41064f184a2bd616..text: 那就把这一条写进剪辑备注。以后改到这里，还能记得为什么。

assets/voice-lines/4306c84c3d9a00e9368a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4306c84c3d9a00e9368a..text: 是采访对象的补充消息。我等这段听完，再认真回复。

assets/voice-lines/99f9a213147f476bbec6..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/99f9a213147f476bbec6..text: 会被追。但也想学会，坐在一个人旁边的时候，就真的先在这里。

assets/voice-lines/4674f797b03cddb7680e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4674f797b03cddb7680e..text: 放映机可以设好。你不能每次都只负责别人坐在哪里。

assets/voice-lines/8526921c3c4effa6fcfd..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/8526921c3c4effa6fcfd..text: 那一场先当观众。看完以后，我也有自己的感受要告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/da2a8ac2a853555a40e0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/da2a8ac2a853555a40e0..text: 这个字不能按常见读音念。陆伯下午专门发语音提醒过。

assets/voice-lines/0d00806f1a02e78059fe..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/0d00806f1a02e78059fe..text: 还有是谁说过这句话。署名写错，比少一个漂亮的句子更要紧。

assets/voice-lines/737bddd31d5c87aff08b..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/737bddd31d5c87aff08b..text: 好。空白可以带到明天，猜出来的名字不该带进版面。

assets/voice-lines/63fc192a2196a829f7e1..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/63fc192a2196a829f7e1..text: 我把待核标记存好。剩下的明天继续，不用让电脑替我们熬这一夜。

assets/voice-lines/b2456f508a1f6d1394e3..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/b2456f508a1f6d1394e3..text: 因为这次我真的饿了。工作之外，答案有时候很简单。

assets/voice-lines/ec823c042bf22f5cd8d4..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ec823c042bf22f5cd8d4..text: 工作上的先到这里。现在，我想听你今天过得怎么样。

assets/voice-lines/3a54b6d514e829581258..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/3a54b6d514e829581258..text: 不用整理好才来。你可以像现在这样，说到哪里，我就听到哪里。

assets/voice-lines/1b8dd854603825976b4e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1b8dd854603825976b4e..text: 好。陪我逛一圈书店？上次你挑的书，还没来得及看完。

assets/voice-lines/89f3b1904f326c6c159f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/89f3b1904f326c6c159f..text: 你去还档案室索引的时候。现在这句话，算还到了吧。

assets/voice-lines/5252d889e722858663b4..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/5252d889e722858663b4..text: 记住这句。要是又忘了，江月会比我更早看见你的工作室灯。

assets/voice-lines/5c86dc999b16241de0c6..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/5c86dc999b16241de0c6..text: 留了。他回信说会带家里人一起来，所以这里空出两把。

assets/voice-lines/15e873d7b0818f5770bb..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/15e873d7b0818f5770bb..text: 嗯。先把今天能送到的，认真送到。剩下的记得，不用藏起来。

assets/voice-lines/c5cf28ef240858d83da2..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c5cf28ef240858d83da2..text: 我帮你核最后一遍。说确定的事，也把仍在找的部分留在原来的位置。

assets/voice-lines/3e0a60cea028b388b919..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/3e0a60cea028b388b919..text: 不是。下次陪你来看电影，可以不用再重新问坐哪一边。

assets/voice-lines/6f8a52a89c1513291602..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6f8a52a89c1513291602..text: 拿着它，也可以站进画面。你今天已经检查过很多次，不差这一遍。

assets/voice-lines/df088f6f4fbefb5d669b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/df088f6f4fbefb5d669b..text: 制作人要记得坐下。我昨天特意找了一把不晃的椅子。

assets/voice-lines/9124f3a0e9c055d8dab5..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9124f3a0e9c055d8dab5..text: 就是给大家都到了以后留的。别等最后只剩摄影机后面那一块地。

assets/voice-lines/8fa0cae08ad8aa9b1086..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/8fa0cae08ad8aa9b1086..text: 因为我也想看你看电影的样子。这一项，算我的私心。

assets/voice-lines/2829748a0effd170c642..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/2829748a0effd170c642..text: 好。我会记得，今天的镜头后面，也有一个人值得出现在观众席里。

assets/voice-lines/a20b399c9c509f880450..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/a20b399c9c509f880450..text: 那我去把手机架好。你帮我看一下角度，别拍到只想来看电影的人。

assets/voice-lines/041e218dd09037e407cb..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/041e218dd09037e407cb..text: 比如，今天有个制作人，已经第三次确认同一个插头了。

assets/voice-lines/6e25ad094b3e8e02fe85..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6e25ad094b3e8e02fe85..text: 那你站我旁边。忘词了也没关系，我们又不是第一次一起把话接下去。

assets/voice-lines/1f9df6c98163b7f77f98..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1f9df6c98163b7f77f98..text: 可以。可最后要真的让人看见，别又把自己缩成一行看不清的小字。

assets/voice-lines/259e2444d328cacf8c8c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/259e2444d328cacf8c8c..text: 我们暖场到这里。正式放映的时候，我也要去做观众。

assets/voice-lines/a5e1914415884869fa0b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/a5e1914415884869fa0b..text: 那我也留一个。今天有个人主动走到了镜头前，我会记得很久。

assets/voice-lines/be66f1affcc195b303c7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/be66f1affcc195b303c7..text: 以前先看哪里说得不好。今天想先喝水，然后听你叫我去坐下。

assets/voice-lines/5bab4f3d84a244be7753..speaker: uncle-lu
assets/voice-lines/5bab4f3d84a244be7753..text: 是。你父亲还说，拍一部小片子，给大家看看平时没留意的一天。

assets/voice-lines/b841f41bc5ec6aa68581..speaker: uncle-lu
assets/voice-lines/b841f41bc5ec6aa68581..text: 钟楼旁边的空地。椅子都借好了，后来下雨，只好先收起来。

assets/voice-lines/36c82edaf75bc7d70666..speaker: uncle-lu
assets/voice-lines/36c82edaf75bc7d70666..text: 我不知道他还想做什么。至少那一天，我们都在等自己的名字。

assets/voice-lines/b69314622c4596542c24..speaker: uncle-lu
assets/voice-lines/b69314622c4596542c24..text: 拿去拍吧。别替我把字补得太齐，有些人我还得慢慢想。

assets/voice-lines/624cc572721ea3d69c40..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/624cc572721ea3d69c40..text: 嗯。不过它现在前后有人接着讲，不再只有盒子上的三个字。

assets/voice-lines/4abfee1553531a5faa6c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4abfee1553531a5faa6c..text: 好。唱错的地方也先别纠正，让我看看自己到底记住了什么。

assets/voice-lines/2dda63214ab5761d23f3..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2dda63214ab5761d23f3..text: 那我们去问记得的人。找歌这件事，比替一首歌编身世有意思多了。

assets/voice-lines/2d7212fe2ded7229c150..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2d7212fe2ded7229c150..text: 许知夏。今天的工作是写歌，明天的工作可能是把今天写的划掉。

assets/voice-lines/e40339d155c625139a1c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e40339d155c625139a1c..text: 来都来了，先帮我看住纸。这里的风，比我还想当主唱。

assets/voice-lines/c1101298524b641c9a63..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c1101298524b641c9a63..text: 先留十秒空白吧。让我知道，开始的时候也可以没有声音。

assets/voice-lines/e418621bc60038c40de7..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e418621bc60038c40de7..text: 那下一遍，可以了。不过你也别坐得像监考老师，喝口茶。

assets/voice-lines/cc2c97d0601ccbbf4a71..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/cc2c97d0601ccbbf4a71..text: 等一下，杯子又离电线太近了。制作人，这条得扣分。

assets/voice-lines/7ff1d3d0fce2e07d6e03..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7ff1d3d0fce2e07d6e03..text: 好多年没认真问过她，这首歌到底叫什么。我总觉得，下次还有机会。

assets/voice-lines/83d860ce293313079d6c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/83d860ce293313079d6c..text: 好，模糊的地方留空。字不认识，就不替它猜一个看起来顺口的。

assets/voice-lines/ab310210a3abe4b8b64d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ab310210a3abe4b8b64d..text: 那我们下次帮你一起找。今天不把你整本回忆都借走。

assets/voice-lines/7cecefdd648c635b8b2c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7cecefdd648c635b8b2c..text: 我会把旧旋律和新写的部分分开记。也把帮忙找回来的人写上。

assets/voice-lines/4421b0aefc7691f525bf..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4421b0aefc7691f525bf..text: 那就别把歌唱得像在替谁告别。我想让它还有下一句。

assets/voice-lines/134210f67f2da27f2730..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/134210f67f2da27f2730..text: 嗯。不替他们宣布遗憾，也不替他们宣布圆满。先把椅子留着。

assets/voice-lines/bf6e30c15cac5afa3847..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/bf6e30c15cac5afa3847..text: 可以先借你的名字用用。不是定稿，是让我知道这一页往哪里写。

assets/voice-lines/565c3e5e0f74baa9fce8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/565c3e5e0f74baa9fce8..text: 我正想说这句。不能让我一个人负责所有心跳和跑调。
