assets/voice-lines/c8dd1b4839865135585d..text: 那我也不急着找到结论。

assets/voice-lines/c664c6b7e6fef6b3e452..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c664c6b7e6fef6b3e452..text: 不用笑，私人关心也是认真提问。

assets/voice-lines/26c73db20a6a66004f67..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/26c73db20a6a66004f67..text: 那本一起读的书，还剩很多页。

assets/voice-lines/400c4f1e0397bf5e5ea0..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/400c4f1e0397bf5e5ea0..text: 是。而且现在不用对镜头笑了。

assets/voice-lines/53c9328bd494ab5aab91..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/53c9328bd494ab5aab91..text: 那今天就不剪掉这些空白了。

assets/voice-lines/4cf1c59e1901bba3823b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/4cf1c59e1901bba3823b..text: 下次你来，直接坐这里就好。

assets/voice-lines/6c6c3a88ac79a44ff9a9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6c6c3a88ac79a44ff9a9..text: 我应该再试一次。大家还在等。

assets/voice-lines/0f8ce1ac2f926f284952..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0f8ce1ac2f926f284952..text: 好。先把安全的消息发出去。

assets/voice-lines/511391d71d2429e31dc1..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/511391d71d2429e31dc1..text: 不是有多少人看见的那个我吗？

assets/voice-lines/c0dc3d51c5726dba9361..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c0dc3d51c5726dba9361..text: 今天还有很长一段没被记录。

assets/voice-lines/ad661cf5ffdeddafb170..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/ad661cf5ffdeddafb170..text: 原本的构图看不见制作人的工作。

assets/voice-lines/a957e2ee4fc76e2375f5..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/a957e2ee4fc76e2375f5..text: 原来不抢着说话，也能收到回答。

assets/voice-lines/e5e427f4601cae2a646c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e5e427f4601cae2a646c..text: 她担心关掉滤镜后观众会失望。

assets/voice-lines/5051a3533008b1a148e1..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/5051a3533008b1a148e1..text: 明天的开播提醒已经排好了。

assets/voice-lines/ed68dcf5f014d8216ad7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/ed68dcf5f014d8216ad7..text: 今天的光只在窗边停了七分钟。

assets/voice-lines/f032b0d9660f3156a396..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f032b0d9660f3156a396..text: 有些画面，想留给我们自己。

assets/voice-lines/c1c7f1225f185a0ea67c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c1c7f1225f185a0ea67c..text: 下播之后，耳机里突然安静了。

assets/voice-lines/791d00199bd21afec3b9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/791d00199bd21afec3b9..text: 它不发到频道，只想发给你。

assets/voice-lines/c58d817c125461e1407a..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c58d817c125461e1407a..text: 新耳机的线比旧的长一点。

assets/voice-lines/18fc7abfeb080ec4f41d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/18fc7abfeb080ec4f41d..text: 以后也让我替你守一次镜头。

assets/voice-lines/c22dc03546f1a9390ce5..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c22dc03546f1a9390ce5..text: 结束后，先不要走，好不好？

assets/voice-lines/974738438733a6201f46..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/974738438733a6201f46..text: 测试连线时，对面只有你一个人。

assets/voice-lines/1956fcb7f6e9ffa1959b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1956fcb7f6e9ffa1959b..text: 下次不测试设备，只聊聊我们吧。

assets/voice-lines/833e57b9acfa9dcb6a5c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/833e57b9acfa9dcb6a5c..text: 今天心跳监测的数值有点高。

assets/voice-lines/b22a2c31138e1e574b65..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/b22a2c31138e1e574b65..text: 下播以后，我们慢慢散步降降温？

assets/voice-lines/0fc235ed825f26d9e7d1..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0fc235ed825f26d9e7d1..text: 这才是我一天里最喜欢的亮度。

assets/voice-lines/d0205f1329c647f69c2d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d0205f1329c647f69c2d..text: 下一问，我想听听你自己的愿望。

assets/voice-lines/f933eb2a3da23ea6e609..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f933eb2a3da23ea6e609..text: 镜头外的空位现在也有名字了。

assets/voice-lines/dd01b42ab5a946ddd108..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/dd01b42ab5a946ddd108..text: 下次合照，你就站在我旁边好吗？

assets/voice-lines/af82e81b8953b6fc327c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/af82e81b8953b6fc327c..text: 今天开拍前，我认真吃完了早餐。

assets/voice-lines/82d7bdebb6d4cf597d74..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/82d7bdebb6d4cf597d74..text: 说好了，你也要出现在照片里。

assets/voice-lines/ae7ac126af56f5481606..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/ae7ac126af56f5481606..text: 那就从不看镜头的一张开始。

assets/voice-lines/5389a38d26eb269fda40..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/5389a38d26eb269fda40..text: 好，今天没有观众等着更新。

assets/voice-lines/cdb04f58e542604b54e3..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/cdb04f58e542604b54e3..text: 那你要记得，我今天很开心。

assets/voice-lines/f8a1137bcc0d0fba1540..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f8a1137bcc0d0fba1540..text: 这次不用挑最好看的那张。

assets/voice-lines/9e9c69f2c955ea2ce562..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9e9c69f2c955ea2ce562..text: 就录一小段，录完我一定收起来。

assets/voice-lines/e942074cdd3535c42ad1..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e942074cdd3535c42ad1..text: 今天没有看到约好的那片晚霞。

assets/voice-lines/e1bd4154213c2c223191..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e1bd4154213c2c223191..text: 今天先不发，也没有人在催。

assets/voice-lines/c59d920315d65b49c294..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c59d920315d65b49c294..text: 那我终于可以把肩膀放松一点了。

assets/voice-lines/a126a459339179267ffe..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/a126a459339179267ffe..text: 你不用打字回复我，我听得见。

assets/voice-lines/d69df992c1e58937fb71..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d69df992c1e58937fb71..text: 这张照片我不会拿来做封面。

assets/voice-lines/f88b76487b7047b840dd..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f88b76487b7047b840dd..text: 那你不算别人了。你是第一个。

assets/voice-lines/49612038f98a3898c037..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/49612038f98a3898c037..text: 等发布的时候，很多人都能听见。

assets/voice-lines/2a03d025277f3bddd5b1..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2a03d025277f3bddd5b1..text: 今天这一版，先只属于你和我。

assets/voice-lines/cfe497b3f502ea46603d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/cfe497b3f502ea46603d..text: 那这位观众，可以坐近一点吗？

assets/voice-lines/bb9a1b96448b4d105cb7..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/bb9a1b96448b4d105cb7..text: 没有舞台的时候，也想叫你来。

assets/voice-lines/260ec943418d45b4d67d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/260ec943418d45b4d67d..text: 唱到我把最后一句说清楚。

assets/voice-lines/ccd1dc7e1ecadb541608..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ccd1dc7e1ecadb541608..text: 那我们以后，不只在旋律里见面。

assets/voice-lines/6dfc72f2848b449755bd..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6dfc72f2848b449755bd..text: 风声盖过了吉他的低音。

assets/voice-lines/29d915f51fba0383a249..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/29d915f51fba0383a249..text: 一个孩子总是比大家慢半拍。

assets/voice-lines/1892a759d58d95bf8cb8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/1892a759d58d95bf8cb8..text: 没有舞台灯，也看得见你在听。

assets/voice-lines/a1a88b61f6e7f47e1bff..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a1a88b61f6e7f47e1bff..text: 明天也来听吗？我会认出你。

assets/voice-lines/dc70c0d5c8072822e5e2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/dc70c0d5c8072822e5e2..text: 带你喜欢的那张来，我们慢慢听。

assets/voice-lines/8b20925a14b585c0d0f1..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/8b20925a14b585c0d0f1..text: 我录了一段只有八秒的旋律。

assets/voice-lines/08fdd8b65033f03f77de..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/08fdd8b65033f03f77de..text: 想先发给你听，连同那个笑场。

assets/voice-lines/99943338e206d766371d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/99943338e206d766371d..text: 左边耳机又接触不良了。

assets/voice-lines/bb635cd6e98e935e10c9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/bb635cd6e98e935e10c9..text: 下次见面，还是一人一边？

assets/voice-lines/5b99bc726854ff9154f8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/5b99bc726854ff9154f8..text: 剥橘子的声音被我录进了新歌。

assets/voice-lines/b07c6d46c6e40327723f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b07c6d46c6e40327723f..text: 你来当第一个知道答案的听众。

assets/voice-lines/f17f62ff067b1c6e96f0..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f17f62ff067b1c6e96f0..text: 要不要来帮我做一次公正的裁判？

assets/voice-lines/72fdef63e623fe4b7c4d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/72fdef63e623fe4b7c4d..text: 你听见时，也会认出我吗？

assets/voice-lines/b4bd52a9db32a1d5ac07..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b4bd52a9db32a1d5ac07..text: 最靠近我的那个位置，给你留着。

assets/voice-lines/7968c6ccf321abcb3452..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7968c6ccf321abcb3452..text: 今晚想在这样的声音里唱给你听。

assets/voice-lines/ccc981abdb8c13dc184b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ccc981abdb8c13dc184b..text: 演出单上没有最后一首歌。

assets/voice-lines/e305436ab8a4f263f0df..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e305436ab8a4f263f0df..text: 今晚不用录音，陪我坐着就好。

assets/voice-lines/ec59fdff6f991864f164..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ec59fdff6f991864f164..text: 混音里多了一点没计划的低频。

assets/voice-lines/d25435a18b70e3a9f48b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/d25435a18b70e3a9f48b..text: 我可以把这一小段留下来吗？

assets/voice-lines/6f2eeea53d5e6182adba..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6f2eeea53d5e6182adba..text: 那首长曲写到了第四段。

assets/voice-lines/1e14bd304734d79bb201..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/1e14bd304734d79bb201..text: 我试着接下去，居然有点好听。

assets/voice-lines/3e95540bf9b7c4ad05d2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/3e95540bf9b7c4ad05d2..text: 新作品要不要给它署一个名字？

assets/voice-lines/2b0212be1c52ca97fec8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2b0212be1c52ca97fec8..text: 露台的弦乐会借来了月亮作灯。

assets/voice-lines/049b3079d9f698e30088..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/049b3079d9f698e30088..text: 轮到你点歌了。我会认真听。

assets/voice-lines/88189503a7699c638edb..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/88189503a7699c638edb..text: 下次再问你，今晚先晚安。

assets/voice-lines/db8baf34d02d9fde57cb..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/db8baf34d02d9fde57cb..text: 琴擦干了，你也记得把外套晾好。

assets/voice-lines/a1a345f4cd9721a48b98..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a1a345f4cd9721a48b98..text: 那段檐下的节拍，我会慢慢写完。

assets/voice-lines/29b17eb6bbe44102446e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/29b17eb6bbe44102446e..text: 你走以后，我没有再改那句歌词。

assets/voice-lines/19f7dd45b6f3fafe3199..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/19f7dd45b6f3fafe3199..text: 刚刚又把母带的旋律听了一遍。

assets/voice-lines/179a762c97d0f005f41e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/179a762c97d0f005f41e..text: 我写了八小节新的旋律。

assets/voice-lines/cda2959d6fc45cb009b6..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/cda2959d6fc45cb009b6..text: 那我也把最喜欢的一段留给你。

assets/voice-lines/59f6bd3664149da879bf..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/59f6bd3664149da879bf..text: 录音里留了一拍没有声音。

assets/voice-lines/f59a318f42b26e924f67..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f59a318f42b26e924f67..text: 那今天就把惊喜交给唱针。

assets/voice-lines/c31e25b09e7400f2920b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c31e25b09e7400f2920b..text: 今天这首歌，还没有正式的名字。

assets/voice-lines/19a045019d6525e2a152..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/19a045019d6525e2a152..text: 今天的试听只完成了一半。

assets/voice-lines/977e3fd7da53203fef14..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/977e3fd7da53203fef14..text: 你先走四拍，我在下一拍跟上。

assets/voice-lines/797f4341acfecfcf92af..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/797f4341acfecfcf92af..text: 这不是没写完，是约好了下一次。

assets/voice-lines/4a7570a0705f638cb7b5..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4a7570a0705f638cb7b5..text: 下次不用怕跑调，我想听的是你。

assets/voice-lines/69397de36debd85736d7..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/69397de36debd85736d7..text: 今天这首歌，可以晚一点寄。

assets/voice-lines/461b913f0735d67a2844..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/461b913f0735d67a2844..text: 今天你发来一句，到家喝点水。

assets/voice-lines/c00a3ecb19efd1348e4e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c00a3ecb19efd1348e4e..text: 那我就不怕这首歌太安静了。

assets/voice-lines/324e71967ead6ab3de93..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/324e71967ead6ab3de93..text: 有一点紧张，也能一起完成。

assets/voice-lines/28b1219647a178767bbd..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/28b1219647a178767bbd..text: 你坐在这儿，连安静都像和声。

assets/voice-lines/7f96c723c18eeec906a6..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7f96c723c18eeec906a6..text: 你给下一首取个名字吧。

assets/voice-lines/5fb9b8e8622b685b6a77..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/5fb9b8e8622b685b6a77..text: 窗帘拉开了。今天的第一道光，想和你一起看。

assets/voice-lines/56669c64e1d660b00dc8..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/56669c64e1d660b00dc8..text: 图纸先放一边。给你留的午饭，还热着。

assets/voice-lines/8c9574cf406f7532fcfd..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8c9574cf406f7532fcfd..text: 钟楼的影子慢慢变长了。忙完以后，我们去走走。

assets/voice-lines/f8311019299d3ee749ca..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/f8311019299d3ee749ca..text: 我的计划表里，有一段空白。那段时间想留给你。

assets/voice-lines/fec707c41cfa4be2057b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/fec707c41cfa4be2057b..text: 刚才还很会说话，靠近了怎么反而不出声？

assets/voice-lines/91231c6ce1cd63ad46b7..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/91231c6ce1cd63ad46b7..text: 我不太会说漂亮话。这样握着，你能明白吧。

assets/voice-lines/83179168d70e49e70366..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/83179168d70e49e70366..text: 我陪着你。下一页图纸画完，就一起休息。

assets/voice-lines/9dd66c0f2ca967134ccd..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/9dd66c0f2ca967134ccd..text: 今天不验收工程。只想把这里最好的风景介绍给你。

assets/voice-lines/226f1d9a8349afe0b2b6..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/226f1d9a8349afe0b2b6..text: 嗯。今天的身份是我的客人，也是我想见的人。

assets/voice-lines/cf626e49e6af2c3e6c7d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/cf626e49e6af2c3e6c7d..text: 工作上我很少犹豫，可这张图改了好几遍。

assets/voice-lines/83064af4552f90969570..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/83064af4552f90969570..text: 现在觉得，有人愿意听你说难过，也很重要。

assets/voice-lines/0fc38fcc6394d48edb2c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0fc38fcc6394d48edb2c..text: 这里以后也会开放。但这个位置，我想先替你留着。

assets/voice-lines/7d4039ce91b9da53ffcf..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/7d4039ce91b9da53ffcf..text: 说好了。下次见面，不用写进工作日程。

assets/voice-lines/41246bba7374093a79af..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/41246bba7374093a79af..text: 预约好的展览去不成了。我不太擅长临时改变计划。

assets/voice-lines/e4bc37c70af1190e3a4c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e4bc37c70af1190e3a4c..text: 可以。路线不必完全一样，只要愿意等彼此。

assets/voice-lines/e00211b00fc379cf014e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e00211b00fc379cf014e..text: 嗯。这一项完成得很好，其他的可以往后放。

assets/voice-lines/0ee39f01904d32c715ae..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0ee39f01904d32c715ae..text: 我今天想等你。这不是加班，是我的选择。

assets/voice-lines/d8eada0816446bb5720e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d8eada0816446bb5720e..text: 这样也很好。等你想说的时候，这盏灯还会亮着。

assets/voice-lines/58194817aac2be827572..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/58194817aac2be827572..text: 这盏灯的开关，你以后也可以自己按。

assets/voice-lines/2ad69ab5f619a382b235..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/2ad69ab5f619a382b235..text: 如果你愿意这么理解，我会很高兴。

assets/voice-lines/3175e9d0d5f39cf3cec9..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/3175e9d0d5f39cf3cec9..text: 我以前设计过很多归处，自己却总在赶路。

assets/voice-lines/c0fab2a09621e3f88eea..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/c0fab2a09621e3f88eea..text: 那就按我们商量的办法，试着拍下来吧。

assets/voice-lines/64f30098f11bcec92f57..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/64f30098f11bcec92f57..text: 这次改动的理由，不只写在尺寸里。

assets/voice-lines/1dcace00b2ddbf88803e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1dcace00b2ddbf88803e..text: 午后的逆光让楼梯看起来比实际更危险。

assets/voice-lines/1b0727b33df9ed88f4de..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1b0727b33df9ed88f4de..text: 慢一点，我会一直站在你看得见的地方。

assets/voice-lines/89b06633289ddea9b021..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/89b06633289ddea9b021..text: 老人想要长椅，孩子们想要能跑的空地。

assets/voice-lines/34807748fdf68574158c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/34807748fdf68574158c..text: 把不同人的行走路线叠到同一张图上。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/ac582f6547967dd4e373..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ac582f6547967dd4e373..text: 这个位置，是给记录大家的人留的。

assets/voice-lines/f02062812cd5edb1b64c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/f02062812cd5edb1b64c..text: 店主以为只要一个漂亮台阶就够了。

assets/voice-lines/149a9771bed17116bf76..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/149a9771bed17116bf76..text: 好的设计，是让更多人可以一起进来。

assets/voice-lines/c69485f465323632bf6c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/c69485f465323632bf6c..text: 今天的最后一项验收，是你有没有好好休息。

assets/voice-lines/47922d64ce001664ac36..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/47922d64ce001664ac36..text: 漂亮的完工照遮住了许多曾经的争论和修正。

assets/voice-lines/d1310d6586ce6e1b1f9f..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d1310d6586ce6e1b1f9f..text: 把修改稿与最终画面并排剪进片子。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/279c396ae6cf5468359f..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/279c396ae6cf5468359f..text: 下一张图纸，也想和你一起打开。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/35cda81389eecebd28ee..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/35cda81389eecebd28ee..text: 我是顾清禾。钟楼的现场图发到工作室邮箱了。

assets/voice-lines/5c5004491a573cb75b80..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/5c5004491a573cb75b80..text: 私人的号码也留给你，现场有事可以直接找我。

assets/voice-lines/0033eec2c8980d7958e7..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0033eec2c8980d7958e7..text: 我会准时。你慢慢来，路上注意安全。

assets/voice-lines/0416e7df5754a95476ac..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0416e7df5754a95476ac..text: 好，先吃饭。空出来的时间留着，之后再约。

assets/voice-lines/4c9a0c5d9af82f2ad4a0..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4c9a0c5d9af82f2ad4a0..text: 如果你不忙，陪我去河边看看新的照明吧。

assets/voice-lines/1d3ab67799b19b6b0f3e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1d3ab67799b19b6b0f3e..text: 办公室前台问，下次你来要不要提前登记。

assets/voice-lines/e5386c1512edbc0e22d7..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e5386c1512edbc0e22d7..text: 我说不用，给你留一个能随时坐下的位置。

assets/voice-lines/64d4b7eb09cc2f0fa800..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/64d4b7eb09cc2f0fa800..text: 现在方便接电话吗？有件小事想亲口告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/4fbdbcfb46e06395d494..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4fbdbcfb46e06395d494..text: 今天不催你交作业，也不讨论方案。

assets/voice-lines/f9428980cbf6d7220de1..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/f9428980cbf6d7220de1..text: 那今天先到这里。晚安，明天再见。

assets/voice-lines/62e5b8e30da2e078d09e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/62e5b8e30da2e078d09e..text: 我画钟楼时，把街边长椅也画进去了。

assets/voice-lines/dba4e138a9cec75543e8..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/dba4e138a9cec75543e8..text: 构图本来不需要它，但那是你等我收工的位置。

assets/voice-lines/73659901666daf52224d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/73659901666daf52224d..text: 新图纸有一道折痕，刚好经过屋顶。

assets/voice-lines/4e3393edaa030db27fd6..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4e3393edaa030db27fd6..text: 我没有重印，沿着折痕改出了一条采光带。

assets/voice-lines/895f9a21f15a7393664c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/895f9a21f15a7393664c..text: 其实是看到窗外有人拿着和你一样的摄像机。

assets/voice-lines/457cad5ce958b0ae4be9..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/457cad5ce958b0ae4be9..text: 下午能不能借你十分钟，补上那一眼。

assets/voice-lines/03f49065903ad0e6d922..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/03f49065903ad0e6d922..text: 新办公室的晨光比预计早了十二分钟。

assets/voice-lines/530c82397843e7517100..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/530c82397843e7517100..text: 上面写着你说过的那句：旧东西也值得被认真对待。

assets/voice-lines/d3a0b41fb028d66f47a6..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d3a0b41fb028d66f47a6..text: 我习惯把事情安排好，但见你可以不用那么周密。

assets/voice-lines/6e20d15e5c9e6f02a41b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/6e20d15e5c9e6f02a41b..text: 刚刚又想起了那天的事，想打给你。

assets/voice-lines/d264c9cbe7fdaefa7588..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d264c9cbe7fdaefa7588..text: 走惯的路突然空出一段，才发现少了你的脚步声。

assets/voice-lines/880429ea189cbbd72602..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/880429ea189cbbd72602..text: 地址栏没有填，因为我想亲手递给你。

assets/voice-lines/2f4ab1ba0e602a45c5f4..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/2f4ab1ba0e602a45c5f4..text: 如果你还在剪辑，我可以再等一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/d70bd51d2ddab2f6c1e6..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d70bd51d2ddab2f6c1e6..text: 我留下窗边那盏，不全是为了检查模型。

assets/voice-lines/7d04a87bba307fd4f3c8..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/7d04a87bba307fd4f3c8..text: 会议桌换了位置，我仍然坐在靠窗的一侧。

assets/voice-lines/b3eebc54ed5b1b8ad327..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b3eebc54ed5b1b8ad327..text: 旁边空着的椅子，让我想起你来听方案那天。

assets/voice-lines/c7ca2fcd96bb241b5944..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/c7ca2fcd96bb241b5944..text: 城市模型里多了一间小小的工作室。

assets/voice-lines/00228d815cad4ba9114c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/00228d815cad4ba9114c..text: 它不在委托范围内，是我自己想加上的。

assets/voice-lines/95f8886cf9e6f6be5d57..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/95f8886cf9e6f6be5d57..text: 工作结束了，想和你吃一顿普通的晚饭。

assets/voice-lines/097e137a00f6ccd62507..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/097e137a00f6ccd62507..text: 那一刻我才觉得，房子真的开始成为一个家。

assets/voice-lines/eabe898089fb942effae..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/eabe898089fb942effae..text: 我拍了三张，都没有把那种安静留下来。

assets/voice-lines/0a6ca6f5e3cdfcd3b5d4..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0a6ca6f5e3cdfcd3b5d4..text: 我刚算完承重，它已经在屋顶睡着了。

assets/voice-lines/1625f1230d36570a5610..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1625f1230d36570a5610..text: 你来评评理，这算不算未经许可入住？

assets/voice-lines/454a9d4c5db049fc6e7b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/454a9d4c5db049fc6e7b..text: 你父亲的工作室也在图上，门前还是一棵小树。

assets/voice-lines/1ca87a48201a692e8bb9..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1ca87a48201a692e8bb9..text: 展馆把我的模型放在极光投影下面。

assets/voice-lines/211373b8354ac42a6051..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/211373b8354ac42a6051..text: 今晚可以暂时不做设计师，只做陪你看光的人。

assets/voice-lines/df7f2427689a8637bf30..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/df7f2427689a8637bf30..text: 那些严格的线条，第一次有了像梦一样的颜色。

assets/voice-lines/20824950ee180df59ea9..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/20824950ee180df59ea9..text: 你来的时候，我想听听你想坐在哪里。

assets/voice-lines/cbb8a208e68dab7d2f16..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/cbb8a208e68dab7d2f16..text: 靠窗的椅子留了两把，和最初的图纸不一样。

assets/voice-lines/a1836f6c6a8bd0562962..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/a1836f6c6a8bd0562962..text: 如果今晚不赶时间，我们再走一次吧。

assets/voice-lines/d15eb12cdb6c7c89ab57..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d15eb12cdb6c7c89ab57..text: 里面有一张没写进图纸的小桌，两把椅子。

assets/voice-lines/bc713b9814f402c8881c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/bc713b9814f402c8881c..text: 等你忙完，我们来讨论窗帘的颜色。

assets/voice-lines/666cd6fb6fbb9475aaa1..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/666cd6fb6fbb9475aaa1..text: 到家了。安全帽已经放回柜子，你不用再担心。

assets/voice-lines/df488d803c44413d0bd5..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/df488d803c44413d0bd5..text: 第一次带人看旧窗，却比汇报方案还紧张。

assets/voice-lines/e354adbfa71b392eeda7..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e354adbfa71b392eeda7..text: 明信片放进你的包里了吗？别和湿伞放在一起。

assets/voice-lines/b7c5fee1f8298498ce55..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b7c5fee1f8298498ce55..text: 方案的最后一页已经补上旧窗的说明。

assets/voice-lines/e93b710908745dbe3613..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e93b710908745dbe3613..text: 你说要让更多人知道它的故事，我把这句话记住了。

assets/voice-lines/4e5a5e96d45c9319aa88..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4e5a5e96d45c9319aa88..text: 下次拍摄，记得也给自己留一个名字。

assets/voice-lines/c921170abbe752269fed..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/c921170abbe752269fed..text: 今天翻开图纸时，发现页角多了一条折痕。

assets/voice-lines/1a4995439115d6783ac1..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1a4995439115d6783ac1..text: 绕过施工区，发现一条开着玉兰的小路。

assets/voice-lines/2966f97af1804492a4ac..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/2966f97af1804492a4ac..text: 忙完最后一张图，我上屋顶站了一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/4a724fa5595528d2c42f..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4a724fa5595528d2c42f..text: 风有点大，下次会多带一件外套，也替你带一件。

assets/voice-lines/3efa1bacc9ea351969c2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/3efa1bacc9ea351969c2..text: 这周画过很多房间，最喜欢的却很简单。

assets/voice-lines/4c815f8cceccb16dce80..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4c815f8cceccb16dce80..text: 嗯，今天我只负责和你一起看风景。

assets/voice-lines/b57873e8c95071b88c16..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b57873e8c95071b88c16..text: 原来不用记录尺寸，也能把一个地方记得很牢。

assets/voice-lines/728b85dfc37fc2689e85..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/728b85dfc37fc2689e85..text: 看来有些地方，不能总放到计划的最后。

assets/voice-lines/30242e4bba7140327ccf..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/30242e4bba7140327ccf..text: 两杯都留着热气，这样就不会画得太安静。

assets/voice-lines/5ebf9e671497fa86c5f9..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/5ebf9e671497fa86c5f9..text: 我画过很多房子，这一扇窗最像家。

assets/voice-lines/1b5fdedcf675b0526030..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1b5fdedcf675b0526030..text: 今天的客户问我，理想的卧室应该多大。

assets/voice-lines/f3cb46191d8b51ab5502..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/f3cb46191d8b51ab5502..text: 它应该能放下一个不必假装精神很好的人。

assets/voice-lines/758f069eb7bc36287ec8..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/758f069eb7bc36287ec8..text: 这里不会因为你沉默，就要求你解释原因。

assets/voice-lines/95a98b264130bd37313c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/95a98b264130bd37313c..text: 我画过很多房间，也拆过很多不合适的墙。

assets/voice-lines/d351c4d7e4643f1b5ade..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d351c4d7e4643f1b5ade..text: 只有现在这盏灯，我不想在图纸上标一个标准亮度。

assets/voice-lines/71a176f612c1da1981a9..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/71a176f612c1da1981a9..text: 你觉得刚刚好，那就是我们今晚需要的尺寸。

assets/voice-lines/e6b61c28acbb1d235ca2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e6b61c28acbb1d235ca2..text: 我买椅子时，老板问第二把平时会不会用到。

assets/voice-lines/59060b8f18306f1b17a9..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/59060b8f18306f1b17a9..text: 那时候我说，会的，只是坐的人偶尔有点忙。

assets/voice-lines/920f1832f3bc074b56c2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/920f1832f3bc074b56c2..text: 后来这句话让我在回来的路上笑了很久。

assets/voice-lines/9ce09232c839ff137929..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/9ce09232c839ff137929..text: 我明明可以说待客，却不太愿意把你算成客人。

assets/voice-lines/0509d780425275947190..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0509d780425275947190..text: 你上次放在椅背的围巾，我也没有收进柜子。

assets/voice-lines/0a241e49c337146c5910..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0a241e49c337146c5910..text: 它在那儿，就像你说了一句，等会儿还回来。

assets/voice-lines/3114dafc7ded6266ea1a..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/3114dafc7ded6266ea1a..text: 不是怕黑，是怕还有人没回家，门口就已经安静了。

assets/voice-lines/2a67d8e7e4c1c9ee1bef..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/2a67d8e7e4c1c9ee1bef..text: 所以后来工作再晚，我都想给自己留一盏小灯。

assets/voice-lines/613faf779be8dddfbe63..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/613faf779be8dddfbe63..text: 今天回来的时候，你已经把它打开了。

assets/voice-lines/8e96d6121d86cd5b244e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8e96d6121d86cd5b244e..text: 那一刻我忽然不用再想，这间房子哪里还缺东西。

assets/voice-lines/bbeccf139b05fe98051a..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/bbeccf139b05fe98051a..text: 原来被人记住的感觉，不需要很大的声响。

assets/voice-lines/0bfbc2d521495020b633..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0bfbc2d521495020b633..text: 你问我困不困。困了，可是还想再看你一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/dc3e42016d400f6d6253..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/dc3e42016d400f6d6253..text: 等你闭上眼睛，我再把灯调到我们都舒服的亮度。

assets/voice-lines/e3a4bfffe982040417e7..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e3a4bfffe982040417e7..text: 有我在，不必听见一点动静就醒过来。

assets/voice-lines/921a615dcc375cac0d3e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/921a615dcc375cac0d3e..text: 我看见你了。没有在想图纸，刚才是在看你。

assets/voice-lines/cf2a9791e05af69b2018..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/cf2a9791e05af69b2018..text: 手伸过来就好。我会握住，不用提醒第二次。

assets/voice-lines/b552aead486b125b1afd..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b552aead486b125b1afd..text: 现在想起来，也能温柔地看待那时候的自己了。

assets/voice-lines/7775a62022facbf72b32..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/7775a62022facbf72b32..text: 这不是交付图。是我想和你一起住过的那些地方。

assets/voice-lines/2097dc2f22ce4a8fab86..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/2097dc2f22ce4a8fab86..text: 因为想象你坐在旁边，比计算采光更早。

assets/voice-lines/7bad29b92429fdf83185..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/7bad29b92429fdf83185..text: 那这次我不检查了。我想好好走过去。

assets/voice-lines/c013330b3d024dbcb32d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/c013330b3d024dbcb32d..text: 我第一次觉得，计划外的部分，也可以让人安心。

assets/voice-lines/4d8ae647a341ad0a79a1..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4d8ae647a341ad0a79a1..text: 以后忙到很晚，也别把回家写成最后一项任务。

assets/voice-lines/794768d33f6a45cb85bd..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/794768d33f6a45cb85bd..text: 等很久了吗？今天我想先问你这句话。

assets/voice-lines/b0211d08f40fa1152602..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b0211d08f40fa1152602..text: 有些未来，可以从一起选一张椅子开始。

assets/voice-lines/e8a34d60baea4c19797e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e8a34d60baea4c19797e..text: 披肩还够两个人用。你再站近一点。

assets/voice-lines/93b83cb1bcf90cab8115..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/93b83cb1bcf90cab8115..text: 今晚不讲结构力学，想听你说些没有标准答案的话。

assets/voice-lines/749f593f0ec72a053770..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/749f593f0ec72a053770..text: 只要上面有我们两个人的钥匙，就已经足够特别。

assets/voice-lines/d0ac9cee4943dd934ab9..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d0ac9cee4943dd934ab9..text: 烤箱刚响了一声。早上的第一块面包，是给你的。

assets/voice-lines/d5f51eba1ac618e15bf8..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d5f51eba1ac618e15bf8..text: 嘴角没有奶油？那就是……想让我靠近一点？

assets/voice-lines/a40a46ddd814733e9c8a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a40a46ddd814733e9c8a..text: 今天的配方里，好像多加了一点心跳。

assets/voice-lines/a83e3e0e426d0e1baffb..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a83e3e0e426d0e1baffb..text: 面团也需要醒一醒。休息不会把之前的努力变没的。

assets/voice-lines/2619f07f7dbb0f500f44..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/2619f07f7dbb0f500f44..text: 我在旁边，不会催你。茶凉了我再帮你换一杯。

assets/voice-lines/84aab2edb8d4c75b9809..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/84aab2edb8d4c75b9809..text: 也可以尝第一口。那个位置本来就是给你的。

assets/voice-lines/bfbb871a8cf0dc39d5d8..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/bfbb871a8cf0dc39d5d8..text: 我的这一块也有点歪。你想给它什么名字？

assets/voice-lines/2a993778b23c747b6d3a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/2a993778b23c747b6d3a..text: 真的像小猫了。你看，原来歪一点也能有新的可爱。

assets/voice-lines/fe7f6871f3a7a0fd83e0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/fe7f6871f3a7a0fd83e0..text: 那我们今天烤两只不太整齐的小猫。

assets/voice-lines/a174dd10528cf2b7c744..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a174dd10528cf2b7c744..text: 小时候我总担心，慢一点就会错过最好的火候。

assets/voice-lines/5388348395d5880525db..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/5388348395d5880525db..text: 嗯。十二分钟，原来也可以过得这么开心。

assets/voice-lines/caea06048cd8272fed54..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/caea06048cd8272fed54..text: 卖不了这么歪的，但可以留给喜欢它的人。

assets/voice-lines/323f019c65745aa7e854..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/323f019c65745aa7e854..text: 今天没有其他订单，这一杯可以慢慢试。

assets/voice-lines/4af4b61a80b0cd4bbf19..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/4af4b61a80b0cd4bbf19..text: 要说真话。你喜欢什么，我想记得准确一点。

assets/voice-lines/7eae61fe9b37b3a1327f..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/7eae61fe9b37b3a1327f..text: 是不是还是甜了？别因为是我做的，就勉强喝完。

assets/voice-lines/338e9c13e553439e0c64..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/338e9c13e553439e0c64..text: 不会。比起听夸奖，我更想知道你过得舒不舒服。

assets/voice-lines/71a398f93015ffbb3bbb..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/71a398f93015ffbb3bbb..text: 你愿意告诉我，我也很开心。我们不用猜一整天。

assets/voice-lines/1ec44838835f86cfa344..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1ec44838835f86cfa344..text: 当然。喜欢也会变化，我可以一直认真听。

assets/voice-lines/a4ce73d171d6904fce76..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a4ce73d171d6904fce76..text: 今天不是节日。只是想和你庆祝一个普通的晚上。

assets/voice-lines/c6c766698f6166549594..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c6c766698f6166549594..text: 说给我听吧，我想知道我们能不能一起做到。

assets/voice-lines/0e3fcf49f9c960f9be71..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0e3fcf49f9c960f9be71..text: 如果把今天叫纪念日，会不会显得我太认真？

assets/voice-lines/e2f9a13288f349572041..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/e2f9a13288f349572041..text: 原来你也在等我问。那今天的日期，我们一起写。

assets/voice-lines/cc8b3a7233dadc3411b3..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/cc8b3a7233dadc3411b3..text: 那我可以把你写进以后每一年的今天吗？

assets/voice-lines/77ac2d40ecd508292c80..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/77ac2d40ecd508292c80..text: 原来被人记得，也像吃到刚出炉的点心一样暖。

assets/voice-lines/78bef015fc41c3867fa4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/78bef015fc41c3867fa4..text: 可以。我在柜子里给它留一个位置。

assets/voice-lines/0a8e04310e28585b8a1e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0a8e04310e28585b8a1e..text: 面团的发酵时间与拍摄排期对不上。

assets/voice-lines/2c5853e739c48b9404ad..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/2c5853e739c48b9404ad..text: 那就按我们商量的办法，试着拍下来吧。

assets/voice-lines/7acff031e22c6a602506..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/7acff031e22c6a602506..text: 等得有点饿了吧，先尝这一个。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/80f37cf0b544bfd5251a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/80f37cf0b544bfd5251a..text: 试喝的人给出完全不同的甜度建议。

assets/voice-lines/8fc77afe05caeb8a4023..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/8fc77afe05caeb8a4023..text: 你的那杯，我大概已经记住了。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/35813cf7a02c1ae6d993..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/35813cf7a02c1ae6d993..text: 不用和样品一样，好吃和开心都算数。

assets/voice-lines/6e66f1ddb3dda44aa35e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/6e66f1ddb3dda44aa35e..text: 把事情做好，比拍得感人更要紧。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/3e8df35fd86bb6a86bd8..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/3e8df35fd86bb6a86bd8..text: 手写配方上的分量全是“少许”和“差不多”。

assets/voice-lines/55341c2b0d2fefc76071..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/55341c2b0d2fefc76071..text: 这样，下次想念的时候就有办法再做一次。

assets/voice-lines/b00e04ed702dc4f9666c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b00e04ed702dc4f9666c..text: 你想补一组空店镜头，她却迟迟没关最后一盏灯。

assets/voice-lines/0e709ca8bc11699cb824..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0e709ca8bc11699cb824..text: 拍完以后，也别急着走。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/d62e6ee9d7d75f85500a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d62e6ee9d7d75f85500a..text: 店里的号码你已经存了，这个是我自己的。

assets/voice-lines/d8fe50ebdc156e318e87..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d8fe50ebdc156e318e87..text: 那就先忙你的，我会给那一份盖好。

assets/voice-lines/40a5115d442c1ad58189..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/40a5115d442c1ad58189..text: 如果只是想吃一点热的，也可以给我发消息。

assets/voice-lines/c3ee19b262ff82467d1e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c3ee19b262ff82467d1e..text: 今天面包多烤了两个，不想一个人吃。

assets/voice-lines/e6d8e894f7a4b8e16597..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/e6d8e894f7a4b8e16597..text: 如果你收工了，来陪我分掉它们吧。

assets/voice-lines/433d8981f1699d32f6e8..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/433d8981f1699d32f6e8..text: 第一次可能没有那么漂亮，但我会认真看着烤箱。

assets/voice-lines/786f3cbd12cd3168d108..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/786f3cbd12cd3168d108..text: 你愿意做那个不用打分的试吃员吗？

assets/voice-lines/b880f96837f9e1fd31a0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b880f96837f9e1fd31a0..text: 现在方便接电话吗？有件小事想亲口告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/18b547dccb5f05845bd6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/18b547dccb5f05845bd6..text: 如果今天累了，过来什么也不用做。

assets/voice-lines/bfff0f7d3b234a54dc99..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/bfff0f7d3b234a54dc99..text: 吃不完也没关系，重要的是你有好好吃饭。

assets/voice-lines/1c00e34415143d9d0f82..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1c00e34415143d9d0f82..text: 那今天先到这里。晚安，明天再见。

assets/voice-lines/0d11d92f1b883800834c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0d11d92f1b883800834c..text: 我没有多加糖，想让奶油留出一点清清爽爽的味道。

assets/voice-lines/8835a09d8a2c62e3168a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/8835a09d8a2c62e3168a..text: 想画月亮，最后变成了一颗歪歪的心。

assets/voice-lines/d093cbd68bf44b3a11fa..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d093cbd68bf44b3a11fa..text: 店外还没有人，我却习惯先把靠窗的位置擦干净。

assets/voice-lines/a302b360c4380d785961..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a302b360c4380d785961..text: 早起的话，来吃一顿慢慢的早餐吧。

assets/voice-lines/33af0e8c02c76c909da5..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/33af0e8c02c76c909da5..text: 今天没有新品，也没有特别的节日。

assets/voice-lines/9290bd5d7d0c28c92f5f..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/9290bd5d7d0c28c92f5f..text: 那一点银白让我想起你上次夸过的装饰。

assets/voice-lines/b42246833bedaeb98f01..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b42246833bedaeb98f01..text: 等待的时候没有觉得烦，反而有点期待门上的铃声。

assets/voice-lines/a2af888cfb247cd63051..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a2af888cfb247cd63051..text: 刚刚又想起了那天的事，想打给你。

assets/voice-lines/1e1b0088b1e74771af56..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1e1b0088b1e74771af56..text: 不是卖相不好，是我从出炉时就决定留下它。

assets/voice-lines/b8c264c38d675d9956d0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b8c264c38d675d9956d0..text: 今天可以晚一点来，它不会被卖掉。

assets/voice-lines/13c9730bf892777445f0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/13c9730bf892777445f0..text: 你来帮我确认，够不够我们慢慢吃。

assets/voice-lines/64fdcf33d599cdfdae74..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/64fdcf33d599cdfdae74..text: 名字还没想好，份量倒是先试了好几遍。

assets/voice-lines/d591ac1b3a8c7af2d7ec..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d591ac1b3a8c7af2d7ec..text: 可可凉到适合入口时，我看了眼门口。

assets/voice-lines/fa584a283b88c169dbbc..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/fa584a283b88c169dbbc..text: 有时等一杯饮料，有时等一个人，心情好像差不多。

assets/voice-lines/b4349925de50f059299b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b4349925de50f059299b..text: 新蛋糕里加了一小撮，甜味反而更清楚了。

assets/voice-lines/aa996a714ce7c1117353..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/aa996a714ce7c1117353..text: 火要很小，时间要很长，中间不能急着离开。

assets/voice-lines/a9788c84ce3fa2e7d6dd..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a9788c84ce3fa2e7d6dd..text: 冬天等面包的时候，两个人坐着会更暖。

assets/voice-lines/73c3028f8925cfd9dcd0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/73c3028f8925cfd9dcd0..text: 小猫坐在玻璃外面，看起来比我还担心。

assets/voice-lines/4359c1ef5ab67fdf657d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/4359c1ef5ab67fdf657d..text: 以前觉得最难懂，现在好像能尝出她说的温度。

assets/voice-lines/1a546ba9abc7126335d9..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1a546ba9abc7126335d9..text: 这次想做给你吃，也听听你的答案。

assets/voice-lines/c74f67aa38173dd169fd..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c74f67aa38173dd169fd..text: 结束后想换回舒服的衣服，和你去吃夜宵。

assets/voice-lines/67b1c8c48e62cdb93f7a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/67b1c8c48e62cdb93f7a..text: 希望以后，关店之后不必总是一个人。

assets/voice-lines/ec694629f8f6af9d2a04..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ec694629f8f6af9d2a04..text: 两人份，不代表一定要做得一模一样。

assets/voice-lines/32fda4589c10189227a2..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/32fda4589c10189227a2..text: 你的那份少一点糖，我已经记住了。

assets/voice-lines/e181497a43fa223ca6d7..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/e181497a43fa223ca6d7..text: 今晚的小饼干没有全部卖完，留了两块给我们。

assets/voice-lines/772c118c0a8f2fc3792d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/772c118c0a8f2fc3792d..text: 一块多一点桂花，一块少一点糖，都不是边角料。

assets/voice-lines/d05b0bffd62a6d65014c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d05b0bffd62a6d65014c..text: 我留了两只杯子，没着急把第二只收起来。

assets/voice-lines/c76591e52ee165ee8057..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c76591e52ee165ee8057..text: 你不用赶路。等你坐下来，我再泡一壶热茶。

assets/voice-lines/319b52029003090458b6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/319b52029003090458b6..text: 围裙洗好了，鼻尖的面粉也应该早就擦干净了吧？

assets/voice-lines/27674cb738c8918c3f25..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/27674cb738c8918c3f25..text: 今天等面包的时候，我一直希望烤箱能再慢一点。

assets/voice-lines/3a69db2c05bd97ce0274..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/3a69db2c05bd97ce0274..text: 你的那杯热可可，我把配方记下来了。

assets/voice-lines/34de71ce15f40ebe10c4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/34de71ce15f40ebe10c4..text: 不用夸它特别好喝，记得告诉我哪里还能调一调。

assets/voice-lines/feee4ff19e52158d566e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/feee4ff19e52158d566e..text: 明天也欢迎你来，不需要特别的理由。

assets/voice-lines/c7c42c95e2e8c5e43cf8..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c7c42c95e2e8c5e43cf8..text: 你不需要每一分钟都证明自己做得够好。

assets/voice-lines/5b9736b2754659784bf0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/5b9736b2754659784bf0..text: 首映那天，我会坐在第一排，认真看完。

assets/voice-lines/80772450853a93e3b9ef..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/80772450853a93e3b9ef..text: 最后一桌客人离开以后，我留了靠窗那盏灯。

assets/voice-lines/e5f9ff6bc829bf097b7f..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/e5f9ff6bc829bf097b7f..text: 名字还没想好。等你坐到对面，我们边吃边想。

assets/voice-lines/9d2e5d358452dfd91703..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/9d2e5d358452dfd91703..text: 那今天的甜度，就由湖边的风来决定。

assets/voice-lines/da44f39dfa864144eacd..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/da44f39dfa864144eacd..text: 分得这么认真，像在举行很重要的仪式。

assets/voice-lines/0697e026ba19dcd6ca90..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0697e026ba19dcd6ca90..text: 平时总想着让每个人满意，今天想慢一点。

assets/voice-lines/c6150437fb78e44d4d61..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c6150437fb78e44d4d61..text: 也行，不过新配方可能要再试几次。

assets/voice-lines/e6c485c0b770c0d276f0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/e6c485c0b770c0d276f0..text: 说好让烤箱休息，结果又忙了一天。

assets/voice-lines/2334425a6b72e9d6bdb6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/2334425a6b72e9d6bdb6..text: 以前总觉得，休息也该做一点新的东西才算值得。

assets/voice-lines/349853787be99b0b6dc5..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/349853787be99b0b6dc5..text: 你看这里，我想把新加的橙皮也画进去。

assets/voice-lines/03046dd23c039631776d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/03046dd23c039631776d..text: 我以前只写做法，现在想把一起做的人也写进去。

assets/voice-lines/6b8efaef63fb1fb7f0c8..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/6b8efaef63fb1fb7f0c8..text: 这句话最轻松，不是每一天都一定要有成品。

assets/voice-lines/1654f0c4d9b2981129b2..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1654f0c4d9b2981129b2..text: 这份很清楚，但下次想写得更像我一点。

assets/voice-lines/4846b50e62ec7adac7b9..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/4846b50e62ec7adac7b9..text: 今天试做的新点心，糖比原来的配方少了一点。

assets/voice-lines/997699de519f29ae560d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/997699de519f29ae560d..text: 我请大家尝，自己却一直盯着他们的表情。

assets/voice-lines/be6f0a597fea03675b27..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/be6f0a597fea03675b27..text: 后来你尝完说，留着明天再吃一次吧。

assets/voice-lines/a62157e02151437d7b4f..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a62157e02151437d7b4f..text: 我以为你在帮我解围，你却把剩下的认真装进盒子。

assets/voice-lines/cc77eeeff50544edf5d1..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/cc77eeeff50544edf5d1..text: 有些喜欢，是要等明天还想不想打开同一个盒子。

assets/voice-lines/fc5798b0fce8a391c7a9..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/fc5798b0fce8a391c7a9..text: 所以这份配方我还没有改，今晚也不想再算比例。

assets/voice-lines/4a0c1932fc70d3653ce1..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/4a0c1932fc70d3653ce1..text: 店里最后一个客人离开，我会把烤箱里的灯也关掉。

assets/voice-lines/401d388e8bbf42f33120..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/401d388e8bbf42f33120..text: 现在你偶尔会站在门口，问我想不想一起走回家。

assets/voice-lines/f7a00a5e454bfc4fe6de..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/f7a00a5e454bfc4fe6de..text: 原来忙完以后，生活还会继续给我一些小东西。

assets/voice-lines/6d4b9b2121b9614d12b1..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/6d4b9b2121b9614d12b1..text: 不需要做成甜点卖出去，也不需要谁来打分。

assets/voice-lines/743ca372a3a113f7e7bf..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/743ca372a3a113f7e7bf..text: 比如回家以后，你把枕头拍松，问我今天累不累。

assets/voice-lines/5116f9085a92f70652f3..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/5116f9085a92f70652f3..text: 累呀。但这样说出来，疲惫就不需要一个人放着了。

assets/voice-lines/fd6e25d96d0a737a485c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/fd6e25d96d0a737a485c..text: 今天切蛋糕的时候，我给自己留了半块。

assets/voice-lines/d0fb751221077c392e49..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d0fb751221077c392e49..text: 不是边角，也不是试吃剩下的，是我认真选的一块。

assets/voice-lines/3bc171ce14f9c074919b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/3bc171ce14f9c074919b..text: 以前总说等忙完再吃，等到忙完又觉得太晚了。

assets/voice-lines/ae73ca6c103273012b4e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ae73ca6c103273012b4e..text: 我想了好几天，终于把那半块放进自己的小碟子。

assets/voice-lines/cd9e7d086b1e0ad44e1c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/cd9e7d086b1e0ad44e1c..text: 吃的时候我没拍照，不过很想告诉你一声。

assets/voice-lines/06eb2288927b84cf123c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/06eb2288927b84cf123c..text: 明天的面团会慢慢发起来，不需要我们盯着它过夜。

assets/voice-lines/48331ce02dd4900de3e9..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/48331ce02dd4900de3e9..text: 谢谢你。被子已经软软的，像刚晾好的云。

assets/voice-lines/420f85ade3420278653f..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/420f85ade3420278653f..text: 现在有人愿意听完，过去好像也没有那么难开口了。

assets/voice-lines/e27858f4ef43d4898932..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/e27858f4ef43d4898932..text: 好。这回不是试吃，是正式邀请你陪我。

assets/voice-lines/42bac16159f5ea97aea3..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/42bac16159f5ea97aea3..text: 明明是自己的庆祝日，我却比替别人做蛋糕更紧张。

assets/voice-lines/9fe1f65bfe4b0c2d5e40..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/9fe1f65bfe4b0c2d5e40..text: 我总觉得，把好的留给别人，才算照顾到了。

assets/voice-lines/499816cfd8b6ce8378c7..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/499816cfd8b6ce8378c7..text: 那你帮我切吧。我想练习，接受一点偏心。

assets/voice-lines/1ac532834418f231384b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1ac532834418f231384b..text: 礼裙不能沾奶油，今天只吃一小口就好。

assets/voice-lines/98c5b6754c27071a37b4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/98c5b6754c27071a37b4..text: 不过如果是你递来的，我可能会忘记刚才说过什么。

assets/voice-lines/ceee688968d21b94830a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ceee688968d21b94830a..text: 我们再走一圈吧。不用比刚才跳得好。

assets/voice-lines/15ee18b0a210b19bf679..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/15ee18b0a210b19bf679..text: 你笑了，就已经比任何练习都值得。

assets/voice-lines/749ebb48a71dfad80e36..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/749ebb48a71dfad80e36..text: 明早不用太早来，面团也需要慢慢醒。

assets/voice-lines/aa8873992bb2e0527c6b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/aa8873992bb2e0527c6b..text: 先把午饭吃好，再去处理那些等着你的事吧。

assets/voice-lines/14d72841ceecea863562..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/14d72841ceecea863562..text: 你靠过来的时候，连花开的声音都好像更清楚了。

assets/voice-lines/cd231ec8a811b2536165..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/cd231ec8a811b2536165..text: 头发里有一片叶子？……原来只是想摸摸我呀。

assets/voice-lines/523403a54e9d4d738229..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/523403a54e9d4d738229..text: 手有一点凉。握紧些，我陪你等到春天。

assets/voice-lines/7c48742ec5fa39231f29..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/7c48742ec5fa39231f29..text: 嗯，我在。先完成手边的事吧，等一下再听你说。

assets/voice-lines/7e4b25a4bbf466a1e302..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/7e4b25a4bbf466a1e302..text: 本来想说是给来访者准备的，可我只告诉了你。

assets/voice-lines/82d09d38f7bedee5e742..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/82d09d38f7bedee5e742..text: 可以再贪心一点吗？下次也坐这里。

assets/voice-lines/29b556370c59854bf42b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/29b556370c59854bf42b..text: 那今天就先坐在这里吧。我把第二杯茶也泡上。

assets/voice-lines/2215d73cda2f1e221e2d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/2215d73cda2f1e221e2d..text: 你没有催我想办法。谢谢你先看见这些。

assets/voice-lines/d6635b7226caeac5f26c..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/d6635b7226caeac5f26c..text: 再轻一点，根系比叶子更怕被碰疼。

assets/voice-lines/843da2c0bac711ef40c1..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/843da2c0bac711ef40c1..text: 嗯。有人愿意跟我一起慢下来，原来是这种感觉。

assets/voice-lines/46b0c5a0cf3636878824..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/46b0c5a0cf3636878824..text: 今天没有开花，可我还是想给这一天画个小星星。

assets/voice-lines/f5ac1dd48550f3baab37..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f5ac1dd48550f3baab37..text: 出门前明明查过天气。我连让你不淋雨都没做到。

assets/voice-lines/53920590629c780f92ac..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/53920590629c780f92ac..text: 你怎么连它也记得。那我们一起躲雨。

assets/voice-lines/80f2704e43bf4adec512..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/80f2704e43bf4adec512..text: 我以前会把喜欢写成植物观察，假装谁都看不出来。

assets/voice-lines/29ea168eef76b6711b51..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/29ea168eef76b6711b51..text: 和你靠近的时候，心跳比雨声还明显。

assets/voice-lines/0c960e6326943ac32bed..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0c960e6326943ac32bed..text: 当然。也可以不找理由，直接来见我。

assets/voice-lines/015a36bbc43ac2303601..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/015a36bbc43ac2303601..text: 可能还要很久。你困了就睡一会儿，我会叫你。

assets/voice-lines/3367e2d3020a4fb78dbb..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3367e2d3020a4fb78dbb..text: 那我给你讲讲，它这一年是怎么长大的。

assets/voice-lines/16f47d1eab3bde00e9c3..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/16f47d1eab3bde00e9c3..text: 如果今晚不开，你会觉得白来了吗？

assets/voice-lines/35d429c79121756bf3ae..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/35d429c79121756bf3ae..text: 那今晚无论花开不开，我都会记得你在这里。

assets/voice-lines/c136e65bb7f957f84abd..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c136e65bb7f957f84abd..text: 那你交给谁了？……我好像知道答案了。

assets/voice-lines/c2412392a930078cad57..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c2412392a930078cad57..text: 我喜欢你这样说。好像我们也不用急着证明什么。

assets/voice-lines/5860729402f373b09648..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/5860729402f373b09648..text: 今晚的花会谢，可这段路，我想和你再走很多次。

assets/voice-lines/ef65c72f6de0d7cbae90..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ef65c72f6de0d7cbae90..text: 那我也不把想念写成暗号了。明天，想见你。

assets/voice-lines/ba0be4779e1462472069..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ba0be4779e1462472069..text: 同事担心一整天没有变化，节目会显得沉闷。

assets/voice-lines/5e8d6ec18d9a0fc77040..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/5e8d6ec18d9a0fc77040..text: 那就按我们商量的办法，试着拍下来吧。

assets/voice-lines/039cd805279565263138..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/039cd805279565263138..text: 每天固定拍十秒，把等待也留在片子里。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/da61007944b35ae77ecd..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/da61007944b35ae77ecd..text: 原来有人一起等，时间也会变得很好看。

assets/voice-lines/506c80824b94297bc8f6..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/506c80824b94297bc8f6..text: 大雨将至，收音里全是机器的嗡鸣。

assets/voice-lines/87676908ddcc82cae12b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/87676908ddcc82cae12b..text: 先停下风扇，录屋檐和叶面各自的雨声。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/11e5a1cb873abf24f904..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/11e5a1cb873abf24f904..text: 这次不用旁白，雨已经把故事说完了。

assets/voice-lines/0bb6cd7fbb9bd1a66fad..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0bb6cd7fbb9bd1a66fad..text: 负责人希望把缺角的叶子藏在画面外。

assets/voice-lines/20cbb7f8ca4ec5fc1aed..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/20cbb7f8ca4ec5fc1aed..text: 漂亮也可以有很多种样子，对吧？下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/8e189a760e088693c0c1..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8e189a760e088693c0c1..text: 保安提醒闭馆时间到了，而花还没动静。

assets/voice-lines/6f489e792565735c59c0..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/6f489e792565735c59c0..text: 幸好你在，不然我一定要打电话叫醒你。

assets/voice-lines/0a95b09bfe4147efd697..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0a95b09bfe4147efd697..text: 小朋友没有网络，直播参观的计划无法完成。

assets/voice-lines/007ee5b3c5a3adc4c8f0..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/007ee5b3c5a3adc4c8f0..text: 下次一起去看看吧，镜头之外也有春天。

assets/voice-lines/dd918389a54d69f41532..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/dd918389a54d69f41532..text: 你发现最好看的花期没有出现在最后一天。

assets/voice-lines/12a6cd17b81335a80da2..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/12a6cd17b81335a80da2..text: 用人们照料空枝的动作作结尾。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/8dfaef48f9e6d1ee8445..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8dfaef48f9e6d1ee8445..text: 节目结束了，你还可以常常来。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/0393da573174d48bc772..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0393da573174d48bc772..text: 它不需要很深的水，放在避开直晒的窗边就好。

assets/voice-lines/115f543ac079505019ae..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/115f543ac079505019ae..text: 也可以只坐一会儿，我给你倒一杯茶。

assets/voice-lines/bc8e654e319ee8f84fbd..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/bc8e654e319ee8f84fbd..text: 如果还没有花瓶，我这里正好有一只空的。

assets/voice-lines/f602c402764dfb9aedde..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f602c402764dfb9aedde..text: 观察结束了，我在温室外面坐了一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/b4c96d21ada32af7896a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b4c96d21ada32af7896a..text: 刚刚路过工作室，看见你还在对着屏幕。

assets/voice-lines/8a2ae0af63c252c6f095..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8a2ae0af63c252c6f095..text: 要不要下来走几步？不用说话也可以。

assets/voice-lines/076df8244d4381280115..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/076df8244d4381280115..text: 明天可能会有一点风，我把门口的小盆栽搬进来了。

assets/voice-lines/3a15bd6b1c8fa4742152..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3a15bd6b1c8fa4742152..text: 早上遇见的话，再把今天没说完的话说给你听。

assets/voice-lines/cdaccd1037d2adac50f2..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/cdaccd1037d2adac50f2..text: 现在方便接电话吗？有件小事想亲口告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/deb81fa0ba4ae04ce91d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/deb81fa0ba4ae04ce91d..text: 如果你在，大概又会说这是很好的同期声。

assets/voice-lines/23103e25165d93f9a759..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/23103e25165d93f9a759..text: 不用急着给我答案。你愿意来，我就已经很开心。

assets/voice-lines/7e41bcde4cf37a96f738..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/7e41bcde4cf37a96f738..text: 那今天先到这里。晚安，明天再见。

assets/voice-lines/d55cd9a7957c65855551..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/d55cd9a7957c65855551..text: 温室的玻璃上有一道光，刚好照着你上次坐的位置。

assets/voice-lines/8f52204dca01f3f7c21d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8f52204dca01f3f7c21d..text: 整理抽屉找到一包忘记写日期的种子。

assets/voice-lines/89ac879dcdd314da7108..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/89ac879dcdd314da7108..text: 我决定先种下，不急着给它一个名字。

assets/voice-lines/aa299dc5dc7b73810cd6..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/aa299dc5dc7b73810cd6..text: 我沿路认了七种野花，第八种还没找到。

assets/voice-lines/b4f3b9d6eaac68d987f4..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b4f3b9d6eaac68d987f4..text: 有些变化慢一点，反而能看得更清楚。

assets/voice-lines/4366f2e328507671780b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/4366f2e328507671780b..text: 明天一起看看它有没有恢复精神吧。

assets/voice-lines/4143002883dd32d41b91..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/4143002883dd32d41b91..text: 刚刚又想起了那天的事，想打给你。

assets/voice-lines/4fc00992ec6d5eea0e02..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/4fc00992ec6d5eea0e02..text: 不是长歪了，它只是在找最喜欢的阳光。

assets/voice-lines/8d15527278b39c4c793e..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8d15527278b39c4c793e..text: 我也想给自己放半天假，和你去有光的地方。

assets/voice-lines/705dda599d5c3e50e409..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/705dda599d5c3e50e409..text: 你把杯子递给我时，掌心比杯沿还暖一点。

assets/voice-lines/6bebdaeea626d51c721b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/6bebdaeea626d51c721b..text: 那株去年没有开花的树终于有花苞了。

assets/voice-lines/9ada37831687dc6351b4..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/9ada37831687dc6351b4..text: 夜巡时发现一只小萤火虫落在窗边。

assets/voice-lines/e303cb62a45f05fb5320..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/e303cb62a45f05fb5320..text: 我关了顶灯，它的光才慢慢变得清楚。

assets/voice-lines/59d440c1fe26bf8b68fd..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/59d440c1fe26bf8b68fd..text: 也想留下一些我们一起去过的地方。

assets/voice-lines/8c8f540fb63033c31cee..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8c8f540fb63033c31cee..text: 春夏秋冬各一张，但我不想只贴植物标本。

assets/voice-lines/dfc5a702e6fd346427aa..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/dfc5a702e6fd346427aa..text: 它绕过了所有墨迹，偏偏踩在我写你名字的那一行。

assets/voice-lines/f95ed7499125ad1a1b62..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f95ed7499125ad1a1b62..text: 下次来，记得和这位小审稿员打招呼。

assets/voice-lines/2379ad176b59e7c42186..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/2379ad176b59e7c42186..text: 想和你做一个新的，把旧的挂在旁边。

assets/voice-lines/3f39e016b25c8e76cd36..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3f39e016b25c8e76cd36..text: 你没有按我写的日期浇水，却记得每天看看它。

assets/voice-lines/d999c0ec17e752d9d05d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/d999c0ec17e752d9d05d..text: 有你照顾的地方，好像总能慢慢变好。

assets/voice-lines/7145ade52038c901e9c0..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/7145ade52038c901e9c0..text: 散场后，想牵着你再看一会儿夜空。

assets/voice-lines/bbd9438eedf236efa682..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/bbd9438eedf236efa682..text: 我们明明坐在地面上，却像一起走进了很远的花园。

assets/voice-lines/0ace7d9f65072b05e317..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0ace7d9f65072b05e317..text: 希望下一季，这个位置也有人陪我一起看。

assets/voice-lines/19b964561dedb6649799..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/19b964561dedb6649799..text: 整理压花时，发现那封一直没寄出的信。

assets/voice-lines/c6cee9eb18677f4250ec..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c6cee9eb18677f4250ec..text: 我不想再把想说的话全部夹进书里了。

assets/voice-lines/2194e3d8e2256a0228a6..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/2194e3d8e2256a0228a6..text: 以后走远一点，也不用把熟悉的地方全都丢下。

assets/voice-lines/f0845f8a2e5eb4dd97a8..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f0845f8a2e5eb4dd97a8..text: 我把观察日志移到另一边，给你空出一张椅子。

assets/voice-lines/c560cd25a84cfac1ea9d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c560cd25a84cfac1ea9d..text: 明早一起浇水吧。你来了，才算完整的晴天。

assets/voice-lines/7ba04701ef21db90b6d8..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/7ba04701ef21db90b6d8..text: 你到家了吗？我把窗边的软垫收好了。

assets/voice-lines/caa836559f5b59fc772e..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/caa836559f5b59fc772e..text: 那把椅子今天坐过以后，再看起来就没有那么空了。

assets/voice-lines/2f9ede560b4eff14b7ac..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/2f9ede560b4eff14b7ac..text: 有人陪着看已经做好的事，等待也没有那么难。

assets/voice-lines/444876922054368e6765..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/444876922054368e6765..text: 明天观察结束，再告诉你小苗的情况。

assets/voice-lines/45a98495a7927981ae01..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/45a98495a7927981ae01..text: 日志末尾的两个人名，我没有擦掉。

assets/voice-lines/a80bf79284126fe1e705..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a80bf79284126fe1e705..text: 今天没有开花，但我还是给这一页画了小星星。

assets/voice-lines/faf3c16544f3b9c72408..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/faf3c16544f3b9c72408..text: 今天的第一场拍摄结束了，我又去看了那株小树。

assets/voice-lines/da87e075100534bf7d48..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/da87e075100534bf7d48..text: 你没有催它开花，也没有催我把故事一次说完。

assets/voice-lines/2373f19ca4d677f8305b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/2373f19ca4d677f8305b..text: 我开始期待，纪录片里会留下怎样的春天。

assets/voice-lines/0f610e6565d936b24132..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0f610e6565d936b24132..text: 广场的椅子收好了，大家都平安到家。

assets/voice-lines/4e50f7eff73885f1d4cd..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/4e50f7eff73885f1d4cd..text: 放映结束时，你终于也出现在了合照里。

assets/voice-lines/faf399b2c52b16310904..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/faf399b2c52b16310904..text: 我替你留了一把小剪刀，周末来取一些回去泡水吧。

assets/voice-lines/cabed3cb8b375ba7a5a1..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/cabed3cb8b375ba7a5a1..text: 清单上最重要的一项，今天终于打了勾。

assets/voice-lines/6cd61409664a7b549aa9..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/6cd61409664a7b549aa9..text: 最后一行还空着，留给我们一起去湖边的那一天。

assets/voice-lines/04d83975cf7fd3a877d4..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/04d83975cf7fd3a877d4..text: 那我们一人搬一边。小心这盆，它刚长出新根。

assets/voice-lines/c31dcfbcbe7b8db8e7c4..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c31dcfbcbe7b8db8e7c4..text: 我今天发现，薄荷的香气也会随着阳光改变。

assets/voice-lines/a6ad9162d08399d029c3..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a6ad9162d08399d029c3..text: 明年这个时候，还来这里，好不好？

assets/voice-lines/2129feb9f7bb20ecff0e..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/2129feb9f7bb20ecff0e..text: 原来你也喜欢这里。那把长椅搬近一点。

assets/voice-lines/08aa69fd402954ccf856..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/08aa69fd402954ccf856..text: 我平时一个人听见的这些声音，终于可以讲给你听。

assets/voice-lines/39ec097c575ef4c84730..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/39ec097c575ef4c84730..text: 好呀，我会尽快收拾完。你在树荫下等，别晒着。

assets/voice-lines/c1521d8e31909ee0391a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c1521d8e31909ee0391a..text: 有点可惜，今天还没来得及好好陪你。

assets/voice-lines/2dbd6373323d974daf1c..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/2dbd6373323d974daf1c..text: 这格一直空着。我想，或许可以交给我们一起种。

assets/voice-lines/bb0f00b622db05baa16c..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/bb0f00b622db05baa16c..text: 这是角堇。明年开花时，我们还可以一起认颜色。

assets/voice-lines/ca7744e2944a9c51b83e..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ca7744e2944a9c51b83e..text: 你总记得把很远的约定，放进今天。

assets/voice-lines/fe73cff5f490506fef18..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/fe73cff5f490506fef18..text: 不用等到春天，也已经有很多喜欢的事了。

assets/voice-lines/ef3aaa7e940f36fb547d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ef3aaa7e940f36fb547d..text: 好，我来挑一只不会压坏花种的纸袋。

assets/voice-lines/ec3781fccb27eaa9241b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ec3781fccb27eaa9241b..text: 没关系，下次来温室，我带你重新认识它们。

assets/voice-lines/affc6c5aff58d3b7c495..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/affc6c5aff58d3b7c495..text: 春天不会因为晚寄一封信就不来了。

assets/voice-lines/26c674ce520c859e3a65..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/26c674ce520c859e3a65..text: 今天有一盆花，比我预计的晚开了一天。

assets/voice-lines/8bdf01d79be6cf53494d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8bdf01d79be6cf53494d..text: 你听到这里，是不是也在想今天没做完的事？

assets/voice-lines/e6dc72bf86a8b16dba18..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/e6dc72bf86a8b16dba18..text: 那就先把它们放在床头，像放下一本还没读完的书。

assets/voice-lines/5a823b2aba9f44fd9408..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/5a823b2aba9f44fd9408..text: 未完成不等于做得不好。它只是还需要明天。

assets/voice-lines/d341c3e35c0e336fe6b6..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/d341c3e35c0e336fe6b6..text: 明早如果天气好，我们去看看那盆慢慢开花的植物。

assets/voice-lines/1a4accc49046b7553264..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/1a4accc49046b7553264..text: 下雨时，我会把观察手册翻到最后一页。

assets/voice-lines/bb4b0ad93bdcc21b7c09..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/bb4b0ad93bdcc21b7c09..text: 小时候我总怕忘记什么，听到雨响，也要写下来。

assets/voice-lines/f41bd9615e1974c692bb..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f41bd9615e1974c692bb..text: 比如现在。窗子关得很好，床单很暖，你在旁边。

assets/voice-lines/daef838ebe7fbb521b76..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/daef838ebe7fbb521b76..text: 我不用把这三件事排成句子，就已经觉得今天值得。

assets/voice-lines/6893f63da28efbfc70d9..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/6893f63da28efbfc70d9..text: 等到雨声都变轻了，再一起把这一页合上。

assets/voice-lines/3a4d51bf91bd377b2f79..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3a4d51bf91bd377b2f79..text: 床头这个纸袋里，是我今天收好的花种。

assets/voice-lines/6c444be2f730db67b680..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/6c444be2f730db67b680..text: 想了很久，我决定明天把两边都空出来。

assets/voice-lines/15524634f95950c8e795..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/15524634f95950c8e795..text: 你选哪一边都好，另一边可以种你喜欢的东西。

assets/voice-lines/ed67f1635ee8041821af..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ed67f1635ee8041821af..text: 你的手终于暖了一点。就这样放着，不用一直用力。

assets/voice-lines/a353f38321e1119200d8..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a353f38321e1119200d8..text: 现在有人愿意听完，过去好像也没有那么难开口了。

assets/voice-lines/6b0b38d6f468d2c0b46f..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/6b0b38d6f468d2c0b46f..text: 那我终于可以把你的名字写在另一张座位卡上了。

assets/voice-lines/b0777894c09d402103ed..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b0777894c09d402103ed..text: 不能因为大家想看，就让它提前结束冬天。

assets/voice-lines/5d3af51eda40f75d04a5..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/5d3af51eda40f75d04a5..text: 好。等待如果有一个约定，就不会只剩担心。

assets/voice-lines/f68e2b11898ecde3a64d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f68e2b11898ecde3a64d..text: 不只是明年。四季慢慢来，我都想和你一起看。

assets/voice-lines/dad1ff7fb2112b48ff48..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/dad1ff7fb2112b48ff48..text: 灯再暗一点也没关系，我看得见你。

assets/voice-lines/af08974b83f5613dd8b8..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/af08974b83f5613dd8b8..text: 你的手还是有一点凉。可以借我的袖口挡挡风。

assets/voice-lines/044ccb85b57921e75045..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/044ccb85b57921e75045..text: 不用急着松开。下一趟回家的车，还要很久才来。

assets/voice-lines/35cb91145b3988d17b65..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/35cb91145b3988d17b65..text: 观察日志的下一页是空白的。你想写什么？

assets/voice-lines/59d4d7f91f4382ad7f6d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/59d4d7f91f4382ad7f6d..text: 那就写：明天也会见面。别的，我们慢慢补上。

assets/voice-lines/e6f6779da6ac5728104a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e6f6779da6ac5728104a..text: 你们给幼苗换盆。她扶着根，你慢慢把土填进空隙。

assets/voice-lines/fac876909f4397f9602d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fac876909f4397f9602d..text: 你们把这一天留在记忆里，约好下一次见面。

assets/voice-lines/4790d715e51b607266e9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4790d715e51b607266e9..text: 骤雨拍响温室的玻璃，林栀把一盆薄荷抱进屋檐下。

assets/voice-lines/f3a1fe78afef5ea7de10..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f3a1fe78afef5ea7de10..text: 走到路口时，她从包里拿出一小枝裹好根的薄荷。

assets/voice-lines/841c9e1e8009edf386b5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/841c9e1e8009edf386b5..text: 花苞迟迟没有动静，她把凉掉的茶换了一次又一次。

assets/voice-lines/00b4b8d95a3d3cbf16f8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/00b4b8d95a3d3cbf16f8..text: 回程的路灯映着她的侧脸，林栀把手放进你的掌心。

assets/voice-lines/3b9f91ff52c0c530cddb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3b9f91ff52c0c530cddb..text: 顾清禾替你检查好安全帽，推开修缮后的第一扇窗。

assets/voice-lines/d863d02aec5364f943b6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d863d02aec5364f943b6..text: 她展开一张没标尺寸的草图，两把椅子画得很近。

assets/voice-lines/bd88616ae718bcec3ead..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bd88616ae718bcec3ead..text: 她在画面的路口添了一道身影，随后把铅笔递给你。

assets/voice-lines/12f0035ee321856eb387..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/12f0035ee321856eb387..text: 她轻敲桌沿，你跟着打了两个不太准的节拍。

assets/voice-lines/b40bbf405e1b8f0d6f2b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b40bbf405e1b8f0d6f2b..text: 她唱到副歌，忽然停住，视线从歌词本移到你脸上。

assets/voice-lines/0137f69ef6e1ecefb342..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0137f69ef6e1ecefb342..text: 苏晚把录音笔关掉，将一本空白的提纲推到你面前。

assets/voice-lines/7b0eacf48cb46e740c1e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7b0eacf48cb46e740c1e..text: 锁好门时，她把手放到你手里，往你身边靠近一步。

assets/voice-lines/ab91c5ed22cae5636145..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ab91c5ed22cae5636145..text: 林栀把一盘还没发芽的种子搬到窗边。

assets/voice-lines/9ad50b0d3e2ed3683850..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9ad50b0d3e2ed3683850..text: 第三天，一道很细的绿从土里探出来。

assets/voice-lines/b1d57d9624cb383255e7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b1d57d9624cb383255e7..text: 她把第一张延时照片夹进你的工作本。

assets/voice-lines/8e48d8c9b8aa6e3eb6a1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8e48d8c9b8aa6e3eb6a1..text: 温室屋檐下摆起了大小不同的接水桶。

assets/voice-lines/448e5896c2df56422a7d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/448e5896c2df56422a7d..text: 林栀摘下耳机，让你听最后一滴水。

assets/voice-lines/b9dbe80099354597985b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b9dbe80099354597985b..text: 社区花展把最不起眼的一盆植物留给了她。

assets/voice-lines/d67cbf8679aef4eeef0c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d67cbf8679aef4eeef0c..text: 一位老人认出了自己曾经救活的小苗。

assets/voice-lines/34389f6e29238447c8f4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/34389f6e29238447c8f4..text: 你们把照片挂在没有修剪过的枝条旁。

assets/voice-lines/3dd8bc6829f80f4953b7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3dd8bc6829f80f4953b7..text: 林栀带着保温杯来等一朵只在夜里开的花。

assets/voice-lines/14cece9f359d41ef35ad..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/14cece9f359d41ef35ad..text: 远程监视器里，花瓣在午夜悄悄展开。

assets/voice-lines/4a3728666280e8d1e724..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4a3728666280e8d1e724..text: 她先把屏幕转向你，自己的茶已经凉了。

assets/voice-lines/eee3bb22a9b968712ac0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/eee3bb22a9b968712ac0..text: 一所乡村小学写信来问温室里的树叫什么。

assets/voice-lines/689f0458ce5800a2d06b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/689f0458ce5800a2d06b..text: 回信里装着孩子们画的六种不同的树。

assets/voice-lines/9187919563dfb23b842a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9187919563dfb23b842a..text: 林栀把画贴在实验台旁，特意给你留出一块地方。

assets/voice-lines/f9d604d96bdb4fb5fb56..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f9d604d96bdb4fb5fb56..text: 试映时，观众在最后一片空镜前安静下来。

assets/voice-lines/a33295cb64a620599d82..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a33295cb64a620599d82..text: 她没有收走你的椅子，只把它向窗边挪了一点。

assets/voice-lines/33c78abdfb6f1daae8a7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/33c78abdfb6f1daae8a7..text: 顾清禾在旧街测量一扇向内开的木窗。

assets/voice-lines/802f3cf72854e7317706..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/802f3cf72854e7317706..text: 住户指着刻痕，说那是孩子每年的身高。

assets/voice-lines/e64727fee482b49a6beb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e64727fee482b49a6beb..text: 你跟着她走进一栋没有电梯的旧楼。

assets/voice-lines/4521e99527cba5732ca8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4521e99527cba5732ca8..text: 顾清禾停在半层平台，等你把设备搬上来。

assets/voice-lines/8533aed5e85425c60e6b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8533aed5e85425c60e6b..text: 小样图里，长椅围着空地留下宽宽的通道。

assets/voice-lines/cf1a206f1e4a889f2ca0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cf1a206f1e4a889f2ca0..text: 她把你的摄影机也画成了广场角落的一个小图标。

assets/voice-lines/3361a924e4265df9a4b1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3361a924e4265df9a4b1..text: 新开的小店请她检查门口的通行条件。

assets/voice-lines/4071a6c223707117efc1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4071a6c223707117efc1..text: 婴儿车和送货推车也顺利经过新的入口。

assets/voice-lines/8e1e01295b7fefb8a9a1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8e1e01295b7fefb8a9a1..text: 她把标注尺交给你，请你签下共同记录。

assets/voice-lines/658d25acaac35688f63a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/658d25acaac35688f63a..text: 顾清禾想给旧楼屋顶做一个临时花园。

assets/voice-lines/7c2a4efde46793880ef8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7c2a4efde46793880ef8..text: 第一次试水结束，楼下天花板保持干燥。

assets/voice-lines/8072bbc05229e1df885f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8072bbc05229e1df885f..text: 她递给你一把折椅，终于肯坐下来看看晚霞。

assets/voice-lines/87b6479bc5ddc64e4bb1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/87b6479bc5ddc64e4bb1..text: 居民在放映后认出了自己的那条建议。

assets/voice-lines/0c517b94d6c95c476c0e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0c517b94d6c95c476c0e..text: 顾清禾在片尾的联合制作栏写下你的名字。

assets/voice-lines/19adc234f356755791bf..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/19adc234f356755791bf..text: 许知夏在天台摆好了两只不同的麦克风。

assets/voice-lines/a34606199c4e04dfd0d3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a34606199c4e04dfd0d3..text: 剪辑里的第一阵风，恰好落在她吸气之前。

assets/voice-lines/3207324d39c2f65ce48e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3207324d39c2f65ce48e..text: 孩子发现自己的鼓点也能成为一段前奏。

assets/voice-lines/3d75599135c92575e533..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3d75599135c92575e533..text: 许知夏把鼓槌递给你，笑着说还缺一位制作人。

assets/voice-lines/64661f721f2b2a6a947d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/64661f721f2b2a6a947d..text: 一位修收音机的师傅寄来旧曲谱的复印件。

assets/voice-lines/bbfae26d6940f39a8d27..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bbfae26d6940f39a8d27..text: 她在节目致谢里先念了你的工作室名字。

assets/voice-lines/e2a944d2f918c2802f84..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e2a944d2f918c2802f84..text: 雨声渐小，屋檐下反而多了几个轻轻和声的人。

assets/voice-lines/b43511d1d4911529967d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b43511d1d4911529967d..text: 她把原定的返场曲改成你们刚才唱的那一首。

assets/voice-lines/cff3832303b7d120060e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cff3832303b7d120060e..text: 许知夏把一叠删改过的歌词带到工作室。

assets/voice-lines/f98a22daafd1e733f0d4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f98a22daafd1e733f0d4..text: 粗糙的试唱和成品放在一起，反而让副歌更清楚。

assets/voice-lines/cef399d0e695bec996f5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cef399d0e695bec996f5..text: 她在最后一页空白处写下你的建议。

assets/voice-lines/2e4a7625ed0f4134ec8b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2e4a7625ed0f4134ec8b..text: 音乐纪录短片要在天台做一次试映。

assets/voice-lines/3c1dac25b5c6a3ca7692..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3c1dac25b5c6a3ca7692..text: 片尾和弦落下时，楼下传来一声轻轻的掌声。

assets/voice-lines/e06f31d264ec6d4d0046..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e06f31d264ec6d4d0046..text: 许知夏没有立刻收琴，先问你明天有没有空。

assets/voice-lines/5447c6fac7c692f013b5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5447c6fac7c692f013b5..text: 老人自己打开话匣，讲起第一次借书的日子。

assets/voice-lines/b8aefc230c629c97817b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b8aefc230c629c97817b..text: 她在采访本上划掉准备好的第一个问题。

assets/voice-lines/3abf0300bb924c368065..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3abf0300bb924c368065..text: 照片背面的褪色印章提供了关键年份。

assets/voice-lines/8358ebd336055107a035..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8358ebd336055107a035..text: 苏晚把不同说法一并留进采访附件。

assets/voice-lines/ec2701f7c3ad8b44ec8f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ec2701f7c3ad8b44ec8f..text: 夜班公交司机答应在交班后接受采访。

assets/voice-lines/cf99f0c1b4d9561f603a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cf99f0c1b4d9561f603a..text: 清晨那段短短的空镜，比仓促追问更有分量。

assets/voice-lines/49f3b069e9d52f7c42c9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/49f3b069e9d52f7c42c9..text: 她把第二次采访约在司机休息好的午后。

assets/voice-lines/bdc1ee057e1a719c0d69..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bdc1ee057e1a719c0d69..text: 一段已发出的预告把店名字幕写错了。

assets/voice-lines/52ce99b87916247c411a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/52ce99b87916247c411a..text: 店主回信说，认真说明比假装没发生更让人放心。

assets/voice-lines/607f3b47aa40c48e4626..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/607f3b47aa40c48e4626..text: 苏晚让你把这次检查加入以后的工作流程。

assets/voice-lines/28bfc565029c81678a06..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/28bfc565029c81678a06..text: 公益活动的工作人员要求隐藏一位参与者身份。

assets/voice-lines/88fa78087b19a2299632..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/88fa78087b19a2299632..text: 保留的信息已经足够让观众理解活动的意义。

assets/voice-lines/57f5c615835b0c48428b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/57f5c615835b0c48428b..text: 她和你一起逐帧检查，直到最后一处反光也处理好。

assets/voice-lines/e5183c7c54f2f504248b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e5183c7c54f2f504248b..text: 一位志愿者第一次在银幕上看到了自己的全名。

assets/voice-lines/b0566de6024d9018fa04..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b0566de6024d9018fa04..text: 苏晚把你的采访本放回原来的位置，没有合上。

assets/voice-lines/1a728de9695010237533..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1a728de9695010237533..text: 第一盘面包出炉时，街上的卷帘门才陆续升起。

assets/voice-lines/0950847f94891e5821a7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0950847f94891e5821a7..text: 她把一个还热的圆面包放在你的镜头盖旁。

assets/voice-lines/e5b9f4b9e5c4033ca441..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e5b9f4b9e5c4033ca441..text: 菜单上多了一栏可以自己选的甜度。

assets/voice-lines/360ce227fc1942523acc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/360ce227fc1942523acc..text: 江月在你的杯子下贴了一个小小的记号。

assets/voice-lines/e3c85cdba2afc955ea6c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e3c85cdba2afc955ea6c..text: 孩子们做出的蛋糕，每一个都有不同的小故事。

assets/voice-lines/143167e5710f257034d4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/143167e5710f257034d4..text: 她把剩下的奶油交给你，请你画片尾的小花。

assets/voice-lines/26b6b23372e3c0e2c33d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/26b6b23372e3c0e2c33d..text: 最后一位顾客急着给住院的家人送点心。

assets/voice-lines/9d58501b9d6f1c7deaba..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9d58501b9d6f1c7deaba..text: 得到明确确认后，一盒简单的点心才开始制作。

assets/voice-lines/6510e746fef5e8c2d335..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6510e746fef5e8c2d335..text: 江月让你关掉对着顾客的镜头，留住厨房的灯。

assets/voice-lines/349de7dbb5d3078108c8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/349de7dbb5d3078108c8..text: 邻居奶奶愿意教她做一道老式点心。

assets/voice-lines/c9c304f86ebfef35193a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c9c304f86ebfef35193a..text: 量杯和旧瓷勺终于出现在同一张配方里。

assets/voice-lines/a8d3081be809fb456afd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a8d3081be809fb456afd..text: 烘焙系列最后一场拍摄安排在闭店后。

assets/voice-lines/25f136ce6d3510acf013..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/25f136ce6d3510acf013..text: 银幕上的暖灯，与桌边这盏照在同一个方向。

assets/voice-lines/03dde97a080ba25bab71..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/03dde97a080ba25bab71..text: 江月端来两小块蛋糕，在你的那份上放了一颗草莓。

assets/voice-lines/13ef9a5d9b7b09a5e424..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/13ef9a5d9b7b09a5e424..text: 唐梨把助播的位置从角落搬到自己旁边。

assets/voice-lines/144405642e7e9cebdb50..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/144405642e7e9cebdb50..text: 弹幕开始问灯光和收音，话题比预期更丰富。

assets/voice-lines/2e29f96d26f38f3b20a9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2e29f96d26f38f3b20a9..text: 一个卖花的阿姨在镜头边自然地说了一声早安。

assets/voice-lines/a1d49ff13ac75ea36e40..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a1d49ff13ac75ea36e40..text: 唐梨反复回放那三秒，舍不得加上花哨转场。

assets/voice-lines/289efa00e6082bbd1ed5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/289efa00e6082bbd1ed5..text: 太阳只露出很短一瞬，大家却记住了整个傍晚。

assets/voice-lines/a8718c1ef7ddb093348e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a8718c1ef7ddb093348e..text: 她把最后一张照片先传给你，没有配公开文案。

assets/voice-lines/925e0b95c4d498864b20..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/925e0b95c4d498864b20..text: 唐梨要演示不同镜头怎样改变画面。

assets/voice-lines/d7db61f6a1accd5536e9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d7db61f6a1accd5536e9..text: 留言里出现了许多关于自然光的认真提问。

assets/voice-lines/3c55c1a5cd24ce5a2642..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3c55c1a5cd24ce5a2642..text: 她把自己的原片与你拍的测试图并排保存。

assets/voice-lines/851040eed268f34241d6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/851040eed268f34241d6..text: 补发的视频比正式直播短，却清楚解释了发生的事。

assets/voice-lines/ec5e6b67138fc9b19411..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ec5e6b67138fc9b19411..text: 唐梨把手机翻面放在桌上，终于肯先夹一口菜。

assets/voice-lines/b809a64f0814630b1b0d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b809a64f0814630b1b0d..text: 幕后系列要用一段下播后的画面作结尾。

assets/voice-lines/ae5da0f43bebc36cd03a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ae5da0f43bebc36cd03a..text: 成片只留下她关灯前轻轻挥手的那一秒。

assets/voice-lines/281167f208657fd134a5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/281167f208657fd134a5..text: 我打开带来的纸袋，里面是两块仍带着余温的面包。

assets/voice-lines/c3bc153d148582ce52d0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c3bc153d148582ce52d0..text: 我们并肩坐在草地上，一只小瓢虫从她的指尖飞走。

assets/voice-lines/0a4252f13ce21e8766c9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0a4252f13ce21e8766c9..text: 晚风绕过玻璃窗，两块面包被分成了更小的份。

assets/voice-lines/52a01c8150f7187dc476..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/52a01c8150f7187dc476..text: 柜台边摆着六种邮戳，墨水里有淡淡的木香。

assets/voice-lines/f15c5586fdbaae3906da..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f15c5586fdbaae3906da..text: 她把种子小心包好，信纸上还留着一点叶脉的影子。

assets/voice-lines/b77fcf1d9bce0926d0d2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b77fcf1d9bce0926d0d2..text: 窗外的梧桐叶落在邮筒旁，像一封没有封口的信。

assets/voice-lines/c6942b0fb2def04ea00a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c6942b0fb2def04ea00a..text: 邮局打烊前，我们牵着手走过了那一排小花盆。

assets/voice-lines/62e61d15f1f55b7248c3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/62e61d15f1f55b7248c3..text: 我写下祝福以后，才发现信纸上没有留下花的名字。

assets/voice-lines/09a03568e746a3489145..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/09a03568e746a3489145..text: 她在路口买了两杯热茶，把其中一杯放到我手里。

assets/voice-lines/db91af38418a69e26dff..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/db91af38418a69e26dff..text: 我们绕回书店时，只赶上店主收起门边的挂牌。

assets/voice-lines/feda2f079ef893c5b500..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/feda2f079ef893c5b500..text: 我看见她拿出的地址，是我们常走的那条回家路。

assets/voice-lines/aa722975813dad0a3a0c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/aa722975813dad0a3a0c..text: 她在纸上画了两把靠得很近的椅子。

assets/voice-lines/47d755c865f68dd3d0d1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/47d755c865f68dd3d0d1..text: 窗台上的两杯茶被邮戳轻轻连在一起。

assets/voice-lines/44632b319cddcd90008a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/44632b319cddcd90008a..text: 她在画好的钥匙旁写下我的名字，字比地址小一点。

assets/voice-lines/f7256395b9c0b00d3a81..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f7256395b9c0b00d3a81..text: 邮车已经离开，她把卡片装进信封，约好明天再来。

assets/voice-lines/12b7823573df07eb8404..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/12b7823573df07eb8404..text: 唱片转到一段轻轻的吉他前奏，她在膝上敲出节拍。

assets/voice-lines/e17b4fdaa660d3c1c116..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e17b4fdaa660d3c1c116..text: 她借来一张便签，把我说的那句话写在歌名下面。

assets/voice-lines/0f792416adaabd8e3b83..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0f792416adaabd8e3b83..text: 窗外恰好落起小雨，她把耳机分给我一边。

assets/voice-lines/7dda1f64826b4ac16e6c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7dda1f64826b4ac16e6c..text: 我把两支笔摆在桌上，今天不需要写一首完整的歌。

assets/voice-lines/b4995d8a0105febde5b7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b4995d8a0105febde5b7..text: 谱纸上出现了长短不同的音符，像街上的一串脚印。

assets/voice-lines/ecb1642a8c9003d0ddec..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ecb1642a8c9003d0ddec..text: 她把没有写词的最后一行推到我面前。

assets/voice-lines/a1e46daa88e990929ca7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a1e46daa88e990929ca7..text: 盖戳声恰好落在她敲出的第四拍上。

assets/voice-lines/0d635e85f4fed5d7df71..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0d635e85f4fed5d7df71..text: 她在空白小节旁画了一颗很小的星星。

assets/voice-lines/6c32edb1e21f4275731f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6c32edb1e21f4275731f..text: 副歌写了又改，邮局的音乐先换成了打烊提示。

assets/voice-lines/1a65fc20ca39bd0043fe..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1a65fc20ca39bd0043fe..text: 我把手机收进外套口袋，今天没有人需要交稿。

assets/voice-lines/3bd8ce7db2ff30a9e394..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3bd8ce7db2ff30a9e394..text: 河边的长椅空了出来，她把书摊开在两个人之间。

assets/voice-lines/6c0316e02321387ab00c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6c0316e02321387ab00c..text: 我们在河边看了很久水鸟，直到影子变得长长的。

assets/voice-lines/9222b9c5d656356ba23b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9222b9c5d656356ba23b..text: 苏晚拿着一封没有收件人的旧信，约我去秋日邮局。

assets/voice-lines/6d59a212a9f4f153e7d1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6d59a212a9f4f153e7d1..text: 信纸上的句子没有署名，也没有采访对象。

assets/voice-lines/4b567182f2377efb5d6f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4b567182f2377efb5d6f..text: 她读了读前半段，把几个太正式的词轻轻划掉。

assets/voice-lines/b61b6e4fa9a024aee79e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b61b6e4fa9a024aee79e..text: 两个人的名字挨在一起，没有加任何介绍。

assets/voice-lines/62f009560c0a4697ddce..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/62f009560c0a4697ddce..text: 我们改到窗口关灯，信纸最后没有被投进邮筒。

assets/voice-lines/fdfe8836842ca5263424..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fdfe8836842ca5263424..text: 湖面的光映在叉子上，我们谁都没有催着吃完。

assets/voice-lines/b5203bae30c7b9565915..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b5203bae30c7b9565915..text: 江月带了一小盒手包糖，糖纸上都画着不同的小花。

assets/voice-lines/8114fd3d55c84db61f12..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8114fd3d55c84db61f12..text: 她给两份食谱各画了一颗橙子，又把糖盒打开。

assets/voice-lines/07dbbe164210c88c805f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/07dbbe164210c88c805f..text: 我的信封边上沾了一点糖粉，她伸手轻轻抹掉。

assets/voice-lines/bb9cc30653ee28a4f2a3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bb9cc30653ee28a4f2a3..text: 临时窗口关门了，两张食谱被她放在糖盒下面。

assets/voice-lines/146307907d85064e1754..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/146307907d85064e1754..text: 我们在山脚集合，云正从远处的屋顶慢慢走过。

assets/voice-lines/720952373a1b2d73e691..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/720952373a1b2d73e691..text: 她把手机调成静音，放进了背包最里面的口袋。

assets/voice-lines/c036f2d07d2ceb917a40..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c036f2d07d2ceb917a40..text: 定时快门响了一声，她的手还握着我的衣袖。

assets/voice-lines/03dfe7ba0b7a8861c021..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/03dfe7ba0b7a8861c021..text: 开场重录了几遍，平台上的云已经走远了。

assets/voice-lines/0e06a4fa47be99485628..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0e06a4fa47be99485628..text: 唐梨把手机放在桌面上，所有提示音都关掉了。

assets/voice-lines/c6e4012e1ec37948ae63..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c6e4012e1ec37948ae63..text: 打印出的相纸还带着一点温度，她用指尖托住边角。

assets/voice-lines/1a3e298eb7d5bbd00d6a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1a3e298eb7d5bbd00d6a..text: 照片里我的领口被风吹歪，她正伸手帮我理好。

assets/voice-lines/5b4bf5127f6d860e2d9d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5b4bf5127f6d860e2d9d..text: 她把一张照片贴好，另一张轻轻放进我的钱包。

assets/voice-lines/7a9c1770ccc34dd98aad..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7a9c1770ccc34dd98aad..text: 信封上只有一个地址，背面写着两个人的名字。

assets/voice-lines/0e80c6b5d4028e68ad27..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0e80c6b5d4028e68ad27..text: 我们翻过太多滤镜，打印机却到了当天的休息时间。

assets/voice-lines/3173f51a96abbf2eb674..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3173f51a96abbf2eb674..text: 替别人设计一个家时，我很容易想到他们需要什么。

assets/voice-lines/8dd97fa10029e9ee72d2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8dd97fa10029e9ee72d2..text: 这不是加演。她没有写节目单，也没有准备开场白。

assets/voice-lines/29fc101afc9ee2b5f858..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/29fc101afc9ee2b5f858..text: 要不先唱吧。唱完以后，再看着他把歌名说出来。

assets/voice-lines/9b96fe36429e5b4a8bca..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9b96fe36429e5b4a8bca..text: 这一次不用带“大家”。我想试试直接看着他。

assets/voice-lines/5d06e639a5529d9f9564..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5d06e639a5529d9f9564..text: 她看见包装上的购买日期，轻轻碰了碰我的袖口。

assets/voice-lines/4e4701f3286560d4b892..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4e4701f3286560d4b892..text: 她走过来时没有提工期，也没有提验收。

assets/voice-lines/05600deba5fe9baa9a8b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/05600deba5fe9baa9a8b..text: 翻到旧书里一张空白书签，她忽然把它递给了你。

assets/voice-lines/6835c575cbc7317bef1a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6835c575cbc7317bef1a..text: 苏晚读了两遍，把书签重新夹好，没有要求我解释。

assets/voice-lines/267a534b0acf85dd20b2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/267a534b0acf85dd20b2..text: 那我今天就做一位不急着走的来访者。

assets/voice-lines/81f80166c6724f0651a2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/81f80166c6724f0651a2..text: 我想和你一起走，但也想听听你的意思。

assets/voice-lines/e379310b0af2501ca330..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e379310b0af2501ca330..text: 我会记得浇水。养不好的时候，可以请教你吗？

assets/voice-lines/dfacaf4a232e91fdfa81..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/dfacaf4a232e91fdfa81..text: 我更想陪你看看等待的时候是什么样子。
