assets/voice-lines/71ddaa88f81d0d752518..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/71ddaa88f81d0d752518..text: 好。相机可以等，我们先把这一刻留给自己。

assets/voice-lines/7a49d66c0e708c20e409..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7a49d66c0e708c20e409..text: 下次不一定要等花开。想见你的时候，我就来。

assets/voice-lines/cde282680aa90a24069c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/cde282680aa90a24069c..text: 这次要不要先不考虑它能不能说服别人？

assets/voice-lines/a21b5f6257ce00eb94a1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a21b5f6257ce00eb94a1..text: 没关系，我约的是你，展览可以下次再看。

assets/voice-lines/86c25ffb231faf7d9177..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/86c25ffb231faf7d9177..text: 收到你亲手画的风景，已经很珍贵了。

assets/voice-lines/fe5cba3347aea789a69a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/fe5cba3347aea789a69a..text: 在我面前，你不用替所有人把气氛撑起来。

assets/voice-lines/db9e26aa5db7aa9572c2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/db9e26aa5db7aa9572c2..text: 以后有第一排的位置，也记得叫我。

assets/voice-lines/e1837cf9111247186813..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e1837cf9111247186813..text: 你可以用最舒服的方式说，我会听。

assets/voice-lines/04d8269c0463919b6a30..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/04d8269c0463919b6a30..text: 想。不是每个故事都需要变成作品。

assets/voice-lines/0c65ec255c61372e67e3..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0c65ec255c61372e67e3..text: 不用留下特别大的纪念，像这样就很好。

assets/voice-lines/b84b4aae64e0c8ea1434..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b84b4aae64e0c8ea1434..text: 先喝一口热的。邮件不会在一分钟里消失。

assets/voice-lines/4a8936e8ae28a8d614ca..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4a8936e8ae28a8d614ca..text: 职业不会把人变成一块不会疲惫的电池。

assets/voice-lines/e05a7f89d09403d38a0c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e05a7f89d09403d38a0c..text: 因为你现在可以只休息。答案等精神好一点再想。

assets/voice-lines/5dd57b444f258d356f36..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5dd57b444f258d356f36..text: 我觉得很像没有把心事收进工作里的你。

assets/voice-lines/2ca6cd6778573b9db7ef..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2ca6cd6778573b9db7ef..text: 可以。没有新闻价值的那些，也算。

assets/voice-lines/5e87613cdb7bbae0980e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5e87613cdb7bbae0980e..text: 那今天我只当一位认真等待的客人。

assets/voice-lines/8672d065543e6de2807c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8672d065543e6de2807c..text: 现在有人一起看着，总不会让你一个人着急。

assets/voice-lines/f6fc4c3f99b76fb81c20..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f6fc4c3f99b76fb81c20..text: 告诉你真实的口味，会不会让你失望？

assets/voice-lines/445656e8b7d1474368ad..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/445656e8b7d1474368ad..text: 刚好。谢谢你愿意听我说哪里不合适。

assets/voice-lines/eb3696ded13aa9e4badd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/eb3696ded13aa9e4badd..text: 如果哪天想喝更甜的，也可以改吗？

assets/voice-lines/0e9566e79f366d8ac617..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0e9566e79f366d8ac617..text: 你认真对待的事，我也想认真回答。

assets/voice-lines/97a066d5dbaf06c18c57..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/97a066d5dbaf06c18c57..text: 我想和你一起吃，也想把你喜欢的那一半留给你。

assets/voice-lines/478958ba6478017a82da..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/478958ba6478017a82da..text: 那我明天也来。可以带自己的杯子吗？

assets/voice-lines/59816918be4a722a9630..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/59816918be4a722a9630..text: 我知道你在工作。现在的这把椅子，是留给我的吗？

assets/voice-lines/fe70e7de41776f136a8c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/fe70e7de41776f136a8c..text: 不用。和你一起安静着，也算好好见面。

assets/voice-lines/c54e2210cbff67c67fa0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c54e2210cbff67c67fa0..text: 先告诉他们你已经安全躲雨，再慢慢处理，好吗？

assets/voice-lines/5e918b61ea16bf954f18..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5e918b61ea16bf954f18..text: 我不知道每个人会怎样，但我今天想见的是你。

assets/voice-lines/008a088b89b301f69e8f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/008a088b89b301f69e8f..text: 每天固定拍十秒，把等待也留在片子里。

assets/voice-lines/090fccad12f1d22ff738..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/090fccad12f1d22ff738..text: 先听听你的想法，我们一起调整拍法。

assets/voice-lines/f9a0837dc8e96c8fd19f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f9a0837dc8e96c8fd19f..text: 先停下风扇，录屋檐和叶面各自的雨声。

assets/voice-lines/ae7e46b89400d2ea5ee8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ae7e46b89400d2ea5ee8..text: 拍下缺角，再让种花的人讲它怎样活下来。

assets/voice-lines/e658d2d0d34ff7c387b4..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e658d2d0d34ff7c387b4..text: 申请留下固定机位，两个人到门外等结果。

assets/voice-lines/369b9010534b7dbcd084..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/369b9010534b7dbcd084..text: 做一份纸质照片册，再附上可以离线播放的短片。

assets/voice-lines/ba6dd09af00a866b260b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ba6dd09af00a866b260b..text: 先记录窗框的旧刻痕，再请住户一起确认方案。

assets/voice-lines/baf942fe0daac4e2f734..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/baf942fe0daac4e2f734..text: 分时记录采光，并拍清楚扶手和台阶的修缮点。

assets/voice-lines/930aad0249a42e7d1077..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/930aad0249a42e7d1077..text: 把不同人的行走路线叠到同一张图上。

assets/voice-lines/7a746e849236eb4f1ee5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7a746e849236eb4f1ee5..text: 请轮椅使用者实地体验，再用镜头记录转弯半径。

assets/voice-lines/18839ba21831acca5a59..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/18839ba21831acca5a59..text: 先做轻量样段，逐项拍下承重和排水测试。

assets/voice-lines/20411d4c211dde643fc9..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/20411d4c211dde643fc9..text: 把修改稿与最终画面并排剪进片子。

assets/voice-lines/6cba1771a5b827e8722b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6cba1771a5b827e8722b..text: 留下风声作引子，再换到背风面录主旋律。

assets/voice-lines/968fda864fc414338e6e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/968fda864fc414338e6e..text: 先录每个人的节奏，再让不同的拍子相互呼应。

assets/voice-lines/62261ef6f31c1891cbf0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/62261ef6f31c1891cbf0..text: 把短短的旋律唱出来，征求听众线索。

assets/voice-lines/9e85639bc7eb049f83c7..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/9e85639bc7eb049f83c7..text: 先确认安全，再用无扩音的小合唱等待雨停。

assets/voice-lines/8a854e027c7eb9d72bb7..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8a854e027c7eb9d72bb7..text: 只展示她愿意说的修改，让每次取舍都有声音。

assets/voice-lines/93f29c57829d17841c2c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/93f29c57829d17841c2c..text: 保留今天的版本，并把下一段留给以后的作品。

assets/voice-lines/68d7755a9b853513df74..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/68d7755a9b853513df74..text: 先关机聊天，等对方愿意再开始正式记录。

assets/voice-lines/298d9b65d5e64c4e847e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/298d9b65d5e64c4e847e..text: 分别记录记忆，再用门牌和旧报纸交叉核对。

assets/voice-lines/f968d7424afeac99ae6d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f968d7424afeac99ae6d..text: 把采访拆成两次，今天只拍他熟悉的回家路。

assets/voice-lines/657421df3793d0865c1c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/657421df3793d0865c1c..text: 明确发布更正，并请店主确认修订后的内容。

assets/voice-lines/a2ce55abbcbad1b1296a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a2ce55abbcbad1b1296a..text: 只拍经过同意的手部和物件，删掉可定位的远景。

assets/voice-lines/7e27d056d886e85df9a1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7e27d056d886e85df9a1..text: 做一份完整片尾，并把采访授权逐项归档。

assets/voice-lines/7e54d592a361cb5b94c0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7e54d592a361cb5b94c0..text: 让摄影机等面团，先拍准备和称量的细节。

assets/voice-lines/113b324a49596489bce3..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/113b324a49596489bce3..text: 记录每种口味的理由，不急着选出唯一的最好。

assets/voice-lines/f8a13cdab1f363698892..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f8a13cdab1f363698892..text: 把缺口变成小路，让装饰沿着它继续生长。

assets/voice-lines/3d2003a5ccde9bb511c5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/3d2003a5ccde9bb511c5..text: 先请顾客确认医嘱，只记录合适的备料方案。

assets/voice-lines/aeac0f4762c6ead20c0a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/aeac0f4762c6ead20c0a..text: 让奶奶一边做一边解释，再把实际用量记下来。

assets/voice-lines/73741011b15ea2669e87..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/73741011b15ea2669e87..text: 把收拾柜台的日常也留下，然后坐下来一起试映。

assets/voice-lines/8f228c40e78a3de0b697..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8f228c40e78a3de0b697..text: 保留一个反打机位，让观众知道画面怎样完成。

assets/voice-lines/c02f9b4cea6c038b0aef..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c02f9b4cea6c038b0aef..text: 先按自己的节奏拍完，再给观众选择停留的时间。

assets/voice-lines/2e2dd59c1c6b3d60b736..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2e2dd59c1c6b3d60b736..text: 今天先把「街角长镜头」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/779ad79ff2f32799b08f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/779ad79ff2f32799b08f..text: 如实说明天气，把等待中的声音与小事拍给观众。

assets/voice-lines/679e6e0bea718c5f1a24..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/679e6e0bea718c5f1a24..text: 让她决定展示范围，只比较色彩和光线的变化。

assets/voice-lines/90e675265455c8357695..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/90e675265455c8357695..text: 保存本地录像，吃完饭再补一段说明。

assets/voice-lines/fbb909d939d062f6b180..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/fbb909d939d062f6b180..text: 让公开片子停在关灯前，之后的时间留给两个人。

assets/voice-lines/eb014faf926242dfb6c8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/eb014faf926242dfb6c8..text: 我想和你一起，把这件小事认真过完。

assets/voice-lines/596ee971cd69cbb758e0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/596ee971cd69cbb758e0..text: 我先把手边的事做好，晚一点来找你。

assets/voice-lines/283dfee724f2a13f0676..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/283dfee724f2a13f0676..text: 她指了指花园的小径和温室里的长椅。

assets/voice-lines/3adac177f876b1f0ab3c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/3adac177f876b1f0ab3c..text: 好。到时让我认一认今天种下的花。

assets/voice-lines/3983aef2a1e354179cca..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/3983aef2a1e354179cca..text: 没关系。下次先一起收拾，我们就不着急了。

assets/voice-lines/ac68395b306a4110ab5d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ac68395b306a4110ab5d..text: 那今天先一起照顾它们。野餐留给下一次。

assets/voice-lines/a329dedd014b6e093265..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a329dedd014b6e093265..text: 那就从最容易照顾的开始，我还有很多要学。

assets/voice-lines/5ef48c06b17bcaea0ec0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5ef48c06b17bcaea0ec0..text: 好。这一栏先空着，留给我们下次一起写。

assets/voice-lines/de47a03f8118ce279406..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/de47a03f8118ce279406..text: 那我们下次一起投进去。今天先去吃热饭。

assets/voice-lines/ca06a811968d24ada402..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ca06a811968d24ada402..text: 她停在一间旧书店前，说橱窗和记忆里不太一样。

assets/voice-lines/7add6bee05e129888463..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7add6bee05e129888463..text: 以后路过这里，我们就有一幅自己的记忆了。

assets/voice-lines/e786769d71b96ff5ae61..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e786769d71b96ff5ae61..text: 下次第一站就来这里。我陪你把那段回忆找回来。

assets/voice-lines/a79adb48e9f894dcd177..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a79adb48e9f894dcd177..text: 可是这段路已经很好了，余下的留给下次。

assets/voice-lines/882940103814fa03cb34..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/882940103814fa03cb34..text: 那今天我先坐下来，陪你把这一页翻过去。

assets/voice-lines/2a955737a0b1d331002c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2a955737a0b1d331002c..text: 那就把我的座位，也一直留在旁边。

assets/voice-lines/9538526b647b47916652..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/9538526b647b47916652..text: 我也会记得，每次出门都好好说再见。

assets/voice-lines/f7b287eae0b3f5403b24..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f7b287eae0b3f5403b24..text: 她想先听一首陌生的歌，却不知道名字。

assets/voice-lines/89d0956e4c536af16dbd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/89d0956e4c536af16dbd..text: 没有关系，今天的最后一首由你来选。

assets/voice-lines/59a82997d591dcbbde6b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/59a82997d591dcbbde6b..text: 下次不赶排行榜，我们一起去找它。

assets/voice-lines/97efd448b419fd44978b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/97efd448b419fd44978b..text: 剩下的一半，下次留两个位置就好。

assets/voice-lines/a0d66217118f236b5330..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a0d66217118f236b5330..text: 好。下次见面，我把今天的节奏带来。

assets/voice-lines/1dacbe67a3c07f59ccf8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/1dacbe67a3c07f59ccf8..text: 我们先回家，把剩下的一小节慢慢写完。

assets/voice-lines/8a7a9193a8f01e443f65..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8a7a9193a8f01e443f65..text: 她问，如果是我们一起出发，会在空白页上写什么。

assets/voice-lines/18f1ceb656acb3440f7b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/18f1ceb656acb3440f7b..text: 留给我们，哪天真的出发时再翻开。

assets/voice-lines/cd9bd02b1bb5fca9d693..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/cd9bd02b1bb5fca9d693..text: 那今天先听你的，不用替别人写结尾。

assets/voice-lines/9bfc926d26c5caedcc4f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/9bfc926d26c5caedcc4f..text: 好。下次仍然约在这里，从这一页开始。

assets/voice-lines/7617f27560b33005688d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7617f27560b33005688d..text: 好，我们各留一份，偶尔拿出来看看。

assets/voice-lines/7c62629cfe9d5ed31471..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7c62629cfe9d5ed31471..text: 那从刚才那扇门开始，我们慢慢写。

assets/voice-lines/86eccc9be9de911db8fb..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/86eccc9be9de911db8fb..text: 出门前，她又看了一眼没有写完的新配方。

assets/voice-lines/97cebaaa9f7a383bb4ee..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/97cebaaa9f7a383bb4ee..text: 是什么？两个人、一块蛋糕，还有一整个下午？

assets/voice-lines/3b5e016ce6e3e0a127ba..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/3b5e016ce6e3e0a127ba..text: 今天没有订单。你喜欢怎样，就怎样。

assets/voice-lines/1973238771ce43af9d4e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/1973238771ce43af9d4e..text: 下次我先把篮子准备好，陪你真正放个假。

assets/voice-lines/91aa8090667f23d133b1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/91aa8090667f23d133b1..text: 谢谢。下次我们一起把整个下午打包带走。

assets/voice-lines/0363dd566a017b1b50dd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0363dd566a017b1b50dd..text: 这份配方不用打分，照着过就很好。

assets/voice-lines/d30860c44af36411681b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d30860c44af36411681b..text: 她问要不要把配方里的克数写得更清楚。

assets/voice-lines/4c480833ce623e1abca6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4c480833ce623e1abca6..text: 我会把这张食谱收好，等下一个休息日。

assets/voice-lines/9247b0540b485cbe5983..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/9247b0540b485cbe5983..text: 明天再来。今天我们先把这两颗糖分完。

assets/voice-lines/b39cc43cf2e1837ef756..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b39cc43cf2e1837ef756..text: 她看见一片很适合拍开场的草地，脚步停了一下。

assets/voice-lines/78ed41fb54f5a5c48aef..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/78ed41fb54f5a5c48aef..text: 她问这段没有录像的时间，应该怎样留下。

assets/voice-lines/de7a105a708cd0213046..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/de7a105a708cd0213046..text: 对。它已经在我们两个的记忆里了。

assets/voice-lines/ef47eddedddaa789f15d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ef47eddedddaa789f15d..text: 因为每一张，都是我们今天的样子。

assets/voice-lines/b0bbbd451470b56d97c8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b0bbbd451470b56d97c8..text: 下次我帮你背相机，你就只负责看云。

assets/voice-lines/894181df7ee59e7490f7..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/894181df7ee59e7490f7..text: 还好我们没有把下一次约定也剪掉。

assets/voice-lines/441b7043f9954373923a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/441b7043f9954373923a..text: 那我再说一遍。今天也很想见到你。

assets/voice-lines/51fc669a381050d4142c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/51fc669a381050d4142c..text: 下一张，等我们下次一起出门时再拍。

assets/voice-lines/1f0d90e364d8f69f28f3..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/1f0d90e364d8f69f28f3..text: 我收到了。还没等邮车出发，就已经收到了。

assets/voice-lines/ba0a0625a4f8303ea0e1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ba0a0625a4f8303ea0e1..text: 那就慢慢写。我在这里，等你想到想说的话。

assets/voice-lines/d39082047065b8f659f8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d39082047065b8f659f8..text: 我愿意。那天不带摄像机，把时间留给你。

assets/voice-lines/0f04263e1d91b2d8c084..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0f04263e1d91b2d8c084..text: 我想让今晚成为我们两个人的记忆。

assets/voice-lines/ebd15f9a4c969d5d4242..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ebd15f9a4c969d5d4242..text: 那以后晚一点回来的时候，我也会提前告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/750db27d7aec2e2ec203..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/750db27d7aec2e2ec203..text: 明年花展，也把旁边的位置留给我。

assets/voice-lines/6e9daf988c71b8ab6f54..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6e9daf988c71b8ab6f54..text: 这里的两把椅子，为什么朝着同一扇窗？

assets/voice-lines/663129dca643c507b142..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/663129dca643c507b142..text: 可以。走到哪里，哪里就是今晚的安排。

assets/voice-lines/b4ea01c60b362217d7e8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b4ea01c60b362217d7e8..text: 我会听到最后，连休止符也不漏掉。

assets/voice-lines/43e5e0443e5848d56a33..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/43e5e0443e5848d56a33..text: 你也可以不用重来。刚才那个停顿，我很喜欢。

assets/voice-lines/e649c2df8314af5ceef5..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e649c2df8314af5ceef5..text: 你想起什么就说什么，我也可以先讲我的一天。

assets/voice-lines/afe615c783781bbb628b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/afe615c783781bbb628b..text: 我想写下来的，不是一个漂亮标题。

assets/voice-lines/0bd6455baeeba7d8ca95..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0bd6455baeeba7d8ca95..text: 我只是想多站一会儿。这样的你，我想慢慢认识。

assets/voice-lines/b06ce255675769c32f04..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b06ce255675769c32f04..text: 下一次遇见难题，我们再一起走一段。

assets/voice-lines/61fc8dd2662eb46be136..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/61fc8dd2662eb46be136..text: 那先把请柬给我。饼干也留着，两样我都收。

assets/voice-lines/abf06334a236324c4735..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/abf06334a236324c4735..text: 因为今天你也可以期待被好好照顾。

assets/voice-lines/30b26975384d7d0c403b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/30b26975384d7d0c403b..text: 当然。走错了，就当作只有我们知道的舞步。

assets/voice-lines/e16d93720f282235a10e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e16d93720f282235a10e..text: 也把你算进去。今天我想和你分同样大的一份。

assets/voice-lines/a856e0eca9d9c38f76f9..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a856e0eca9d9c38f76f9..text: 明天早上的第一块面包，还是一起吃吧。

assets/voice-lines/e16e7c34f0dc1c2d02e2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e16e7c34f0dc1c2d02e2..text: 你不用变成镜头里最会说话的样子。

assets/voice-lines/868ff3d439d8755d27a6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/868ff3d439d8755d27a6..text: 我想把今晚留好，也想先听听你的意思。

assets/voice-lines/6bb9d343032fa3642d59..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6bb9d343032fa3642d59..text: 以后关机的时候，也给我发一句到家了。

assets/voice-lines/806d5626589c0e31f051..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/806d5626589c0e31f051..text: 采访暂停。我也有一个问题想问你：午饭想吃什么？

assets/voice-lines/85cecb88a0fe5a40ca28..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/85cecb88a0fe5a40ca28..text: 这个表情不能刊登。我只想自己留着。

assets/voice-lines/f10bc7210e662eba4f86..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f10bc7210e662eba4f86..text: 嗯？这是你的采访方式吗？那我可要认真回答了。

assets/voice-lines/9c7b2a25dae1e14efeac..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/9c7b2a25dae1e14efeac..text: 所有问题都可以晚一点回答。手先给我。

assets/voice-lines/ffd1ffaad39b39b94c56..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ffd1ffaad39b39b94c56..text: 嗯，我听见了。先忙吧，这里的安静也是给你的。

assets/voice-lines/0cfecd756f201a87b282..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/0cfecd756f201a87b282..text: 第一条采访原则就合格了。现在，我有一点期待。

assets/voice-lines/7226f4d76c7cc5c3da5c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7226f4d76c7cc5c3da5c..text: 采访取消了，编辑却又补来三条修改意见。

assets/voice-lines/f17d9855e043200fe9ca..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f17d9855e043200fe9ca..text: 你连我想一口气做完所有事的习惯都看出来了。

assets/voice-lines/59d5b28dc896c7e85567..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/59d5b28dc896c7e85567..text: 我总觉得，既然做了记者，就不应该说累。

assets/voice-lines/0ab646ae8c56d380f896..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/0ab646ae8c56d380f896..text: 我想什么都不安排。我们就听听雨，可以吗？

assets/voice-lines/60c908f413230ce57186..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/60c908f413230ce57186..text: 可我一直不知道，能对谁承认这一句。

assets/voice-lines/6bd64daa1ac4e03d2a26..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/6bd64daa1ac4e03d2a26..text: 那借我一会儿安静。最好，你也在。

assets/voice-lines/18b03f579351a562ae3d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/18b03f579351a562ae3d..text: 今天有点累，但和你待着，很安心。

assets/voice-lines/53880e1cad8202653f90..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/53880e1cad8202653f90..text: 今天的采访都结束了。现在，我想和你去广场走走。

assets/voice-lines/79db0db695b025f82985..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/79db0db695b025f82985..text: 不带。今晚只记得我们听见的声音。

assets/voice-lines/f5888be559ed407fb19a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f5888be559ed407fb19a..text: 我写过那么多人，轮到这一个名字，反而想了很久。

assets/voice-lines/f788df14007b70606f6c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f788df14007b70606f6c..text: 原来我们都不是单方面在记。那以后，交换着看吧。

assets/voice-lines/26ff8ea1f2a8238b79f0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/26ff8ea1f2a8238b79f0..text: 在想，会不会只写一个名字，就已经太明显。

assets/voice-lines/ee157adfa673141d7fb8..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ee157adfa673141d7fb8..text: 你觉得这句话，会不会太不像我的风格？

assets/voice-lines/20b9a44c9b2e4627fd89..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/20b9a44c9b2e4627fd89..text: 那就让它留在这里。我今天不想删改。

assets/voice-lines/f236a80da7fd4b20eae7..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f236a80da7fd4b20eae7..text: 以后普通的日子，也可以一起记吗？

assets/voice-lines/f2a7d270563fd7b41e5c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f2a7d270563fd7b41e5c..text: 受访者怕自己说错话，不肯坐到镜头前。

assets/voice-lines/322d510cc6efb69d2cac..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/322d510cc6efb69d2cac..text: 那就按我们商量的办法，试着拍下来吧。

assets/voice-lines/2e011aa515905741e5f0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/2e011aa515905741e5f0..text: 好的开场，有时候是先把水递过去。

assets/voice-lines/4c260119ab1a071488f0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4c260119ab1a071488f0..text: 几位邻居对照片中的店铺记忆不同。

assets/voice-lines/36d93c18af8413e3a8ca..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/36d93c18af8413e3a8ca..text: 记忆可以不同，核实的过程也值得被看见。

assets/voice-lines/47447d8d23e57b98545e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/47447d8d23e57b98545e..text: 节目组到得太晚，司机已经十分疲惫。

assets/voice-lines/4f0a6d838ac81d457133..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4f0a6d838ac81d457133..text: 新闻不该让一个辛苦的人再多撑一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/7c6c054c87bec8dff827..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7c6c054c87bec8dff827..text: 有人提议悄悄换文件，免得观众注意。

assets/voice-lines/c15a2b827371cc8f4037..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c15a2b827371cc8f4037..text: 我们不保证永不出错，但可以保证认真改正。

assets/voice-lines/5e15285b5a82619a73d9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/5e15285b5a82619a73d9..text: 镜头越是靠近，越可能暴露对方的住处。

assets/voice-lines/eff78a23a2b45797bc29..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/eff78a23a2b45797bc29..text: 有时候，最好的记录是替一个人守住边界。

assets/voice-lines/920da3274bd582c9980d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/920da3274bd582c9980d..text: 版面有限，有人的贡献可能只剩一个泛称。

assets/voice-lines/f278b0083202412d5dd4..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f278b0083202412d5dd4..text: 下一页还有很多人，也还有我想听你说的话。

assets/voice-lines/c9b7dfb7aa0c2157cfa5..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c9b7dfb7aa0c2157cfa5..text: 我是苏晚。今天忘了把采访授权的副本交给你。

assets/voice-lines/16ece82ccd152a4c118d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/16ece82ccd152a4c118d..text: 电子版已经发过去，纸质的我会好好留着。

assets/voice-lines/3937a4aea123876f1114..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/3937a4aea123876f1114..text: 好，我把采访本留在家里，今天只带自己来。

assets/voice-lines/c30a11d36d38323defb9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c30a11d36d38323defb9..text: 记下了。但你不用把每一分钟都解释给我听。

assets/voice-lines/3942635b68acccc9dbe7..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/3942635b68acccc9dbe7..text: 另外，今天的聊天很愉快。这句不用写进备注。

assets/voice-lines/a2d8f73a648dcfec892f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a2d8f73a648dcfec892f..text: 稿件终于发出去了，手机安静得有点不习惯。

assets/voice-lines/d43a1a67b2939828e3f5..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d43a1a67b2939828e3f5..text: 我原本想再检查一次，却先打开了你的对话框。

assets/voice-lines/9d5ce70c59e5ee1fdf60..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/9d5ce70c59e5ee1fdf60..text: 今天不问工作，问问你晚饭吃了什么。

assets/voice-lines/82e3a0fa1cf1abd68a8a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/82e3a0fa1cf1abd68a8a..text: 下一次我们见面，可不可以都不带工作本？

assets/voice-lines/3a9e1c406d0b7b627323..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/3a9e1c406d0b7b627323..text: 现在方便接电话吗？有件小事想亲口告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/1f8cb9d7ef3991d2249d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1f8cb9d7ef3991d2249d..text: 寄信时，风把信封吹到了你站过的台阶。

assets/voice-lines/ec4994be9b3f79878150..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ec4994be9b3f79878150..text: 幸好，有些迟一点的心意仍然来得及。

assets/voice-lines/615b93bf9dbf61eb41ca..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/615b93bf9dbf61eb41ca..text: 你也可以说得零零碎碎，我不会替你写总结。

assets/voice-lines/87449e266f5331f1eae3..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/87449e266f5331f1eae3..text: 那今天先到这里。晚安，明天再见。

assets/voice-lines/b3167fc6879f25cb5006..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/b3167fc6879f25cb5006..text: 编辑给稿子起了一个很响亮的标题。

assets/voice-lines/0d0a16b8b767794aacb3..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/0d0a16b8b767794aacb3..text: 我却更喜欢采访里那句平平常常的明天见。

assets/voice-lines/ab11591be29e1c9f87cd..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ab11591be29e1c9f87cd..text: 下班后，想听听你今天最普通的一件事。

assets/voice-lines/b5c9b0685d3a201d3ef0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/b5c9b0685d3a201d3ef0..text: 原来你也去过那间凌晨还开门的面馆。

assets/voice-lines/4fecbec8de2ddfc572c2..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4fecbec8de2ddfc572c2..text: 受访者却说很喜欢，像把当时的屋檐一起留下了。

assets/voice-lines/b3f099066de978d2eaf6..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/b3f099066de978d2eaf6..text: 刚刚又想起了那天的事，想打给你。

assets/voice-lines/bb40c7708610b5e0b958..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/bb40c7708610b5e0b958..text: 今天写了很多字，却只有这两个字不需要修改。

assets/voice-lines/296ea4b701f78fac0366..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/296ea4b701f78fac0366..text: 字迹明明很好认，我还是把它当成了秘密。

assets/voice-lines/264a8006b44044b631b6..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/264a8006b44044b631b6..text: 等见面时，再问问那位不愿署名的先生。

assets/voice-lines/4eb3ca9b16ca696f3121..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4eb3ca9b16ca696f3121..text: 今天可以先不做记者，只和你聊聊吗？

assets/voice-lines/f649dfdaa6e7cc879d11..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f649dfdaa6e7cc879d11..text: 轮到你问我累不累时，我却不知道怎么回答。

assets/voice-lines/eef072b09503f46afcc5..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/eef072b09503f46afcc5..text: 读到一页很好的句子，我停了好久。

assets/voice-lines/87ac97a1cdb4895f9733..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/87ac97a1cdb4895f9733..text: 不是不懂，是想知道如果你在，会在哪里停顿。

assets/voice-lines/c273eb4631b01c4c3d53..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c273eb4631b01c4c3d53..text: 想给我们的故事，也留一点这样的痕迹。

assets/voice-lines/d5e10680172a6577de2f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d5e10680172a6577de2f..text: 它不影响任何事实，却让那个下午变得很近。

assets/voice-lines/563180e9026c74ad2ba6..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/563180e9026c74ad2ba6..text: 今天遇到一个不愿意被简单定义的人。

assets/voice-lines/823f2b4cbf04866826e5..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/823f2b4cbf04866826e5..text: 你也不用每次都给我一个漂亮答案。

assets/voice-lines/e6c1adbc88bf818e94ce..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/e6c1adbc88bf818e94ce..text: 我删掉了采访里最漂亮的总结，留下他的原话。

assets/voice-lines/cecf9567987aaf00adc6..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/cecf9567987aaf00adc6..text: 它只露出头版的一角，看起来很会挑新闻。

assets/voice-lines/2e3cd55c58df5cd11788..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/2e3cd55c58df5cd11788..text: 今天想留一些没有工作通知的时间。

assets/voice-lines/d07b1954e5bc1c8e363a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d07b1954e5bc1c8e363a..text: 如果你有空，我们沿着河边走一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/89e140e9e469265cf38f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/89e140e9e469265cf38f..text: 旧剪报旁边，现在多了一张新的便签。

assets/voice-lines/92b79ddf1d6fb45f3ffb..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/92b79ddf1d6fb45f3ffb..text: 有空来书店吗？今天换我慢慢说给你听。

assets/voice-lines/749b7a94207371670c9a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/749b7a94207371670c9a..text: 这次上面不是采访问题，是我想告诉你的事。

assets/voice-lines/7e5f36cb8e2d388a66bd..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7e5f36cb8e2d388a66bd..text: 有些答案可以晚一点，有些人值得多等一班车。

assets/voice-lines/46b63e312dcca93741cd..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/46b63e312dcca93741cd..text: 我没有写新闻题目，只写了见你的日期。

assets/voice-lines/b178add323544c83fbe2..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/b178add323544c83fbe2..text: 下午的采访结束了。窗边那杯茶，想等你一起喝。

assets/voice-lines/f61dff6320309a1f0eb2..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f61dff6320309a1f0eb2..text: 今天的采访本是空的，心里却存了很多句子。

assets/voice-lines/122258b6cb642627f28a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/122258b6cb642627f28a..text: 原来被人认真问一问，也会舍不得太快结束。

assets/voice-lines/2c4a7cfda432fa5b292b..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/2c4a7cfda432fa5b292b..text: 你问的最后那个问题，下次见面再答。

assets/voice-lines/289081f1021ac1490fd7..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/289081f1021ac1490fd7..text: 旧书放回架子上了，便签我留了一张。

assets/voice-lines/361f61823b471bb1dc87..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/361f61823b471bb1dc87..text: 你问我累不累的时候，我其实很想点头。

assets/voice-lines/894300636ebe5c1a0dce..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/894300636ebe5c1a0dce..text: 今天的稿件已经归档，手账还摊在桌上。

assets/voice-lines/1747ce7bde05a7dd9723..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1747ce7bde05a7dd9723..text: 这次的首映，我会带着采访本坐在台下。

assets/voice-lines/25476feb1e55019b3934..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/25476feb1e55019b3934..text: 今天收工以后，受访者送了我们一篮橘子。

assets/voice-lines/45d52e1d10ac4eeb8890..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/45d52e1d10ac4eeb8890..text: 我把最甜的两个留在桌上。你来时，我们不谈工作。

assets/voice-lines/09156dcef9a4bb0d4a0f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/09156dcef9a4bb0d4a0f..text: 旧照片背面的名字终于核对清楚了。

assets/voice-lines/2e2d0c6d6196b6bd46f7..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/2e2d0c6d6196b6bd46f7..text: 采访超时了十分钟，但我很庆幸没有打断。

assets/voice-lines/681c6ad73810ec77a5a0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/681c6ad73810ec77a5a0..text: 我把稿件里一句太笃定的话改掉了。

assets/voice-lines/2b91d2f406b2e25fc8d5..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/2b91d2f406b2e25fc8d5..text: 这次没有标准答案，我们可以慢一点。

assets/voice-lines/453f730ae464709c2963..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/453f730ae464709c2963..text: 这句很适合你，认真照顾每个普通的时刻。

assets/voice-lines/11505125ea562af7e620..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/11505125ea562af7e620..text: 那你得提醒我，别又拿起手机记采访提纲。

assets/voice-lines/e84d9f296e7225936a72..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/e84d9f296e7225936a72..text: 原来不提问，也能得到很好的回答。

assets/voice-lines/9d3fe1fd655ed5a90ee6..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/9d3fe1fd655ed5a90ee6..text: 你查吧，我再看看书页里有没有别的线索。

assets/voice-lines/0647f0beb7debd663954..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/0647f0beb7debd663954..text: 有些故事只能由经历它的人慢慢讲。

assets/voice-lines/cb8d1a7f5775a053bb5e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/cb8d1a7f5775a053bb5e..text: 想记住的事？比如你刚才替我扶住了会回弹的门。

assets/voice-lines/643f2020ca2eab1cb038..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/643f2020ca2eab1cb038..text: 嗯，这是写给你的，不需要别人的批准。

assets/voice-lines/8d1d40dc363b3fbfa720..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/8d1d40dc363b3fbfa720..text: 平时总替别人记录，今天终于写了自己。

assets/voice-lines/e4f56ee6014de643672d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/e4f56ee6014de643672d..text: 我喜欢这个暗号，不必放进报道的注释里。

assets/voice-lines/9119ef26231e88fd1af0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/9119ef26231e88fd1af0..text: 标题我倒是很擅长。只是这一次，不是给读者看的。

assets/voice-lines/a568a7316a9fe7bd98d8..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a568a7316a9fe7bd98d8..text: 这一页可以重写，感受不用排版得太整齐。

assets/voice-lines/33b7d5a8be99d5160a12..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/33b7d5a8be99d5160a12..text: 没寄出也没关系，今天已经说给你听了。

assets/voice-lines/a6827d67f3c50a6b8a78..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a6827d67f3c50a6b8a78..text: 我说当然算，故事写完并不等于人就停在那里。

assets/voice-lines/4507987b1e51c5e0083f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4507987b1e51c5e0083f..text: 说完这句话，我忽然很想给你发消息。

assets/voice-lines/17f027527a178e24dec1..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/17f027527a178e24dec1..text: 你在厨房找杯子，我在桌边把眼镜摘下来。

assets/voice-lines/31e24a0f693435e1a80e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/31e24a0f693435e1a80e..text: 谁都没有说什么特别值得记下的话，可我很喜欢。

assets/voice-lines/94a72fd354bf20c9f74a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/94a72fd354bf20c9f74a..text: 今天就不急着把这些整理成一个好听的结尾了。

assets/voice-lines/c1628a9b374022b2c040..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c1628a9b374022b2c040..text: 我们之间没有截稿时间，明天还可以接着聊。

assets/voice-lines/d56930343cc561e1f3a3..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d56930343cc561e1f3a3..text: 我带回来的那本旧书，里面夹了一张车票。

assets/voice-lines/e61ee11bd87c2ed33af0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/e61ee11bd87c2ed33af0..text: 日期很旧，背面只写着，记得买面包。

assets/voice-lines/dc52a54b473fdb6cf604..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/dc52a54b473fdb6cf604..text: 我本来想查一查那天发生过什么大新闻。

assets/voice-lines/8fa773192722c7ad7666..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/8fa773192722c7ad7666..text: 生活不是只有值得刊登的那一面，才算被认真过过。

assets/voice-lines/f6c7934ac0f8af370bc9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f6c7934ac0f8af370bc9..text: 像你刚才替我把书签夹好，就已经把今晚留住了。

assets/voice-lines/8bc4b17ea32d89de86ae..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/8bc4b17ea32d89de86ae..text: 不用再读一章来证明今天没有白费。

assets/voice-lines/418444634ee250d6f8bb..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/418444634ee250d6f8bb..text: 我以前写稿，会很仔细地把自己的感受删掉。

assets/voice-lines/6749e3034aefb27dcce0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/6749e3034aefb27dcce0..text: 怕多写一个我，故事就不够客观了。

assets/voice-lines/052b962514dbf2e91a95..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/052b962514dbf2e91a95..text: 你不用为了出现在我的故事里，特意做一件大事。

assets/voice-lines/1c408e889f619d811d27..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1c408e889f619d811d27..text: 像现在这样待在旁边，我就已经有好多话想写。

assets/voice-lines/586226654372da893ba6..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/586226654372da893ba6..text: 不过今晚先不写了。这个句子，我想用晚安来收尾。

assets/voice-lines/33a626827e07818a8890..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/33a626827e07818a8890..text: 新闻留到明天。现在没有谁需要把心事说得有条理。

assets/voice-lines/28547cf2462d5f9c0836..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/28547cf2462d5f9c0836..text: 你的沉默不会错过截止时间，我可以慢慢等。

assets/voice-lines/a18c6d2a702c48c0ad75..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a18c6d2a702c48c0ad75..text: 被你这样看着，记者也会突然忘记下一句。

assets/voice-lines/4b47db16c2115b055b83..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4b47db16c2115b055b83..text: 这一句不用录音。我握住，就记住了。

assets/voice-lines/609acc924a20d810a3f1..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/609acc924a20d810a3f1..text: 谢谢。你照顾人的时候，总比任何采访稿都具体。

assets/voice-lines/bbfdb33d19d12b5f733d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/bbfdb33d19d12b5f733d..text: 现在有人愿意听完，过去好像也没有那么难开口了。

assets/voice-lines/c4efc7033bacc55577e4..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c4efc7033bacc55577e4..text: 今天我想写一点不能刊登的内容。收件人只有你。

assets/voice-lines/fe33d7422c2b32781c4c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/fe33d7422c2b32781c4c..text: 原来不准备问题，也可以见一个人。我还在适应。

assets/voice-lines/6477b266d70ff932c075..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/6477b266d70ff932c075..text: 那我先听。今天想把主角的位置让给你。

assets/voice-lines/7a0f66c24ca93add7118..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7a0f66c24ca93add7118..text: 这一次，能不能请你在上面写一句和工作无关的话？

assets/voice-lines/605c90df1bee6dc36bc5..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/605c90df1bee6dc36bc5..text: 好。世界有很多答案，我先认真记住你。

assets/voice-lines/f19809ccc8e6fd5d8ee9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f19809ccc8e6fd5d8ee9..text: 她给了这句平常话，比任何标题都认真的位置。

assets/voice-lines/8e5aedc0291389b58f96..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/8e5aedc0291389b58f96..text: 有人愿意听完整的她，就已经足够。

assets/voice-lines/291545ecd6011d477910..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/291545ecd6011d477910..text: 今天听了太多人的故事，脑子有点拥挤。

assets/voice-lines/72f228a91ddaf2a5626c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/72f228a91ddaf2a5626c..text: 早安！今天先拍一张不发出去的照片，只留给我们。

assets/voice-lines/d2a26a752c213fc26b0e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d2a26a752c213fc26b0e..text: 直播结束啦。下一段时间，是我留给你的午休。

assets/voice-lines/cc9d14fce06aa8fe22a7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/cc9d14fce06aa8fe22a7..text: 夕阳特别好看。镜头已经收起来了，想直接和你看。

assets/voice-lines/44987135efc40a6ead3f..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/44987135efc40a6ead3f..text: 镜头外面，你也一直这么看着我吗？

assets/voice-lines/b2b8b40b46dca3d9f3b5..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/b2b8b40b46dca3d9f3b5..text: 直播间有很多人，但这只手，是专门伸给你的。

assets/voice-lines/d84e8c61ddc319936d6c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d84e8c61ddc319936d6c..text: 我把镜头盖上了。现在只陪你，不会打扰。

assets/voice-lines/0cdc5c3ebfd669858a74..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0cdc5c3ebfd669858a74..text: 刚才只顾着看弹幕，你会不会觉得我一直没有看你？

assets/voice-lines/c411ee201ff0929cf7b9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c411ee201ff0929cf7b9..text: 直播时总有话题，真的见到你，反而怕冷场。

assets/voice-lines/b465391ec36edf20588d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/b465391ec36edf20588d..text: 那如果我只想坐一会儿，你也会留下吗？

assets/voice-lines/dbbb090d43984a1c83f4..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/dbbb090d43984a1c83f4..text: 刚才那段沉默，我差点想说要不要重来一遍。

assets/voice-lines/0f4a65259c382fddfbb8..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0f4a65259c382fddfbb8..text: 也可以早点来。知道你在，我会有点高兴。

assets/voice-lines/8dcd2c8130801d70397e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/8dcd2c8130801d70397e..text: 如果我今天不再出现，会不会很快就被忘记？

assets/voice-lines/cef7767ab9f787c726e9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/cef7767ab9f787c726e9..text: 这张画面很好看，可我想空出一只手。

assets/voice-lines/fd2ac9febf3db5bcb189..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/fd2ac9febf3db5bcb189..text: 可以牵一下你吗？不拍下来，只是牵着。

assets/voice-lines/c2c0adef63a4b3be6cf9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c2c0adef63a4b3be6cf9..text: 不会。我记得你手心的温度，这个更重要。

assets/voice-lines/68cbd23d3e9c0e88011b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/68cbd23d3e9c0e88011b..text: 刚才说了很多次晚安，可还有一个没说。

assets/voice-lines/00957352907311304d64..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/00957352907311304d64..text: 留给今天一直在镜头后面等我的人。

assets/voice-lines/7855b7bcb9a68de2641c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/7855b7bcb9a68de2641c..text: 这句话不想靠麦克风放大。你可以过来一点吗？

assets/voice-lines/7e3fddb6f408380915b3..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/7e3fddb6f408380915b3..text: 我不是想留住一位观众。我想留住你。

assets/voice-lines/2c9850a2d026257ef508..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/2c9850a2d026257ef508..text: 那今天的这一句，就不存成素材了。我们一起记着。

assets/voice-lines/1fa1494fb94cbbbf2fc3..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1fa1494fb94cbbbf2fc3..text: 那现在，晚安。只对你说的那一个。

assets/voice-lines/1dc1acd6e1515acf549e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1dc1acd6e1515acf549e..text: 那就按我们商量的办法，试着拍下来吧。

assets/voice-lines/c46c3b93c36b2eb68637..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c46c3b93c36b2eb68637..text: 以后都坐这里吧，我转过头就能看见你。

assets/voice-lines/bd954307d32833c162cc..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/bd954307d32833c162cc..text: 一路上总有人提醒她，慢视频可能没人看。

assets/voice-lines/ed8e8002a62cf28c7499..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/ed8e8002a62cf28c7499..text: 原来不抢着说话，也能收到回答。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/ba413c2b7be9a1591fa1..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/ba413c2b7be9a1591fa1..text: 直播预告已经发出，大家都在等日落。

assets/voice-lines/af2ef19e9e0e5cdcdfcc..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/af2ef19e9e0e5cdcdfcc..text: 这一张，先只给你看。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/c4fd3fa03e2a4a3c63c6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c4fd3fa03e2a4a3c63c6..text: 谢谢你让我可以自己决定，怎样被看见。

assets/voice-lines/b6718fefbfbb11693052..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/b6718fefbfbb11693052..text: 她下意识不停刷新，忘了已经过了晚饭时间。

assets/voice-lines/5f278664757c7dca4f92..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/5f278664757c7dca4f92..text: 保存本地录像，吃完饭再补一段说明。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/e7aa0c16539b4712170b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e7aa0c16539b4712170b..text: 今天不用追着数字跑了，先听你说。

assets/voice-lines/b93b5551f195d3956d61..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/b93b5551f195d3956d61..text: 她不知道怎样区分公开的感谢和私人的心意。

assets/voice-lines/d34b5e471c7d2202ae36..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d34b5e471c7d2202ae36..text: 这一个晚安，是想当面说给你听的。

assets/voice-lines/cf4c6ee09c69cefc82fd..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/cf4c6ee09c69cefc82fd..text: 我是唐梨。今天的灯光测试，谢谢你陪到最后。

assets/voice-lines/0f833a8fa274e8ff18df..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0f833a8fa274e8ff18df..text: 说好了！今天这段时间，只留给我们。

assets/voice-lines/59a1ad3e94f1924446cc..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/59a1ad3e94f1924446cc..text: 好，我先去收设备。等你来时，补光灯已经关掉了。

assets/voice-lines/03ecc1b87778e8eeebcb..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/03ecc1b87778e8eeebcb..text: 这个片段可以不剪掉吗？我想留着。

assets/voice-lines/21948c062687c71b473d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/21948c062687c71b473d..text: 频道已经下线了，这条消息没有观众能看见。

assets/voice-lines/27a1d35bc498e15cf42d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/27a1d35bc498e15cf42d..text: 今天一直在说话，真正想说的却留到了现在。

assets/voice-lines/bbc39b78d81fff667f77..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/bbc39b78d81fff667f77..text: 但想见你这件事，我不想只交给系统通知。

assets/voice-lines/5bda4950d220c77ee2f1..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/5bda4950d220c77ee2f1..text: 如果有空，提前来坐一会儿。我给你留椅子。

assets/voice-lines/43f7fc11a23e533ea7b5..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/43f7fc11a23e533ea7b5..text: 现在方便接电话吗？有件小事想亲口告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/c7959ea5349e7be1e643..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c7959ea5349e7be1e643..text: 关掉补光灯，房间还剩下一盏小台灯。

assets/voice-lines/f95eb9691a33c5f5e1cf..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f95eb9691a33c5f5e1cf..text: 你有空的话，想在这样的光里听你说话。

assets/voice-lines/b44869e73895ac1859dc..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/b44869e73895ac1859dc..text: 不用担心冷场，我也在学着享受安静。

assets/voice-lines/8516281f69a1176a4f4b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/8516281f69a1176a4f4b..text: 那今天先到这里。晚安，明天再见。

assets/voice-lines/88cbd372fde4065f00b0..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/88cbd372fde4065f00b0..text: 第一次直播的倒数画面一直卡在三。

assets/voice-lines/c32772b7530b9dc2ff91..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c32772b7530b9dc2ff91..text: 我紧张得想关掉，你却说可以先和观众打个招呼。

assets/voice-lines/e6e400685ea1e9c7ba29..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e6e400685ea1e9c7ba29..text: 今晚如果又冷场，给我发一颗小星星吧。

assets/voice-lines/f992cc8240e441b2825c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f992cc8240e441b2825c..text: 我本来在调白平衡，后来干脆放下相机看了一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/6f95da3f2bc1726a0e09..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6f95da3f2bc1726a0e09..text: 我还不太习惯，所以录了一句很轻的晚安。

assets/voice-lines/7809a59fe53f8eb9b309..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/7809a59fe53f8eb9b309..text: 试戴时发现，终于够两个人坐在同一张桌边听了。

assets/voice-lines/0b253d119dd604755193..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0b253d119dd604755193..text: 我说因为灯光调好了，其实是看到你的名字上线。

assets/voice-lines/fd3685a5d3cc6b043aef..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/fd3685a5d3cc6b043aef..text: 镜头以外的我可能话少一点，但还是很想和你说。

assets/voice-lines/003e5f3481061b4ed6c7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/003e5f3481061b4ed6c7..text: 刚刚又想起了那天的事，想打给你。

assets/voice-lines/74031d7cb0ef3d0266e7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/74031d7cb0ef3d0266e7..text: 中间那张写着你的提醒：不用每一秒都说话。

assets/voice-lines/2b509550df9f84aff937..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/2b509550df9f84aff937..text: 今天也想请你来，陪我把空白留得舒服一点。

assets/voice-lines/0db97b1adc5aafa6006c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0db97b1adc5aafa6006c..text: 观众没注意，我却来来回回看了好几次。

assets/voice-lines/1c6d54c7b548723ce298..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1c6d54c7b548723ce298..text: 线下活动的灯很亮，台下的脸看不太清。

assets/voice-lines/c6b635f51161cee54684..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c6b635f51161cee54684..text: 我还是一眼找到了你，大概因为你总在认真听。

assets/voice-lines/f78d1d6850e6efd2cf42..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f78d1d6850e6efd2cf42..text: 新视频的片尾终于放上了你的名字。

assets/voice-lines/761b6c256b1d26dd99de..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/761b6c256b1d26dd99de..text: 想和你喝点热的，庆祝这个小小的完成。

assets/voice-lines/f77fcd9c8a5a6b298155..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f77fcd9c8a5a6b298155..text: 不是客气的鸣谢，是我们真的一起把它做完了。

assets/voice-lines/8e29dabfc0a06c4eb9fc..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/8e29dabfc0a06c4eb9fc..text: 我突然觉得，比面对很多观众还要紧张。

assets/voice-lines/a06895db174bf9780def..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/a06895db174bf9780def..text: 健身教练说运动量够了，我没告诉他你刚好走进来。

assets/voice-lines/083ea57b475889eb2154..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/083ea57b475889eb2154..text: 它什么都没做，观众却说这是今晚最好看的十分钟。

assets/voice-lines/b39c99617875852e83d9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/b39c99617875852e83d9..text: 有空来教教我，怎么像它一样自然？

assets/voice-lines/6ff8e53dcdce26cd62f7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6ff8e53dcdce26cd62f7..text: 每转一下，都想起刚开始拍视频时手忙脚乱的样子。

assets/voice-lines/0fcead7978de6c70899a..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0fcead7978de6c70899a..text: 想和你再去一次最初拍过的那条街。

assets/voice-lines/49bc30cfc53d0728fd4d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/49bc30cfc53d0728fd4d..text: 我把摄像机对着你，你第一句话却是在夸大家。

assets/voice-lines/bc8a1600d63cb395aff7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/bc8a1600d63cb395aff7..text: 天台展映的幕布被风吹得微微起伏。

assets/voice-lines/d009759b43355009911c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d009759b43355009911c..text: 这一张合照，我们都不要躲在画面外。

assets/voice-lines/3531fa9ea80f1a94c70a..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/3531fa9ea80f1a94c70a..text: 你站在光里检查设备，我突然很想按下快门。

assets/voice-lines/890f7eb40575485a6773..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/890f7eb40575485a6773..text: 片尾不用每次都写感谢观看。写下次见，怎么样？

assets/voice-lines/c0224d1038d6f34e7607..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c0224d1038d6f34e7607..text: 那段没有观众的散步，比直播回放更清楚。

assets/voice-lines/233055cf8db6316ca1c6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/233055cf8db6316ca1c6..text: 下次见面，也可以先把手机收起来。

assets/voice-lines/000a16ff9782e2de1b52..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/000a16ff9782e2de1b52..text: 露台的花刚好开到栏杆外，我想请你一起入镜。

assets/voice-lines/91ead6215b26b870bd66..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/91ead6215b26b870bd66..text: 这一张不上传。原片和这个下午，都只留给我们。

assets/voice-lines/723296ee3d7fcefc4789..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/723296ee3d7fcefc4789..text: 相机回到包里了，今天没有可以上传的花絮。

assets/voice-lines/08c2f10a4e517d023e7c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/08c2f10a4e517d023e7c..text: 但我发现，不被录下来的好时光也会记得很清楚。

assets/voice-lines/7eb9447c767381420eee..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/7eb9447c767381420eee..text: 下次约会，手机也可以再安静一点。

assets/voice-lines/0b8edf775c4674d38c26..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0b8edf775c4674d38c26..text: 窗边的雨停了，我没有补拍空镜头。

assets/voice-lines/1d6f02a83a70b8c5a9fc..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1d6f02a83a70b8c5a9fc..text: 这一张，先放在我们自己的记忆里。

assets/voice-lines/292af0e139b17bb97f47..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/292af0e139b17bb97f47..text: 你走以后，我终于把最后一句晚安说完了。

assets/voice-lines/e58da5df6dd688a902a5..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e58da5df6dd688a902a5..text: 明天先去吃早饭。晚安，只对你说。

assets/voice-lines/e110164f3195bf5715f6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e110164f3195bf5715f6..text: 拍到一张很好看的日落，先没有发动态。

assets/voice-lines/6404d4fe03937371190b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6404d4fe03937371190b..text: 想先给你看看。那一刻，最想让你也站在我旁边。

assets/voice-lines/d424e4f06b5a4e7ef900..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d424e4f06b5a4e7ef900..text: 本来想拍一段完美的一分钟，后来关掉了倒计时。

assets/voice-lines/8b243ce9a0fd8fd9b059..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/8b243ce9a0fd8fd9b059..text: 镜头里笑得有点傻，但那是我真正开心的样子。

assets/voice-lines/647e863a536ecd7fd015..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/647e863a536ecd7fd015..text: 今天相机里终于有一张我没有整理头发的照片。

assets/voice-lines/b4da7c50808936806a0f..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/b4da7c50808936806a0f..text: 这周的素材整理完了，还缺一张合照。

assets/voice-lines/9823bf7191bd533f0b95..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9823bf7191bd533f0b95..text: 没有记录的下午，也没有丢掉，对吧？

assets/voice-lines/d645f63ba1bd365d8976..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d645f63ba1bd365d8976..text: 这张照片不用想文案，只写今天的日期。

assets/voice-lines/cb6b12bec6027304b92b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/cb6b12bec6027304b92b..text: 刚才说了不直播，还是忍不住想着拍摄。

assets/voice-lines/52bc4ecc29a58b345387..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/52bc4ecc29a58b345387..text: 刚开始会不习惯，总想看看是不是错过了什么。

assets/voice-lines/30debf83fd723a36c161..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/30debf83fd723a36c161..text: 我记得你笑到眼睛都眯起来的那一张。

assets/voice-lines/358632623056e4d23f0f..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/358632623056e4d23f0f..text: 这么短，却比我想过的很多文案都好。

assets/voice-lines/06b388290d3d18077ade..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/06b388290d3d18077ade..text: 不用每天更新，这一张就能看很久。

assets/voice-lines/28e476de6e3de8cb1dec..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/28e476de6e3de8cb1dec..text: 这次收件人和镜头里的人，都很确定。

assets/voice-lines/9af2ab16ee73c7942de6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9af2ab16ee73c7942de6..text: 原来按下发送以后，也可以只期待一个人的回应。

assets/voice-lines/61fe48acb2ab43ac3a08..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/61fe48acb2ab43ac3a08..text: 也好。不过今天不用太在意点赞会不会多。

assets/voice-lines/1c4bccdd8d47e14421d9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1c4bccdd8d47e14421d9..text: 有点后悔，刚才应该先看那张自然的。

assets/voice-lines/687f32060a57b1b09c30..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/687f32060a57b1b09c30..text: 今天下播以后，我差点又拿起手机补拍一个晚安。

assets/voice-lines/d7a50987f4bdb588dbb5..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d7a50987f4bdb588dbb5..text: 可是转过头，你已经把充电线放到我找得到的地方。

assets/voice-lines/2787045f47683d761b4f..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/2787045f47683d761b4f..text: 还把窗帘留了一道小缝，说这样早上会慢慢亮起来。

assets/voice-lines/f682d8b3865f0bbdc043..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f682d8b3865f0bbdc043..text: 这些都没被镜头拍到，我却想了很久。

assets/voice-lines/c885bb2a6c6ee3d7720e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c885bb2a6c6ee3d7720e..text: 原来一天也可以在这些小动作里，好好结束。

assets/voice-lines/867e86121d90772a646c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/867e86121d90772a646c..text: 你困了就闭眼，不用为了礼貌，等到我的最后一句。

assets/voice-lines/9eac0b67d68386f4c9ce..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9eac0b67d68386f4c9ce..text: 哪怕没有真的响，也会突然想看看有没有新的提醒。

assets/voice-lines/713150652afe8a78a462..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/713150652afe8a78a462..text: 你没有把它拿走，只是问我，想不想先放远一点。

assets/voice-lines/3b7632e511e08886bbe7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/3b7632e511e08886bbe7..text: 我就试着把手机放到窗边，开始有点不习惯。

assets/voice-lines/33a40f0aaa5ce2ec0ca7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/33a40f0aaa5ce2ec0ca7..text: 因为那一会儿没有谁在催我赶快切到下一件事。

assets/voice-lines/64bb83424973fde94602..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/64bb83424973fde94602..text: 相册里还有几十张今天的云，没有挑好。

assets/voice-lines/f66744b1f28af983dcb8..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f66744b1f28af983dcb8..text: 有的逆光，有的被头发挡住一小角，我看了又看。

assets/voice-lines/cbb8665109e9bbdcff25..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/cbb8665109e9bbdcff25..text: 构图不太完整，手边甚至拍进了半个纸袋。

assets/voice-lines/c3801bef329f5d667a9d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c3801bef329f5d667a9d..text: 可那一下让我很清楚地记起，当时的风有多轻。

assets/voice-lines/f38bbaa0b7d0cb500173..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f38bbaa0b7d0cb500173..text: 所以有些照片，不需要用最好看做留下来的理由。

assets/voice-lines/da9134c00a9a875f204e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/da9134c00a9a875f204e..text: 我们明天再挑吧。今晚先不把这一天变成任务。

assets/voice-lines/052745625c7e6b20d8ff..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/052745625c7e6b20d8ff..text: 没有弹幕也很好。你不回应的时候，我也知道你在。

assets/voice-lines/e166b5cd43b9b9924762..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e166b5cd43b9b9924762..text: 镜头没开呀。怎么你看我，比开播时还让我紧张。

assets/voice-lines/68d9ac7987c01338c157..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/68d9ac7987c01338c157..text: 手给你。这样就算闭上眼睛，也不会找不到你。

assets/voice-lines/2199284cde3386dc60f8..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/2199284cde3386dc60f8..text: 好啦，盖好了。我保证今晚不突然起床找相机。

assets/voice-lines/fa346d8066abf79f4901..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/fa346d8066abf79f4901..text: 那时候的我，还不知道后来会遇到你。

assets/voice-lines/9f4e1f9faae3d0ebc594..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9f4e1f9faae3d0ebc594..text: 那我就可以不用一直想着，哪里适合拍给大家看。

assets/voice-lines/4d92dc32a08699768e2c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/4d92dc32a08699768e2c..text: 好。那今晚我可以偶尔把话说一半，等你接住。

assets/voice-lines/d8a24dd903559d7c15bd..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d8a24dd903559d7c15bd..text: 好。最后一条晚安消息，我想一直留给你。

assets/voice-lines/0fb08b9588294ddf8d95..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0fb08b9588294ddf8d95..text: 我把空着的手伸过去，替代了所有构图建议。

assets/voice-lines/9368c7fcf82bce6bfe8e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9368c7fcf82bce6bfe8e..text: 院门响起时，她没有检查画面，只抬头笑了。

assets/voice-lines/2c2d8612b0a8240e68b3..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/2c2d8612b0a8240e68b3..text: 好奇怪，明明只有一个人，心跳却比开播还快。

assets/voice-lines/bf2aa33d80792005e3cd..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/bf2aa33d80792005e3cd..text: 今晚的灯会还没散，但我想和你先回去。

assets/voice-lines/277cf84e53a6a93840cc..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/277cf84e53a6a93840cc..text: 早上好！我刚写好一小段旋律，想第一个弹给你听。

assets/voice-lines/d831128e0f7124d07c81..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/d831128e0f7124d07c81..text: 你再这样看着我，我的下一句歌词可要写跑调了。

assets/voice-lines/e8876090339a6ca128c7..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e8876090339a6ca128c7..text: 今天没有演出，但可以给你一位观众的特别返场。

assets/voice-lines/d12befab211fec8b8b37..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/d12befab211fec8b8b37..text: 跟着我的节拍走吧。没关系，慢一点也很好。

assets/voice-lines/69f760bc39881d544898..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/69f760bc39881d544898..text: 给你鼓掌！休息时要不要听听我刚刚写的副歌？

assets/voice-lines/bae1d5495c2db9ac6753..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/bae1d5495c2db9ac6753..text: 一首歌也有休止符呀。停一下，下一段会更好听。

assets/voice-lines/e0ea5a8d38c1dd1d45b3..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e0ea5a8d38c1dd1d45b3..text: 嘘，我把音量调小了。陪你把这段时间慢慢走完。

assets/voice-lines/3e2a29cc6b7b21709e2f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/3e2a29cc6b7b21709e2f..text: 第一次让别人听新歌，比站上舞台还紧张。

assets/voice-lines/da0876568d0652b35ebf..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/da0876568d0652b35ebf..text: 我想写一件很小的事，又怕它不值得被唱出来。

assets/voice-lines/4b40c347f01c0d9f86c0..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4b40c347f01c0d9f86c0..text: 原来你也记得。那这一句，不是我一个人的秘密了。

assets/voice-lines/928f37c937594aaa9da9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/928f37c937594aaa9da9..text: 比如，有个人总会把耳机线理好，再还给我。

assets/voice-lines/6a4f97ac8bb65194b361..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6a4f97ac8bb65194b361..text: 不对，第二下慢半拍。不过别改，我想把它留下来。

assets/voice-lines/2e154cc4ef88b76949a1..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2e154cc4ef88b76949a1..text: 不会。那是我认得出的，你的节拍。

assets/voice-lines/727a84affe9f93aaf96a..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/727a84affe9f93aaf96a..text: 票都退完了。今天好像一首歌也没唱成。

assets/voice-lines/921ed76483e60cb735f2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/921ed76483e60cb735f2..text: 我是不是应该表现得更轻松？大家都已经很失望了。

assets/voice-lines/c713b4d33b518fca4466..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c713b4d33b518fca4466..text: 那我想先说一句：今天其实有点难过。

assets/voice-lines/c4bdc8fe21d857e715e9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c4bdc8fe21d857e715e9..text: 不用和雨比声音大。我们跟着它来。

assets/voice-lines/ede9caf7b33e024dbd47..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ede9caf7b33e024dbd47..text: 因为这次我知道，有人会听见轻一点的声音。

assets/voice-lines/f748b3b0588424a68760..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f748b3b0588424a68760..text: 今天还是唱成了。谢谢我的第一排。

assets/voice-lines/13f78f5dcc2b12858cdd..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/13f78f5dcc2b12858cdd..text: 今晚没有返场要求，也没有工作人员催结束。

assets/voice-lines/9e1de5f23008a503b179..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/9e1de5f23008a503b179..text: 如果我不把它唱成歌，直接告诉你，会不会太突然？

assets/voice-lines/84e8d101cb9b9c6a7f78..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/84e8d101cb9b9c6a7f78..text: 嗯。知道你愿意听，我好像也更有勇气了。

assets/voice-lines/2737ff11fe2d002d303c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2737ff11fe2d002d303c..text: 我想说的，不只是一句好听的歌词。

assets/voice-lines/91d367ed39ffe1da5ec9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/91d367ed39ffe1da5ec9..text: 下一首我们一起选。明天、后天都可以。

assets/voice-lines/6300dbca308ea29aeb46..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6300dbca308ea29aeb46..text: 好。我会记得带上你总说舒服的那一副。

assets/voice-lines/8e3f86379041436306fe..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/8e3f86379041436306fe..text: 那就按我们商量的办法，试着拍下来吧。

assets/voice-lines/92fc2b01347959035460..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/92fc2b01347959035460..text: 现在这个位置，是我们两个人的听众席。

assets/voice-lines/cd5c52e54fcb622ac2f2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/cd5c52e54fcb622ac2f2..text: 你不用打得很准，先把开心打出来。

assets/voice-lines/0daed1dba76bc5ddfdf6..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/0daed1dba76bc5ddfdf6..text: 对方只记得旋律，找不到歌曲的名字。

assets/voice-lines/c972b66c95b615baed0c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c972b66c95b615baed0c..text: 把短短的旋律唱出来，征求听众线索。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/760a88fde41fce929fd3..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/760a88fde41fce929fd3..text: 有人把记得的小事接起来，歌就不会走丢。

assets/voice-lines/842f6003bb65f9d23d62..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/842f6003bb65f9d23d62..text: 观众躲进屋檐下，舞台设备也必须断电。

assets/voice-lines/33b422b08c0ef9197f0c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/33b422b08c0ef9197f0c..text: 没有舞台灯，也看得见你在听。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/246cacf356c6e34fc9aa..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/246cacf356c6e34fc9aa..text: 她担心公开草稿会让作品显得不够成熟。

assets/voice-lines/6c3e2a247f214e72745d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6c3e2a247f214e72745d..text: 这不是标准答案，是有人认真听过的证据。

assets/voice-lines/4086ed64727e862836f9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4086ed64727e862836f9..text: 她想继续修改，却始终舍不得交出终稿。

assets/voice-lines/eaa674c560f4bd54a7a5..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/eaa674c560f4bd54a7a5..text: 这首完成了，下一首还想先唱给你听。

assets/voice-lines/1287cfe9e2d7ba33a934..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/1287cfe9e2d7ba33a934..text: 我是许知夏！你拿走的那只耳机，不用急着还。

assets/voice-lines/04ee13c196b65813ded3..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/04ee13c196b65813ded3..text: 成交！这次不准把摄影机挡在脸前面。

assets/voice-lines/74d65783c2ac0296b752..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/74d65783c2ac0296b752..text: 那我先把这一小段存好，等你忙完再听。

assets/voice-lines/9b6be1fbb01675658016..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/9b6be1fbb01675658016..text: 听完再聊，我不提前给你标准答案。

assets/voice-lines/2b56e83f91164765b8e3..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2b56e83f91164765b8e3..text: 工作室的窗帘拉上了，你还在里面吗？

assets/voice-lines/a726b414fdd988c28952..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a726b414fdd988c28952..text: 我在楼下练歌，今晚没有大音箱，只有一把吉他。

assets/voice-lines/3315866c12b24089f13d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/3315866c12b24089f13d..text: 收工后就下来，给你弹一个很短的前奏。

assets/voice-lines/974231d2ef4362599c66..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/974231d2ef4362599c66..text: 有人问我，安可曲一般留给什么样的观众。

assets/voice-lines/a5c1cce02be1fcf0dda0..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a5c1cce02be1fcf0dda0..text: 现在方便接电话吗？有件小事想亲口告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/2ad4f976d99b7c522288..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2ad4f976d99b7c522288..text: 别把这当工作邀约，我只是想见你。

assets/voice-lines/6d85d47653857dce1477..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6d85d47653857dce1477..text: 那今天先到这里。晚安，明天再见。

assets/voice-lines/8b6515a4c0181727b264..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/8b6515a4c0181727b264..text: 第九秒是楼下阿姨喊我吃饭，所以没舍得删。

assets/voice-lines/dae0e35e11d7e8bb1339..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/dae0e35e11d7e8bb1339..text: 原本想换新的，后来想起每次都把右边留给你。

assets/voice-lines/6286a54d81a19e6748f5..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6286a54d81a19e6748f5..text: 鼓手听了半天，问这是哪一种打击乐器。

assets/voice-lines/10155e37df9145c86e8d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/10155e37df9145c86e8d..text: 不是困，是窗外的鸽子比节拍器更有主见。

assets/voice-lines/b9e680121de3ed142194..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b9e680121de3ed142194..text: 我差点上去接唱，幸好先想起那段副歌还没发布。

assets/voice-lines/6bfaa71638de4e58009a..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6bfaa71638de4e58009a..text: 如果生活也有前奏，我想让今天长一点。

assets/voice-lines/a54282d2ca5c85035ddf..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a54282d2ca5c85035ddf..text: 刚刚又想起了那天的事，想打给你。

assets/voice-lines/c468dead3b95bfb2899f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c468dead3b95bfb2899f..text: 老板说观众太少，我却觉得每张脸都看得更清楚。

assets/voice-lines/89f85a79c01e3827638d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/89f85a79c01e3827638d..text: 喧闹没有停，却忽然变成了前奏的一部分。

assets/voice-lines/a541d1e5a7931fdde4ef..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a541d1e5a7931fdde4ef..text: 别急着收摄影机，我还有一句想唱。

assets/voice-lines/2a5adefc879b36e564a9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2a5adefc879b36e564a9..text: 它被我藏在琴盒里，等其他观众都走以后。

assets/voice-lines/6e448bbb0c1c51fb36ce..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6e448bbb0c1c51fb36ce..text: 我对着它们数拍子，数到你名字的时候停了一下。

assets/voice-lines/c5fb942dffa0fed9de5c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c5fb942dffa0fed9de5c..text: 仔细听才发现，是你靠近麦克风时碰到的心跳。

assets/voice-lines/381cc3e6ed01f4d623c8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/381cc3e6ed01f4d623c8..text: 想再和你过一些日子，再决定最后一个音。

assets/voice-lines/e4ffdce301a57c372d6e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e4ffdce301a57c372d6e..text: 原本以为结尾很难，现在却舍不得太早结束。

assets/voice-lines/183e794f990757e466d7..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/183e794f990757e466d7..text: 唱针有一点沙沙声，比修得太干净更像小时候。

assets/voice-lines/2dd5a95c787ebd06b742..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2dd5a95c787ebd06b742..text: 那时台下只有七个人，我紧张得忘了介绍自己。

assets/voice-lines/ccc974cd91972c2785da..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ccc974cd91972c2785da..text: 如果你当时也在，我一定会记住你的座位。

assets/voice-lines/216b87f0e1521eb16535..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/216b87f0e1521eb16535..text: 回放时听见街坊跟着哼唱，我比登台还紧张。

assets/voice-lines/c45d18dea41675dc66a6..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c45d18dea41675dc66a6..text: 你写的那句副歌，真的被大家记住了。

assets/voice-lines/7adb48c2f1f4eb223b12..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7adb48c2f1f4eb223b12..text: 安可结束后，我们一起把琴送回家吧。

assets/voice-lines/706519821365e9a0754e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/706519821365e9a0754e..text: 我换了一把琴，却还是先找到了你坐的方向。

assets/voice-lines/8683ce05d43d01c466f5..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/8683ce05d43d01c466f5..text: 原来等一个人唱下去，也可以是旋律的一部分。

assets/voice-lines/c9d737a9e956d628855c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c9d737a9e956d628855c..text: 下一次，我们不用急着接上那个半拍。

assets/voice-lines/9373643fa9de79326b58..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/9373643fa9de79326b58..text: 零点的节目没有播完，最后一首歌留给了明晚。

assets/voice-lines/53347ae5905801ce68fd..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/53347ae5905801ce68fd..text: 我第一次觉得，留白不是失误，而是在等一句回应。

assets/voice-lines/c2b5248c493e7abe0c82..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c2b5248c493e7abe0c82..text: 今天没有排练安排，我却想在这里多坐一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/46c7454152622f63c14d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/46c7454152622f63c14d..text: 来听我弹一段吧，剩下的休止符我们一起过。

assets/voice-lines/4c94295410697de3ab44..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4c94295410697de3ab44..text: 我忍不住猜，是不是那一句刚好唱到了你心里。

assets/voice-lines/4d82c20888a0e74af7de..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4d82c20888a0e74af7de..text: 音乐会没能按计划开始，却有了一位很认真的观众。

assets/voice-lines/f8b6d37217fb33db2251..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f8b6d37217fb33db2251..text: 原来明天也想见你，真的可以直接唱出来。

assets/voice-lines/92937f5a74515addfb51..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/92937f5a74515addfb51..text: 希望下一次唱的时候，你还坐在那个位置。

assets/voice-lines/177c02fc491f52b4e31e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/177c02fc491f52b4e31e..text: 副歌不急着交稿，我们一起把它写完。

assets/voice-lines/ea225416ff76f2300e3c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ea225416ff76f2300e3c..text: 雨落在棚顶的声音被录进了吉他轨。

assets/voice-lines/03adfc61e180c51d4e7d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/03adfc61e180c51d4e7d..text: 我没有删掉。你说过，那像我们上次散步时的节拍。

assets/voice-lines/259ee2afea7721bcf1b2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/259ee2afea7721bcf1b2..text: 今天没发生什么大事，还是写了一首歌。

assets/voice-lines/fcf0ab0ca7fca42262e5..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/fcf0ab0ca7fca42262e5..text: 晚饭很热，路灯很亮，想见的人就在消息的另一端。

assets/voice-lines/e7a5cba5e8426f5359ea..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e7a5cba5e8426f5359ea..text: 周末想去街角演出，节目单已经写好。

assets/voice-lines/b93afdf67063d1a2c213..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b93afdf67063d1a2c213..text: 那我记下来，下一首就写这样的回家路。

assets/voice-lines/ce5b93e0c78289a037b9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ce5b93e0c78289a037b9..text: 你这么一说，连休止符都有了灯光。

assets/voice-lines/ea3b6d59a05187374beb..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ea3b6d59a05187374beb..text: 还想再听一遍。等雨停也没有关系吧？

assets/voice-lines/5f25e26f905b20c29f99..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/5f25e26f905b20c29f99..text: 也好，至少不会漏掉你熟悉的那一首。

assets/voice-lines/3716e21a6b68337ada5f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/3716e21a6b68337ada5f..text: 看来还是该先听听让人好奇的那一首。

assets/voice-lines/24fbd5477e6c98e2d86e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/24fbd5477e6c98e2d86e..text: 正式录音以前，总想把这些删掉。今天却舍不得。

assets/voice-lines/e87296fb00ba0c94d436..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e87296fb00ba0c94d436..text: 嗯。不是每一种声音都要唱给所有人听。

assets/voice-lines/c1c1bc33eb85f47012fd..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c1c1bc33eb85f47012fd..text: 我会给这句话留一个很温柔的和弦。

assets/voice-lines/e726c33eb6ca7a81d4d8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e726c33eb6ca7a81d4d8..text: 三个月以后的我，一定会认出这个节奏。

assets/voice-lines/478dca77a50586fe53f1..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/478dca77a50586fe53f1..text: 那这一小节，就暂时只有我们知道。

assets/voice-lines/fb0d041d5de3d975bd2e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/fb0d041d5de3d975bd2e..text: 也好，不过今天更想听听你的声音。

assets/voice-lines/1bd9ac8ee32d0fce9ba4..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/1bd9ac8ee32d0fce9ba4..text: 今天写歌写到一半，我把副歌空下来了。

assets/voice-lines/5f0e8c8ee47976e8139d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/5f0e8c8ee47976e8139d..text: 可是今天想到的是你回家时，放轻的关门声。

assets/voice-lines/0621ed59ebedb9b3410c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/0621ed59ebedb9b3410c..text: 还有你怕我还在录音，连拖鞋都走得很小心。

assets/voice-lines/79f1b633002d69c18cd7..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/79f1b633002d69c18cd7..text: 所以这首歌可能没有特别热闹的地方。

assets/voice-lines/f0c9fa57ec591b864694..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f0c9fa57ec591b864694..text: 现在先给你听这个空白。是不是也挺像我们的？

assets/voice-lines/5971bb147e153ec51bc8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/5971bb147e153ec51bc8..text: 床头那副耳机，左边的海绵该换了。

assets/voice-lines/d01a92d29f115ffac137..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/d01a92d29f115ffac137..text: 你总把好用的那一边给我，说自己听得见就够了。

assets/voice-lines/9adc2d7e4ed97437a7a6..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/9adc2d7e4ed97437a7a6..text: 我今天去店里问了配件，顺便挑了一根长一点的线。

assets/voice-lines/9c3d6ad6fcc96caf022f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/9c3d6ad6fcc96caf022f..text: 这样以后靠在一起听歌，就不用谁迁就谁的姿势。

assets/voice-lines/0f758a3cd8ea2183b147..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/0f758a3cd8ea2183b147..text: 老板问我是不是要给旧耳机再用好几年。

assets/voice-lines/01db39775cde2fdaf74a..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/01db39775cde2fdaf74a..text: 我说，是啊，有个人已经记住它放在哪一格。

assets/voice-lines/6dc42ab86fe805905ee6..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6dc42ab86fe805905ee6..text: 你看，修好一件小东西，也很像认真约好下一次。

assets/voice-lines/08daa914f26ce4de9316..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/08daa914f26ce4de9316..text: 演出结束时，我有时会最后一个离开后台。

assets/voice-lines/aa128731316ff58c0e56..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/aa128731316ff58c0e56..text: 不是舍不得掌声，是想等耳朵里的回响慢慢落下去。

assets/voice-lines/ae0f12f0b066cacda3fe..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ae0f12f0b066cacda3fe..text: 很短的一行字，却比我的返场曲更早让我安静下来。

assets/voice-lines/ed53ee8024b0a8cd7342..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ed53ee8024b0a8cd7342..text: 后来发现，亮一点暗一点都没关系，你都会认真听。

assets/voice-lines/3dc052f241be546196d3..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/3dc052f241be546196d3..text: 所以我今天想讲的其实不是星星，是这条回家的路。

assets/voice-lines/f6ca2ec74861e8524b3b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f6ca2ec74861e8524b3b..text: 刚才那句旋律只在心里哼了哼，怕把你的困意吵跑。

assets/voice-lines/39847d361d7ab3a76252..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/39847d361d7ab3a76252..text: 不想睡也可以先闭一会儿眼睛，我陪你安静待着。

assets/voice-lines/4601be3e15eed133f6c9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4601be3e15eed133f6c9..text: 看我做什么呀……好吧，我也在偷偷看你。

assets/voice-lines/5ee507155cac342db98d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/5ee507155cac342db98d..text: 抓到了！今晚的返场曲，就用手心打很轻的拍子。

assets/voice-lines/4589ded36d6977d2ac86..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4589ded36d6977d2ac86..text: 谢谢助理先生帮我盖好。今天没有演出，只想陪你。

assets/voice-lines/ba1d443ec4a056e9a369..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ba1d443ec4a056e9a369..text: 现在有人愿意听完，过去好像也没有那么难开口了。

assets/voice-lines/0e994c0dce2787a3d01c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/0e994c0dce2787a3d01c..text: 这里一直想写得很盛大，写到最后却只剩两个音。

assets/voice-lines/0eca1a43f72a68c7ae08..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/0eca1a43f72a68c7ae08..text: 是呀。我想让你坐近一点，仅此而已。

assets/voice-lines/4c2c0f187ba885b3958f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4c2c0f187ba885b3958f..text: 因为我看见你笑了，才忘记往下弹。

assets/voice-lines/660fc08922a9efe2cb9d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/660fc08922a9efe2cb9d..text: 当然。而且不在最后一排，就在这里。

assets/voice-lines/5469cf5c6bcda02bbc66..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/5469cf5c6bcda02bbc66..text: 灯光之外，我们有一个别人不知道的暗号。

assets/voice-lines/aad8e85d2176c3b0795a..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/aad8e85d2176c3b0795a..text: 这段不用录音。唱得很轻，你靠近才听得清。

assets/voice-lines/893acff6d2423c631198..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/893acff6d2423c631198..text: 要是有一句忘词，就让我用你的名字补上。

assets/voice-lines/5b391e04db2e2dff0b51..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/5b391e04db2e2dff0b51..text: 叫明天见？好。那我每次唱它，都有理由期待明天。

assets/voice-lines/04764e3f7a21835852b3..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/04764e3f7a21835852b3..text: 这盏灯是专门给你留的。回来就好，不用急着解释今天。

assets/voice-lines/6b35af0434510a2d4df2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/6b35af0434510a2d4df2..text: 我画图，你忙你的。中间记得抬头休息，窗外还有很好的风景。

assets/voice-lines/9093cb6ccc15c9f382d9..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/9093cb6ccc15c9f382d9..text: 做到这里很好。别只挑自己的不足，也看看今天完成了多少。

assets/voice-lines/2131a9ea2aeb9eb683ef..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/2131a9ea2aeb9eb683ef..text: 调整计划很正常。先照顾好自己，我们可以重新开始。

assets/voice-lines/7fe76fd46236918c736a..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/7fe76fd46236918c736a..text: 比尺子量出来的更准。原来合适的距离，要两个人一起决定。

assets/voice-lines/3da24311b0b834bac188..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/3da24311b0b834bac188..text: 我想让你在这里待久一点。说出来，好像也没有很难。

assets/voice-lines/cddb0e3907693e16c766..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/cddb0e3907693e16c766..text: 小时候我以为，漂亮的房子就是不会让人难过的房子。

assets/voice-lines/10a64eb027be1348669a..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/10a64eb027be1348669a..text: 写正式一点像公函，写亲近一点，又怕让你觉得突然。

assets/voice-lines/686f3ca0cfb394709ee8..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/686f3ca0cfb394709ee8..text: 那我就不再练习称呼了。你的名字，我其实早就写得很熟。

assets/voice-lines/f6a15c996b0c68923df4..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/f6a15c996b0c68923df4..text: 原来一张明信片也可以共同署名。我会把这张留在手边。

assets/voice-lines/d025c2f87b3a76f3b2be..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d025c2f87b3a76f3b2be..text: 不用解释为什么这么晚。先吃饭，再告诉我哪一段剪好了。

assets/voice-lines/1e06e02c33a2a73073be..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1e06e02c33a2a73073be..text: 这些也不是一遍就画好的。你不用每次见我，都只带成功的版本。

assets/voice-lines/193f5fb76670cc7bd7dc..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/193f5fb76670cc7bd7dc..text: 嗯，我在听。这里不用开会，也不需要你马上给出解决办法。

assets/voice-lines/d7fb0a130861a7438807..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d7fb0a130861a7438807..text: 先记录窗框的旧刻痕，再请住户一起确认方案。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/1d9df71320241676b127..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1d9df71320241676b127..text: 这次改动的理由，不只写在尺寸里。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/43491c561412b19b1d5a..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/43491c561412b19b1d5a..text: 分时记录采光，并拍清楚扶手和台阶的修缮点。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/018617eca4fed9248d0b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/018617eca4fed9248d0b..text: 慢一点，我会一直站在你看得见的地方。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/ada3feecf4da9b455188..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ada3feecf4da9b455188..text: 这个位置，是给记录大家的人留的。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/fc8106fa5681360b1a19..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/fc8106fa5681360b1a19..text: 请轮椅使用者实地体验，再用镜头记录转弯半径。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/ab2b386a49472c43a9e2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ab2b386a49472c43a9e2..text: 好的设计，是让更多人可以一起进来。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/25bc9cf16c47a3724b9a..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/25bc9cf16c47a3724b9a..text: 先做轻量样段，逐项拍下承重和排水测试。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/38ecacefbefad6d969db..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/38ecacefbefad6d969db..text: 今天的最后一项验收，是你有没有好好休息。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/f28d6326d8c82d4b5408..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/f28d6326d8c82d4b5408..text: 难得空出来一个傍晚，我却花了很久才想到该怎么过。

assets/voice-lines/9c27f1bc93d541474ca0..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/9c27f1bc93d541474ca0..text: 你坚持保留的采访片段，帮住户说清了真正需要什么。

assets/voice-lines/df08398e03bf3a01c13c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/df08398e03bf3a01c13c..text: 工作当然重要。但逗号后面，也要有我自己想过的日子。

assets/voice-lines/1a31fa033e005a935700..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1a31fa033e005a935700..text: 那条绕远的路，我给它起了一个只有我们知道的名字。

assets/voice-lines/5249a0093b9411e0db12..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/5249a0093b9411e0db12..text: 有些没能照着计划说出口的话，写在纸上好像容易一点。

assets/voice-lines/ae1db4ba9c04ce2a3833..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ae1db4ba9c04ce2a3833..text: 刚刚终于知道，等待一个人时的光，和加班的光不太一样。

assets/voice-lines/a47ade7348563f663b99..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/a47ade7348563f663b99..text: 原来是你上次指给我看的那扇窗。这个修改，我想保留下来。

assets/voice-lines/a8516a0b072d737d19e6..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/a8516a0b072d737d19e6..text: 回去会多走十分钟。如果是和你一起，我愿意绕远一点。

assets/voice-lines/362feed48c9dd8b860cf..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/362feed48c9dd8b860cf..text: 修好之前先给你看看。因为你总能看见它原本想成为的样子。

assets/voice-lines/5f66eb1822a8f38b43d9..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/5f66eb1822a8f38b43d9..text: 窗边两把椅子，一盏灯，还有你可以放下背包的位置。

assets/voice-lines/51179bf5ab2b91930649..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/51179bf5ab2b91930649..text: 一直想找个合适的位置。后来发现，放在我旁边就很好。

assets/voice-lines/f03116b5d1ff7b21acd5..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/f03116b5d1ff7b21acd5..text: 可以看书，也可以什么都不做。你不用先准备一个理由。

assets/voice-lines/be4d64f29f82d1997381..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/be4d64f29f82d1997381..text: 我讲了采光、动线和储物，回家路上却想到另一个答案。

assets/voice-lines/fb6dcf29141eac0278af..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/fb6dcf29141eac0278af..text: 你可以把外套搭在椅子上，把没回复的消息留到明天。

assets/voice-lines/857646adae61a5d461dd..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/857646adae61a5d461dd..text: 明天我们把椅子搬近一点吧，中间不用再隔一张小桌。

assets/voice-lines/0d1bf5b13eeb026e9138..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0d1bf5b13eeb026e9138..text: 今晚先从枕头开始。你看，这样说话已经不用提高声音。

assets/voice-lines/476f2fcf6ece91597d7c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/476f2fcf6ece91597d7c..text: 图纸收好了，窗边留了一盏灯。今晚这间房子只负责让你安心。

assets/voice-lines/607440be94c952fdc79f..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/607440be94c952fdc79f..text: 屋里的每一条线都可以明天再画。你现在不用回答工作消息。

assets/voice-lines/b0c90afdb6d78d74c659..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b0c90afdb6d78d74c659..text: 这一角也给你留好了。空间够，我们都可以睡得舒服。

assets/voice-lines/2960f81bad4a8d42d160..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/2960f81bad4a8d42d160..text: 现在可以谈谈我们工作室的窗了。你喜欢朝哪一边坐？

assets/voice-lines/20f81128aa0966913a8e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/20f81128aa0966913a8e..text: 她在桌子的另一侧写下你的名字，随后擦掉了“临时”两个字。

assets/voice-lines/7531f87ec81c4973d67b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/7531f87ec81c4973d67b..text: 石桥上没有新的测量任务。她慢慢走着，把每一步都留给眼前的人。

assets/voice-lines/54e5bfd0642f43459d19..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/54e5bfd0642f43459d19..text: 我刚把最后一封工作邮件关掉。不是所有问题都必须在今晚回答。

assets/voice-lines/62cf5da57465f8c7a21b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/62cf5da57465f8c7a21b..text: 明天有晴天。我想知道，你窗边的光会先落在哪一件小东西上。

assets/voice-lines/9a411eca9a385d1949db..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/9a411eca9a385d1949db..text: 原来自己画过很多次的空间，真正有人陪着走进来，是另一种感觉。

assets/voice-lines/6feb5a485911116ddce3..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/6feb5a485911116ddce3..text: 两个人都没有拿相机。那一刻的天空，先属于你们亲眼看见的记忆。

assets/voice-lines/0f9703381b271ad6a1bf..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0f9703381b271ad6a1bf..text: 今天的地图已经收好了。我没有在上面再加工作行程。

assets/voice-lines/4ccdc4a5ce6b48432d33..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4ccdc4a5ce6b48432d33..text: 如果你还在路上，不用赶着回复。抬头看看路灯，慢一点走。

assets/voice-lines/29e00de7161268457a8a..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/29e00de7161268457a8a..text: 以前我只在意桥能让人安全到达。今天我有点在意，另一端是谁在等。

assets/voice-lines/3f92310bbd6fdfcab57e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/3f92310bbd6fdfcab57e..text: 总不能把所有距离都画进图纸。你愿意替我决定一次吗？

assets/voice-lines/729e38fc17e7d7911338..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/729e38fc17e7d7911338..text: 她替你按住披肩的一角。风小了，可我们还可以靠近一点。

assets/voice-lines/65869db3342e4e62019f..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/65869db3342e4e62019f..text: 她的手停在你掌心，没有再量那段距离。好，这次由我跟着你走。

assets/voice-lines/520c245eb3b78c2da6fe..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/520c245eb3b78c2da6fe..text: 今天不做备选方案了。能不能就沿着有灯的地方，和你走走？

assets/voice-lines/5faa4bb554343913bdd3..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/5faa4bb554343913bdd3..text: 那我会留一扇亮着的窗。你不用站在外面猜，我是不是还在等。

assets/voice-lines/8afffabec83843afcc80..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8afffabec83843afcc80..text: 那一排亮着的窗里，有人刚刚回家，有人正等着门响。

assets/voice-lines/64de02415cb87adbfdd4..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/64de02415cb87adbfdd4..text: 我画过很多种钥匙挂钩，最后还是喜欢最普通的木头。

assets/voice-lines/56607c40b26b8ee87cd6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/56607c40b26b8ee87cd6..text: 甜点先放到一边。午饭吃够了，才有力气喜欢明天呀。

assets/voice-lines/92996124f53cd39c342e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/92996124f53cd39c342e..text: 给你留下了一小块蛋糕。不是卖剩的，是早早挑好的。

assets/voice-lines/7bc7aafafea5b9b86eff..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/7bc7aafafea5b9b86eff..text: 牛奶温好了。把今天放下来，今晚不用努力讨谁喜欢。

assets/voice-lines/0cce3a3bbc52262df8cb..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0cce3a3bbc52262df8cb..text: 我手上还沾着一点面粉。你不介意的话，就这样牵一会儿吧。

assets/voice-lines/cb41b2fb0d4cabd7adb4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/cb41b2fb0d4cabd7adb4..text: 你认真做事，我慢慢揉面。等时间到了，正好一起休息。

assets/voice-lines/15219e9c69c7fb17632d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/15219e9c69c7fb17632d..text: 完成啦！来挑一个你喜欢的。今天的奖励，也要甜一点。

assets/voice-lines/25ccf039d2862a3096dd..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/25ccf039d2862a3096dd..text: 不是请你来帮工。想找个人陪我闻一闻刚出炉的香气。

assets/voice-lines/4f48f8e76ee8943a3828..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/4f48f8e76ee8943a3828..text: 那它今天就不必变成标准答案了。我们一起看看它会烤成什么样。

assets/voice-lines/528327395cac30fe023a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/528327395cac30fe023a..text: 收到。你没有客气地把整杯喝完，对我来说也是一种信任。

assets/voice-lines/429cdbbaec525b3c4941..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/429cdbbaec525b3c4941..text: 那我们一人试一小口，找到两个人都觉得舒服的温度。

assets/voice-lines/57c76e3d2e1b32e30be7..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/57c76e3d2e1b32e30be7..text: 我习惯把好看的那块给别人，今天想问问你会不会介意一起分。

assets/voice-lines/caad73057305871b5685..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/caad73057305871b5685..text: 以后不用每次都带礼物。你来，就已经是我期待的事情。

assets/voice-lines/a619c041c6b0974a10d4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a619c041c6b0974a10d4..text: 让摄影机等面团，先拍准备和称量的细节。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/34904119d39b1d44613d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/34904119d39b1d44613d..text: 记录每种口味的理由，不急着选出唯一的最好。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/d713cd292ba32937fd4b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d713cd292ba32937fd4b..text: 把缺口变成小路，让装饰沿着它继续生长。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/ec0bf5f2b16efa8d6831..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ec0bf5f2b16efa8d6831..text: 不用和样品一样，好吃和开心都算数。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/20d7370a2cb0859c52d6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/20d7370a2cb0859c52d6..text: 先请顾客确认医嘱，只记录合适的备料方案。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/1769df9e8bfc4a0fcbe8..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1769df9e8bfc4a0fcbe8..text: 让奶奶一边做一边解释，再把实际用量记下来。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/ef3de370f5010f68cb64..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ef3de370f5010f68cb64..text: 这样，下次想念的时候就有办法再做一次。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/763ada9c44153c3000c4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/763ada9c44153c3000c4..text: 把收拾柜台的日常也留下，然后坐下来一起试映。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/306e2be45a8eb8f91bca..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/306e2be45a8eb8f91bca..text: 我是江月。刚刚那块蛋糕放冰箱时，记得把盒盖盖好。

assets/voice-lines/6e9e188ab0f9d64ed304..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/6e9e188ab0f9d64ed304..text: 我还是做了两份布丁，觉得普通日子也应该被认真对待。

assets/voice-lines/92b78e1caaf87a6d2cf8..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/92b78e1caaf87a6d2cf8..text: 我穿着它站在镜子前，第一反应却是担心你会不会等太久。

assets/voice-lines/77257b40ddde9091ca96..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/77257b40ddde9091ca96..text: 不是谁的生日，却很想以后翻到这一页时还能笑一下。

assets/voice-lines/27a81012e24322eed23d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/27a81012e24322eed23d..text: 我掰开一个试了试，外脆里软。给你那份已经装好了。

assets/voice-lines/7182b9ba404b43d53dc6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/7182b9ba404b43d53dc6..text: 想起你说，喜欢能尝出原材料味道的甜。下次来帮我试试吧。

assets/voice-lines/6327e6c33fdec3319b3b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/6327e6c33fdec3319b3b..text: 换一片草莓，反而有了新的样子。普通的一天也可以这样补救。

assets/voice-lines/22f72e7d8e5b5dee8f07..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/22f72e7d8e5b5dee8f07..text: 不是还在营业，是等你过来一起尝今天剩下的小蛋糕。

assets/voice-lines/3d44da18935bfcfebdf4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/3d44da18935bfcfebdf4..text: 今天想把配方改成：好好吃饭，和你散步，早点回家。

assets/voice-lines/0e5d28ba9fdb1b5842da..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0e5d28ba9fdb1b5842da..text: 那一刻我才想起来，好不好吃也可以不用马上定下来。

assets/voice-lines/f9a83b0160a1ccb8c3cc..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/f9a83b0160a1ccb8c3cc..text: 先睡吧。明早如果你想，我们再一起商量要不要加那勺糖。

assets/voice-lines/aab15e6b40cf969436ec..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/aab15e6b40cf969436ec..text: 以前那一下总让我觉得，今天是不是还有哪里没有做好。

assets/voice-lines/8a46a0fbd3424a4bc230..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/8a46a0fbd3424a4bc230..text: 我就开始留意路上哪家花店关得晚，哪段路的风比较小。

assets/voice-lines/a043af4d5a46f7afbbeb..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a043af4d5a46f7afbbeb..text: 你上次问，为什么给别人挑好的，却总让自己等一下。

assets/voice-lines/bd82aae8d84cb4b24cc8..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/bd82aae8d84cb4b24cc8..text: 你看，我也在慢慢学，不用做得足够辛苦才能奖励自己。

assets/voice-lines/14cac49b1163388c78e2..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/14cac49b1163388c78e2..text: 烤箱已经休息啦。热水放在床头，今晚的甜只需要一点点就好。

assets/voice-lines/ac978316e6658f41927b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ac978316e6658f41927b..text: 你已经很努力了。今晚可以什么都不做，也值得被好好照顾。

assets/voice-lines/bbe42b2c94ba91124b2e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/bbe42b2c94ba91124b2e..text: 是不是闻到一点黄油味？已经洗干净啦，是你靠太近了。

assets/voice-lines/88f2cfab317c3f8678f7..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/88f2cfab317c3f8678f7..text: 手心这样暖，刚好。别担心，我没有打算拉你去揉面团。

assets/voice-lines/0d33d6ed2969501c7881..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0d33d6ed2969501c7881..text: 今天如果没有完成任务，能不能也当作一次很好的出门？

assets/voice-lines/036201775274a262e165..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/036201775274a262e165..text: 蓝色围裙沾了少许面粉。她笑着指给你看，正确的力气不是越大越好。

assets/voice-lines/73d2eb07f3d156808835..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/73d2eb07f3d156808835..text: 她为两张椅子留下相同的距离，不把任何一人放在镜头之外。

assets/voice-lines/87b9485dd183006eaf69..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/87b9485dd183006eaf69..text: 不用现在就决定明天要做好多少事。先喝一口温水，让肩膀放松一点。

assets/voice-lines/c5df7e1988549c396e63..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c5df7e1988549c396e63..text: 如果路过月见，直接推门进来。不是每一次见面都要带着订单。

assets/voice-lines/f5cab7616b1a57e0ebda..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/f5cab7616b1a57e0ebda..text: 如果只能记住一个味道，你会选哪一种？不用照顾我的答案。

assets/voice-lines/bb27aa2b597431d1f467..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/bb27aa2b597431d1f467..text: 现在不用试吃点评。我只想和你一起，把今天慢慢吃完。

assets/voice-lines/79bb6c7727c732d85498..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/79bb6c7727c732d85498..text: 如果想不出来也没关系。我们可以等明天见面，再一起决定。

assets/voice-lines/db2ec808d9a480536839..speaker: jiang-yue
