assets/voice-lines/db2ec808d9a480536839..text: 今天的糖花已经装好了，不会因为没有立刻拍照就失去意义。

assets/voice-lines/59d3d3a52d51415d2ead..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/59d3d3a52d51415d2ead..text: 本来想做一块写着邀请的饼干，又怕你先吃掉，没看见。

assets/voice-lines/ccc6243b94bb7d903e80..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ccc6243b94bb7d903e80..text: 我不会跳舞。你要是也不会，我们可以一起慢慢学吗？

assets/voice-lines/248ca9633054e9329f6c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/248ca9633054e9329f6c..text: 她笑起来，裙摆轻轻划过地面。这个圆刚刚好，小到我们不会走散。

assets/voice-lines/20d1b9dbe0641a319e53..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/20d1b9dbe0641a319e53..text: 好。漫长不是一个很远的词，是我们还愿意一起吃很多顿早饭。

assets/voice-lines/a01790b7180fe13589d8..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a01790b7180fe13589d8..text: 你到了就敲两下门，我会知道，是想一起吃早饭的人。

assets/voice-lines/b4d69b6b8cc24faaa551..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b4d69b6b8cc24faaa551..text: 温室里的叶子还挂着露珠。早上好，给你留了一杯温水。

assets/voice-lines/f914896cca5f860d8070..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f914896cca5f860d8070..text: 今天的观察日志写完了。晚风很好，要一起坐一会儿吗？

assets/voice-lines/84200ed059dfd905924f..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/84200ed059dfd905924f..text: 花也会在夜里休息。你已经很努力了，别再为难自己。

assets/voice-lines/ad81921687e626ab8575..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ad81921687e626ab8575..text: 我把观察日志放在你旁边。我们各自努力，抬起头就能看见对方。

assets/voice-lines/cf665628eacad9e921c8..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/cf665628eacad9e921c8..text: 时间到了。你认真做事的样子，我都看见了。来，看看刚开的这朵花。

assets/voice-lines/685266fe5572b09a3501..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/685266fe5572b09a3501..text: 今天的事可以慢慢来。停下来喝口水，也是在照顾自己。

assets/voice-lines/4f0e9f9ca01e0af985d8..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/4f0e9f9ca01e0af985d8..text: 项目报告要交了，这株花却一点动静都没有。我是不是照顾得不够好？

assets/voice-lines/f97c3625a32d4ee37e71..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f97c3625a32d4ee37e71..text: 原来已经做了这么多。和你一起翻这些页，我没那么着急了。

assets/voice-lines/7cc3b6c8424e99642a70..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/7cc3b6c8424e99642a70..text: 这把伞有点小。你要是不习惯靠近，我可以再找一把。

assets/voice-lines/a82a1208b23a955873b2..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a82a1208b23a955873b2..text: 谢谢你把选择留给我。现在，可以借我一点点位置吗？

assets/voice-lines/b3e5b556d9f9b3429254..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b3e5b556d9f9b3429254..text: 那由我来决定我们的距离。再近一点，就都淋不到了。

assets/voice-lines/884063e6d2fed9f1f671..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/884063e6d2fed9f1f671..text: 给你。不是约会的谢礼，是想让你的窗台也有一点我的春天。

assets/voice-lines/6a09d07969bb78085ad2..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/6a09d07969bb78085ad2..text: 不是花开的那一秒。是你听我说了一整年的故事，还没有移开目光。

assets/voice-lines/71a6694b7bc6fb57617e..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/71a6694b7bc6fb57617e..text: 原来有人一起等，时间也会变得很好看。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/76476770541123cd25cf..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/76476770541123cd25cf..text: 这次不用旁白，雨已经把故事说完了。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/c68cb221ed7e89d08ce7..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c68cb221ed7e89d08ce7..text: 拍下缺角，再让种花的人讲它怎样活下来。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/0774d9d728e909a07394..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0774d9d728e909a07394..text: 申请留下固定机位，两个人到门外等结果。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/8bdadba40591ce68346f..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8bdadba40591ce68346f..text: 幸好你在，不然我一定要打电话叫醒你。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/b3fdcf9d0ab83a640299..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b3fdcf9d0ab83a640299..text: 做一份纸质照片册，再附上可以离线播放的短片。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/08167b32f5d3a002d722..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/08167b32f5d3a002d722..text: 下次一起去看看吧，镜头之外也有春天。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/f01bda780d5996cf90bf..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f01bda780d5996cf90bf..text: 我是楼下温室的林栀。今天那枝花，有找到合适的瓶子吗？

assets/voice-lines/0a10815e3242bac36456..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0a10815e3242bac36456..text: 想到你总会在清晨经过，想先告诉你，门边现在不挤了。

assets/voice-lines/6478810b9a5180e9e778..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/6478810b9a5180e9e778..text: 它没有枝头上的那样完整，却很适合夹在我们拍摄的那一页。

assets/voice-lines/f8c3abf87ad8ac6b654c..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f8c3abf87ad8ac6b654c..text: 我把低垂的花枝扶起来，忽然想到你替我撑伞的样子。

assets/voice-lines/83cb38e66d6c7474510b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/83cb38e66d6c7474510b..text: 我忍住了给所有人发消息的冲动，先打开了你的对话框。

assets/voice-lines/39553f84dbdde7afa555..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/39553f84dbdde7afa555..text: 照片里我正在看花，你在看我，所以我有点不敢放大。

assets/voice-lines/455dde07a47daa45bccf..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/455dde07a47daa45bccf..text: 我在屋檐下听了十分钟雨，发现每一片叶子的声音都不同。

assets/voice-lines/8eccc8fb98b0fc4673a3..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8eccc8fb98b0fc4673a3..text: 回去看了一遍今天的记录，发现自己没有再盯着被划掉的日期。

assets/voice-lines/d9e2a80d340379c29f1b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/d9e2a80d340379c29f1b..text: 下一部片子，也想一起拍。温室的门会一直给你留着。

assets/voice-lines/e468c40b838642b4f94b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/e468c40b838642b4f94b..text: 不是实验结果，是记得在午后停下来，喝完你带的茶。

assets/voice-lines/a63d413a5775e7216a17..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a63d413a5775e7216a17..text: 我给它浇了水，也给自己留了一点耐心。你今天也不用着急。

assets/voice-lines/2eb9e935b1acb02d8f9c..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/2eb9e935b1acb02d8f9c..text: 我想起你坐在那里翻书的样子。下次来，不用提前找话题。

assets/voice-lines/9180cce51baa4646f385..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/9180cce51baa4646f385..text: 不用每次都做得完美。来过、浇过水，都会留下痕迹。

assets/voice-lines/be9dbe2da00e9b491e21..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/be9dbe2da00e9b491e21..text: 我盯着它看了很久，后来反倒笑了。花从来没答应过按我的表格长大。

assets/voice-lines/b4b35dd89d14119f5115..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b4b35dd89d14119f5115..text: 我把明天的观察时间划掉了一格，留给一场没有任务的散步。

assets/voice-lines/485e57ba2a4371637eee..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/485e57ba2a4371637eee..text: 现在，先借我的枕头旁边这点安静，给自己也放一天假。

assets/voice-lines/3e601c9d1b1a5cc96fd4..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3e601c9d1b1a5cc96fd4..text: 那里没有植物学名，也没有日期，是我特意留下的空白。

assets/voice-lines/bfe6727fd8a3c2495506..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/bfe6727fd8a3c2495506..text: 后来才慢慢知道，有些夜晚不需要留下很完整的证据。

assets/voice-lines/cf738550a9e7dfa268c5..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/cf738550a9e7dfa268c5..text: 如果你还想说话，我就听；如果不想，我们听一会儿雨。

assets/voice-lines/bbf522c3d478a0c7cb34..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/bbf522c3d478a0c7cb34..text: 没有马上播下去，因为我还想和你商量，种在窗边的哪一侧。

assets/voice-lines/0eb44f199af747df7b90..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0eb44f199af747df7b90..text: 靠左会先晒到早晨的光，靠右能看见你平时坐的椅子。

assets/voice-lines/cf64f0043b524735dd8c..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/cf64f0043b524735dd8c..text: 我以前很习惯自己做这些决定，现在却喜欢多问一句。

assets/voice-lines/750aba6e9418a53efb86..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/750aba6e9418a53efb86..text: 不是因为拿不定主意，是因为想让这里慢慢有你的习惯。

assets/voice-lines/f073b9a3f84d52a04f14..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f073b9a3f84d52a04f14..text: 所以明天醒来，第一件事不是赶去温室，是听听你的答案。

assets/voice-lines/30a95d73d83da989ef62..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/30a95d73d83da989ef62..text: 温室的灯已经关了。今晚不用照顾所有花，先照顾好自己。

assets/voice-lines/c5d9162f6500400d735a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c5d9162f6500400d735a..text: 小夜灯留着吧。你不用为了怕打扰我，一直绷着精神。

assets/voice-lines/3f6b275d070c6c53930f..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3f6b275d070c6c53930f..text: 窗外的叶影停下来了。我们也慢一点，今天就到这里。

assets/voice-lines/fd6d448a2eca465b386c..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/fd6d448a2eca465b386c..text: 是想看看我有没有睡着吗？还没呢，我在等你说晚安。

assets/voice-lines/44c3f0fcac61a57bafa2..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/44c3f0fcac61a57bafa2..text: 被角已经掖好了。谢谢你，今晚轮到我陪你安心休息。

assets/voice-lines/4eeb6fe37cd0d8bcc5bf..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/4eeb6fe37cd0d8bcc5bf..text: 这次不用赶着拍它最好看的样子。先和我一起看一会儿，好吗？

assets/voice-lines/666853511b410447b90b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/666853511b410447b90b..text: 你们在花架另一端停下。雨点不再像催促，她把伞柄放到你们中间。

assets/voice-lines/b5c687ae90dc26418a98..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b5c687ae90dc26418a98..text: 以后不只花开的时候。我也想在那些还没有结果的日子见到你。

assets/voice-lines/a7070262073da4b9119a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a7070262073da4b9119a..text: 我刚看过那盆白花，状态很好。你也不用为了让我安心而说自己不累。

assets/voice-lines/e43a72dd10d133ecff23..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/e43a72dd10d133ecff23..text: 其实只要能方便照顾花就好。可想到你会来，我又想认真选一次。

assets/voice-lines/420f0a0b5ba8c0cf07da..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/420f0a0b5ba8c0cf07da..text: 她没有交给你一张严格的养护任务表，只说遇到问题随时找她。

assets/voice-lines/251d0bc85e79d2748ec9..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/251d0bc85e79d2748ec9..text: 两张椅子之间的距离被花篮挡住，你们干脆一起挪到拱门的同一侧。

assets/voice-lines/83f04ab32470cbaa7c4d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/83f04ab32470cbaa7c4d..text: 下一次夜展，我们可以不做邀请名单。先把彼此留在最靠近的位置。

assets/voice-lines/58e65d6da74f7c31fea4..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/58e65d6da74f7c31fea4..text: 那盆植物今天适应得好吗？不用每小时都去看，它也需要一点安静。

assets/voice-lines/6f5a4457660159cb12d6..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/6f5a4457660159cb12d6..text: 我忽然觉得，能和你讨论叶子的颜色，比在开幕式上发言还让我期待。

assets/voice-lines/716eff3aab538e1dd4e2..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/716eff3aab538e1dd4e2..text: 我想邀请你以朋友以外的身份来。不过，你可以慢慢回答。

assets/voice-lines/ccbd221af753da29008a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ccbd221af753da29008a..text: 我还以为你会劝我换一盆开着的花。谢谢你愿意和我站在这里。

assets/voice-lines/0352348784669adcbd5a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0352348784669adcbd5a..text: 你可以帮我戴上吗？别笑，我练习邀请你已经练习了好多遍。

assets/voice-lines/5b5c5f1005d384953d60..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/5b5c5f1005d384953d60..text: 她先看了看你的手，然后笑着走过来。好，我自己决定这一步的距离。

assets/voice-lines/ae0334d6c5ea76514a75..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ae0334d6c5ea76514a75..text: 这些灯不是展品。是我怕你回来找不到门，特意留着的。

assets/voice-lines/e94faaf54b41fc0fc0fa..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/e94faaf54b41fc0fc0fa..text: 这次不写花开了几分钟。我想记下，我终于牵到了你的手。

assets/voice-lines/f18283805180e479d357..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/f18283805180e479d357..text: 原来在我发出邀请之前，你就已经把这一天留出来了。

assets/voice-lines/298f10612d01a71b4bcf..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/298f10612d01a71b4bcf..text: 今天的花影有两道。以前我没有发现，这件小事会让我这样开心。

assets/voice-lines/b5e056234ae6ab87730f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b5e056234ae6ab87730f..text: 温室的窗边摆着两把椅子，其中一把垫了新洗的软垫。

assets/voice-lines/dae076e9a69639409751..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/dae076e9a69639409751..text: 时间在说话声里慢慢过去。这一段相处，被你们认真记住。

assets/voice-lines/8ab0b9099cf267a6f708..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8ab0b9099cf267a6f708..text: 观察表上，林栀划掉了预定开花的日期，铅笔停在纸边。

assets/voice-lines/566ce9b26ccf9249b873..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/566ce9b26ccf9249b873..text: 临走时，林栀在观察日志的最后一栏写下两个人的名字。

assets/voice-lines/31f22612f77b9e10abb3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/31f22612f77b9e10abb3..text: 雨势转小。门边只剩一把伞，两个人同时伸手，又停住。

assets/voice-lines/6ff45d42f751faa85cc7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6ff45d42f751faa85cc7..text: 林栀轻轻挽住你的手臂，试着让你们的步子落在同一拍上。

assets/voice-lines/672d875efc14e45d9a7a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/672d875efc14e45d9a7a..text: 温室留下了一盏小灯。林栀在昙花旁摆好椅子，认真看了看钟。

assets/voice-lines/a5bb9b0258167fae0a33..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a5bb9b0258167fae0a33..text: 花瓣终于松开了一道缝。你们屏住呼吸，又忍不住同时笑了。

assets/voice-lines/ffcee6bc32906c249e3b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ffcee6bc32906c249e3b..text: 你们并肩坐下。风穿过窗框，吹起她压在手边的草图。

assets/voice-lines/9ee69e8d3f7e58f2162d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9ee69e8d3f7e58f2162d..text: 下楼前，她把第二把椅子转向窗边，留出刚好能放杯子的地方。

assets/voice-lines/ce30ae6b57ed7b457298..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ce30ae6b57ed7b457298..text: 设计室的窗外下起雨，顾清禾把写满行程的便签翻了过去。

assets/voice-lines/9916b5f603a7cb86d9e1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9916b5f603a7cb86d9e1..text: 她拿出一张自己画的明信片，背面只有一个没写完的称呼。

assets/voice-lines/880a521fe276d1267450..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/880a521fe276d1267450..text: 你们把明信片立在桌边，雨声渐渐轻了，谁也没有急着起身。

assets/voice-lines/87b69f75ad0ebd836a0e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/87b69f75ad0ebd836a0e..text: 剪辑结束时，顾清禾还坐在窗边，台灯旁放着一份温热的晚餐。

assets/voice-lines/4e7b9fd058e2948ed4d8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4e7b9fd058e2948ed4d8..text: 你关掉播放失败的片段，她把自己的废稿箱推了过来。

assets/voice-lines/3f9dbf21d1260c8627e2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3f9dbf21d1260c8627e2..text: 你把椅子挪到她身边。她没有说话，只把灯光调得柔和一些。

assets/voice-lines/73b31369b748ea8ab78d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/73b31369b748ea8ab78d..text: 走廊只剩下你们的脚步声。她回头检查门锁，随后自然地牵住你。

assets/voice-lines/542a58ec2d4ce308891e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/542a58ec2d4ce308891e..text: 许知夏把耳机的一边递给你，手指却还停在播放键上。

assets/voice-lines/4a18b9d863862036222e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4a18b9d863862036222e..text: 旋律停在一句哼唱上，她把歌词本转向你，留白处有很多擦痕。

assets/voice-lines/5d7ea431b69a518605f1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5d7ea431b69a518605f1..text: 新歌录好了。她没有上传，先把文件发进了你们的聊天框。

assets/voice-lines/212219e995218c2e07a8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/212219e995218c2e07a8..text: 雨把露天演出推迟了，许知夏抱着吉他坐到窄窄的屋檐下。

assets/voice-lines/910c2882f6064b9a6719..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/910c2882f6064b9a6719..text: 她刚弹响第一个和弦，弦音便断了一下。你看见她悄悄握紧了手。

assets/voice-lines/b267977139a231a21146..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b267977139a231a21146..text: 你们听了一会儿雨。她忽然把滴水声敲进琴箱，重新唱起那段副歌。

assets/voice-lines/446598e4906fd7fe0d66..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/446598e4906fd7fe0d66..text: 雨停以后，路过的人为你们鼓了掌，她却先朝你弯起眼睛。

assets/voice-lines/40f8ddee3b4d5f31e781..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/40f8ddee3b4d5f31e781..text: 天台上只有两把椅子。许知夏把手机调成静音，认真调好琴弦。

assets/voice-lines/3e73f246a836a2191666..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3e73f246a836a2191666..text: 她放下吉他，握住你的手，清楚地说出那句反复修改过的话。

assets/voice-lines/757dc024c3d21f94d39c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/757dc024c3d21f94d39c..text: 城市的灯慢慢亮起来。她把一只耳机放回包里，另一只留在你手边。

assets/voice-lines/e25c7f9f8671c0807116..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e25c7f9f8671c0807116..text: 你问起她最近最开心的事。她翻了翻手账，合上时嘴角轻轻上扬。

assets/voice-lines/1c07df9515239c2954c2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1c07df9515239c2954c2..text: 她找到一张没有写日期的借书单，夹进你们共同读的那本书。

assets/voice-lines/b823c613c6bfb90f5c45..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b823c613c6bfb90f5c45..text: 离开书店前，她在手账末尾写下一行字，却没有立刻给你看。

assets/voice-lines/cc717f5c12c1b717ee17..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cc717f5c12c1b717ee17..text: 书店挂起暂停营业的牌子，苏晚借来两把椅子，和你坐在窗边。

assets/voice-lines/c22153260cb6fb96f6fa..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c22153260cb6fb96f6fa..text: 她把写满批注的稿纸折起来，折痕正好盖住一句没发出的抱怨。

assets/voice-lines/dad49afe1d1a2cbd509d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/dad49afe1d1a2cbd509d..text: 雨模糊了窗外的招牌。你替她把手机翻过去，留出一段安静。

assets/voice-lines/17012c6377954af06c31..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/17012c6377954af06c31..text: 她把那张稿纸拆开，撕下空白的背面，写了一张新的便签。

assets/voice-lines/28ba9d50a811bdd359d2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/28ba9d50a811bdd359d2..text: 最后一封确认邮件发出，苏晚没有打开新文件，而是合上了电脑。

assets/voice-lines/df02968a5630115fb6b2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/df02968a5630115fb6b2..text: 钟楼广场空了大半，她在手账上写下日期，又写下你的名字。

assets/voice-lines/8eeb252fe9f9ce65f753..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8eeb252fe9f9ce65f753..text: 她让你看那一页。名字下面写着：想把今晚留得长一点。

assets/voice-lines/561f8d5eb8fe725aa4d1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/561f8d5eb8fe725aa4d1..text: 你们沿着广场边缘走回去。她挽住你，问了今晚最后一个问题。

assets/voice-lines/e633ddc25e77ac7682ee..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e633ddc25e77ac7682ee..text: 江月把围裙递给你，烤箱里的第一炉面包还要等十二分钟。

assets/voice-lines/33fb129a5483f1892e7d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/33fb129a5483f1892e7d..text: 你搓出的面团歪向一边，她没有重做，只把自己的放在旁边。

assets/voice-lines/05576060407fb1ebe768..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/05576060407fb1ebe768..text: 面包慢慢涨起来，你们隔着烤箱的玻璃看它们挤到一起。

assets/voice-lines/bc8a6820048855d86e18..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bc8a6820048855d86e18..text: 江月把稍微歪一点的面包装进袋子，贴上一张画着笑脸的便签。

assets/voice-lines/1ca7f3438726550265cd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1ca7f3438726550265cd..text: 雨让街道提前安静下来。江月翻过门牌，为你调了一杯热可可。

assets/voice-lines/57056c8b938f1adab36c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/57056c8b938f1adab36c..text: 你喝了一口，江月立刻看向你，又把糖罐挪远了一点。

assets/voice-lines/9fb7cb9cd8b48162bbc2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9fb7cb9cd8b48162bbc2..text: 她换了一只杯子，少加一点糖，先试好温度，再推到你手边。

assets/voice-lines/16bb69a95bcaccb1cdf6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/16bb69a95bcaccb1cdf6..text: 雨停了，江月在菜单背面记下你的口味，旁边画了一个小月亮。

assets/voice-lines/b206f54b9f0227fe7241..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b206f54b9f0227fe7241..text: 烘焙店关灯前，江月从柜台下取出一块只写了日期的小蛋糕。

assets/voice-lines/f6e1dcdf47ce5b654b37..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f6e1dcdf47ce5b654b37..text: 她准备写蛋糕上的字，糖霜在笔尖停住，迟迟没有落下。

assets/voice-lines/fd5ecaed7a6cd9a4129e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fd5ecaed7a6cd9a4129e..text: 你们把蛋糕分成两半。她把有小月亮的那一块推到你这边。

assets/voice-lines/46d68cb80b791d614d3d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/46d68cb80b791d614d3d..text: 唐梨关掉补光灯，把直播中的牌子翻过去，又把身边的椅子拉开。

assets/voice-lines/e7a6d709b1bd61d7e93a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e7a6d709b1bd61d7e93a..text: 屋里安静下来，她下意识摸了摸手机，又把手收回去。

assets/voice-lines/68c93b90bdea828efdfa..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/68c93b90bdea828efdfa..text: 你们一起收好设备，她没有开新素材，而是替你倒了一杯水。

assets/voice-lines/653c8ed7c42a01949f50..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/653c8ed7c42a01949f50..text: 临走前，她把你的椅子留在原地，椅背上搭了一条柔软的毯子。

assets/voice-lines/5baa59dfd4e424605019..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5baa59dfd4e424605019..text: 户外直播被雨打断，你们坐进咖啡店，手机屏幕上还停着重连提示。

assets/voice-lines/5117e4fa74da707c1387..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5117e4fa74da707c1387..text: 消息发完，她还是看了一眼增长缓慢的关注数，随即把屏幕扣住。

assets/voice-lines/ad20ff91707c723b103a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ad20ff91707c723b103a..text: 窗外的雨映在杯沿上，她举起相机，最后却没有按下快门。

assets/voice-lines/c9ed0d829fc78b7b854f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c9ed0d829fc78b7b854f..text: 离开咖啡店时，她没有补发照片，而是把手机放回包里。

assets/voice-lines/2d2c95f9e0b02ee38d39..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2d2c95f9e0b02ee38d39..text: 弹幕清空后，唐梨没有离开。她关掉电脑，留下一盏暖色的小灯。

assets/voice-lines/15cc89ed14ee7e57c48b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/15cc89ed14ee7e57c48b..text: 她摘下耳机，声音比平时轻了一些，目光却没有躲开。

assets/voice-lines/1a8407c1108c55fe3a9c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1a8407c1108c55fe3a9c..text: 你在她身边坐下，她把手轻轻覆上来，等你回应之后才握紧。

assets/voice-lines/589b1e87c3803e44087c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/589b1e87c3803e44087c..text: 走到门口，她回头看了一眼没有开启的摄像机，安心地关上灯。

assets/voice-lines/eed07ddd4cf6cf9708f9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/eed07ddd4cf6cf9708f9..text: 你重新调整机位，把这次拍摄需要的准备记在场记板上。

assets/voice-lines/4cd77a875260f0f20511..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4cd77a875260f0f20511..text: 她把两份记录都装进文件夹，舍不得丢掉原来的字迹。

assets/voice-lines/5d03fdb040544a933540..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5d03fdb040544a933540..text: 你收好设备时，她又叫住你，说还有一句没有录进去。

assets/voice-lines/6b2136d7185be07cb3ad..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6b2136d7185be07cb3ad..text: 周末的温室快闭馆了，林栀把修剪过的枝叶收进纸袋。

assets/voice-lines/d60d7730adf11380f2db..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d60d7730adf11380f2db..text: 我按照约定来到侧门，发现她的帆布包里还装着两张野餐垫。

assets/voice-lines/1415c7d6e2c3ffd8533c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1415c7d6e2c3ffd8533c..text: 林栀看了看渐渐西斜的阳光，笑着把手里的喷壶放下。

assets/voice-lines/c4b0c6c04d15d35c8261..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c4b0c6c04d15d35c8261..text: 最后一只花盆被摆回窗边，玻璃上的金色光斑慢慢移动。

assets/voice-lines/9d66c24a26f999082d0e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9d66c24a26f999082d0e..text: 我在花园坐了很久，她终于拎着空花袋赶来，闭园铃却先响了。

assets/voice-lines/ab30b56900f4d0c0422e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ab30b56900f4d0c0422e..text: 温室临时需要清点苗木，我在门口帮她接过了收好的花盆。

assets/voice-lines/dee2e06e38de8e1da13b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/dee2e06e38de8e1da13b..text: 我带着收集的花形书签来到温室，林栀正在给一排空盆写标签。

assets/voice-lines/a7a317dcedb26fd3825e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a7a317dcedb26fd3825e..text: 她在标签上写下两个名字，把那只小盆放到最容易看到的地方。

assets/voice-lines/9ef1fbff9aea99108830..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9ef1fbff9aea99108830..text: 秋日邮局在温室旁开了临时窗口。林栀递给我一张压花明信片。

assets/voice-lines/8a93f0d20a9947ade652..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8a93f0d20a9947ade652..text: 她带来几粒可以越冬的花种，说想和我寄一封写给春天的信。

assets/voice-lines/3380991a935b0fe9b083..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3380991a935b0fe9b083..text: 我们把邮戳盖在同一张纸上，花种安静地躺在信封里。

assets/voice-lines/9b562875f2944a199ba7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9b562875f2944a199ba7..text: 收信窗口临时关闭，压花明信片被她重新收进了书里。

assets/voice-lines/b5758de8464910c2bc3a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b5758de8464910c2bc3a..text: 顾清禾约我去看一条修缮后的老街，手里没有平时那卷图纸。

assets/voice-lines/5895ed16d79347b78b57..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5895ed16d79347b78b57..text: 石板路上刚晒过太阳，窗台上的猫打了个长长的呵欠。

assets/voice-lines/09b888c085a351220625..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/09b888c085a351220625..text: 巷口的钟响过一声，我发现她把步子放得比平时更慢。

assets/voice-lines/7a0e1582b1a5a991b91a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7a0e1582b1a5a991b91a..text: 她指着一扇低低的窗，说这里以前会飘出烤栗子的香气。

assets/voice-lines/ccf5aca621f2abc1a38b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ccf5aca621f2abc1a38b..text: 她在我的歪线旁添了一束花，纸上那扇窗忽然像有了住户。

assets/voice-lines/ffcde9f711e389cd5af2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ffcde9f711e389cd5af2..text: 桥下的水把夕阳揉得很碎，她的手轻轻碰到我的手背。

assets/voice-lines/b90e4dc7993f74e72f7e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b90e4dc7993f74e72f7e..text: 桥面临时维修，我们在围栏外分享了杯里最后一点热茶。

assets/voice-lines/9b0f957bfeb34761f41f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9b0f957bfeb34761f41f..text: 顾清禾在书房里挪开一只纸箱，露出新添的第二把椅子。

assets/voice-lines/9760f333afcbc3fd835b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9760f333afcbc3fd835b..text: 她把桌灯转了个角度，让两个人都能看清各自的那一页。

assets/voice-lines/5402914efe22548b738e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5402914efe22548b738e..text: 顾清禾带我走进老邮局，挑了一张印着街角灯影的卡片。

assets/voice-lines/11a917038066ce09a232..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/11a917038066ce09a232..text: 她说这里以前负责投递整条老街的信，柜台的木纹还和记忆里一样。

assets/voice-lines/68e506afa4c0e79137e4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/68e506afa4c0e79137e4..text: 柜台上的钟走过整点，工作人员把下一班邮车时间写在黑板上。

assets/voice-lines/192f68ce5c95d735c1ce..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/192f68ce5c95d735c1ce..text: 我们赶上了投递，却没来得及给那两把椅子涂上颜色。

assets/voice-lines/86870d4eefa381f613e9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/86870d4eefa381f613e9..text: 许知夏在唱片店门前冲我挥手，耳机线从帆布包里露出一小截。

assets/voice-lines/4eb1104d0ad864693329..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4eb1104d0ad864693329..text: 店里贴着一张手写告示：今天可以试听旧唱片的B面。

assets/voice-lines/59a3cabebb81e73c57d7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/59a3cabebb81e73c57d7..text: 她把一张没有封套的唱片举到灯下，像发现了什么宝物。

assets/voice-lines/47170284387187f4cf75..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/47170284387187f4cf75..text: 试听间里只有一张小沙发，她往里挪了一点，为我留出位置。

assets/voice-lines/eb89353771e11a2885d2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/eb89353771e11a2885d2..text: 店员找到的热门曲结束时，那张陌生唱片已经被另一位客人借走。

assets/voice-lines/410d8596f35bcd8144a5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/410d8596f35bcd8144a5..text: 店主临时收店，我们撑着一把伞站在檐下，耳机还没来得及打开。

assets/voice-lines/b9c1c7f1e1c98eddbb4e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b9c1c7f1e1c98eddbb4e..text: 许知夏打开录音笔，里面不是作品小样，是几声走调的笑。

assets/voice-lines/9316392fc51627b96b92..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9316392fc51627b96b92..text: 她把文件换了个只有我们能明白的名字，靠着我又哼了一遍。

assets/voice-lines/c9617236c9c1e9f18c84..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c9617236c9c1e9f18c84..text: 许知夏带来一张空白五线谱，想寄给三个月后的自己。

assets/voice-lines/9e14a68d6af33bbe4cc9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9e14a68d6af33bbe4cc9..text: 邮局窗口播放着老电台，她跟着哼了一小句，又停下来笑。

assets/voice-lines/1d841c85235a080febb7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1d841c85235a080febb7..text: 我誊完那段熟悉的副歌，抬头才发现她一直在等我的新一句。

assets/voice-lines/875d1504083be81bdb33..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/875d1504083be81bdb33..text: 苏晚终于有了一个不用追采访的下午，约我在河边旧书摊见面。

assets/voice-lines/0a2d010b35af610f530c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0a2d010b35af610f530c..text: 她买了一本封皮磨旧的旅行笔记，书里夹着一张没有署名的车票。

assets/voice-lines/303904eedfb357556ca4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/303904eedfb357556ca4..text: 纸页上只有一行铅笔字：到了以后，先给家里打电话。

assets/voice-lines/d2d149e23a3a5ce70a95..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d2d149e23a3a5ce70a95..text: 她在自己的随身本里写下我们的答案，合上时没拍照片。

assets/voice-lines/21fce9edba87acc9d8f1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/21fce9edba87acc9d8f1..text: 搜索结果很完整，那张车票却始终没有说出主人的名字。

assets/voice-lines/2957ee54f979f02398db..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2957ee54f979f02398db..text: 风把纸页吹乱，书摊老板收摊的铃声打断了我们的猜测。

assets/voice-lines/53f4913b856a6d8c07eb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/53f4913b856a6d8c07eb..text: 苏晚递给我一本新笔记，第一页只有一句：今天有人等我。

assets/voice-lines/80c71c8a0e4f1ce7aead..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/80c71c8a0e4f1ce7aead..text: 她把笔记放在两个人之间，空白的半页被午后的光慢慢照亮。

assets/voice-lines/428586f8bf16037e5ca4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/428586f8bf16037e5ca4..text: 她说今天不查证寄信人的身份，只想写一封属于自己的。

assets/voice-lines/d8af4073471b7aa0042e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d8af4073471b7aa0042e..text: 柜台摆着一枚特别邮戳，图案是一只停在栏杆上的小鸟。

assets/voice-lines/904a360c97bec3ace8c1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/904a360c97bec3ace8c1..text: 邮戳的小鸟落在我们画的小鸟旁边，像多了一位安静的见证者。

assets/voice-lines/0fe84e35bcdc506cc394..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0fe84e35bcdc506cc394..text: 漂亮的标题占了一整行，真正想说的话却还没写出来。

assets/voice-lines/5bbda60c3fd0b68319de..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5bbda60c3fd0b68319de..text: 江月把店门的牌子翻到休息，围裙上还沾着一点糖粉。

assets/voice-lines/12a7675ee3251650317a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/12a7675ee3251650317a..text: 今天她想去湖边走走，把最后一块试做蛋糕留给了我。

assets/voice-lines/658679987965e879f006..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/658679987965e879f006..text: 我拎起她放在柜台上的野餐篮，发现里面只有两个小叉子。

assets/voice-lines/141b3d28e030eb6abbee..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/141b3d28e030eb6abbee..text: 湖边的长凳刚好能坐下两个人，她打开装着蛋糕的小盒子。

assets/voice-lines/8460468a6abeaef96fb2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8460468a6abeaef96fb2..text: 奶油的一角在路上有点歪，她不好意思地用叉子把它扶正。

assets/voice-lines/47d31c0a515943cc2bcd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/47d31c0a515943cc2bcd..text: 她把两半草莓摆在两块蛋糕上，又把我的那块轻轻推过来。

assets/voice-lines/cd83ca3d848534631fd9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cd83ca3d848534631fd9..text: 试做结束时已经过了午后，我们提着篮子赶到湖边，长凳却都坐满了。

assets/voice-lines/7ed5e0d9450a46207967..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7ed5e0d9450a46207967..text: 一盘接一盘的调整让人忘了时间，蛋糕最后被分装进两个盒子。

assets/voice-lines/557065e8c71664bd4652..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/557065e8c71664bd4652..text: 江月拿出一本旧配方本，夹页里是一张写着休息日的小纸条。

assets/voice-lines/aacaa8777a8e796773c7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/aacaa8777a8e796773c7..text: 她用橙色笔把三个小方框都画得圆圆的，给我也留了一支笔。

assets/voice-lines/837eb2a82b357cd6d429..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/837eb2a82b357cd6d429..text: 她想把一张甜点食谱寄给远方的老师，也把一份留给我。

assets/voice-lines/79b5cbb6d85a58434a64..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/79b5cbb6d85a58434a64..text: 临时邮局不卖蛋糕，但窗边有足够两个人写字的小桌。

assets/voice-lines/8c5e4acda27b0cc39a07..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8c5e4acda27b0cc39a07..text: 食谱旁画着两条小围裙，我的那条口袋里还有一朵花。

assets/voice-lines/c65dec257e8186ceae87..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c65dec257e8186ceae87..text: 我们在邮局外分完最后两颗糖，糖纸被她折成小小的船。

assets/voice-lines/fbf3f5f3dd83fb812825..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fbf3f5f3dd83fb812825..text: 排队的人渐渐散去，最简版食谱上只写了步骤，没有她想画的花。

assets/voice-lines/cacf8c45ddedc813df17..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cacf8c45ddedc813df17..text: 唐梨说今天的散步不直播，只带了一台关着屏幕的小相机。

assets/voice-lines/099be1fcce4e9437111d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/099be1fcce4e9437111d..text: 山路拐到一处平台，她摘下相机挂绳，认真伸了个懒腰。

assets/voice-lines/2a36922cd32392ecfe2e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2a36922cd32392ecfe2e..text: 没有提示音的风里，只能听见两个人的脚步和远处的鸟。

assets/voice-lines/0b7bd37bf961a1a98b6f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0b7bd37bf961a1a98b6f..text: 我们躺在草地上认云，她把一朵说成了正在睡觉的小猫。

assets/voice-lines/a1b21fd94f9a35c51525..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a1b21fd94f9a35c51525..text: 我们在山脚剪完最后一段画面，回头时日落已经被楼影遮住。

assets/voice-lines/4325e0ceb6995d1f8584..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4325e0ceb6995d1f8584..text: 我把椅子往她身边移近一些，窗外的车声像慢慢退远的潮水。

assets/voice-lines/97a2b18e56f5fe7d013f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/97a2b18e56f5fe7d013f..text: 唐梨找到一张可以贴合影的明信片，背面没有直播账号的标记。

assets/voice-lines/2ea425b3e191384858d4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2ea425b3e191384858d4..text: 她说今天想试试，不给所有人看的记录会是什么样子。

assets/voice-lines/492a386b9d89e0018f29..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/492a386b9d89e0018f29..text: 邮局窗边摆着一台即时打印机，我们的照片只需要印两张。

assets/voice-lines/63d33f59453a54ac0438..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/63d33f59453a54ac0438..text: 漂亮的照片选好了，明信片背面却始终没写出第一句。

assets/voice-lines/f3dd8de699a30bec54b5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f3dd8de699a30bec54b5..text: 我曾经以为，想留下一个人，就要准备足够有趣的话题。

assets/voice-lines/b3992e98a0f54cd9b056..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b3992e98a0f54cd9b056..text: “下次再来”听起来太客气，“希望你留下”又说得太急。

assets/voice-lines/c2726396016aec60cdd1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c2726396016aec60cdd1..text: 观察表的最后一格依旧空着。她忽然觉得，不急着填满也很好。

assets/voice-lines/b58ae604b245e78a212b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b58ae604b245e78a212b..text: 在这个以时间命名的地方，她第一次没有用分钟计算一次等待。

assets/voice-lines/7e3ea59e6c2034338bb8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7e3ea59e6c2034338bb8..text: 今天没有必须加班的理由。灯还亮着，是我自己的决定。

assets/voice-lines/99f64f6d1beb0240496a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/99f64f6d1beb0240496a..text: 沈屿把播放按钮交给她。她按下去，第一次没有伸手调低自己的声音。

assets/voice-lines/84f38ca92019a95336bb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/84f38ca92019a95336bb..text: 今天我想留住的，是没有麦克风也愿意听我说话的人。

assets/voice-lines/fff1166db1c569512a8d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fff1166db1c569512a8d..text: 为另一个人腾出位置，有时比一段长长的措辞更先暴露心意。

assets/voice-lines/0e172981b200120faccb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0e172981b200120faccb..text: 我很会问别人想说什么，却总觉得自己的话可以晚一点再说。

assets/voice-lines/6543fb54f0f9e20fdfc6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6543fb54f0f9e20fdfc6..text: 今天想试试，让他先听我讲一件和工作完全无关的小事。

assets/voice-lines/2f6ec0b1c2ba6243e66e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2f6ec0b1c2ba6243e66e..text: 我写给他，也写给我自己。我们都太习惯把“没关系”放在句子前面。

assets/voice-lines/baf85a2b7990d2ea532a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/baf85a2b7990d2ea532a..text: 如果他看到了，我就不解释成随手摘抄。那确实是我想对他说的话。

assets/voice-lines/9ec006e41bd5831d79b1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9ec006e41bd5831d79b1..text: 一份甜点可以先是甜点，一次见面也可以先因为想见面。

assets/voice-lines/d4c3625fbf201b6c365f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d4c3625fbf201b6c365f..text: 上次他说桂花味很轻，我就记住了。不能再假装今天只是随便试做。

assets/voice-lines/9593e37289cf5351d914..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9593e37289cf5351d914..text: 有的人坐下来以后，店里缺了什么、多了什么，好像都能慢慢说。

assets/voice-lines/8fe5ba33c8b428cb417f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8fe5ba33c8b428cb417f..text: 镜头拍不到这个位置。唐梨却比布置直播背景更认真地整理过它。

assets/voice-lines/81429bc4f8e0df8c2fb8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/81429bc4f8e0df8c2fb8..text: 拍摄清单当然可以明天再核对。我留下他，不全是为了工作。

assets/voice-lines/9e371f7401b9e9fa2437..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9e371f7401b9e9fa2437..text: 她换上白金色礼裙，掌心托着刚编好的花冠，细枝上保留着几片叶子。

assets/voice-lines/ac70ff8d10414aa23e73..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ac70ff8d10414aa23e73..text: 花冠并不完美，但当你靠近时，她忽然不再想把每一片叶子都摆正。

assets/voice-lines/5242d644ab2e331d8713..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5242d644ab2e331d8713..text: 宾客离开后，林栀把主灯关掉，窗边的两盏小灯却没有熄。

assets/voice-lines/75bf66cdbf72314af6d4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/75bf66cdbf72314af6d4..text: 邀请函写错了三次。林栀把前三张留在日志里，没有撕掉。

assets/voice-lines/4261a63390e3c9c623a1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4261a63390e3c9c623a1..text: 夜色渐深，四周的声音慢慢远去。她把这一段时间，只留给了你。

assets/voice-lines/942eb0217c225fd67247..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/942eb0217c225fd67247..text: 钟楼修缮的庆祝晚会将开场，顾清禾却递来一张没有尺寸标注的草图。

assets/voice-lines/62abc669ed91dfe73ee6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/62abc669ed91dfe73ee6..text: 晚会的音乐传来，她把搭在臂弯的披肩往你这边挪了一些。

assets/voice-lines/0d2f1a03957e20705ea2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0d2f1a03957e20705ea2..text: 她认真地点头。桥上的风很轻，两个人终于不用隔着一张工作台说话。

assets/voice-lines/234883c9fcdf2c4d8235..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/234883c9fcdf2c4d8235..text: 原定看烟火的露台因为小雨关闭，她却没有拿出第二份行程表。

assets/voice-lines/be9058777cc9f66b87a8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/be9058777cc9f66b87a8..text: 钟声响起时，她没有看表。窗外的整座城市，都安静地退到你们身后。

assets/voice-lines/f873415e5c2513f72ecf..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f873415e5c2513f72ecf..text: 我提前半小时到了廊桥，站在她从办公室出来一定能看见的地方。

assets/voice-lines/51e9a83036c484e87cea..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/51e9a83036c484e87cea..text: 许知夏把音乐会的票交给你，票背没有写座位号，只画了一颗小星星。

assets/voice-lines/0c26076c668fc159dc16..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0c26076c668fc159dc16..text: 她换好金色礼裙，挪出琴凳的一半，膝边还放着刚刚取下的外套。

assets/voice-lines/3f6ca514e4a2251e233b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3f6ca514e4a2251e233b..text: 她把节拍放慢，原本练了很多遍的曲子，第一次有了两个人的停顿。

assets/voice-lines/d3b19d4ffacdfef34268..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d3b19d4ffacdfef34268..text: 掌声停下后，她把最后一束花放在钢琴边，却没有离开琴凳。

assets/voice-lines/5ba6cb4f6ad2513ddfb2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5ba6cb4f6ad2513ddfb2..text: 窗外星光映在琴盖上。她的手落在你的手旁边，没有急着按下琴键。

assets/voice-lines/272467abb093823817d7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/272467abb093823817d7..text: 我把手机调成静音，怕错过她琴声里最轻的一次呼吸。

assets/voice-lines/5b7cf893471bc6033d79..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5b7cf893471bc6033d79..text: 她忘了一个音，看向台下。我没有替她着急，只抬起手轻轻数了四拍。

assets/voice-lines/cc0cdcd26e695341f861..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cc0cdcd26e695341f861..text: 许知夏把邀请他合奏的话写在琴谱角上，彩排时却怎么也说不自然。

assets/voice-lines/a21f9ab7ff12899d6eb9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a21f9ab7ff12899d6eb9..text: 苏晚将最后一篇城市报道提交，屏幕旁放着一封没有报社抬头的邀请。

assets/voice-lines/94e3fd8d552458f9b9e3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/94e3fd8d552458f9b9e3..text: 晚宴设在书馆顶楼。她穿着银蓝礼裙，却忘了带习惯随身放的采访本。

assets/voice-lines/cf471c0eabad722cb45c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cf471c0eabad722cb45c..text: 她没有偷看笔尖。等待你写完的几分钟，比整场晚宴都让她紧张。

assets/voice-lines/9f553f69113f3fce8e5c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9f553f69113f3fce8e5c..text: 人群散去，她倚着窗边，第一次没有马上追问你刚才沉默的原因。

assets/voice-lines/fb4a23e3c272143cadd8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fb4a23e3c272143cadd8..text: 书签夹回了书里。她关掉录音笔，和你并肩望着街巷最后一盏店灯。

assets/voice-lines/cac6ff72bc0e9f77e7df..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cac6ff72bc0e9f77e7df..text: 我原本想写一大段郑重的话，落笔时却只剩一句普通的约定。

assets/voice-lines/4eb72ad871caee9cc7af..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4eb72ad871caee9cc7af..text: 那些想说又停住的话，不需要剪辑，不需要写成引语。

assets/voice-lines/a464b2af904ecff44461..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a464b2af904ecff44461..text: 为晚宴准备的蛋糕试做三次，她仍不满意最后一层糖霜。

assets/voice-lines/3cde61ff2a11d7a72a5c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3cde61ff2a11d7a72a5c..text: 宴会的音乐响起，江月拢了拢白金礼裙的裙摆，脚尖却没有往前。

assets/voice-lines/96044ad3398af95907dc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/96044ad3398af95907dc..text: 她把手放进你掌心，小心翼翼的一步，却比练习过的任何动作都自然。

assets/voice-lines/d880fb9fbe79bb79620c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d880fb9fbe79bb79620c..text: 夜色映在水晶杯上，她取下披肩的一角，替你挡住露台的风。

assets/voice-lines/58ea8eb7457380d67417..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/58ea8eb7457380d67417..text: 谢谢你把我也算进去。她说得很轻，却把整块都吃完了。

assets/voice-lines/e1a6b8230ed6f630708a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e1a6b8230ed6f630708a..text: 她穿着红金礼裙站在院门边，出门前最后一次确认相机已经关机。

assets/voice-lines/ecd6a40574790abb85b8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ecd6a40574790abb85b8..text: 灯影落在石阶上，唐梨拿出一台旧拍立得，却没有举向你。

assets/voice-lines/d07fdb785d6c8e50f0f9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d07fdb785d6c8e50f0f9..text: 你们找到一张安静的长椅。她把原来放包的位置空出来，拍了拍身边。

assets/voice-lines/1079fddca467938acfae..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1079fddca467938acfae..text: 相纸慢慢显影，她把照片放进没有透明展示窗的夹层。

assets/voice-lines/f6f82b6c430f5089896b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f6f82b6c430f5089896b..text: 她问照片好不好看，我却先说，刚才你松了一口气的样子很好。

assets/voice-lines/b4ed72f30c96cc056065..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b4ed72f30c96cc056065..text: 这不是躲开观众。是终于愿意把一段时间，留给没有镜头的自己。

assets/voice-lines/50a0bc1ac25a2ad82ecf..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/50a0bc1ac25a2ad82ecf..text: 我看见你每天记下的温度和湿度，那些认真并没有白费。

assets/voice-lines/51ebd55ecd47b2e722c8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/51ebd55ecd47b2e722c8..text: 我也是。我想认识写不出歌、会紧张、也会开心的你。

assets/voice-lines/6a49702dbe14fc13b62d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6a49702dbe14fc13b62d..text: 我听见了。我喜欢那个会等关机声结束，才认真说话的唐梨。

assets/voice-lines/58f37e9fa741bd539dbf..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/58f37e9fa741bd539dbf..text: 今天先把「种子观察纪录」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/bcd7e8c985b28f47fe55..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/bcd7e8c985b28f47fe55..text: 今天留下的素材里，这一段我想放在最靠近片尾的地方。

assets/voice-lines/b643dd758fef232f5009..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b643dd758fef232f5009..text: 那我们下次拍摄的时候见。也可以，在不工作的时候见。

assets/voice-lines/ac394812f14d52173a41..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ac394812f14d52173a41..text: 今天先把「温室雨声采样」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/5fbca83e43c4dbb87fed..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5fbca83e43c4dbb87fed..text: 今天先把「社区花展访谈」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/5eafe667a074d3abb355..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5eafe667a074d3abb355..text: 今天先把「夜花固定机位」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/1fadaddc78ff9077f28c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/1fadaddc78ff9077f28c..text: 今天先把「植物影像课堂」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/03b4b991fc58bc1df314..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/03b4b991fc58bc1df314..text: 今天先把「温室四季片尾」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/b23d9fdb5d529af50af4..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b23d9fdb5d529af50af4..text: 今天先把「旧窗测绘记录」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/7220de0c4ff2b363f1c0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7220de0c4ff2b363f1c0..text: 今天先把「楼道采光调查」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/97a25aa4f536b394e74e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/97a25aa4f536b394e74e..text: 今天先把「邻里空间提案」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/13fcf574fdb49c89e1fc..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/13fcf574fdb49c89e1fc..text: 今天先把「无障碍动线测试」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/68d0f7a071942d65ce33..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/68d0f7a071942d65ce33..text: 今天先把「屋顶花园样段」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/69ff0b147bb6bf668a9f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/69ff0b147bb6bf668a9f..text: 今天先把「街区修缮终稿」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/9db1a51b0fa5f5ed5207..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/9db1a51b0fa5f5ed5207..text: 今天先把「天台声音测试」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/b94ff8f2f7438edcb2af..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b94ff8f2f7438edcb2af..text: 今天先把「社区节奏课堂」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/281dac388ea86c3492a7..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/281dac388ea86c3492a7..text: 今天先把「旧歌征集节目」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/e1edebeccc5085482671..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e1edebeccc5085482671..text: 今天先把「雨天演出记录」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/8d62e6a99be405e3a772..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8d62e6a99be405e3a772..text: 今天先把「创作手稿访谈」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/38d44e3d50efe4c174b6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/38d44e3d50efe4c174b6..text: 今天先把「天台试映终曲」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/9a9b0501f43ba0727f03..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/9a9b0501f43ba0727f03..text: 今天先把「阅览室人物采访」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/be9c6e1c720458e4a9f9..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/be9c6e1c720458e4a9f9..text: 那就让观众陪他安静两秒。

assets/voice-lines/530139bc5bace91b1a6d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/530139bc5bace91b1a6d..text: 最后一遍回放，陪我一起看好吗？

assets/voice-lines/9812601115346550e888..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/9812601115346550e888..text: 等布场完成，我就坐过去。

assets/voice-lines/6fecc019a5588fff8fa1..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/6fecc019a5588fff8fa1..text: 今天没有答案，也不算白来。

assets/voice-lines/a39fe224e4fdc232b62b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a39fe224e4fdc232b62b..text: 音乐好了。你准备好抬头了吗？

assets/voice-lines/ec8fc9e6a57561942e5a..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ec8fc9e6a57561942e5a..text: 安全帽戴好。这里每一块砖，都比我们的年纪大。

assets/voice-lines/61e383324cb646977f6d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/61e383324cb646977f6d..text: 这是小时候画的钟楼。窗户画歪了，一直没舍得改。

assets/voice-lines/658486fb8b928e87f074..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/658486fb8b928e87f074..text: 也许，先把当时站在窗前的人画进去。

assets/voice-lines/e5b8aab1d4ad7f88421f..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e5b8aab1d4ad7f88421f..text: 慢一点也没关系。这次没有人催我们交稿。

assets/voice-lines/b38997c4c1cd33c9d6f3..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b38997c4c1cd33c9d6f3..text: 测量完了。接下来这十分钟，可以不用谈工作吗？

assets/voice-lines/119507f67515b1587307..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/119507f67515b1587307..text: 过来一点。好的位置，要给两个人留。

assets/voice-lines/eaa7eba26d724cc4ead2..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/eaa7eba26d724cc4ead2..text: 都这么晚了，工作室还亮着灯。先把手上的活放下。

assets/voice-lines/8eec274ec4efecbe93a0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/8eec274ec4efecbe93a0..text: 这条不用拍进去。是专门写给你的。

assets/voice-lines/c985832262b52366ae7c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c985832262b52366ae7c..text: 你说会来，我就不把这一份算成剩下的。

assets/voice-lines/7397ff7e09e75d1b4b5f..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/7397ff7e09e75d1b4b5f..text: 还有人预订了那块“烤歪了也很好吃”的蛋糕。

assets/voice-lines/b6d9300416e7081e0ffa..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b6d9300416e7081e0ffa..text: 有人问，片子里的温室明天开不开门。

assets/voice-lines/f33bed97b21e45faa227..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f33bed97b21e45faa227..text: 店里收拾完毕，靠窗却还亮着灯，桌上有两把叉子。

assets/voice-lines/9dc2d279453c60b48aa4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9dc2d279453c60b48aa4..text: 字幕走到最后，江月轻轻敲了敲你的杯沿。

assets/voice-lines/60ca2fffb2d2715f59d1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/60ca2fffb2d2715f59d1..text: 你画的修缮方案，保留了楼顶那扇旧窗。为什么？

assets/voice-lines/03157b6d198577f53929..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/03157b6d198577f53929..text: 采访名单最后，为什么还有你的名字？

assets/voice-lines/f630f563ba5c7456aec2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f630f563ba5c7456aec2..text: 那我们去买两杯热饮，等这阵雨过去。

assets/voice-lines/c850a8f3ee0af632c866..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c850a8f3ee0af632c866..text: 那就一起把它拍下来，让更多人知道这扇窗的故事。

assets/voice-lines/5f59cc18b7177d3ed016..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5f59cc18b7177d3ed016..text: 这一版图纸的署名，变成了“晴川街坊共同修订”。

assets/voice-lines/add7190840c90cd27553..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/add7190840c90cd27553..text: 这段旋律……我在父亲的旧母带里听过。

assets/voice-lines/1e5f1649cdff0664e219..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/1e5f1649cdff0664e219..text: 我写了很多句，还是觉得不像歌词。

assets/voice-lines/b6816c051a7153bfb7dd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b6816c051a7153bfb7dd..text: 想。这次，我坐在离你最近的位置。

assets/voice-lines/bf47dda23db12aeb61da..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/bf47dda23db12aeb61da..text: 父亲那天也在钟楼。可这盘片子为什么没有上映？

assets/voice-lines/174288b1aff7fc7bb49c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/174288b1aff7fc7bb49c..text: 我明白。不能因为着急，就替一个人决定他的故事。

assets/voice-lines/b287846dc98efd5bd8d2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b287846dc98efd5bd8d2..text: 有一点累。但坐在这里，就想再说一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/e8c20946001441bac21c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e8c20946001441bac21c..text: 剪了一整天，却总觉得还不够好。我怕辜负大家。

assets/voice-lines/4611ceb4a89b6c6ec9ba..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4611ceb4a89b6c6ec9ba..text: 那今天这一段，叫“什么也不赶”。

assets/voice-lines/944d2f94077dfc94775c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/944d2f94077dfc94775c..text: 刚才失焦了。你递蛋糕的那一下，没有拍清楚。

assets/voice-lines/8d4ba946024a101e7f80..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8d4ba946024a101e7f80..text: 如果我也只是做到了“味道还不错”呢？

assets/voice-lines/ae284ae640187a6cda62..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ae284ae640187a6cda62..text: 原来，普通的一天也能让这么多人安静下来。

assets/voice-lines/5d29d94b273d54820f53..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5d29d94b273d54820f53..text: 谢谢你们。下一部片子，还想和大家一起拍。

assets/voice-lines/064493baf087242bac26..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/064493baf087242bac26..text: 那就送出去吧。这次，别忘了让自己也走进画面。

assets/voice-lines/f9e01a0662012dda69e8..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f9e01a0662012dda69e8..text: 被认真叫出名字，也是一件很重要的事。

assets/voice-lines/1903f9312dd35e2b7801..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1903f9312dd35e2b7801..text: 制作人也是这条街的一员，当然在名单里。

assets/voice-lines/39d6ab109ad12faf9371..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/39d6ab109ad12faf9371..text: 定时十秒。沈屿，快来，这次别落下自己。

assets/voice-lines/4cb63da8d767d68bb747..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4cb63da8d767d68bb747..text: 第一遍先别录。今天的手指，还有一点紧张。

assets/voice-lines/710a4909b09e21417fdd..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/710a4909b09e21417fdd..text: 原来歌也会等人。那我们让它等到一个完整的结尾。

assets/voice-lines/dbdbbb356eec5c1430ad..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/dbdbbb356eec5c1430ad..text: 当然。但副歌要你来写。不许躲在摄影机后面哦。

assets/voice-lines/161e86f5860fcd2561b4..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/161e86f5860fcd2561b4..text: 这一次，我们都没有躲在别人的声音后面。

assets/voice-lines/1e4f945f153eff0588be..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/1e4f945f153eff0588be..text: 还有一首，没有写在节目单里。你想听吗？

assets/voice-lines/b7cf1e6753c07fbca699..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b7cf1e6753c07fbca699..text: 别紧张，你写的副歌，比你自己以为的好听。

assets/voice-lines/05bd048479805c809be4..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/05bd048479805c809be4..text: 我也住在这座城里。也想留下一段，和你一起修窗的记忆。

assets/voice-lines/d9d528255863eca5fc63..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d9d528255863eca5fc63..text: 好。但我希望片尾，有你自己的名字。不是只做别人的影子。

assets/voice-lines/70c5a60b2ecd5d9b4fc1..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/70c5a60b2ecd5d9b4fc1..text: 因为这不是我一个人的答案。谢谢你，把每一个声音都录下来。

assets/voice-lines/1cd93b4201ab3a045d2c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1cd93b4201ab3a045d2c..text: 旧窗修好了。片子上映以后，带你上去看看新的风景。

assets/voice-lines/e4387684cf0c76f1f80f..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e4387684cf0c76f1f80f..text: 电线检查完了，窗也关好了。剩下的，就交给你们的故事。

assets/voice-lines/4e0bb0640ad952c93d76..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/4e0bb0640ad952c93d76..text: 等面包的时候，不一定要再做一件事。坐下来，也是在过日子。

assets/voice-lines/da6e900eddad69a72053..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/da6e900eddad69a72053..text: 这是今天烤歪的一块蛋糕。卖不了，但味道还是好的。

assets/voice-lines/c0e86b11a8a128afea29..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c0e86b11a8a128afea29..text: 可你接住了呀。不是每一件好事，都必须留在镜头里。

assets/voice-lines/cbc30837f03015f50856..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/cbc30837f03015f50856..text: 那我就坐在第一排，认真看完。你做的事情，不需要每一刻都完美。

assets/voice-lines/26cdb01b7b02c3181b71..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/26cdb01b7b02c3181b71..text: 今晚别剪到太晚。片子里的人，也希望你照顾好自己。

assets/voice-lines/32b02b8080b728f4a2da..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/32b02b8080b728f4a2da..text: 我知道，还没首映。不过今天这一小步，也值得碰杯。

assets/voice-lines/3728ce022c69af730499..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3728ce022c69af730499..text: 温室里的树开花了。我把第一枝留给你，和第一次见面时一样。

assets/voice-lines/d3ff0bc3064bc7a104af..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d3ff0bc3064bc7a104af..text: 木楼梯响了两声。顾清禾停下来，等你收好录音设备。

assets/voice-lines/a2fc0b3ecab4048fc7dc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a2fc0b3ecab4048fc7dc..text: 风把图纸吹散，你蹲下来，和她一起把落在地上的未来收好。

assets/voice-lines/c5a45041e5014441e852..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c5a45041e5014441e852..text: 窗框投下完整的光。她却先转过头，查看你有没有站在阴影里。

assets/voice-lines/74a2fc5b8c22d0b19e75..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/74a2fc5b8c22d0b19e75..text: 旧唱片背面写着一句没有下文的歌词，字迹和母带盒上很像。

assets/voice-lines/fc917c2df3cee0fe9027..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fc917c2df3cee0fe9027..text: 她把一只耳机放进你掌心。两个陌生的故事，第一次有了相同的声音。

assets/voice-lines/9129dcc2304471f6a51d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9129dcc2304471f6a51d..text: 录音灯熄灭。她没有立刻摘耳机，而是把回放分了一半给你。

assets/voice-lines/fed4a48d34e82f4dfb07..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fed4a48d34e82f4dfb07..text: 老人还没有准备好开口。苏晚合上笔记本，先问了问茶叶的名字。

assets/voice-lines/7fb6d364b6f39024801c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7fb6d364b6f39024801c..text: 她标出的不是你的错字，而是每位受访者名字的读音。

assets/voice-lines/2dd2fda560556caf8d56..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2dd2fda560556caf8d56..text: 一张写着配方，一张写着“记得吃饭”。后者被贴在你的电脑上。

assets/voice-lines/6e3085f01d31b0257151..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6e3085f01d31b0257151..text: 她在桌边坐下，把蛋糕分成两半。窗外的月光落在没完成的时间线上。

assets/voice-lines/ffea3defd25d0bb344ea..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ffea3defd25d0bb344ea..text: 钟楼广场摆好了白色幕布。六个人把最后一排椅子留给了你。

assets/voice-lines/353f5b693e84d0d76ac2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/353f5b693e84d0d76ac2..text: 椅背贴着街坊们的名字。你发现自己的那张，也被认真写好了。

assets/voice-lines/d92163b22610cb72dfc7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d92163b22610cb72dfc7..text: 灯暗下去。银幕上的晴川，先响起一阵清晨开门的声音。

assets/voice-lines/23e855dbf552585c192a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/23e855dbf552585c192a..text: 片尾出现你的名字。灯光亮起时，你知道，明天也有人在这里等你。

assets/voice-lines/b549c76798e054abfa8a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b549c76798e054abfa8a..text: 你走进画面。镜头记录下的，是一群人正在等你靠近。

assets/voice-lines/003456ea05c1af863559..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/003456ea05c1af863559..text: 今天先把「旧照年代核实」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/5c314a3c2cd508003dc8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5c314a3c2cd508003dc8..text: 今天先把「夜班通勤随访」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/ef3c7e9baa2f3bdddefa..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ef3c7e9baa2f3bdddefa..text: 今天先把「报道更正记录」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/477c96848234ad02ecaa..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/477c96848234ad02ecaa..text: 今天先把「隐私保护剪辑」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/c3b8643cb63bd133c5ea..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c3b8643cb63bd133c5ea..text: 今天先把「人物系列终稿」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/77b422a333099a120cd2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/77b422a333099a120cd2..text: 今天先把「清晨发酵纪录」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/02834b25ea93617efbe1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/02834b25ea93617efbe1..text: 今天先把「新品试味采访」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/898e5d69ec0f75e45fcc..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/898e5d69ec0f75e45fcc..text: 今天先把「烘焙课堂记录」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/2bdf0af76ac78f2dc2ce..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2bdf0af76ac78f2dc2ce..text: 今天先把「特殊订单工作流」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/4c06c1b589ebdc91db43..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4c06c1b589ebdc91db43..text: 今天先把「街区家常味道」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/929ae33c4c5edce8d120..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/929ae33c4c5edce8d120..text: 今天先把「月见烘焙片尾」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/43d23c7574af02e0893f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/43d23c7574af02e0893f..text: 今天先把「直播幕后短片」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/52def28c877203bcb391..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/52def28c877203bcb391..text: 今天先把「日落等待纪录」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/6aee894da898d88af044..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6aee894da898d88af044..text: 今天先把「镜头与光线课堂」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/5f5a5546de743dcd6280..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/5f5a5546de743dcd6280..text: 今天先把「断网应对手册」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/00a5bb2b05d16366a720..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/00a5bb2b05d16366a720..text: 今天先把「幕后系列片尾」做好，剩下的我们慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/a8c1b392087c3378e8ef..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a8c1b392087c3378e8ef..text: 我会等你。不过这句紧张，也可以留给以后的自己听。

assets/voice-lines/d334e4135948a6eceeea..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d334e4135948a6eceeea..text: 可以用这首歌做纪录片的主题曲吗？我们一起把约定完成。

assets/voice-lines/a2567acc8cd1fe7dc7bb..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a2567acc8cd1fe7dc7bb..text: 我以为他留下的是一个失败的项目。原来，是一份还没送出去的礼物。

assets/voice-lines/dca497ae26d497878fe8..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/dca497ae26d497878fe8..text: 街边有一段安静的台阶，也有一座能看见全街的小桥。

assets/voice-lines/492399a60e608b1acb8c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/492399a60e608b1acb8c..text: 我把设备放下。先看看窗锁和水槽，不能让你一个人守整夜。

assets/voice-lines/1a9149a2cd1b9e5bc67d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/1a9149a2cd1b9e5bc67d..text: 我没有替过去找一个漂亮的答案，只把新的日期写在她留白的那一页。

assets/voice-lines/295ff649bb3609924ca6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/295ff649bb3609924ca6..text: 我签下沈屿，也在下一次观察的日期旁边，画了两只小小的茶杯。

assets/voice-lines/9ab0579928bf948c9f3a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/9ab0579928bf948c9f3a..text: 我关掉摄像机的自动收音。先陪你走一遍，再决定哪些话需要被记录。

assets/voice-lines/d44bf5a148b249bf069a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d44bf5a148b249bf069a..text: 我画了一只笨拙的杯子。她没帮我重画，只认真给杯柄留出了位置。

assets/voice-lines/0ba01b13043e4a165410..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0ba01b13043e4a165410..text: 我把监听音量调低。先弹你最初想到的那一句，今天不用给谁交作业。

assets/voice-lines/2bdd336e49d448fa7eb4..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2bdd336e49d448fa7eb4..text: 我尝了一小块边角。先告诉我你真正想让路过的人吃到什么味道。

assets/voice-lines/f547b9670ee252a8eb97..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f547b9670ee252a8eb97..text: 我把空盒子叠好。原来今天需要保存的，也许不只是最终成功的配方。

assets/voice-lines/420981d72eabef5f5311..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/420981d72eabef5f5311..text: 我问第一张要起什么名字。她想了想，写下“今天，你也在”。

assets/voice-lines/26570a185243f26e1653..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/26570a185243f26e1653..text: 我把片尾拍摄往后挪。今晚先和你一起找那一片最适合等待的天空。

assets/voice-lines/1b2feeab7a2a3e65d6ca..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/1b2feeab7a2a3e65d6ca..text: 我带队重新安排拍摄路径。今晚先把会被使用的地方做好，再谈镜头。

assets/voice-lines/55afd71dfc070e2ae604..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/55afd71dfc070e2ae604..text: 我把节目单放进衣袋，不再担心自己错过了哪个最适合拍摄的角度。

assets/voice-lines/0382446d25c7bfc8ac3c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/0382446d25c7bfc8ac3c..text: 我把空白处留着，没有立刻替明天安排一个完美的开头。

assets/voice-lines/17fa2b15ce7c100f6efc..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/17fa2b15ce7c100f6efc..text: 我们把展览改成记录等待。你这一年留下的观察，也值得被看见。

assets/voice-lines/b00d26592605413527b7..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/b00d26592605413527b7..text: 早间新闻读完了。今天的头条，是你有没有好好吃早饭。

assets/voice-lines/53b92414e6e75e808344..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/53b92414e6e75e808344..text: 我把今天的见闻带回来了。不过，想先听听你的那一份。

assets/voice-lines/f79c99bd5a8d71b7f97f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f79c99bd5a8d71b7f97f..text: 夜深了。今天的故事不必马上有结论，我先陪你坐着。

assets/voice-lines/964239a9f2c6f35729cc..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/964239a9f2c6f35729cc..text: 我整理录音，你专注工作。完成以后，我们交换今天的发现。

assets/voice-lines/509a3316ea51d4b0d13d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/509a3316ea51d4b0d13d..text: 你把目标完成了，值得写进今天的手账。标题就叫：认真生活的人。

assets/voice-lines/431ba4df1c82d61373f3..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/431ba4df1c82d61373f3..text: 我知道你不是放弃。只是有时候，人需要先休息一下。

assets/voice-lines/a3d25bda555efc587be2..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a3d25bda555efc587be2..text: 那我放心了。有些开心，不用被很多人知道也不会变小。

assets/voice-lines/298194b8eb1a1cf9c038..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/298194b8eb1a1cf9c038..text: 原来不是采访，是交换秘密。这个标题，我会记在自己的手账里。

assets/voice-lines/861ed1d95239a174ed08..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/861ed1d95239a174ed08..text: 我也这么想。你认真听我说话的样子，就已经够特别。

assets/voice-lines/2aa122ad81e0c0fa02c8..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/2aa122ad81e0c0fa02c8..text: 那我今天就不把它删掉了。累是真的，坐在你旁边轻松一点也是真的。

assets/voice-lines/dab4c8c99b5bedcfae38..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/dab4c8c99b5bedcfae38..text: 那我不再拿它当报道修了。这一页，是我想念你的证据。

assets/voice-lines/a664e70858958d9881c8..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a664e70858958d9881c8..text: 先关机聊天，等对方愿意再开始正式记录。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/cc88326af65661968185..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/cc88326af65661968185..text: 好的开场，有时候是先把水递过去。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/849aa24a66577fbe2c43..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/849aa24a66577fbe2c43..text: 分别记录记忆，再用门牌和旧报纸交叉核对。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/05de04dac1e04dc27e62..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/05de04dac1e04dc27e62..text: 记忆可以不同，核实的过程也值得被看见。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/5a2c3ce9853de2026e5c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/5a2c3ce9853de2026e5c..text: 把采访拆成两次，今天只拍他熟悉的回家路。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/757eca3433eb09da9191..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/757eca3433eb09da9191..text: 新闻不该让一个辛苦的人再多撑一会儿。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/0b8f3a0f58babacc8fcf..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/0b8f3a0f58babacc8fcf..text: 明确发布更正，并请店主确认修订后的内容。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/f7cecffc124b2899612e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f7cecffc124b2899612e..text: 我们不保证永不出错，但可以保证认真改正。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/54bfc235adb114d98b33..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/54bfc235adb114d98b33..text: 只拍经过同意的手部和物件，删掉可定位的远景。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/9b90972554a67ed39c7c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/9b90972554a67ed39c7c..text: 有时候，最好的记录是替一个人守住边界。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/d27aaf5f8d0e511ea9b8..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d27aaf5f8d0e511ea9b8..text: 做一份完整片尾，并把采访授权逐项归档。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/f5eda5de419008e0e703..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f5eda5de419008e0e703..text: 下一页还有很多人，也还有我想听你说的话。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/c4c0c036139bd08eabfa..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c4c0c036139bd08eabfa..text: 你在找十年前的街区影像？看看这份报纸，先别谢我。

assets/voice-lines/8af265bb6a8c8c1d79ff..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/8af265bb6a8c8c1d79ff..text: 证据要留原件。就算它看起来，只是一张不起眼的收据。

assets/voice-lines/1328f06f4b6c0ff8a49e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1328f06f4b6c0ff8a49e..text: 报道不是把线索拼起来就结束。有时候，你得先坐下来听一个人说话。

assets/voice-lines/4e9a41d172ae3e90a577..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4e9a41d172ae3e90a577..text: 可它没有消失，只是有人一直在保管。我们换个更准确的标题。

assets/voice-lines/5386636ac42bb6928db2..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/5386636ac42bb6928db2..text: 这里留两秒吧。这个停顿，比剪出来的一句感想更诚实。

assets/voice-lines/add47e6a90e97d6859a2..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/add47e6a90e97d6859a2..text: 采访稿发出去了。现在，我想听听制作人今天过得怎么样。

assets/voice-lines/58af68ddffd79315bf5a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/58af68ddffd79315bf5a..text: 今天的报道标题已经想好了：一条街，和一个终于走进镜头的人。

assets/voice-lines/11b8d112241416a29a8d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/11b8d112241416a29a8d..text: 走近才发现不是你，手里的第二杯咖啡只好自己喝掉。

assets/voice-lines/cd32826390b20419b86c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/cd32826390b20419b86c..text: 大家都在看构图，我在看照片边缘你露出来的半只手。

assets/voice-lines/9fd66f73dc78ecd740c4..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/9fd66f73dc78ecd740c4..text: 今天听了很多人的故事，最后还是想打开你的聊天框。

assets/voice-lines/ec9148a31cc1e071750e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ec9148a31cc1e071750e..text: 照片里的人不知道，自己的普通一天会被后来的人珍藏。

assets/voice-lines/f85fa4e1dd199fb9190c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f85fa4e1dd199fb9190c..text: 我却想在旁边加一句：有人陪着看的夜空，会显得近一点。

assets/voice-lines/f060e66aa6c99078e512..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f060e66aa6c99078e512..text: 读完以后，不必立刻回复。明年的空白页，我们还可以慢慢写。

assets/voice-lines/d40c350bdffd893ef0d0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d40c350bdffd893ef0d0..text: 报道写了很多人的名字，今天想留给自己的那一页只写了你。

assets/voice-lines/af50907d27b9509048a1..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/af50907d27b9509048a1..text: 有些礼物不是失败了，只是还没找到送出去的那一天。

assets/voice-lines/12ac48b5bf069203b7ab..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/12ac48b5bf069203b7ab..text: 把字写完整以后，忽然觉得这张照片亮了一点。想第一个告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/20af65b0a60d4239ca6a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/20af65b0a60d4239ca6a..text: 有些话要绕很远才说得出口。你想说的时候，我也会等。

assets/voice-lines/6ed80a183d3f56cf69a7..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/6ed80a183d3f56cf69a7..text: 承认不知道也需要勇气。谢谢你总愿意陪我一起查证。

assets/voice-lines/d205b864e0aeec130331..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d205b864e0aeec130331..text: 下一页不想写标题，只想和你记录一顿慢慢吃完的午饭。

assets/voice-lines/1dff07558db16c02a1f1..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1dff07558db16c02a1f1..text: 这些不准备发表。也没有人要检查它是不是足够精彩。

assets/voice-lines/93d8bf2ebc20d3a2e586..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/93d8bf2ebc20d3a2e586..text: 你已经在了。不用站得很远替我记录，坐到这里来吧。

assets/voice-lines/45563115b6f64176995f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/45563115b6f64176995f..text: 有一位受访者今天问我，采访结束以后我们还算不算认识。

assets/voice-lines/7cae76a50b5d5d1dc18a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7cae76a50b5d5d1dc18a..text: 因为我们见面的时候，总有很多不用写成稿子的部分。

assets/voice-lines/687329338a7dae96fdf6..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/687329338a7dae96fdf6..text: 后来觉得不查也很好。有人那天坐了车，也有人等着面包。

assets/voice-lines/cd6c4e50548bb444f01c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/cd6c4e50548bb444f01c..text: 书停在这里，我们也停在这里。明天翻开还是这一页。

assets/voice-lines/7fec5f6a58c56116a96c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7fec5f6a58c56116a96c..text: 可是最近写日记，我总忍不住在句子里放进你的名字。

assets/voice-lines/52759dce540e1a5f019a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/52759dce540e1a5f019a..text: 你带来的水果，你忘在椅背的外套，还有你说过的慢一点。

assets/voice-lines/45fbfb0c14ca3dea6451..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/45fbfb0c14ca3dea6451..text: 它们没有任何新闻价值，却比许多标题都更让我记得住。

assets/voice-lines/c928ccce8dd6e5a80c0b..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c928ccce8dd6e5a80c0b..text: 采访本已经合上了。今晚不做提问的人，只听你想说的那一句。

assets/voice-lines/da1ba287bf3fa5d245bf..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/da1ba287bf3fa5d245bf..text: 那今天换你问我吧。不是选题需要，是你自己想知道的那种问题。

assets/voice-lines/1fb3860b8a3db099d3c9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1fb3860b8a3db099d3c9..text: 这里不需要署名，也不用给别人解释。我记得和谁一起度过，就够了。

assets/voice-lines/4fb4141bdd910e2b6f34..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4fb4141bdd910e2b6f34..text: 我会把手机放近一点。不是怕漏掉重点，是想认真听见你。

assets/voice-lines/098e8e19581a7c528c83..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/098e8e19581a7c528c83..text: 我总替文字找解释。今晚想试试，有些感受能不能不解释也被听懂。

assets/voice-lines/6f1fa86514f9c908cd42..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/6f1fa86514f9c908cd42..text: 信里没有“可能”与“如果”。她写下想见你，也愿意听你亲口回答。

assets/voice-lines/c368f8b5bbefc87b39c9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c368f8b5bbefc87b39c9..text: 如果今天有一句话你反复输入又删掉，可以先说给我听。

assets/voice-lines/18ea4e782257bb4f56fd..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/18ea4e782257bb4f56fd..text: 她看完，指尖停在回家两个字上。那我以后交完稿，就先给你发消息。

assets/voice-lines/c982d1783921b3f03d66..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c982d1783921b3f03d66..text: 如果今天有不想说的事，可以留到以后。记者下班了。

assets/voice-lines/baa220a2295b725e1b03..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/baa220a2295b725e1b03..text: 以前总觉得故事应该有答案。现在觉得，有人愿意陪着问，也很好。

assets/voice-lines/d26a9a19679352eb283e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d26a9a19679352eb283e..text: 这座城今天发生了很多事。可现在我只想问，你冷不冷？

assets/voice-lines/67270e512ed8b5db87b9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/67270e512ed8b5db87b9..text: 让我靠一会儿吧。你可以不说话，我也会觉得被回答了。

assets/voice-lines/8ab420ca27b7a354de82..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/8ab420ca27b7a354de82..text: 这次没有截稿日期。看到喜欢的句子，我们就停下来。

assets/voice-lines/0361bc12cbb49be25a37..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0361bc12cbb49be25a37..text: 今晚不看公屏。就坐近一点，听你说今天发生了什么。

assets/voice-lines/efa6239b63b0c681fbcf..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/efa6239b63b0c681fbcf..text: 今天的封面已经选好了。你笑起来的那一张，我想自己收藏。

assets/voice-lines/94fe4e5a1f3365030b86..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/94fe4e5a1f3365030b86..text: 我整理照片，你处理自己的事。我们都不用着急，我一直在。

assets/voice-lines/28299cc42ae21a9fc489..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/28299cc42ae21a9fc489..text: 时间到了！今天你认真努力的这一段，我想替你好好记住。

assets/voice-lines/7b4b2525707baf016c9c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/7b4b2525707baf016c9c..text: 暂停键也是有用的。我们喝点水，换个舒服的姿势再说。

assets/voice-lines/3175b5263381de1eec03..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/3175b5263381de1eec03..text: 真的没有冷场提示音。原来和喜欢的人待着，安静也很舒服。

assets/voice-lines/5c891fe0494e0e0d119b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/5c891fe0494e0e0d119b..text: 听你讲这些，我不用想怎么接梗，只想知道后来怎么样了。

assets/voice-lines/2afdacc6462b14459628..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/2afdacc6462b14459628..text: 那我可以不用证明今天过得很精彩。和你在这里，就已经很好。

assets/voice-lines/743cab437237dc997edd..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/743cab437237dc997edd..text: 想留下这杯还热着的咖啡，还有你认真等我把手机放下的样子。

assets/voice-lines/d2ba9ca904d72333de75..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d2ba9ca904d72333de75..text: 谢谢你没有替我把话说完。这一次，我想亲口告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/166ce38360dce59db184..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/166ce38360dce59db184..text: 原来不是我一个人排练了这么久。那我们以后，都说得直接一点。

assets/voice-lines/fad856313ba21becf4f6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/fad856313ba21becf4f6..text: 我喜欢你。不是直播结束时的客套，也不是说给很多人听的话。

assets/voice-lines/d04c8c7c4ffe5214e5d7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d04c8c7c4ffe5214e5d7..text: 明天见面的时候，我们先去吃早饭吧。手机可以留在包里。

assets/voice-lines/cff52e5de420c63b576f..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/cff52e5de420c63b576f..text: 保留一个反打机位，让观众知道画面怎样完成。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/adc7f29d08394cb61dc9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/adc7f29d08394cb61dc9..text: 以后都坐这里吧，我转过头就能看见你。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/37c6d3573797b898b678..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/37c6d3573797b898b678..text: 先按自己的节奏拍完，再给观众选择停留的时间。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/f740f6122c06700c7034..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f740f6122c06700c7034..text: 如实说明天气，把等待中的声音与小事拍给观众。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/d371fe7a9558cca132ca..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d371fe7a9558cca132ca..text: 让她决定展示范围，只比较色彩和光线的变化。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/973969aaa3a0f969bdc5..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/973969aaa3a0f969bdc5..text: 谢谢你让我可以自己决定，怎样被看见。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/387169ff2be6477fabcc..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/387169ff2be6477fabcc..text: 今天不用追着数字跑了，先听你说。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/cc0c15b14c5bbd8e3f99..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/cc0c15b14c5bbd8e3f99..text: 让公开片子停在关灯前，之后的时间留给两个人。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/1a49439ba129e1432187..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1a49439ba129e1432187..text: 这一个晚安，是想当面说给你听的。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/9ca9b4c0ce41ad12f122..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9ca9b4c0ce41ad12f122..text: 直播镜头放这边。你不用一直站在摄像机后，我给你留了椅子。

assets/voice-lines/cbf7952e578b6ef037f2..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/cbf7952e578b6ef037f2..text: 摄影机已经架好了。这次我来拍，你也要出现在我们的合照里。

assets/voice-lines/ca329f530961eb347427..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/ca329f530961eb347427..text: 回放里有一小段我在笑，是你说不用急着表现得很好。

assets/voice-lines/aeb6660483acdf2ff03e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/aeb6660483acdf2ff03e..text: 最想留下的那个画面，其实是你伸手接过热杯子的时候。

assets/voice-lines/d16a6c179d7137add577..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d16a6c179d7137add577..text: 镜头关掉以后还想靠近你的我，好像也被认真喜欢了。

assets/voice-lines/dbf49a3390370a0365bb..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/dbf49a3390370a0365bb..text: 没有对着镜头，就是想告诉你：你上次的提醒，我记住了。

assets/voice-lines/3421c4e488b491c85f98..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/3421c4e488b491c85f98..text: 是你随手拍的。我很喜欢，因为里面的我不用一直表现得很好。

assets/voice-lines/cadcf70512e511695204..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/cadcf70512e511695204..text: 三脚架带上了。这一次，你也不能一直躲在镜头后面。

assets/voice-lines/d19ac4aee0c0096e95ba..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d19ac4aee0c0096e95ba..text: 现在觉得，错过几条更新也没关系。我不想错过你刚才那句话。

assets/voice-lines/d2b10074b8960ffcc614..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d2b10074b8960ffcc614..text: 习惯了把一天收在一个完整的结尾里，好像没有说就不算结束。

assets/voice-lines/a02ee59c0dcf2b777c1a..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/a02ee59c0dcf2b777c1a..text: 所以今晚的晚安不补录了，我就坐近一点，慢慢说给你听。

assets/voice-lines/469908cf9dfe79f98db9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/469908cf9dfe79f98db9..text: 我以前很怕错过消息，手机总是放在一伸手就够到的地方。

assets/voice-lines/ed2875f727914ffb1399..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/ed2875f727914ffb1399..text: 后来你说起白天走错的一条路，我居然忘了要看时间。

assets/voice-lines/a7b2e44ae942528cc7e8..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/a7b2e44ae942528cc7e8..text: 故事不算精彩，你讲到一半还忘了街名，可是我很喜欢。

assets/voice-lines/92c2c6d49ebd1202492b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/92c2c6d49ebd1202492b..text: 今晚也这样吧。想起来什么就说，想不起来就把手给我。

assets/voice-lines/1a6e85bd47e231982688..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1a6e85bd47e231982688..text: 后来发现，我最舍不得删掉的，是你伸手挡太阳那一张。

assets/voice-lines/9ce7a9bdffaab35de38c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9ce7a9bdffaab35de38c..text: 你也不用记得所有细节。醒来以后，我们还可以一起遇到新的。

assets/voice-lines/4d9158167bfff170722f..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/4d9158167bfff170722f..text: 相机和提示音都关好了。现在只有我们，今晚不用对着镜头说晚安。

assets/voice-lines/9aef14b3182dc707d1d1..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9aef14b3182dc707d1d1..text: 云已经看过，照片明天再挑。今天最想留下的是这份安静。

assets/voice-lines/39cfb5fd11e44a0f1ed6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/39cfb5fd11e44a0f1ed6..text: 大家特地等着看这场日落。我怕他们觉得，等待又被白白浪费了。

assets/voice-lines/facac3d8718fd6133aa4..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/facac3d8718fd6133aa4..text: 可以给我几分钟吗？这次不向观众解释，只和你坐一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/d627515f001b3de01707..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d627515f001b3de01707..text: 这个相册不看点赞。只要我们还想一起拍，它就可以一直增加。

assets/voice-lines/78e6579c8b892e1c9faf..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/78e6579c8b892e1c9faf..text: 我也把手机放下了。下一次见面，想先听你说今天看见了什么。

assets/voice-lines/10c3c00a5a81bbb8c854..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/10c3c00a5a81bbb8c854..text: 这些照片不够吸引人，但每次打开，我都能想起那天是怎么回家的。

assets/voice-lines/1efc2ad086d2c1b6de28..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1efc2ad086d2c1b6de28..text: 紫色裙上的细点映着灯，她把镜头递过来，让你决定这一张怎样开始。

assets/voice-lines/71876225441d06aca09c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/71876225441d06aca09c..text: 你们都留在相机旁，没有人被默认为理所应当的幕后。

assets/voice-lines/3a5de6631b52465cb489..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/3a5de6631b52465cb489..text: 照片可以证明光来过。可你在这里的时候，我更想先用自己的眼睛看。

assets/voice-lines/d7def3d5cd9039866ce4..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d7def3d5cd9039866ce4..text: 你如果也忙了一整天，就把手上的东西放远一点，给眼睛休息几分钟。

assets/voice-lines/b363fb6a8815a12670d6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/b363fb6a8815a12670d6..text: 今晚不是助播工作。能不能以沈屿的身份，陪我去灯会？

assets/voice-lines/6161796865d2cf025307..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6161796865d2cf025307..text: 本来怕你不习惯这么正式。现在才发现，紧张的是我。

assets/voice-lines/79d743b5d16da65e62df..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/79d743b5d16da65e62df..text: 只拍一张，不发出去。可以让你来决定，我们站多近吗？

assets/voice-lines/7fe66495d4afea4b63c8..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/7fe66495d4afea4b63c8..text: 直播的时候，我要记得照顾每个人。现在我想只留一个位置。

assets/voice-lines/f4085d9bd47c6d10fe2c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f4085d9bd47c6d10fe2c..text: 有些喜欢不需要直播。有人在场，比很多人看见更重要。

assets/voice-lines/1dc1aed0d0016ee000b0..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1dc1aed0d0016ee000b0..text: 我想等到某一天翻出来，记得我们是怎样慢慢站到一起的。

assets/voice-lines/88e492868343bdb8827c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/88e492868343bdb8827c..text: 最后一句晚安，走到门口再说。这样就能多和你待一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/f106e8a028dbbbd802da..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f106e8a028dbbbd802da..text: 午休也要认真休哦。耳机分你一边，先听一首轻松的。

assets/voice-lines/e18903160e1dbf327748..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e18903160e1dbf327748..text: 下班的路上听到一只鸟唱歌，我想，它也在等你回家。

assets/voice-lines/08bf3f6e2e199799d2ae..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/08bf3f6e2e199799d2ae..text: 最后一首歌唱得轻一点。今天的烦恼，先留在门外吧。

assets/voice-lines/b15be51d54e18e214f4f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b15be51d54e18e214f4f..text: 我练琴，你完成目标。我们一起把这一小段时间过得认真一点。

assets/voice-lines/97308473921d6329f56b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/97308473921d6329f56b..text: 那我要从你第一次借走耳机的下午开始讲，你不要嫌太长。

assets/voice-lines/6553b0f4364a54462956..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6553b0f4364a54462956..text: 等我说完这句，再唱给你听。这样我就不用把难过藏进笑里了。

assets/voice-lines/52e1075c10d4420698d2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/52e1075c10d4420698d2..text: 你接住琴盒的时候，我突然觉得，今天并没有完全落空。

assets/voice-lines/3f9a2773640cfb81b19b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/3f9a2773640cfb81b19b..text: 那我看着你。这句话，想让你知道是对你一个人说的。

assets/voice-lines/393b2925a87d8abc1366..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/393b2925a87d8abc1366..text: 我喜欢你。是下了舞台以后，还想在你旁边待着的那种喜欢。

assets/voice-lines/a3ff6b2087d84383a1cc..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a3ff6b2087d84383a1cc..text: 留下风声作引子，再换到背风面录主旋律。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/4bb40c1e2b900786c642..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4bb40c1e2b900786c642..text: 现在这个位置，是我们两个人的听众席。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/525cc913ba5d8f4219c0..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/525cc913ba5d8f4219c0..text: 先录每个人的节奏，再让不同的拍子相互呼应。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/ade680dd1f5a58af3789..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ade680dd1f5a58af3789..text: 你不用打得很准，先把开心打出来。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/f648fef28dcf346816d6..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f648fef28dcf346816d6..text: 有人把记得的小事接起来，歌就不会走丢。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/434a288f8fab4c4ea470..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/434a288f8fab4c4ea470..text: 先确认安全，再用无扩音的小合唱等待雨停。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/a548fe322612a9aa5cd8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a548fe322612a9aa5cd8..text: 只展示她愿意说的修改，让每次取舍都有声音。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/c5a413999b3ff4001b6b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c5a413999b3ff4001b6b..text: 这不是标准答案，是有人认真听过的证据。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/4003c8c3531fb12ef4e7..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4003c8c3531fb12ef4e7..text: 保留今天的版本，并把下一段留给以后的作品。你觉得呢？

assets/voice-lines/e01df79bba1c3c02fc49..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e01df79bba1c3c02fc49..text: 这首完成了，下一首还想先唱给你听。下一次也一起吧。

assets/voice-lines/e114cd49044550cb7b99..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e114cd49044550cb7b99..text: 嘘，先别说话。刚才这阵风，把最后一句歌词带过来了。

assets/voice-lines/f7db118618a52aa3ae82..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f7db118618a52aa3ae82..text: 真的？这是邻居奶奶教我的。她说，那是一个没有完成的约定。

assets/voice-lines/b3f3fdc64184cd73a07c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b3f3fdc64184cd73a07c..text: 不要把每个声音都修得一样。那位叔叔的拍子慢半拍，可开心是真的。

assets/voice-lines/4617d95896b777decb60..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4617d95896b777decb60..text: 先写你真正想说的那一句。我会把它唱成你能听见的勇气。

assets/voice-lines/58ba34c3b6e93b44144b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/58ba34c3b6e93b44144b..text: 我刚把今天的旋律发过去，想知道你会在哪一秒跟着哼。

assets/voice-lines/6bac020ae4502afe518c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6bac020ae4502afe518c..text: 我想了想，大概是认真听到最后，还愿意等下一首的人。

assets/voice-lines/1a6acede166dc0f17f4b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/1a6acede166dc0f17f4b..text: 安可也不一定要唱歌。最后这几分钟，想认真听听你。

assets/voice-lines/d08bcaa4edaa9b4a7d89..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/d08bcaa4edaa9b4a7d89..text: 回去又听了一遍录音，发现你在副歌前轻轻吸了一口气。

assets/voice-lines/9c65bd73810bcbf23b65..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/9c65bd73810bcbf23b65..text: 两个原本不认识的故事，原来真的会在同一个音符上相遇。

assets/voice-lines/bcf0d397d7b3076b4220..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/bcf0d397d7b3076b4220..text: 还没有名字，要不要来当第一个听众？跑调的部分也给你听。

assets/voice-lines/f7b505e81feae6000d3a..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f7b505e81feae6000d3a..text: 以前总想填满，今天觉得空着也很好。像你安静听我说话的时候。

assets/voice-lines/3e0f4621524175abec2c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/3e0f4621524175abec2c..text: 最后一首的副歌留给你。不会唱也没关系，看着我就好。

assets/voice-lines/846b48add0868bd2800e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/846b48add0868bd2800e..text: 以前总觉得最亮的一句应该放在那儿，让大家一听就记住。

assets/voice-lines/c9179cb70329bbcb0f73..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c9179cb70329bbcb0f73..text: 这些声音都不响，却让我觉得一天好像被稳稳接住了。

assets/voice-lines/6f721c434b13789f3478..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6f721c434b13789f3478..text: 有一段只是两个人各自呼吸，中间留一点很舒服的空白。

assets/voice-lines/a214883f080a50e6821e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a214883f080a50e6821e..text: 明天拆包装的时候，我还是想把第一首歌的选择留给你。

assets/voice-lines/c1fc077c202b8016c9d0..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c1fc077c202b8016c9d0..text: 回家的路上我一直看天，想挑一颗特别亮的星给你讲。

assets/voice-lines/e439196f45d97b260dcd..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/e439196f45d97b260dcd..text: 走到最后有人等我，我就知道散场也可以是很好的开始。

assets/voice-lines/4c5dd1e30e8205da89df..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/4c5dd1e30e8205da89df..text: 今晚不练琴啦。把今天的杂音关掉，给你留一段很轻的晚安。

assets/voice-lines/aefe571d6de1e04d068f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/aefe571d6de1e04d068f..text: 如果只有你听，我能不能把那些不够漂亮的停顿也留下？

assets/voice-lines/db399493be31a63c9e80..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/db399493be31a63c9e80..text: 她靠近耳机的另一端，轻声数了四拍。你们都没有急着按下结束键。

assets/voice-lines/484812425669ef2581b4..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/484812425669ef2581b4..text: 这一句不是写给观众的。你听懂以后，我才想唱下一句。

assets/voice-lines/6868b170efa934a09f30..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6868b170efa934a09f30..text: 她笑着踩住你的影子。没有舞台灯，也没有需要表现给别人看的动作。

assets/voice-lines/2ef1e064f2a3382f8cf9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2ef1e064f2a3382f8cf9..text: 她把折好的谱纸放进你的口袋：“这份不是备份，是给你的原件。”

assets/voice-lines/563f5fb9a8be2e925ac9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/563f5fb9a8be2e925ac9..text: 下一次我们不用等歌写完才见面。一起散步，也能是一种创作。

assets/voice-lines/73a31a0201d947c50def..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/73a31a0201d947c50def..text: 今晚不唱完整的歌。给你留半小节，等你有空时再接着哼。

assets/voice-lines/da901e7284a759278354..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/da901e7284a759278354..text: 如果今天有人让你觉得自己做得不够好，先别把那句话当成最终混音。

assets/voice-lines/28fb38f232450ed2bbf2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/28fb38f232450ed2bbf2..text: 我听过你认真做一件事时的语气。那种声音，值得被好好保存。

assets/voice-lines/1db7507ca54df7eeb455..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/1db7507ca54df7eeb455..text: 紫色裙摆安静落下。她将琴放稳，第一次没有反复确认别人是否满意。

assets/voice-lines/494cf33ba8c10a3021e5..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/494cf33ba8c10a3021e5..text: 刚才有一句唱给所有人。还有一句，我想现在只说给你听。

assets/voice-lines/82005a9df8d6b9d68cf0..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/82005a9df8d6b9d68cf0..text: 下次你坐远一点也没关系。我已经知道，唱到那一段时该看向哪里。

assets/voice-lines/8bef4bccd0e14f278be7..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/8bef4bccd0e14f278be7..text: 今晚把耳机戴舒服一点。这段声音不需要配合任何节拍。

assets/voice-lines/2ecf4c242c4249d1c990..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2ecf4c242c4249d1c990..text: 最后一首不对外报曲名。你听见就知道，是留给谁的。

assets/voice-lines/98b1c63ffe9fdb000932..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/98b1c63ffe9fdb000932..text: 今晚的返场，要不要和我一起？不用会弹琴，帮我数拍子就好。

assets/voice-lines/cdc2f5be754aac009b8d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/cdc2f5be754aac009b8d..text: 一、二、三、四。她数到最后一拍时笑了。你看，我们已经合得上了。

assets/voice-lines/c42de441cb33fd9076cc..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c42de441cb33fd9076cc..text: 她给你留出位置，肩膀轻轻碰了一下。这次就不用隔着舞台找你了。

assets/voice-lines/0acbc6ab0c39af5cac50..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/0acbc6ab0c39af5cac50..text: 现在没有观众了。我可以把弹错的那一小节，重新弹给你吗？

assets/voice-lines/a3bed08807d77476df43..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a3bed08807d77476df43..text: 别急着盖上。刚才那两个音，我还想听它们慢慢散开。

assets/voice-lines/2a267941292bb096e251..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/2a267941292bb096e251..text: 小时候，母亲在那扇窗后等我下课。不能为了让城市漂亮，就把人的记忆擦掉。

assets/voice-lines/e809055c3eb6bc92c20b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e809055c3eb6bc92c20b..text: 你接着写：有空吃饭，有人等你。她把卡片收进模型的窗后，说这是最合适的尺寸。

assets/voice-lines/37190198dab0147cf809..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/37190198dab0147cf809..text: 结构没有问题，但他们想把旧窗换成更整齐的玻璃。我想再听听这里的人怎么说。

assets/voice-lines/58d4df4d04d91787cb77..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/58d4df4d04d91787cb77..text: 我能解释预算和承重，却不知道该怎么解释，有些光只有从这扇窗照进来才像回家。

assets/voice-lines/e4a89716002518788920..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e4a89716002518788920..text: 她挽起衬衫袖口，把铅笔递给你。两条不同的线，终于可以留在同一张纸上。

assets/voice-lines/cf21124f241b240122bc..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/cf21124f241b240122bc..text: 她披好灰色针织外套，带你站进窗边的落日里。那束光确实不需要更多解释。

assets/voice-lines/7977ac82531afe96bf8c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/7977ac82531afe96bf8c..text: 这次的设计说明，我只写“坐得舒服”。其他的，等我们住进日常里慢慢改。

assets/voice-lines/fab73de4feee0a11c561..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/fab73de4feee0a11c561..text: 如果你的房间也还亮着灯，先把椅背调舒服。我们可以一起安静坐几分钟。

assets/voice-lines/2a91c8c8cec5171a69bc..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/2a91c8c8cec5171a69bc..text: 不能只做成好看的场景。人走进去以后，也得真的有地方坐下来抬头看。

assets/voice-lines/0759916844fff58d8313..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0759916844fff58d8313..text: 深蓝裙上的细小刺绣映着模型灯。她将观测的位置挪开，让你自然站到身旁。

assets/voice-lines/47e8b2da61ef8ecb64aa..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/47e8b2da61ef8ecb64aa..text: 象牙色裙边掠过玻璃拱门，她先试了试椅子的温度，随后给你留出一整块暖光。

assets/voice-lines/5e11aaad1813872ac866..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/5e11aaad1813872ac866..text: 老师说比例不准确。我知道，可如果把他们拿走，那座房子就只是一个作业。

assets/voice-lines/3e26a98cbb70cd041676..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/3e26a98cbb70cd041676..text: 这一次我不讲它用了什么材料。你愿意只告诉我，站在这里的时候想到了什么吗？

assets/voice-lines/dd1f29ff7ba2cb55ebc9..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/dd1f29ff7ba2cb55ebc9..text: 地图不再铺在开会的长桌上。你们坐得很近，可以同时看清同一条小路。

assets/voice-lines/b3ac706b1f70e5712e15..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b3ac706b1f70e5712e15..text: 我想设计很多能留下人的地方。也想有一个地方，不用设计好理由就能来找你。

assets/voice-lines/07ff5c50dd6dff80f9cb..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/07ff5c50dd6dff80f9cb..text: 等你到了，告诉我一声。我想听见的只是，你已经平安回到一个舒服的地方。

assets/voice-lines/1db7a1d8771347afa246..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1db7a1d8771347afa246..text: 那就叫“我们决定一起过普通日子的第一天”。虽然有点长，我会记住。

assets/voice-lines/ca48b669170e644177f0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ca48b669170e644177f0..text: 首映结束还有蛋糕。这次烤得很好，不过你上次说喜欢的那一块，我也留着。

assets/voice-lines/1d5215861f8c228ad057..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1d5215861f8c228ad057..text: 你答应她下次来帮忙刷烤盘。她把生日卡放进月亮糖罐，说这份愿望已经有了第一步。

assets/voice-lines/7f4b3b9860abe79835a4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/7f4b3b9860abe79835a4..text: 今晚这一觉也是。不是因为明天还要工作，是因为现在的我们值得休息。

assets/voice-lines/2a14d2a17f4f57a88d62..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/2a14d2a17f4f57a88d62..text: 海风会改变面团的状态。我不能把城里的配方原样搬过去，也不想只做给镜头看。

assets/voice-lines/b2458281e0aaaf8d3cb1..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b2458281e0aaaf8d3cb1..text: 她换好燕麦色开衫坐到窗边，把两只杯子的杯柄转向彼此。雨天也可以有刚好的温度。

assets/voice-lines/602dd044059ad2a2320d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/602dd044059ad2a2320d..text: 那时觉得蛋糕坏了，整天都不好。后来妈妈说，海还是看见了，我们也一起坐到了天黑。

assets/voice-lines/70d0430864b258728508..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/70d0430864b258728508..text: 以后你来店里，不用总问有没有什么可以帮忙。坐下来陪我尝一口，也很重要。

assets/voice-lines/15525fb794e845419ab1..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/15525fb794e845419ab1..text: 盒子里的酥饼有大有小。她先挑了最不整齐的一块，说这个最像今天的月亮。

assets/voice-lines/a526e576a74f6e8dd781..speaker: jiang-yue
