assets/voice-lines/b4b53d924b2372bfdef6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/b4b53d924b2372bfdef6..text: 那就等灯一盏盏亮起来再走。

assets/voice-lines/59e2d084e636298b241d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/59e2d084e636298b241d..text: 包括不知道该怎么开始的时候。

assets/voice-lines/bf179c05bf543d66857b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/bf179c05bf543d66857b..text: 我以为是录音时配合得不够好。

assets/voice-lines/54309d75a8eb4147f4dc..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/54309d75a8eb4147f4dc..text: 一个观众也可以认真鼓掌。

assets/voice-lines/894470304c91f54ba7d6..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/894470304c91f54ba7d6..text: 原来这句还可以这样唱。

assets/voice-lines/8004d42934fc39fdb876..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8004d42934fc39fdb876..text: 现在问还来得及吗？今天累不累？

assets/voice-lines/043d2a3b6376d55d066e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/043d2a3b6376d55d066e..text: 也可以写“今天想尝试什么”。

assets/voice-lines/541d2a121d94b5c1b481..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/541d2a121d94b5c1b481..text: 我记得你说，紧张也可以慢慢讲。

assets/voice-lines/bc6dc55a8d4088dbc445..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/bc6dc55a8d4088dbc445..text: 那就再说一次。我也会再听一次。

assets/voice-lines/8859ea65c1ba19423471..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8859ea65c1ba19423471..text: 下台以后，我们也拍一张。

assets/voice-lines/89e99da3f8e7b84c7a47..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/89e99da3f8e7b84c7a47..text: 这么小的纸袋，够它住一路吗？

assets/voice-lines/83b6fb72ba6069d1c24f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/83b6fb72ba6069d1c24f..text: 它在地图上绕了好大一圈。

assets/voice-lines/39cefdb57ce0835023b4..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/39cefdb57ce0835023b4..text: 这些地方都要留下来吗？

assets/voice-lines/fea9c84134aec698296a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/fea9c84134aec698296a..text: 今晚的素材，拍给这个方案用吧。

assets/voice-lines/2fe400333928f2a5d53d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2fe400333928f2a5d53d..text: 认真有什么好笑的。我会慢慢看。

assets/voice-lines/6f519425c491ad2d0d7f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6f519425c491ad2d0d7f..text: 那句话对整篇文章很重要吗？

assets/voice-lines/562fa6cd208a2fffbaac..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/562fa6cd208a2fffbaac..text: 比如，明天要不要一起吃早饭。

assets/voice-lines/a4be605ff7f82653b929..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a4be605ff7f82653b929..text: 那剩下的，我们坐下来慢慢吃。

assets/voice-lines/6c8146cc4fe5d2307d30..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6c8146cc4fe5d2307d30..text: 我看到的这碗，刚好装得下今晚。

assets/voice-lines/d532f424eb9b08a8808b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d532f424eb9b08a8808b..text: 窗边不是已经有一排小相框了吗？

assets/voice-lines/4f13e03f06cd4df141ae..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4f13e03f06cd4df141ae..text: 那么多故事里，最想听的是你的。

assets/voice-lines/6d3e05657150282b6e51..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/6d3e05657150282b6e51..text: 你来写标题，我来过这一天。

assets/voice-lines/a044d7b5afc9c754f048..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a044d7b5afc9c754f048..text: 以前我总站在镜头后面。

assets/voice-lines/c6db8955891eb3963134..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c6db8955891eb3963134..text: 你说今天没有截稿时间。

assets/voice-lines/55268a3ce52e99bb599a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/55268a3ce52e99bb599a..text: 镜头里有很多人的故事。

assets/voice-lines/2c1d1e7436fa497766cc..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/2c1d1e7436fa497766cc..text: 这里，想写一个关于我们的。

assets/voice-lines/a6d63398ded778050c38..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a6d63398ded778050c38..text: 如果让你起标题，你会怎么写？

assets/voice-lines/8e8035a801e520821faf..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/8e8035a801e520821faf..text: 老巷里的每一个人，都有故事。

assets/voice-lines/a2e1f91df7baf57e6f8c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a2e1f91df7baf57e6f8c..text: 有一点。不过想和你再坐一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/73c1840a86cb3d251bf8..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/73c1840a86cb3d251bf8..text: 这一次，你不用记住我说的话。

assets/voice-lines/c329103decb1011be6b6..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/c329103decb1011be6b6..text: 你有一个私人问题想问？

assets/voice-lines/ab952cf990e2d8b0d055..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ab952cf990e2d8b0d055..text: 今天的回答，不会出现在报道里。

assets/voice-lines/67d7ed9281c9a8926da8..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/67d7ed9281c9a8926da8..text: 有些话，我只想说给你听。

assets/voice-lines/d3071c48514480b3b2ad..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d3071c48514480b3b2ad..text: 这条私人消息，我想一直握着。

assets/voice-lines/e8ff900ceb9e3f563f38..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/e8ff900ceb9e3f563f38..text: 胸针歪了吗？你眼睛真尖。

assets/voice-lines/e72ed3331a0ab33eee87..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/e72ed3331a0ab33eee87..text: 好，我知道你在等我抬头。

assets/voice-lines/48284be89908a2c80458..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/48284be89908a2c80458..text: 现在的注意力，全部交给你。

assets/voice-lines/bce09bddff2da18d348b..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/bce09bddff2da18d348b..text: 这是一枚不会刊登的注脚。

assets/voice-lines/533e53ed8f4c6ea70ef2..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/533e53ed8f4c6ea70ef2..text: 我们的故事又多一处标记。

assets/voice-lines/556ce62be346516b7332..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/556ce62be346516b7332..text: 发卡别取掉，我找了很久。

assets/voice-lines/7c0e9daf9791a51ad93f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7c0e9daf9791a51ad93f..text: 你整理的时候，我可以采访你吗？

assets/voice-lines/b4c18311495f55709b28..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/b4c18311495f55709b28..text: 算了，这个心跳已经告诉我答案。

assets/voice-lines/3fddaf90a596f952b7b2..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/3fddaf90a596f952b7b2..text: 你还是回头看了她一眼。

assets/voice-lines/c95d466053969f285e52..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c95d466053969f285e52..text: 你问她是不是换了镜头。

assets/voice-lines/d7556d1dee7ab86275b3..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d7556d1dee7ab86275b3..text: 今天不直播，也不数点赞。

assets/voice-lines/f8152a945dd446b9a5f4..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f8152a945dd446b9a5f4..text: 你们在亮起的灯串下停下来。

assets/voice-lines/4c6c0abae4a4d3b3f61e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/4c6c0abae4a4d3b3f61e..text: 这次的观众，只要你一个。

assets/voice-lines/d54f4e7ecc284321109c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d54f4e7ecc284321109c..text: 今天镜头里的笑，都是因为你。

assets/voice-lines/6b343d964dc75e0ac597..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6b343d964dc75e0ac597..text: 本来想把那句也留下来。

assets/voice-lines/d3e8e089d6e2a81615fa..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d3e8e089d6e2a81615fa..text: 以后下播，你还会在这里吗？

assets/voice-lines/e6774cc0bacd0e096ada..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e6774cc0bacd0e096ada..text: 成交。不过今天轮到你点单。

assets/voice-lines/f3a22f8f0bff3b75dbc0..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f3a22f8f0bff3b75dbc0..text: 有人问我，今晚会不会拍放河灯。

assets/voice-lines/4ba507ebbffec1590af7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/4ba507ebbffec1590af7..text: 好。下一次也只说给你听。

assets/voice-lines/d3c3ac0640885d824add..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d3c3ac0640885d824add..text: 嗯，我在看你，没有偷偷看屏幕。

assets/voice-lines/03d945f139a0f8cf36bd..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/03d945f139a0f8cf36bd..text: 这次没有镜头，不用找角度。

assets/voice-lines/630f439cb1c32b8edbdf..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/630f439cb1c32b8edbdf..text: 算啦。今晚从喜欢你这句开始。

assets/voice-lines/acfe96952773a628f350..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/acfe96952773a628f350..text: 现在不用对着麦克风说话了。

assets/voice-lines/9411172fc3003f385a30..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9411172fc3003f385a30..text: 只有你听得见的音量，我很喜欢。

assets/voice-lines/035f79439c68f3458797..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/035f79439c68f3458797..text: 相机收好了，这只手空着。

assets/voice-lines/9706d5d6a2f5830aff10..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9706d5d6a2f5830aff10..text: 你牵住以后，我就不担心走散。

assets/voice-lines/12f0cdc49023ad90bda4..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/12f0cdc49023ad90bda4..text: 不在直播里，也想一直和你连线。

assets/voice-lines/e34f561af0defbcddd94..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/e34f561af0defbcddd94..text: 发饰没有歪？那你是在叫我呀。

assets/voice-lines/526b4973f4fe2fb565e1..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/526b4973f4fe2fb565e1..text: 这一条特别关注，早就留给你了。

assets/voice-lines/83d9f88b42a8791f2124..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/83d9f88b42a8791f2124..text: 给这张私人照片，盖一颗心。

assets/voice-lines/69af9dc9e236ec40db75..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/69af9dc9e236ec40db75..text: 留着吧，比滤镜更像今晚。

assets/voice-lines/206d0ce92239fb9b7c31..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/206d0ce92239fb9b7c31..text: 所有光点里，我第一眼还是找你。

assets/voice-lines/f26b16795ee84bc2e7f8..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f26b16795ee84bc2e7f8..text: 现在的样子，不拍下来也会记住。

assets/voice-lines/dccbb9cda11ff13fc770..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/dccbb9cda11ff13fc770..text: 下一首歌，要不要只唱给你听？

assets/voice-lines/f71c52bd44a3bb500f29..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f71c52bd44a3bb500f29..text: 听，鞋底踩在砖上有两个节拍。

assets/voice-lines/83f80e91afe20d285420..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/83f80e91afe20d285420..text: 很好，今天第一首歌就叫慢半拍。

assets/voice-lines/226eaaf781e810a8c11b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/226eaaf781e810a8c11b..text: 这里的风比录音棚吵多了。

assets/voice-lines/fa975c99516f09972814..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/fa975c99516f09972814..text: 但每个人都没有重复自己的声音。

assets/voice-lines/ea21f52c3f4d428b4c60..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ea21f52c3f4d428b4c60..text: 我们也留一点声音给这里吧。

assets/voice-lines/913f28122068b8f9fbd2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/913f28122068b8f9fbd2..text: 你没有催她完成那段旋律。

assets/voice-lines/be906e7926433ca53e63..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/be906e7926433ca53e63..text: 好吧，这一句，我想先自己听。

assets/voice-lines/b7a2678bca7bb04350db..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b7a2678bca7bb04350db..text: 我想把街头的脚步声也录进去。

assets/voice-lines/00838369570877437b08..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/00838369570877437b08..text: 剪辑台上这首歌，想先唱给你听。

assets/voice-lines/329c2ae3c8fa35369517..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/329c2ae3c8fa35369517..text: 其实只有一句。是你写的那一句。

assets/voice-lines/dde938c3952dca8719a3..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/dde938c3952dca8719a3..text: 因为这次是唱给写下它的人听。

assets/voice-lines/96cb1a199c840e326dcf..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/96cb1a199c840e326dcf..text: 不播。它已经找到想听的人了。

assets/voice-lines/73e4a6aa52aa37782edf..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/73e4a6aa52aa37782edf..text: 你总能给失误起一个好听的名字。

assets/voice-lines/82c1ea5596dbcafd2191..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/82c1ea5596dbcafd2191..text: 听见我刚才哼的那一句了吗？

assets/voice-lines/731efc519bbb46b549f9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/731efc519bbb46b549f9..text: 糟糕，你一看我，我就忘词。

assets/voice-lines/5b0559f2ef58959201d2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/5b0559f2ef58959201d2..text: 算了，今天允许我只会说喜欢你。

assets/voice-lines/10fb4918289d9fd17e12..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/10fb4918289d9fd17e12..text: 这里离琴弦近，能听到余音。

assets/voice-lines/7de3cf2d7305726311c9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7de3cf2d7305726311c9..text: 别动，这个距离正好能唱给你。

assets/voice-lines/da32ec3c2483b3351e57..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/da32ec3c2483b3351e57..text: 手腕放松，跟着我数拍子。

assets/voice-lines/0040859b3410f5015afe..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/0040859b3410f5015afe..text: 我们的节拍，越来越像了。

assets/voice-lines/6ebc1c2d9dc25305cb68..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/6ebc1c2d9dc25305cb68..text: 这次的合奏，我不想先结束。

assets/voice-lines/776ca1583b19dd77faf8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/776ca1583b19dd77faf8..text: 礼裙上的亮片，不是糖哦。

assets/voice-lines/8fab0bcb1adcccc432f4..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/8fab0bcb1adcccc432f4..text: 我知道，你只是想引起我的注意。

assets/voice-lines/9c33d4c0a8408642a6f1..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/9c33d4c0a8408642a6f1..text: 早就注意到了。从你进门的时候。

assets/voice-lines/aad64e32ceb3a378d931..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/aad64e32ceb3a378d931..text: 这颗当作我们合奏的记号。

assets/voice-lines/fb467e46e13518ed6388..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/fb467e46e13518ed6388..text: 下次返场，我还会先找这道光。

assets/voice-lines/0c4d5e1321a12f2cb271..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/0c4d5e1321a12f2cb271..text: 你整理得比造型师还慢。

assets/voice-lines/33eb887953cea519ce14..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/33eb887953cea519ce14..text: 没催你。慢一点，我更喜欢。

assets/voice-lines/a307950ea991e0c93508..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/a307950ea991e0c93508..text: 一个人撑着确实会累。结构如此，人也是。

assets/voice-lines/d2b38fc266d446d4e44d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d2b38fc266d446d4e44d..text: 是一个我想常常回来的地方。还没完全建好。

assets/voice-lines/cf5238bd89a5401eb560..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/cf5238bd89a5401eb560..text: 这样就够了。我今天想看清的人，不需要打追光。

assets/voice-lines/364db427560276e11231..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/364db427560276e11231..text: 你为我留出的时间，比一份完美方案更珍贵。

assets/voice-lines/f9288786ca293a391cd2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/f9288786ca293a391cd2..text: 好。把两人份的明天，也画进下一张图纸。

assets/voice-lines/d54d0c9a721014289013..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d54d0c9a721014289013..text: 改建的时候，有人认真考虑过后来经过的人。

assets/voice-lines/455b3a1578058ce35e35..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/455b3a1578058ce35e35..text: 会。也会想起第一个愿意等我改完图的人。

assets/voice-lines/ce49f9ae93fd5a34e6a3..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ce49f9ae93fd5a34e6a3..text: 从这里，刚好能看见两棵树和整片天空。

assets/voice-lines/eb680cb9929575f674c0..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/eb680cb9929575f674c0..text: 这张图纸，多画一扇向着夕阳的窗吧。

assets/voice-lines/d52f827c1aaf1f841f72..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d52f827c1aaf1f841f72..text: 预算再改一次就好。我会和你一起把它做完。

assets/voice-lines/be9549add8e3cd9a794e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/be9549add8e3cd9a794e..text: 原来空间也能把人和人的距离拉近。

assets/voice-lines/f1b62c7e90e8adfe6ee7..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/f1b62c7e90e8adfe6ee7..text: 每一个普通的房间，都能装得下一场相遇。

assets/voice-lines/5c7b8432d9aa56e9edd5..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/5c7b8432d9aa56e9edd5..text: 这样就好了。我们的那一边，还是并排的。

assets/voice-lines/a950e8b49d1121d3fb09..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/a950e8b49d1121d3fb09..text: 最想留在图纸上的，就是我们现在的样子。

assets/voice-lines/8aa06c57f2789618c597..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8aa06c57f2789618c597..text: 你来了。这里已经替你留好了位置。

assets/voice-lines/b7e0b6ff5f2c943c83a8..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b7e0b6ff5f2c943c83a8..text: 这件家具，刚刚多了一段属于我们的回忆。

assets/voice-lines/e00fc8c1925e9649a832..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e00fc8c1925e9649a832..text: 一起发现的小东西，也让今天变得不一样。

assets/voice-lines/516c2a72ed19f29a0466..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/516c2a72ed19f29a0466..text: 这个正好是我一直想留在家里的，谢谢你记得。

assets/voice-lines/8d2a1fa18f2ada263063..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8d2a1fa18f2ada263063..text: 谢谢你想着我。只是这一份，我可能还不太习惯。

assets/voice-lines/e443533b1adb5c2b747d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e443533b1adb5c2b747d..text: 你挑的心意我收到了。一起放到家里吧。

assets/voice-lines/a682ce09e7129e3a1697..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/a682ce09e7129e3a1697..text: 这里已经正式开放。今天可以不用戴安全帽了。

assets/voice-lines/46e957d4b85ed47e81d6..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/46e957d4b85ed47e81d6..text: 以前我会马上回答下一个项目。今天想先留在这里。

assets/voice-lines/9b0d7f5179015929e3ae..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/9b0d7f5179015929e3ae..text: 下一扇窗，想让你从最初就一起看。

assets/voice-lines/d84082c545eff83cd9a2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d84082c545eff83cd9a2..text: 按导航走最快。但我想带你看看这条路。

assets/voice-lines/8da5d58f11c4117798ef..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8da5d58f11c4117798ef..text: 那今晚不用赶。我们从第一盏灯开始。

assets/voice-lines/7b73f4d1cd615504a8d8..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/7b73f4d1cd615504a8d8..text: 有。桥中间这段没有安排任务的时间。

assets/voice-lines/40ecab5df9e8577c2a7b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/40ecab5df9e8577c2a7b..text: 不用等全部。现在这样，我已经看得很清楚。

assets/voice-lines/933a297ac0fa28245fea..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/933a297ac0fa28245fea..text: 书签留在这里。困了就睡，下次我们继续。

assets/voice-lines/e4bade044c0bd8c761b2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e4bade044c0bd8c761b2..text: 离近一点看也没关系，今晚我没有别的安排。

assets/voice-lines/e8ae7ee9a6d656ec674b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e8ae7ee9a6d656ec674b..text: 你这样握着，我就知道这个房间画对了。

assets/voice-lines/224210c712b160ec958e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/224210c712b160ec958e..text: 看得这么认真，是在检查两只枕头的距离吗？

assets/voice-lines/6e1abc654a0dcc688f61..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/6e1abc654a0dcc688f61..text: 嗯，这样就够近了。第二把椅子也一直留着。

assets/voice-lines/8549728a2467c0de8c32..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8549728a2467c0de8c32..text: 别替我省被子。这里本来就给你留了一半。

assets/voice-lines/08746695aa948d6536d1..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/08746695aa948d6536d1..text: 灯还亮着，我也还在。放心看，放心睡。

assets/voice-lines/4719ee1e875384f75ce2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4719ee1e875384f75ce2..text: 握着手就不用担心走廊了，我们都已经回家。

assets/voice-lines/e5cb8c0cdf60ea6b49bb..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e5cb8c0cdf60ea6b49bb..text: 谢谢你帮我掖好。以后这件小事，可以轮流做。

assets/voice-lines/92ca9adbd67bfaefe419..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/92ca9adbd67bfaefe419..text: 我画图时手很稳，现在好像不太一样。

assets/voice-lines/1c1c59aae678c30c6f55..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1c1c59aae678c30c6f55..text: 桥上多了一处只有我们知道的坐标。

assets/voice-lines/50599d77b4d96954ad28..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/50599d77b4d96954ad28..text: 这颗我留着。太标准的星星，反而记不住是谁做的。

assets/voice-lines/930bc1a418d26a1ddf83..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/930bc1a418d26a1ddf83..text: 今天终于轮到我收下一份认真准备的温柔了。

assets/voice-lines/d1e400c9a848b2f4d529..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d1e400c9a848b2f4d529..text: 那我就记得，每次都多准备一只杯子。

assets/voice-lines/670bc1358f7eb5148f10..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/670bc1358f7eb5148f10..text: 不赶时间的话，陪我吃完这块蛋糕吧。

assets/voice-lines/bf208e1bdbe1eaff61f5..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/bf208e1bdbe1eaff61f5..text: 不是。是在想下次做给你的那一份。

assets/voice-lines/12d6f3320a1d424193e1..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/12d6f3320a1d424193e1..text: 你在这里，配方好像总能再好一点。

assets/voice-lines/88624346e90ebd3b1b7b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/88624346e90ebd3b1b7b..text: 配方试了三次，终于找到那一点温柔。

assets/voice-lines/6cf487aeabcd13361218..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/6cf487aeabcd13361218..text: 你剪出来的这段，我想留在店里一直播放。

assets/voice-lines/64742ac538545f12c8ca..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/64742ac538545f12c8ca..text: 这家店的灯，会一直为你多亮一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/67f28785c0095f048e29..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/67f28785c0095f048e29..text: 那也没关系，我们本来就是来一起吃点心的。

assets/voice-lines/475ba5ce4379b7cb0f4b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/475ba5ce4379b7cb0f4b..text: 这件家具，刚刚多了一段属于我们的回忆。

assets/voice-lines/a67277e31ee57ca75fa3..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a67277e31ee57ca75fa3..text: 一起发现的小东西，也让今天变得不一样。

assets/voice-lines/cecd67e74624e8dd3676..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/cecd67e74624e8dd3676..text: 这个正好是我一直想留在家里的，谢谢你记得。

assets/voice-lines/cf7e0b78c142b2a63524..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/cf7e0b78c142b2a63524..text: 谢谢你想着我。只是这一份，我可能还不太习惯。

assets/voice-lines/cb51d81dd3cd9975d93e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/cb51d81dd3cd9975d93e..text: 你挑的心意我收到了。一起放到家里吧。

assets/voice-lines/50519f796bdb643523c3..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/50519f796bdb643523c3..text: 一份给你，一份给今天没来得及吃饭的我。

assets/voice-lines/702ebc60c2144863a49c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/702ebc60c2144863a49c..text: 以前总怕不够卖，最后那份也舍不得给自己。

assets/voice-lines/874f9a7f93da2406b965..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/874f9a7f93da2406b965..text: 是啊。我还以为帮大家准备好，就算参与过了。

assets/voice-lines/12b6f2543a4c9a7f95e0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/12b6f2543a4c9a7f95e0..text: 这张桌子，不用等所有事情做完才坐。

assets/voice-lines/923bc98b063a66fc609a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/923bc98b063a66fc609a..text: 我们就知道它不合适。下次换一种。

assets/voice-lines/53b9d8d817370aacda60..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/53b9d8d817370aacda60..text: 好。还有你的名字，提醒你下次继续来。

assets/voice-lines/8a08d500461227b2da80..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/8a08d500461227b2da80..text: 一块加了桂花，一块没有。你猜哪块是你的？

assets/voice-lines/5e90564cf94e1e6486c9..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/5e90564cf94e1e6486c9..text: 好像是。现在这半块，没有试吃的任务。

assets/voice-lines/c3adf2767e6b3c828fcf..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c3adf2767e6b3c828fcf..text: 你上次洗锅，把自己的袖子也洗湿了。

assets/voice-lines/7d040ab44bf6e15870fc..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/7d040ab44bf6e15870fc..text: 看，锅里也有星星。不必一直抬头找。

assets/voice-lines/5dd276dbf4ee813b5688..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/5dd276dbf4ee813b5688..text: 那就喝完再走。灯还可以多亮一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/b472689302ffe75da03e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b472689302ffe75da03e..text: 书签留在这里。困了就睡，下次我们继续。

assets/voice-lines/e8104983ff4c31abf256..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/e8104983ff4c31abf256..text: 笑什么呀，靠近也不能提前偷吃明天的点心。

assets/voice-lines/3bbb3e2580e58d1b6aa9..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/3bbb3e2580e58d1b6aa9..text: 好暖。我现在知道，你不是在客气地等我。

assets/voice-lines/2068017b69a69de2cea4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/2068017b69a69de2cea4..text: 已经盖好了，连配方纸也可以明天再翻。

assets/voice-lines/09e0caf6b1670bf747d5..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/09e0caf6b1670bf747d5..text: 看得出来吗？现在的我，只是在安心地犯困。

assets/voice-lines/c9f4fdad9f80c49c100e..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c9f4fdad9f80c49c100e..text: 今天没有要递出去的纸袋，这只手就交给你了。

assets/voice-lines/a63ff4e5652e87133668..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/a63ff4e5652e87133668..text: 谢谢你。我把烤箱关了，你把夜里的风关在被子外。

assets/voice-lines/bac881196a2f16e3d507..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/bac881196a2f16e3d507..text: 你这样看着，我会以为脸上还沾着奶油。

assets/voice-lines/50183c527e52937bacc4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/50183c527e52937bacc4..text: 我们都先对自己好一点，再把剩下的温柔分给对方。

assets/voice-lines/f0315fbe332dcb6ea51c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/f0315fbe332dcb6ea51c..text: 这一半给你。蛋糕和被子，都可以不用谁迁就谁。

assets/voice-lines/fa548d93304c1690aee2..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/fa548d93304c1690aee2..text: 那我可不可以，也把你当作今晚的惊喜？

assets/voice-lines/b6ae76b653f523a96331..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b6ae76b653f523a96331..text: 现在的心跳，比烤箱提示声更明显。

assets/voice-lines/d01cce0bf35cfa5396b6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d01cce0bf35cfa5396b6..text: 不用说甜话了。你在这里，就已经很甜。

assets/voice-lines/71ff5af1d683bea427dd..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/71ff5af1d683bea427dd..text: 不是要站得笔直才好看。把它们喜欢的方向留下来。

assets/voice-lines/cd27f26f1a466944ab0f..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/cd27f26f1a466944ab0f..text: 这副适合你。以后搬花盆，不能总是我一个人吧。

assets/voice-lines/ffd47515db8b36365843..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ffd47515db8b36365843..text: 这次想把愿望说出来。希望花开以后，你也在。

assets/voice-lines/9b428d495d00df2d206c..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/9b428d495d00df2d206c..text: 那就一起记进观察册。不只记开花的日子。

assets/voice-lines/8aad27e0510e08a676a1..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8aad27e0510e08a676a1..text: 原来书店门口，也有这么好闻的木头香。

assets/voice-lines/b792d2a9699bf1b321d4..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b792d2a9699bf1b321d4..text: 那我们就慢慢长大，像窗台上的这株小苗。

assets/voice-lines/638af1c165344827fa16..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/638af1c165344827fa16..text: 资料已经核对完了。还好，我们是同一队。

assets/voice-lines/4c647fda893d5448fab5..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/4c647fda893d5448fab5..text: 看到成片的第一秒，我就想到了我们。

assets/voice-lines/1c7249337ecb6aebc706..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/1c7249337ecb6aebc706..text: 谢谢你让小小的叶子，也被世界看见。

assets/voice-lines/7a009f8ecc6d0547d183..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/7a009f8ecc6d0547d183..text: 没有人看见的时候，它也一直在长。

assets/voice-lines/ab30019035b515b26a7a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ab30019035b515b26a7a..text: 长成什么样都可以，我们再交换着看。

assets/voice-lines/0c33ee77df9dc1182217..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0c33ee77df9dc1182217..text: 今天的风都像是在替我高兴，因为你回来了。

assets/voice-lines/4018de4c83a15a9695f8..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/4018de4c83a15a9695f8..text: 新叶又长出来了，回来一起看看吧。

assets/voice-lines/fd2ed83c0f5840850547..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/fd2ed83c0f5840850547..text: 这件家具，刚刚多了一段属于我们的回忆。

assets/voice-lines/90029725564d4f1826e1..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/90029725564d4f1826e1..text: 一起发现的小东西，也让今天变得不一样。

assets/voice-lines/89881f51698947b125ed..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/89881f51698947b125ed..text: 这个正好是我一直想留在家里的，谢谢你记得。

assets/voice-lines/4eeda68cf6e526f529b7..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/4eeda68cf6e526f529b7..text: 谢谢你想着我。只是这一份，我可能还不太习惯。

assets/voice-lines/74cafcd5e2d4beae38bd..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/74cafcd5e2d4beae38bd..text: 你挑的心意我收到了。一起放到家里吧。

assets/voice-lines/64b0cba75a6724340b6e..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/64b0cba75a6724340b6e..text: 原来我们都把一样的事情藏了这么久。

assets/voice-lines/a15bf899310ce2a07458..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a15bf899310ce2a07458..text: 背面原本只写了拍摄日期。我想再加一句话。

assets/voice-lines/8e9fb2180d984923e377..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8e9fb2180d984923e377..text: 会。可舍不得，不一定要一直停在原地。

assets/voice-lines/55269322fab0a4df7208..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/55269322fab0a4df7208..text: 还有你拍的照片。我想贴在新温室的门后。

assets/voice-lines/9d77e39d0e640dad56a4..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/9d77e39d0e640dad56a4..text: 好。新地方的第一天，也想让你在。

assets/voice-lines/c6f928386c7bbcb8ef87..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c6f928386c7bbcb8ef87..text: 不是担心坐过站。我只是想记住今天经过的地方。

assets/voice-lines/ebc0ba4c99179baa0c23..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ebc0ba4c99179baa0c23..text: 那就把这条线留下，等下一次和你一起经过。

assets/voice-lines/332bce3ec4eb6161c62a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/332bce3ec4eb6161c62a..text: 书签留在这里。困了就睡，下次我们继续。

assets/voice-lines/b396e0982f23e86e4720..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b396e0982f23e86e4720..text: 原来你也想凑近看看那朵花。等明天，我牵着你去。

assets/voice-lines/108a2f8f91b7c1efc031..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/108a2f8f91b7c1efc031..text: 你的手搭过来，连等待都变得暖一些。

assets/voice-lines/283229c59f955241f804..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/283229c59f955241f804..text: 好，我把被子分你一半。今晚谁都不用赶着开花。

assets/voice-lines/7b2cb2706227678dd147..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/7b2cb2706227678dd147..text: 嗯，眼睛有一点困了。你看见的这份安心，我也有。

assets/voice-lines/c322e1de249d2e94f9fc..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c322e1de249d2e94f9fc..text: 不用说话了，我知道这只手想留下来。

assets/voice-lines/5f28e1cb61cbfc13fb9f..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/5f28e1cb61cbfc13fb9f..text: 被角轻轻响了一下。雨在外面，我们在里面。

assets/voice-lines/9418577091a3d9fb42a1..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/9418577091a3d9fb42a1..text: 现在不用选。困的时候，你只要往舒服的地方靠。

assets/voice-lines/ed52002372b2e7a213b6..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ed52002372b2e7a213b6..text: 握住了。明天分花种，也要给你留一小袋。

assets/voice-lines/3015c0f5f82a7090938f..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3015c0f5f82a7090938f..text: 这边已经暖好了，你睡过来一点也没关系。

assets/voice-lines/d7296ffd9cdc69efaba3..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/d7296ffd9cdc69efaba3..text: 你伸手的时候，我会忍不住看着你。

assets/voice-lines/ec90ef447cabf5c5b7f9..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/ec90ef447cabf5c5b7f9..text: 别躲，刚才那一点笑，我想再看一次。

assets/voice-lines/a503843c723c8e11308a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a503843c723c8e11308a..text: 我没有在数花瓣。我在听你的呼吸。

assets/voice-lines/58ae9cc2b091b88cd326..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/58ae9cc2b091b88cd326..text: 广场的花车停在喷泉旁，风把地图吹到你们脚边。

assets/voice-lines/f67a667744a80bca9608..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f67a667744a80bca9608..text: 她把找到的心贴进地图，留一半空白给你写日期。

assets/voice-lines/b3f31c6d1fec4c186702..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b3f31c6d1fec4c186702..text: 你拾起纸页，发现背面画着一颗小小的心。

assets/voice-lines/e308c4762c472de1d7a8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e308c4762c472de1d7a8..text: 钟声落下时旁，刚好有一块能并肩站下的地方。

assets/voice-lines/a6e6957f4fd8d8a43a19..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a6e6957f4fd8d8a43a19..text: 你问下一站去哪里，她把地图折起，说先一起走。

assets/voice-lines/2e99daef243ab07e46bd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2e99daef243ab07e46bd..text: 路牌的背面旁，刚好有一块能并肩站下的地方。

assets/voice-lines/ea6b71454a45ed245818..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ea6b71454a45ed245818..text: 有人在远处叫卖，热闹越过街道，落在你们身边。

assets/voice-lines/f66b49911bcc11b61088..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f66b49911bcc11b61088..text: 城市的心跳旁，刚好有一块能并肩站下的地方。

assets/voice-lines/b19c4d5d49757efedf56..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b19c4d5d49757efedf56..text: 你们站得近了一点，谁也没有急着解释。

assets/voice-lines/31b8b6f9fd29dcc60acb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/31b8b6f9fd29dcc60acb..text: 旧街的钟走得慢，木窗里传来收音机的歌。

assets/voice-lines/050b6ae49ba54bce33a4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/050b6ae49ba54bce33a4..text: 一只猫沿着屋檐走过，你们也不自觉放轻脚步。

assets/voice-lines/611e38f765d9c2f20f02..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/611e38f765d9c2f20f02..text: 四格照片旁，刚好有一块能并肩站下的地方。

assets/voice-lines/072f64b0259a5ecd18a2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/072f64b0259a5ecd18a2..text: 留白的明信片旁，刚好有一块能并肩站下的地方。

assets/voice-lines/a10d91b10cf8f0cb1a8d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a10d91b10cf8f0cb1a8d..text: 你把买好的植物小册放进她的帆布包。

assets/voice-lines/69808aa6b43b418690e2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/69808aa6b43b418690e2..text: 回家的方向旁，刚好有一块能并肩站下的地方。

assets/voice-lines/64f46b687863cc0ff07b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/64f46b687863cc0ff07b..text: 乐园的灯还没有全亮，傍晚刚好留出一段温柔的蓝。

assets/voice-lines/c744031de3c310c52f39..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c744031de3c310c52f39..text: 她拍拍身旁的位置，把晒暖的一边留给你。

assets/voice-lines/33111fb5fe22e0bb2a30..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/33111fb5fe22e0bb2a30..text: 升空的心愿旁，刚好有一块能并肩站下的地方。

assets/voice-lines/11c2454860c493e211e1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/11c2454860c493e211e1..text: 最后一班车旁，刚好有一块能并肩站下的地方。

assets/voice-lines/c3f713545012cf9175b4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c3f713545012cf9175b4..text: 灯亮之前旁，刚好有一块能并肩站下的地方。

assets/voice-lines/ba78619ad68773639709..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ba78619ad68773639709..text: 你问她，会不会想起自己画的第一张图。

assets/voice-lines/b9a5525bab8be6900b19..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b9a5525bab8be6900b19..text: 你没有拿相机，只安静站在她身边。

assets/voice-lines/b743a2efe771e0191e41..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b743a2efe771e0191e41..text: 她把铅笔递给你，指向画面里的空位。

assets/voice-lines/82526d25357f7a534a45..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/82526d25357f7a534a45..text: 她故意放慢一步，等你的脚步追上来。

assets/voice-lines/6ffdd6ed9c9eddb0010a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6ffdd6ed9c9eddb0010a..text: 你学着她的节奏，差点被自己的影子绊住。

assets/voice-lines/bdcf9833a4a3206d784f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bdcf9833a4a3206d784f..text: 你听见咖啡杯、车铃和远处一声笑。

assets/voice-lines/b1c4f63f37660b467d4f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b1c4f63f37660b467d4f..text: 她看看橱窗，又看看里面并排的倒影。

assets/voice-lines/c64f111a7b7f0ceae92f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c64f111a7b7f0ceae92f..text: 她看着被夕阳照亮的墙，忽然笑起来。

assets/voice-lines/16a19acbbf0f3cf3cbbc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/16a19acbbf0f3cf3cbbc..text: 她把你喜欢的水果悄悄换到你盘子里。

assets/voice-lines/45e35f991a80468d4959..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/45e35f991a80468d4959..text: 她举着一朵小云，认真研究了半天。

assets/voice-lines/3f085b0b3d8cfab94c47..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3f085b0b3d8cfab94c47..text: 糖丝碰到嘴角，她笑得比刚才更软。

assets/voice-lines/bcd91691eb4e8565f470..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bcd91691eb4e8565f470..text: 她走到你身边，把取景框对准两个人的影子。

assets/voice-lines/68bdc4d3d26eee43c81d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/68bdc4d3d26eee43c81d..text: 她靠近了一点，铅笔在纸上划出两张并排的椅子。

assets/voice-lines/fba78a005981065d7a78..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fba78a005981065d7a78..text: 她落下笔，纸页上的字迹比平时轻了一点。

assets/voice-lines/69d8e9989621b8d61d73..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/69d8e9989621b8d61d73..text: 她倒数三声，在快门落下时靠近了你。

assets/voice-lines/f3be92c8e82dfef168b7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f3be92c8e82dfef168b7..text: 你问，这枚书签不是一直夹在她最喜欢的书里吗。

assets/voice-lines/96aff0ae6b69de251918..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/96aff0ae6b69de251918..text: 她点点头，伸手把窗边歪掉的小花盆扶正。

assets/voice-lines/20245d773917037c9f19..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/20245d773917037c9f19..text: 她拿出铅笔写好小牌，却没有立刻插进花盆。

assets/voice-lines/245b28d34d4a4ed3024a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/245b28d34d4a4ed3024a..text: 她的周末计划表只写了一行：给所有事情留出空白。

assets/voice-lines/169a15f68a4786b0a8d7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/169a15f68a4786b0a8d7..text: 她说那棵树已经不在了，但树下的凉意一直记得。

assets/voice-lines/8a391f5240109ec339cb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8a391f5240109ec339cb..text: 她先找到了小台灯，暖黄色的光刚好照亮两张脸。

assets/voice-lines/4934ede0c6e79d051198..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4934ede0c6e79d051198..text: 雨声盖过了冰箱的嗡鸣，小屋变得像漂在水上的岛。

assets/voice-lines/cf6ed15212223115ee3f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cf6ed15212223115ee3f..text: 你提议用它收纳书签，让它换一种方式陪着我们。

assets/voice-lines/de3b077a0d9d5ff44d15..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/de3b077a0d9d5ff44d15..text: 你把写坏的剧本纸裁成便笺，整整齐齐放在花盆旁。

assets/voice-lines/a32cab76d7e025f154c9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a32cab76d7e025f154c9..text: 她把今年拍过的新叶照片排好，最后留下一页空白。

assets/voice-lines/282e65c93e19150f3191..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/282e65c93e19150f3191..text: 你在空白页角落画了一把钥匙，笔迹歪歪扭扭。

assets/voice-lines/56e7545ba0b3b85d4267..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/56e7545ba0b3b85d4267..text: 她在旁边添上一片小叶，和玄关的记号一模一样。

assets/voice-lines/b7538949e614ce1f4295..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b7538949e614ce1f4295..text: 玄关多了一双你的尺码的拖鞋，鞋尖整齐朝向屋内。

assets/voice-lines/d5eafffcc9e5622bd397..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d5eafffcc9e5622bd397..text: 她说买家具时顺便带的，目光却停在你的脚边。

assets/voice-lines/d1e2c5c10c4b0c2a404b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d1e2c5c10c4b0c2a404b..text: 你把包放下，没有再追问那个被改了好几次的尺寸。

assets/voice-lines/f8d90a7c28d9d42fa81b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f8d90a7c28d9d42fa81b..text: 她拿着卷尺量窗边，想放下一张你们都能用的书桌。

assets/voice-lines/27ab7dc582090cebd585..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/27ab7dc582090cebd585..text: 你主动站到另一端，拉直那条总爱弯曲的金属尺。

assets/voice-lines/0f293a944d18b7fe6c8d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0f293a944d18b7fe6c8d..text: “再往左一点。”她说。你照做，恰好走到她身旁。

assets/voice-lines/7d23d55ed3cce55299ae..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7d23d55ed3cce55299ae..text: 最后量出的长度比预计短，但两把椅子还是能并排。

assets/voice-lines/6a4287155069c966f4e5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6a4287155069c966f4e5..text: 她递来小锤子，说房子不是用来保持完美的。

assets/voice-lines/67a669bf4a5b7f2cef8b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/67a669bf4a5b7f2cef8b..text: 她没有拔掉它，只把相框略微调整了一下。

assets/voice-lines/9a6fa5bd0272630565b0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9a6fa5bd0272630565b0..text: 你在屋顶旁加了烟囱，热气把线条慢慢晕开。

assets/voice-lines/6a54d49bdc175847e0c1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6a54d49bdc175847e0c1..text: 你说那就把茶壶当壁炉，今天的设计只负责温暖。

assets/voice-lines/5740438b98a9b4ac440c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5740438b98a9b4ac440c..text: 她把你的杯子添满，再把窗边那条毯子分给你一半。

assets/voice-lines/1310a4e8e62755c663fb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1310a4e8e62755c663fb..text: 雾上的房子很快消失了，真实的小屋却一直暖着。

assets/voice-lines/8905d74c882408a9ce7c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8905d74c882408a9ce7c..text: 她带回一张被退回的方案，卷起来的纸边有点发皱。

assets/voice-lines/c64bbe713a543f8bee8f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c64bbe713a543f8bee8f..text: 她坐下很久，才说今天暂时不想再修改了。

assets/voice-lines/c16b3396e43a101fab4c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c16b3396e43a101fab4c..text: 你把投影幕放下来，提议先研究今晚看哪一部电影。

assets/voice-lines/6af2c1c9ac22807aa766..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6af2c1c9ac22807aa766..text: 你问将来如果搬家，这些改动是不是都得重新开始。

assets/voice-lines/a298e98b76772ccb2d16..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a298e98b76772ccb2d16..text: 她摇头，指着你画在角落里的歪房子。

assets/voice-lines/2f75ee82540e4b354b76..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2f75ee82540e4b354b76..text: 线有点短，你们只好靠着沙发扶手挤在一起。

assets/voice-lines/cbc978c24e42bb0d8ae9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cbc978c24e42bb0d8ae9..text: 你故意再哼一遍，她笑得把原本的旋律都忘了。

assets/voice-lines/f1e9e11d4e009fa02626..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f1e9e11d4e009fa02626..text: 她把琴放好以后，你们坐在地毯上各自翻书。

assets/voice-lines/8a2a19312ec62a3ed804..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8a2a19312ec62a3ed804..text: 你担心太安静会让她无聊，正要去找一首背景音乐。

assets/voice-lines/7e9c3441f4fe792d84d9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7e9c3441f4fe792d84d9..text: 她拉住你的袖口，说这一段已经很好听。

assets/voice-lines/86f10ebdeee9790837bc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/86f10ebdeee9790837bc..text: 翻页声、茶杯轻碰的声音，还有你偶尔忍不住的笑。

assets/voice-lines/b20f9d2b00de03f36f38..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b20f9d2b00de03f36f38..text: 弹到中间她忽然忘了和弦，抬头看你该怎么接下去。

assets/voice-lines/e1659028ec7da573807f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e1659028ec7da573807f..text: 你知道她说得没错，正因为这样，才更想记住此刻。

assets/voice-lines/4c611b3575e0ff45abd6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4c611b3575e0ff45abd6..text: 她先划掉了自己的最后一项：一定要把新歌写完。

assets/voice-lines/7f2d30f309a238dad58f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7f2d30f309a238dad58f..text: “今天已经做得够多了。”她也把笔递到你面前。

assets/voice-lines/564d3a2e03dcf39c5603..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/564d3a2e03dcf39c5603..text: 一张旧唱片播放到熟悉的位置，总会轻轻跳过半拍。

assets/voice-lines/666b0574957d8f6e742e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/666b0574957d8f6e742e..text: 你准备找人修，她却先让你把这一面听完。

assets/voice-lines/f71244d374fc28bece6e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f71244d374fc28bece6e..text: 那是她第一次演出后买的唱片，反复听了很多年。

assets/voice-lines/553c97e74949185edcd9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/553c97e74949185edcd9..text: 你问为什么没有放她最好听的演出片段，她想了想。

assets/voice-lines/2db9e5926ae77810aafa..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2db9e5926ae77810aafa..text: 她把录音笔留在包里，坐下来问你今天想吃什么。

assets/voice-lines/a434ca324f41f8760e88..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a434ca324f41f8760e88..text: 你递来碗，提醒她记者已经下班了。

assets/voice-lines/b0f9bd55d10503dc9ff8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b0f9bd55d10503dc9ff8..text: 整理书柜时，一张旧车票从她的书页中滑出来。

assets/voice-lines/8548708d860abf8b1762..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8548708d860abf8b1762..text: 她把车票夹回去，另拿一张便笺写下今天的日期。

assets/voice-lines/adb01cc781b9fcd487aa..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/adb01cc781b9fcd487aa..text: 你翻到第一页，迟迟不知道要从哪件事开始。

assets/voice-lines/8b68c2848befc1d12948..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8b68c2848befc1d12948..text: 她就在对页画了两只歪歪的小碗，标注今晚的面条。

assets/voice-lines/866b66e0ae9d681c2e82..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/866b66e0ae9d681c2e82..text: 你终于写下一句：她画的碗比我洗得还干净。

assets/voice-lines/4cfe8e44ddbaf9afcb62..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4cfe8e44ddbaf9afcb62..text: 她读完笑了很久，把这一页的空白留得格外大。

assets/voice-lines/66ffb54febef2770bb6b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/66ffb54febef2770bb6b..text: 她摊开地图，给你们规划从沙发到茶几的室内旅行。

assets/voice-lines/a4c60607eb3767a6c6a8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a4c60607eb3767a6c6a8..text: 第一站是一杯热茶，第二站是那本一直没读完的书。

assets/voice-lines/3a8d238ae867861186dc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3a8d238ae867861186dc..text: 你在终点画了一颗星，说这里适合等一个晴天。

assets/voice-lines/46c3ec3a5b822f50db80..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/46c3ec3a5b822f50db80..text: 那片叶子其实并不像，你们绕了半圈才找对角度。

assets/voice-lines/8e89e90e8598e661620a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8e89e90e8598e661620a..text: 她读了一遍，把它放在日记最前面。

assets/voice-lines/a1d809827e98792cb61b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a1d809827e98792cb61b..text: 她打开橱柜，你发现两只早餐碗的花纹并不相同。

assets/voice-lines/54e43bec9863c2c3a5f6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/54e43bec9863c2c3a5f6..text: 你问为什么不买成一对，她把热粥分别盛好。

assets/voice-lines/5fe84d13c3771664d2f3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5fe84d13c3771664d2f3..text: 你们坐到桌前，碗沿轻轻碰出一声清脆的响。

assets/voice-lines/d969902625b25d494fc9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d969902625b25d494fc9..text: 小屋的第一顿早餐，就这样有了属于两个人的尺寸。

assets/voice-lines/bc5e93165ebf3ad60c83..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bc5e93165ebf3ad60c83..text: 你很自然地拿起那块，她却问为什么每次都先选它。

assets/voice-lines/2e00e246ecc8eeb02b7b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2e00e246ecc8eeb02b7b..text: 你说因为它很好认，别人一眼也找不到第二块。

assets/voice-lines/2ff8b40f42215ae6facf..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2ff8b40f42215ae6facf..text: 你把磁铁往上挪了挪，让两行字都完整露出来。

assets/voice-lines/967fea6f958553544a58..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/967fea6f958553544a58..text: 她定好闹钟，宣布今天烤箱只工作到下午三点。

assets/voice-lines/3e20f1df87bc892379e8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3e20f1df87bc892379e8..text: 闹钟响时还有一个配方没试完，她伸手又停住。

assets/voice-lines/69210b4cb47c23bab619..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/69210b4cb47c23bab619..text: 你把两杯茶放到阳台，说预约好的客人已经到了。

assets/voice-lines/8efc480d3b1f3e89040e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8efc480d3b1f3e89040e..text: 她看着只有你们两个人的躺椅，终于脱下围裙。

assets/voice-lines/e75a117c16c0d6c92972..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e75a117c16c0d6c92972..text: 她在纸角画了一朵小花，写上“小屋限定”。

assets/voice-lines/e7bdb21c9f1b81ab474f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e7bdb21c9f1b81ab474f..text: 餐桌边缘磨掉了一小块漆，她问要不要换一张新的。

assets/voice-lines/af144ef462a4b0b7ffba..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/af144ef462a4b0b7ffba..text: 她拿出一张软布，先把那处旧痕擦得干干净净。

assets/voice-lines/252f1bf063b378d1d0aa..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/252f1bf063b378d1d0aa..text: 她把相机放在柜子里，特意给你看了关机的小灯。

assets/voice-lines/92a9850dea4dab53cd8b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/92a9850dea4dab53cd8b..text: 你们把靠垫挪到窗边，那里恰好没有任何镜头。

assets/voice-lines/deffcf7428355f9e95be..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/deffcf7428355f9e95be..text: 她习惯性地整理头发，又被你递来的热茶打断。

assets/voice-lines/78af7acb22d6c46c83f7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/78af7acb22d6c46c83f7..text: 她洗出几张照片，让你挑一张放在小屋的相框里。

assets/voice-lines/a4660f60b5523230214e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a4660f60b5523230214e..text: 你选了那张稍微失焦的，她正回过头听你说话。

assets/voice-lines/b65a5f3897eef65ad4a5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b65a5f3897eef65ad4a5..text: 她问是不是挑错了，你翻到背面写下“她在听我”。

assets/voice-lines/07388cae52869332d9b9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/07388cae52869332d9b9..text: 她看了很久，又在下面添了一句“以后也会”。

assets/voice-lines/0d804afbc508bb01f15b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0d804afbc508bb01f15b..text: 照片被放进相框时，那两行字一起藏在了后面。

assets/voice-lines/63692179bb3eb3563ce7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/63692179bb3eb3563ce7..text: 你也把手机放进去，两个屏幕终于不再轮流亮起。

assets/voice-lines/fa9796f960df87e6ea86..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fa9796f960df87e6ea86..text: 她笑得差点把水洒出来，第一反应不再是去拿相机。

assets/voice-lines/6d1aaff6e73d0079d22a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6d1aaff6e73d0079d22a..text: “这个表情，只给你看过。”她用纸巾擦干桌面。

assets/voice-lines/6bbddc69c486afbd5514..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6bbddc69c486afbd5514..text: 你起床时，她正站在窗边看一块缓慢移动的阳光。

assets/voice-lines/f2d3653e303dec9f98ca..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f2d3653e303dec9f98ca..text: 她说今天的光很好，却没有去找相机。

assets/voice-lines/e4cb3dc13b76018dc571..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e4cb3dc13b76018dc571..text: 你搬来两把椅子，让那块阳光也照到你们的脚边。

assets/voice-lines/eac25afa76867b178303..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/eac25afa76867b178303..text: 整理存储卡时，她发现一段按错按钮录下的视频。

assets/voice-lines/a55b7b9a2d2349f68b65..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a55b7b9a2d2349f68b65..text: 画面里只有桌角，你们的声音却笑成了一团。

assets/voice-lines/7d6e9c3816c8ef58bdbd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7d6e9c3816c8ef58bdbd..text: 视频最后，她用很小的声音叫了一次你的名字。

assets/voice-lines/47cdd499b536189baed8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/47cdd499b536189baed8..text: 你没有改动构图，只在文件名后面添上今天的日期。

assets/voice-lines/d35354a1819beb61a323..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d35354a1819beb61a323..text: 一片新叶藏在旧叶后面，她拉你蹲下来才看清。

assets/voice-lines/aece29e313b6ab15ccad..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/aece29e313b6ab15ccad..text: 你们在花盆边留了今天的日期，没有给它新的期限。

assets/voice-lines/9f189a289d2978b05a0b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9f189a289d2978b05a0b..text: 窗边的小发现，就这样成了两个人共同的秘密。

assets/voice-lines/dacc1b5e2891b92babbd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/dacc1b5e2891b92babbd..text: 便笺被风吹到沙发下面，你替她捡起最远的一张。

assets/voice-lines/02d5c0c96a3f1dd4ef27..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/02d5c0c96a3f1dd4ef27..text: 上面不是工作计划，而是提醒自己记得给你留茶。

assets/voice-lines/6230be0e1c0403271f46..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6230be0e1c0403271f46..text: 她把便笺折好，笑着说这件事已经完成了。

assets/voice-lines/fd78b1309551e905c1f5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fd78b1309551e905c1f5..text: 你们关好窗，决定先把杯子里的这一口暖喝完。

assets/voice-lines/30433fa993b16ea27da6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/30433fa993b16ea27da6..text: 她在琴旁听你慢慢找准一个音，手指跟着轻敲桌沿。

assets/voice-lines/8d4345bae347c1b50202..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8d4345bae347c1b50202..text: 你弹错的时候，她没有急着指出来。

assets/voice-lines/c6775ddec0d7b7aca14d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c6775ddec0d7b7aca14d..text: 你们把种子分进两个小纸袋，准备放到不同的窗边。

assets/voice-lines/b8417b5a7afc1ad98d7d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b8417b5a7afc1ad98d7d..text: 她在你的纸袋上画太阳，在自己的那一袋画月亮。

assets/voice-lines/51dc2ac1e971051c598e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/51dc2ac1e971051c598e..text: 你在图纸边画了一只不像猫的猫，准备偷偷擦掉。

assets/voice-lines/a798aff38340f9e136cb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a798aff38340f9e136cb..text: 她却拿笔给它补上胡须，宣布这片空白有了住户。

assets/voice-lines/426a35780bfd86307b4d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/426a35780bfd86307b4d..text: 你问第三把椅子放下后，两把旧椅子会不会太挤。

assets/voice-lines/3f8ef5a8918af05e1f44..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3f8ef5a8918af05e1f44..text: 她把你的椅子往自己这边轻轻挪了几厘米。

assets/voice-lines/d90bde01c8d21c3dcb5d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d90bde01c8d21c3dcb5d..text: 你按下一个和弦，让她猜像哪一种房间。

assets/voice-lines/1015f442a44db0833168..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1015f442a44db0833168..text: 她说像有阳光的高窗，又认真试了几个更低的音。

assets/voice-lines/a36b0ba6881d4b2d56dd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a36b0ba6881d4b2d56dd..text: 她看了一眼你认真皱起的眉，提议先补一壶热水。

assets/voice-lines/134351f49baaaffc9e10..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/134351f49baaaffc9e10..text: 你们回来时忘了轮到谁走，索性把这一局记成平手。

assets/voice-lines/4bb455b81375219d60a0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4bb455b81375219d60a0..text: 你们整理东西时，发现音响一直在重复同一段前奏。

assets/voice-lines/242e6d6f3ef20da1b954..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/242e6d6f3ef20da1b954..text: 她本想换掉，却听见你已经准确哼出下一拍。

assets/voice-lines/278576583d9ec0e34116..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/278576583d9ec0e34116..text: 小屋里第一次出现了不用排练也能同步的合唱。

assets/voice-lines/7475cc873b2ec32dffe6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7475cc873b2ec32dffe6..text: 你把它捡出来，她却在背面写上了今晚点心的名字。

assets/voice-lines/ea0be341e7aba72665db..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ea0be341e7aba72665db..text: 她把琴凳留出一半，问你今天想听哪一首。

assets/voice-lines/1c3d32822f5f80cad6fd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1c3d32822f5f80cad6fd..text: 你说可以听她还没写完的那首吗，她认真点头。

assets/voice-lines/9330d642451d0d4e57f8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9330d642451d0d4e57f8..text: “下一次再继续。”她把最后一个音轻轻收回。

assets/voice-lines/c7768d79c9533aec8aff..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c7768d79c9533aec8aff..text: 她把先手让给你，却偷偷给自己立了不悔棋的规矩。

assets/voice-lines/4ca7fb1b65a575579e5b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4ca7fb1b65a575579e5b..text: 轮到最难的那一步，她盯着棋盘看了很久。

assets/voice-lines/681cb5482afe40672d04..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/681cb5482afe40672d04..text: 你说可以一起研究，她立刻把输赢的纸条翻了过去。

assets/voice-lines/6aa0d5efb666ef909643..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6aa0d5efb666ef909643..text: 今晚的比赛提前结束，留下来的是一场很长的讨论。

assets/voice-lines/2fbb35f30c6641d53370..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2fbb35f30c6641d53370..text: 她没有猜原来的结尾，而是把空白递给你。

assets/voice-lines/bc53b29f8d3fe8f4fe6c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bc53b29f8d3fe8f4fe6c..text: 你写下一个很日常的答案：今天早点回家。

assets/voice-lines/155a477a7aaed87a7fb7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/155a477a7aaed87a7fb7..text: 她把纸条夹回书里，说这次的句子已经完整了。

assets/voice-lines/ba0e583b6550fdbbca8f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ba0e583b6550fdbbca8f..text: 她放下手里的计时器，认真想了一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/46b0eadd61af86ddff00..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/46b0eadd61af86ddff00..text: 你在琴上随便按了几下，她说很像雨落在空杯子里。

assets/voice-lines/6508b5800f601031e9ce..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6508b5800f601031e9ce..text: 你们试着给这段声音取名，想了好几个都不满意。

assets/voice-lines/9f08701c6e0445d40af3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9f08701c6e0445d40af3..text: 最后她合上便笺，说不一定每段声音都要有题目。

assets/voice-lines/da528a969a749d7c9860..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/da528a969a749d7c9860..text: 有些片刻，只要两个人认得，就已经足够了。

assets/voice-lines/18a5fde6f5ebe8d3b586..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/18a5fde6f5ebe8d3b586..text: 那晚的日记没有写结果，你们也没有觉得缺了一行。

assets/voice-lines/0434d1df3c0db7894fce..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0434d1df3c0db7894fce..text: 她发现量勺少了一把，你们把抽屉翻了个遍。

assets/voice-lines/1d521949cf1ac98489ed..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1d521949cf1ac98489ed..text: 最后它藏在茶罐后面，正好接住几片散落的花瓣。

assets/voice-lines/fdf1a40588c07286771e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fdf1a40588c07286771e..text: 你替她系围裙，才发现自己袖口也沾了面粉。

assets/voice-lines/f225e14f58fa8c2ee625..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f225e14f58fa8c2ee625..text: 她本想拿布擦，看到你鼻尖那一点白又忍不住笑。

assets/voice-lines/4a7db617fa73ca7524c9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4a7db617fa73ca7524c9..text: 烤箱轻轻响了一声，她跟着在琴上敲出相同的节拍。

assets/voice-lines/9aaa742cbc05dc58aad9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9aaa742cbc05dc58aad9..text: 你把水壶的声音也加进来，拼成一段奇怪的小曲子。

assets/voice-lines/b9158234cb4b090f7db4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b9158234cb4b090f7db4..text: 她说以后等点心的时候，就不用只盯着倒计时了。

assets/voice-lines/2e413ea5d75d10d80fcd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2e413ea5d75d10d80fcd..text: 琴旁的便笺多了一行：晚餐前可以一起演奏一次。

assets/voice-lines/a3152baa551908282684..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a3152baa551908282684..text: 她把点心摆在棋盘旁，提议每下一步都休息一口。

assets/voice-lines/8751056e36f6f60866bd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8751056e36f6f60866bd..text: 你提醒她这样很容易忘记棋局，她认真想了想。

assets/voice-lines/d144b552e5ec89da9c70..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d144b552e5ec89da9c70..text: 最后棋盘收得很早，盘子却一直摆到了晚饭前。

assets/voice-lines/24a59225ffe1c3a7ebbf..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/24a59225ffe1c3a7ebbf..text: 一束光刚好落在相框边，你叫她来看。

assets/voice-lines/57e158956108158a0426..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/57e158956108158a0426..text: 她只看了一眼便坐到你身边，没有拿起相机。

assets/voice-lines/1fe07b58e4ee1c0b13d5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1fe07b58e4ee1c0b13d5..text: 直到光斑慢慢移走，小屋里仍留着刚才那一点温暖。

assets/voice-lines/3520982e99047fb641ad..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3520982e99047fb641ad..text: 你替她擦相框，背面掉出一张折得很小的清单。

assets/voice-lines/4d8b9d4e3fa631cdc48f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4d8b9d4e3fa631cdc48f..text: 上面写着以后想和你在家里做的几件普通小事。

assets/voice-lines/40f16256e456a5103452..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/40f16256e456a5103452..text: 她把清单摊开，先划掉“放下一晚的手机”。

assets/voice-lines/355bc25b153dbc8d8096..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/355bc25b153dbc8d8096..text: 真正开始以后，谁也没再碰录制按钮。

assets/voice-lines/e8c2b3374012d26f84c3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e8c2b3374012d26f84c3..text: 你鼓完掌才想起来，自己连一张谢幕照片都没有拍。

assets/voice-lines/b2491134c50d978ae67f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b2491134c50d978ae67f..text: 她放大来看，发现你们连皱眉的角度都很像。

assets/voice-lines/f9dd327535fca0286733..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f9dd327535fca0286733..text: 得到你的回答后，她把照片存进只属于小屋的相册。

assets/voice-lines/d6ba0b05a1ea167c0958..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d6ba0b05a1ea167c0958..text: 把相机架在茶几上，再把窗帘拉开一点。

assets/voice-lines/d00e70528b4670235784..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d00e70528b4670235784..text: 她靠近了半步，留出刚好能站下两个人的位置。

assets/voice-lines/42df5c4d8c01fdf8cca8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/42df5c4d8c01fdf8cca8..text: 快门轻响。窗边的光，和笑意一起留在了照片里。

assets/voice-lines/a2e07d2b080157e75f0b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a2e07d2b080157e75f0b..text: 琴谱上夹着一片薄薄的书签。她把琴凳让出一半。

assets/voice-lines/9490e18164b5e229269b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9490e18164b5e229269b..text: 你先弹出几个音，她放慢速度，等你跟上。

assets/voice-lines/d3a5a1b8ac239354a313..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d3a5a1b8ac239354a313..text: 两个声部终于遇在同一拍，窗外的风也安静了。

assets/voice-lines/dcadf957660aaa5a3d64..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/dcadf957660aaa5a3d64..text: 林栀说，这段旋律很适合留给不用赶路的下午。

assets/voice-lines/a5edb678a6dd59810dbd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a5edb678a6dd59810dbd..text: 棋盘摆在两人之间，茶杯刚好留在不会碰倒的地方。

assets/voice-lines/fa483abcb3d61e2ab07a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fa483abcb3d61e2ab07a..text: 你想了一会儿，把第一颗棋子放在靠近中间的位置。

assets/voice-lines/cb6054bb672ba79f861a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cb6054bb672ba79f861a..text: 她接着落下一颗，笑着说这一盘可以慢慢下。

assets/voice-lines/6d05ac1f8d7d42bc80bc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6d05ac1f8d7d42bc80bc..text: 她从靠椅上拿起软枕，先提醒你别碰倒窗边的花。

assets/voice-lines/4e2ac12043203ff413eb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4e2ac12043203ff413eb..text: 你把枕头轻轻抛过去，她笑着伸手接住。

assets/voice-lines/41a025aed6f1cc6c7d88..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/41a025aed6f1cc6c7d88..text: 软枕沿着短短的弧线回到你手边，没有碰到家具。

assets/voice-lines/a608051c0b511293ff6d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a608051c0b511293ff6d..text: 苏晚把照片放进手账，旁边只写了两个字：回家。

assets/voice-lines/514a44bf8fb012061df2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/514a44bf8fb012061df2..text: 苏晚说，先把这一句弹好，晚饭后再学下一句。

assets/voice-lines/adcb73fd3109bf4598df..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/adcb73fd3109bf4598df..text: 苏晚替你续上温茶，让这盘棋有足够慢的时间。

assets/voice-lines/0450c3389356197d7405..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0450c3389356197d7405..text: 苏晚把软枕拍松摆好，说玩累了就来尝刚煮好的汤。

assets/voice-lines/bf48b24b7f19e1833b06..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bf48b24b7f19e1833b06..text: 唐梨没有开直播，只把这一张留进你们自己的相册。

assets/voice-lines/c1941623cb652ea2bef6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c1941623cb652ea2bef6..text: 她在信封上补写了日期，郑重放进你的掌心。

assets/voice-lines/c26a85f79aa55d416bfb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c26a85f79aa55d416bfb..text: 她把笔交给你，留出照片背面一半的位置。

assets/voice-lines/8fc2ad1831b1cf3d607a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8fc2ad1831b1cf3d607a..text: 她把钥匙收进包里，靠在你身旁的栏杆上。

assets/voice-lines/69ba8fa17d7a6801fc2f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/69ba8fa17d7a6801fc2f..text: 她把琴盒挪到你脚边，坐上刚折起一半的椅子。

assets/voice-lines/9003adcd90f4a416953d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9003adcd90f4a416953d..text: 她没有像采访时那样立刻给出一个完整答案。

assets/voice-lines/733f92821d238e6b36a6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/733f92821d238e6b36a6..text: 她把空白便签贴在提纲下方，推到你面前。

assets/voice-lines/5e516237a17d1df231a2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5e516237a17d1df231a2..text: 她慢慢写完，笔尖在最后一个句号上停了一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/a0e5fb783be25d630ff7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a0e5fb783be25d630ff7..text: 她把纸袋放到两人之间，伸手扶住轻轻摇晃的嫩叶。

assets/voice-lines/c4dfb42b5578f4c9895d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c4dfb42b5578f4c9895d..text: 她的手指沿着河岸移动，在一盏街灯的标记旁停下。

assets/voice-lines/5d385fa290b868d64363..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5d385fa290b868d64363..text: 她把地图对折，刻意没有折过那些细小的店名。

assets/voice-lines/f193f8cef4939510fd0e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f193f8cef4939510fd0e..text: 一阵风吹起地图的边角，她没有立刻按住。

assets/voice-lines/4402ddd1b5a2056d1db5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4402ddd1b5a2056d1db5..text: 她调低伴奏，把纸条放在了麦克风照不到的那一侧。

assets/voice-lines/b464c5c8e8dc422e11ce..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b464c5c8e8dc422e11ce..text: 她关掉直播指示灯，仍然把最后一段旋律轻轻哼完。

assets/voice-lines/987febd2f25213fb134f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/987febd2f25213fb134f..text: 站台灯照在信纸背面，只看得见几行模糊的笔迹。

assets/voice-lines/245da9a14b30fcfe09f9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/245da9a14b30fcfe09f9..text: 她没有松开信封的另一端，先轻轻吸了一口气。

assets/voice-lines/afa704e5a54d217774b4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/afa704e5a54d217774b4..text: 沈屿掰开其中一块，留了一半在掌心，递过另一半。

assets/voice-lines/e34b4c054b4ac1d084d1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e34b4c054b4ac1d084d1..text: 沈屿卷起袖口，先把案台上空掉的纸袋收在一起。

assets/voice-lines/9437483df6bed645e9f3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9437483df6bed645e9f3..text: 她侧过脸，看见沈屿正替纸灯避开伸到路中的树枝。

assets/voice-lines/75bee94b05b721d41ea4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/75bee94b05b721d41ea4..text: 她努力接住了话题。下次，可以先听听她的想法。

assets/voice-lines/19e4f5feb24b5a02a3f2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/19e4f5feb24b5a02a3f2..text: 她把呼吸放得很轻，让你也能安心休息。

assets/voice-lines/c6653758796379877d4c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c6653758796379877d4c..text: 生日快乐。愿你一直做喜欢的自己。

assets/voice-lines/7ee155ec5926c9e821f1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7ee155ec5926c9e821f1..text: 生日快乐。愿以后的日子都有我们。

assets/voice-lines/ba0ed7bb002b44a1fdc0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ba0ed7bb002b44a1fdc0..text: 不赶时间。今天可以慢慢认识你喜欢的这座城。

assets/voice-lines/a5d40f244bce659a1dcd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a5d40f244bce659a1dcd..text: 如果有想看的地方，就再多待一会儿吧。

assets/voice-lines/15d384101326a2f8f50b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/15d384101326a2f8f50b..text: 那就把这个街角，记进我们下次的路线。

assets/voice-lines/511bbfeb796148c8435e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/511bbfeb796148c8435e..text: 这里的每一个转角，都值得和你重新走一遍。

assets/voice-lines/53beb419a870a79c222c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/53beb419a870a79c222c..text: 把今天的日期写在背面，就不会认错了。

assets/voice-lines/a5b15e59912cd91328f0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a5b15e59912cd91328f0..text: 下次路过这里，我大概会先想起今天。

assets/voice-lines/f4997160abc916a3a6ed..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f4997160abc916a3a6ed..text: 排队也没关系，和你一起就不会觉得太久。

assets/voice-lines/2a7da5db8a9ca0fdb245..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2a7da5db8a9ca0fdb245..text: 这盏灯很暖，和你站在这里刚刚好。

assets/voice-lines/931d530382f7c0ad4474..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/931d530382f7c0ad4474..text: 这些细小的日常，值得被好好记录。

assets/voice-lines/d062b736d3844431131e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d062b736d3844431131e..text: 屏幕上的每一帧，都有一起努力的痕迹。

assets/voice-lines/6439ef2dd84ef9e00e67..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6439ef2dd84ef9e00e67..text: 那天你递给我的第一枝花，我也夹在了工作手册里。

assets/voice-lines/13b1b0d9a841e61b8d7e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/13b1b0d9a841e61b8d7e..text: “这个春天，我们一起等过。”这样可以吗？

assets/voice-lines/d40cb5d4646acd1c37b7..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d40cb5d4646acd1c37b7..text: 那放在这里，能看到窗外，也能看到你。

assets/voice-lines/94a305b4b573ca240e0a..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/94a305b4b573ca240e0a..text: 听起来像两个人都决定继续往下走。

assets/voice-lines/a3514ce35eea2b437d8c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a3514ce35eea2b437d8c..text: 那这次不用当报道。写给以后翻到它的自己。

assets/voice-lines/2888eda82e836e1a16d0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2888eda82e836e1a16d0..text: 今天一起吃完吧。你也在首映名单里。

assets/voice-lines/e8870dff420801d92d9f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/e8870dff420801d92d9f..text: 菜单那块空白，先写我们的试吃日期吧。

assets/voice-lines/7e01f0be2907a914e868..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7e01f0be2907a914e868..text: 不一定每件事都要有录像。你说的时候，我听到了。

assets/voice-lines/6bd65db8234f98287b91..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6bd65db8234f98287b91..text: 那就留着。片尾不必每次都用音乐填满。

assets/voice-lines/56a9eca708e65b6ca675..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/56a9eca708e65b6ca675..text: 等换盆那天，叫上我。我负责把那张照片贴正。

assets/voice-lines/86d386a5766e2efd9ede..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/86d386a5766e2efd9ede..text: 要不要问问乘务员？我们还有三站才下车。

assets/voice-lines/ccdf653ae54c1d6385cd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/ccdf653ae54c1d6385cd..text: 椅子可以晚点买，空行也可以先留着。

assets/voice-lines/35166ddf52fb2e9502f1..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/35166ddf52fb2e9502f1..text: 我们还会再来。到时候把这一页接着写。

assets/voice-lines/6dceb3636f39ff4e82b0..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6dceb3636f39ff4e82b0..text: 多拍一条真实的路，比补一段空镜有意思。

assets/voice-lines/c81eb8ff52794b235870..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/c81eb8ff52794b235870..text: 今天拍到的那个老人，只说想把门前的树留下。

assets/voice-lines/4642a24b76ab56d40935..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/4642a24b76ab56d40935..text: 你也有想留下、却没写进方案的东西吗？

assets/voice-lines/82f2a62358a16a481675..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/82f2a62358a16a481675..text: 那就再站一会儿。等对岸最后一扇窗亮起来。

assets/voice-lines/cff0e30d3383f7555a7f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/cff0e30d3383f7555a7f..text: 我只写了歌名，没有想好点歌理由。

assets/voice-lines/fa3dac5a26d2074ad18f..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/fa3dac5a26d2074ad18f..text: 这首歌让我想起第一次陪你收工。那天也是这么晚。

assets/voice-lines/65d7c6a80fb1c509e995..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/65d7c6a80fb1c509e995..text: 那也算进我的问题里。我不该抢镜。

assets/voice-lines/783246e186a2e803aa65..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/783246e186a2e803aa65..text: 里面是采访提纲，还是给我的稿费单？

assets/voice-lines/bcd6e4e13a4cf089316d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/bcd6e4e13a4cf089316d..text: 这一句我收到了。信里的每一句，我也都会收好。

assets/voice-lines/d12a5db4d77438928dcd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d12a5db4d77438928dcd..text: 明早醒来再读一遍，可能更知道要不要改。

assets/voice-lines/7198781d1eca9fee5b66..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7198781d1eca9fee5b66..text: 是在邀请你陪我坐这班车。车上可以不谈工作。

assets/voice-lines/75d85ecd721456451d5b..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/75d85ecd721456451d5b..text: 这样你也能知道，我尝到的是什么味道。

assets/voice-lines/da20b7208f53b2dfdd0c..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/da20b7208f53b2dfdd0c..text: 可那时候你站在灶台边，现在我们在河边。

assets/voice-lines/7a09c1d71b746c72ec09..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/7a09c1d71b746c72ec09..text: 那今晚就尝一碗。明天的配方可以重新煮。

assets/voice-lines/6cc789f0419dc1e50151..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/6cc789f0419dc1e50151..text: 挑花和洗锅交给我。等待的部分，我们一起。

assets/voice-lines/db364c7a716776720d6d..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/db364c7a716776720d6d..text: 所以今天先卷好了。总要有一点进步。

assets/voice-lines/f97f66413aaf3172c117..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/f97f66413aaf3172c117..text: 那我负责提回去。路上你可以空着手。

assets/voice-lines/2e8a868986028a72161e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/2e8a868986028a72161e..text: 可以先不说。河水已经替我们聊了很久。

assets/voice-lines/8213df502b8ad9c65536..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/8213df502b8ad9c65536..text: 你想说的时候我会听，不想说的时候就再走一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/109ed77de02a7532edbe..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/109ed77de02a7532edbe..text: 我也是。要是明天再想起，我们还可以再说一次。

assets/voice-lines/af69e37db1c5b8bb94ca..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/af69e37db1c5b8bb94ca..text: 谢谢你连不够成熟的部分，也愿意认真找来。

assets/voice-lines/1ba7f52671e91923e260..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1ba7f52671e91923e260..text: 别躲。送礼物的人，也该被放进记忆里。

assets/voice-lines/a82638d01609c799044d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a82638d01609c799044d..text: 谢谢你没有把今天写成一篇需要交稿的报道。

assets/voice-lines/868fc20b3e320611fe48..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/868fc20b3e320611fe48..text: 我记下了。这一次，不需要采访录音证明。

assets/voice-lines/71b2ca5fcb301a4c9aa1..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/71b2ca5fcb301a4c9aa1..text: 你问，那谁来记录这个难得的休息日。

assets/voice-lines/2c26f4d4a77b1074503f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/2c26f4d4a77b1074503f..text: 那我可以再贪心一点，多待一会儿吗？

assets/voice-lines/a1608323f2538486ff9f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a1608323f2538486ff9f..text: 街坊说，这里晚上会开一盏很暖的灯。

assets/voice-lines/20df6f7d52a70453cd1f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/20df6f7d52a70453cd1f..text: 你们等到灯亮，没有任何惊天动地的事发生。

assets/voice-lines/7c4e1752753546c75bf2..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7c4e1752753546c75bf2..text: 今天的好消息，是有人愿意和我等。

assets/voice-lines/db49c2b3d5fb7aecaa78..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/db49c2b3d5fb7aecaa78..text: 你认真翻资料的样子，我偷偷记住了。

assets/voice-lines/9c64ae28ba4ae6a79ff4..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/9c64ae28ba4ae6a79ff4..text: 有些没有写进报道的话，可以只告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/1641fc44d6f8acfd840e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1641fc44d6f8acfd840e..text: 我们把旧故事拍完了，新的故事才刚开始。

assets/voice-lines/20b8030c6a400a942499..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/20b8030c6a400a942499..text: 那我就记住，你刚刚是怎么回答的。

assets/voice-lines/7f22acb5f24569428047..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7f22acb5f24569428047..text: 今天的好消息，是又可以和你一起吃饭。

assets/voice-lines/a9e8f2ad8ce8b14969db..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a9e8f2ad8ce8b14969db..text: 先把今天的烦恼放到门口，晚一点再说。

assets/voice-lines/bcbd4c45997438bfd56b..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/bcbd4c45997438bfd56b..text: 这件家具，刚刚多了一段属于我们的回忆。

assets/voice-lines/8cb6c3a02a49c634b6f0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/8cb6c3a02a49c634b6f0..text: 一起发现的小东西，也让今天变得不一样。

assets/voice-lines/08a6bf67e0872873e8a3..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/08a6bf67e0872873e8a3..text: 这个正好是我一直想留在家里的，谢谢你记得。

assets/voice-lines/1051c1b5554c02865427..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1051c1b5554c02865427..text: 谢谢你想着我。只是这一份，我可能还不太习惯。

assets/voice-lines/952d7fb1d8097992f85f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/952d7fb1d8097992f85f..text: 你挑的心意我收到了。一起放到家里吧。

assets/voice-lines/4a5a7047e7fe0471db63..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4a5a7047e7fe0471db63..text: “旧影像重见天日”。太像一则资料整理通知了。

assets/voice-lines/a04919712c862c68b33b..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a04919712c862c68b33b..text: 可它还是没有写到我最想记住的事。

assets/voice-lines/aba9481bdb318c14d2c9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/aba9481bdb318c14d2c9..text: “那天，我也走进了合照。”会不会太私人？

assets/voice-lines/b132e8a44d2ebc89aea3..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/b132e8a44d2ebc89aea3..text: 我习惯替别人留下名字。谢谢你那天回头叫我。

assets/voice-lines/b66262155cb201de47e9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/b66262155cb201de47e9..text: 本来想放进你的器材箱，结果发现自己一直攥着。

assets/voice-lines/f49e638fc74640e5928c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f49e638fc74640e5928c..text: 都不是。这次不打算用记者的口吻。

assets/voice-lines/dcaf7e59bdb5bc5561aa..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/dcaf7e59bdb5bc5561aa..text: 可以。只是有几句写得太认真，你别笑。

assets/voice-lines/519e0f9b5b15bc726e6d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/519e0f9b5b15bc726e6d..text: 我很期待你每次来找我。不是因为有新的选题。

assets/voice-lines/722fe1680c16adb38fc7..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/722fe1680c16adb38fc7..text: 明明已经交过终稿，还是想再改一个形容词。

assets/voice-lines/ed3d475457c6152b5f0d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ed3d475457c6152b5f0d..text: 也许不是。只是总担心还有一处没照顾好。

assets/voice-lines/3edadf161a98eb172359..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/3edadf161a98eb172359..text: 那要谈什么？我可能一时找不到话题。

assets/voice-lines/ecaa6bf4f06bacbf7616..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ecaa6bf4f06bacbf7616..text: 这个不用留到明天回答。我要一份热豆浆。

assets/voice-lines/64ea9b6dfe43153f6eb7..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/64ea9b6dfe43153f6eb7..text: 书签留在这里。困了就睡，下次我们继续。

assets/voice-lines/178b6ebcaf0033381d5e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/178b6ebcaf0033381d5e..text: 这算一条只给你看的注释，不能摘录给别人。

assets/voice-lines/5784abf66975adc9ba23..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/5784abf66975adc9ba23..text: 嗯，盖好了。稿子先放下，手也可以休息。

assets/voice-lines/321f3406259e8d03b298..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/321f3406259e8d03b298..text: 你比书里的故事近，我当然先看你。

assets/voice-lines/a364b0d319946343a681..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/a364b0d319946343a681..text: 书签已经夹好。这只手现在不用替我翻页。

assets/voice-lines/5fa9d2673310dab4e238..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/5fa9d2673310dab4e238..text: 被角也像一张书签，把我们轻轻留在今晚。

assets/voice-lines/60f6eaabe687e8f87e5a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/60f6eaabe687e8f87e5a..text: 你就在句子里，不用再凑过来确认啦。

assets/voice-lines/620e506da4103a76e4d0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/620e506da4103a76e4d0..text: 名字会写在纸上，温度就留在手心里。

assets/voice-lines/5c3b314545755f323be0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/5c3b314545755f323be0..text: 谢谢你。晚安后面的空白，我们一起睡过去。

assets/voice-lines/e239c837fbcf5e812508..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/e239c837fbcf5e812508..text: 近一点，我就不用把声音借给整间屋子。

assets/voice-lines/086927d8bf67823b60e5..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/086927d8bf67823b60e5..text: 原来你不说话的时候，也能让我安心。

assets/voice-lines/1a542ebb35392b0e75cb..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1a542ebb35392b0e75cb..text: 采访过很多人，只有这时会忘记问题。

assets/voice-lines/53f99a5c8e739eec239a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/53f99a5c8e739eec239a..text: 就让它留着。正文写不下的喜欢，放在这里。

assets/voice-lines/48ab22a77b4f0ed2835c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/48ab22a77b4f0ed2835c..text: 不过，这一张我想站在中间。旁边的位置留给你。

assets/voice-lines/9a6ae31ad52314776546..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9a6ae31ad52314776546..text: 相机已经关了。接下来，不用对观众说话。

assets/voice-lines/f39ebd9d65f535177427..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f39ebd9d65f535177427..text: 收到。镜头外的约定，我会比直播排期记得更清楚。

assets/voice-lines/37925558efda7e53b6c6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/37925558efda7e53b6c6..text: 镜头那边有很多人，但我知道，你一直在。

assets/voice-lines/1f23f30954808b551fbe..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1f23f30954808b551fbe..text: 这条街拍过很多次，今天却有点不一样。

assets/voice-lines/c38cdbc58c5fbdb28735..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c38cdbc58c5fbdb28735..text: 留言里有很多人，说看见了自己的日常。

assets/voice-lines/9054153e97f71d998b07..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9054153e97f71d998b07..text: 下播以后，还想和你一起看这段片子。

assets/voice-lines/1b5c3f88f4a894df2a8d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1b5c3f88f4a894df2a8d..text: 镜头关掉了。接下来的时间，留给我们。

assets/voice-lines/b1c1269f806cb4eb2b0b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/b1c1269f806cb4eb2b0b..text: 你先发现的这束光，我想一起看完。

assets/voice-lines/a2314c109e32b1986e4b..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/a2314c109e32b1986e4b..text: 这一项已经做到了，剩下的慢慢来。

assets/voice-lines/6a419e24f805bf4f273e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6a419e24f805bf4f273e..text: 不用拍下来，我也知道自己现在笑得很开心。

assets/voice-lines/d1b01e08ab78ea0310c6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d1b01e08ab78ea0310c6..text: 相机先放好了。欢迎回到我们的日常。

assets/voice-lines/0100cd5b0128965a9c2f..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0100cd5b0128965a9c2f..text: 这件家具，刚刚多了一段属于我们的回忆。

assets/voice-lines/0852e01d5a566da8ce08..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0852e01d5a566da8ce08..text: 一起发现的小东西，也让今天变得不一样。

assets/voice-lines/100d429d8292aebab35a..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/100d429d8292aebab35a..text: 这个正好是我一直想留在家里的，谢谢你记得。

assets/voice-lines/58bb11384c974e5769e0..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/58bb11384c974e5769e0..text: 谢谢你想着我。只是这一份，我可能还不太习惯。

assets/voice-lines/1e20720162392bcdd2fb..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1e20720162392bcdd2fb..text: 你挑的心意我收到了。一起放到家里吧。

assets/voice-lines/18932ae727be296366b6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/18932ae727be296366b6..text: 我忘记按录制了。那时只顾着帮你别麦克风。

assets/voice-lines/12fbfe8575892fd27824..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/12fbfe8575892fd27824..text: 挪一点就够。你看，我没有把每个位置都排满。

assets/voice-lines/af575ac9059ea033c032..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/af575ac9059ea033c032..text: 一起提吧。我想让今晚走得慢一点。

assets/voice-lines/c17f26726ffd02e9885a..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c17f26726ffd02e9885a..text: 那今晚的收尾，也不用总结今天过得好不好？

assets/voice-lines/f4e64d732bea69b1f02d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f4e64d732bea69b1f02d..text: 今天过得很好。这句话还是想告诉你。

assets/voice-lines/5cdf9055366a71046aaf..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/5cdf9055366a71046aaf..text: 好，那我带大家看看每天路过却没留意过的风景。

assets/voice-lines/9b351a110b1eb444beb6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9b351a110b1eb444beb6..text: 现在是不是舒服多了？今天的助播真的很可靠。

assets/voice-lines/60e4879d80d69756c77c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/60e4879d80d69756c77c..text: 谢谢你陪我到最后，下播后也想和你聊聊。

assets/voice-lines/ae0fe8788f03fcb896fb..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/ae0fe8788f03fcb896fb..text: 书签留在这里。困了就睡，下次我们继续。

assets/voice-lines/9904d08fc9259de72b36..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9904d08fc9259de72b36..text: 握住就好，今晚没有谁需要点一个关注。

assets/voice-lines/ccb81b614977ad0fb0b7..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/ccb81b614977ad0fb0b7..text: 谢谢你把被角拉好。这一句晚安，我只寄给你。

assets/voice-lines/34fb5b7815d1f94c26bf..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/34fb5b7815d1f94c26bf..text: 这比任何提示音都清楚，我接到了。

assets/voice-lines/a406885c5058d45f343e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/a406885c5058d45f343e..text: 靠近一点也很好，不是每个角度都需要拍照。

assets/voice-lines/4a7554e38ca9ab71929a..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/4a7554e38ca9ab71929a..text: 这只手我认得，今天也替我挡过太阳。

assets/voice-lines/485647e8649e273a4d45..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/485647e8649e273a4d45..text: 你这样看我，真的会让我忘记开场白。

assets/voice-lines/2f93e16aa8ad5f2d68b3..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/2f93e16aa8ad5f2d68b3..text: 你帮我整理的时候，我都不想看镜子。

assets/voice-lines/7a433b94149845acc86c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7a433b94149845acc86c..text: 空着也很好。这样第一首歌可以由我们来选。

assets/voice-lines/13ddb1a01bab2d9ba709..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/13ddb1a01bab2d9ba709..text: 大舞台等下次。这一次，只有一个听众也很好。

assets/voice-lines/64556692c3f5874844a1..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/64556692c3f5874844a1..text: 别把杂音全剪掉。那是我们确实在那里待过的证据。

assets/voice-lines/bab05526e31d67f124e4..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/bab05526e31d67f124e4..text: 这个名字太长了。不过，我喜欢里面有回家。

assets/voice-lines/aa9d37025091b27c8c4d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/aa9d37025091b27c8c4d..text: 今天最后一首歌，想唱给坐在这里的你。

assets/voice-lines/481c7981761fd5b7a750..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/481c7981761fd5b7a750..text: 说好了。我会给我们的日常留一段副歌。

assets/voice-lines/b486cb2f242085dd79c8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b486cb2f242085dd79c8..text: 这盏灯亮起的时候，刚好像一个休止符。

assets/voice-lines/a5a8477c5cf241abb481..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/a5a8477c5cf241abb481..text: 好了。有你听的版本，总会更完整。

assets/voice-lines/36bb701fee9cdf24fd10..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/36bb701fee9cdf24fd10..text: 成片里的背景音乐，还留了一小段空白。

assets/voice-lines/771650ea474deb7a34c5..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/771650ea474deb7a34c5..text: 想让你也留下一点声音，什么都可以。

assets/voice-lines/d08e8ec32cda0516e93b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/d08e8ec32cda0516e93b..text: 零碎的录音，慢慢拼成了熟悉的城市。

assets/voice-lines/f5f2f3a4db5bc86598e2..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f5f2f3a4db5bc86598e2..text: 下次录音，也请你坐在我看得到的位置。

assets/voice-lines/cbc6e3679eef164b567a..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/cbc6e3679eef164b567a..text: 以后就知道，散场以后我们还一起吃了这个。

assets/voice-lines/b41e0a52be4fa13440be..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b41e0a52be4fa13440be..text: 你回来的这一拍，比我练过的都好听。

assets/voice-lines/ca292466f1a298699468..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ca292466f1a298699468..text: 今天的合奏，从你进门的声音开始。

assets/voice-lines/682d51f48d1b8e7fedec..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/682d51f48d1b8e7fedec..text: 这件家具，刚刚多了一段属于我们的回忆。

assets/voice-lines/f4e70485a58ddafaf49a..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/f4e70485a58ddafaf49a..text: 一起发现的小东西，也让今天变得不一样。

assets/voice-lines/d67d7c7280e7ce7f78ce..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/d67d7c7280e7ce7f78ce..text: 这个正好是我一直想留在家里的，谢谢你记得。

assets/voice-lines/dadafeeea8fff7bef8f0..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/dadafeeea8fff7bef8f0..text: 谢谢你想着我。只是这一份，我可能还不太习惯。

assets/voice-lines/3885b709bb7b8e7c1d03..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/3885b709bb7b8e7c1d03..text: 你挑的心意我收到了。一起放到家里吧。

assets/voice-lines/5b7862f22d4ba18ab724..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/5b7862f22d4ba18ab724..text: 这里留着吧。那天你在等我吸一口气。

assets/voice-lines/77a652657ba80af7c165..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/77a652657ba80af7c165..text: 就是这个意思！比节拍器更难写进谱子。

assets/voice-lines/c1f520f1fe29e6b30cfb..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c1f520f1fe29e6b30cfb..text: 还有一段没唱。台下只剩你，可以算返场吗？

assets/voice-lines/9d5b37a4fcf47191dcc8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/9d5b37a4fcf47191dcc8..text: 下次没有演出的时候，也想这样叫你留下来。

assets/voice-lines/c2b831242321fa986aae..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c2b831242321fa986aae..text: 节目的规定是，理由可以比歌短，也可以没有。

assets/voice-lines/7f480c9cf0258e31246f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7f480c9cf0258e31246f..text: 可那天你睡着了，根本没听见我唱完。

assets/voice-lines/bb81942e428694807739..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/bb81942e428694807739..text: 那我改一下节目单。不是补课，是现场点歌。

assets/voice-lines/0c529d946f8f3aea7d4f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/0c529d946f8f3aea7d4f..text: 不知道哪里碰到麦克风了。偏偏是在最安静的地方。

assets/voice-lines/999f98016788079d8df7..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/999f98016788079d8df7..text: 看见你在玻璃外举着热茶。杯子还挡住了半张脸。

assets/voice-lines/9394ec8e4bf9fcce5849..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/9394ec8e4bf9fcce5849..text: 不是问题。我只是忽然不想把这段删掉了。

assets/voice-lines/ce9c7b250265722e84b7..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ce9c7b250265722e84b7..text: 零点以后。等下次你晚归，就放给你听。

assets/voice-lines/1b9bc44bd746a8fdf6dc..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/1b9bc44bd746a8fdf6dc..text: 书签留在这里。困了就睡，下次我们继续。

assets/voice-lines/b266ca6b74e655412971..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b266ca6b74e655412971..text: 嗯？靠这么近，连没唱出口的旋律都被你听见了吧。

assets/voice-lines/2f2fc68582bf6a8f4885..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2f2fc68582bf6a8f4885..text: 你不用跟拍，我会慢慢跟上你的呼吸。

assets/voice-lines/33814ccb32cdb0fcd5df..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/33814ccb32cdb0fcd5df..text: 被子像一个小舞台，现在只留我们两个的位置。

assets/voice-lines/51b6a8f002e0c0031c9e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/51b6a8f002e0c0031c9e..text: 不用耳机也听得见，我现在只跟你说话。

assets/voice-lines/7640d97adc84287cb3a1..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7640d97adc84287cb3a1..text: 你把手给我，耳机线就不会再绕成一团了。

assets/voice-lines/9e05ecdca582fe9f31fb..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/9e05ecdca582fe9f31fb..text: 你看，我把散场以后最好的一点精神都留给你了。

assets/voice-lines/b9dd8a67f5a0f930e28e..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b9dd8a67f5a0f930e28e..text: 不鼓掌也没关系，握住这一下我就听到了。

assets/voice-lines/2a6463e1257045c5997a..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2a6463e1257045c5997a..text: 盖好了，今晚的最后一个音也可以轻轻落下。

assets/voice-lines/d2aac05ddcacac13b837..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/d2aac05ddcacac13b837..text: 我想把所有副歌，都唱得像这一刻。

assets/voice-lines/658879ecb69461dedd4b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/658879ecb69461dedd4b..text: 先看看光从哪里进来。尺寸可以改，想留下什么更重要。

assets/voice-lines/6a465606ce85c5c75be1..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/6a465606ce85c5c75be1..text: 这些不是待办，是我要记住的生活。你的邀请，也在这里。

assets/voice-lines/c35829b843efe753c69e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/c35829b843efe753c69e..text: 是不是和平时不一样？有些计划之外的样子，也想慢慢让你认识。

assets/voice-lines/47168b19da581522d8e2..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/47168b19da581522d8e2..text: 耳边的珠子会碰到你的手。靠近时慢一点，我没有要躲。

assets/voice-lines/d2cabdaa3b33e44c8a3a..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d2cabdaa3b33e44c8a3a..text: 裙摆长一点也没关系。你愿意放慢脚步，我就不用赶着走。

assets/voice-lines/e03422d5cd4234c35a4b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/e03422d5cd4234c35a4b..text: 需要带走的其实不多。知道彼此喜欢什么，就可以再搭一次。

assets/voice-lines/0699a91a0504b1e84b44..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/0699a91a0504b1e84b44..text: 旧方案只有一个人的座位。那时候我以为，能独自坐下来就够了。

assets/voice-lines/7959a3a6f5583519df0d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/7959a3a6f5583519df0d..text: 试着放一个你觉得合适的位置吧。不用完全听设计师的。

assets/voice-lines/8163f661f2347c913efa..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8163f661f2347c913efa..text: 原来给另一个人留位置，不一定意味着打乱所有安排。

assets/voice-lines/d5f5235009757fc4fe8d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/d5f5235009757fc4fe8d..text: 我检查过很多遍结构，却一直没有认真站在这里看过落日。

assets/voice-lines/ceac0f2731947247635f..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ceac0f2731947247635f..text: 绕过修鞋铺、夜粥摊，还有一扇每天只开两小时的旧书窗。

assets/voice-lines/74f6f5bc7eb540b7a01b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/74f6f5bc7eb540b7a01b..text: 方案还没定。我得先证明，走得慢的人也需要一条路。

assets/voice-lines/33a43286b3be48ddc8ff..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/33a43286b3be48ddc8ff..text: 小时候我以为，城市只要画得整齐，就会让所有人住得舒服。

assets/voice-lines/3fd50d80bf96470bbdef..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/3fd50d80bf96470bbdef..text: 后来发现，同一扇窗，有人想看日出，有人只想少听一点车声。

assets/voice-lines/c2807b2d33dbb657df40..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/c2807b2d33dbb657df40..text: 我记住了。他讲了二十分钟，但最想说的只有这一句。

assets/voice-lines/9c99ae3259890d7bd8a4..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/9c99ae3259890d7bd8a4..text: 这一篇听完了。故事已经珍藏在夜话里，接下来就安心休息吧。

assets/voice-lines/c48cfb32b7f1dcc015bc..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/c48cfb32b7f1dcc015bc..text: 计时开始了。你可以慢慢睡，到了时间再来珍藏这段陪伴。

assets/voice-lines/aec851ee441f66201016..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/aec851ee441f66201016..text: 时间已经记下来了。今晚不用为了完成目标而勉强自己。

assets/voice-lines/1841b7c79b4d504e016e..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/1841b7c79b4d504e016e..text: 嗯，再往你那边留一点。不用客气，我们一起住在今晚。

assets/voice-lines/1b6d857a586705f42de1..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1b6d857a586705f42de1..text: 一点点酸，会让甜味停得更久。生日也不必每一秒都大笑。

assets/voice-lines/0a240b18f60aacab2871..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0a240b18f60aacab2871..text: 有缺口的这只拿来放花。喝茶的杯子，再选两只结实的。

assets/voice-lines/507c2b94c0423c69cd33..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/507c2b94c0423c69cd33..text: 我喜欢做这些。只是做完以后，也想有人提醒我坐下来吃一口。

assets/voice-lines/b87d707165901f5a2b64..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/b87d707165901f5a2b64..text: 这样吧，第一口一起尝。谁也不用一直做照顾别人的那个。

assets/voice-lines/63a406582d640fd6ec4c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/63a406582d640fd6ec4c..text: 不是蛋糕装饰，是裙子上的小蝴蝶结。你要是喜欢，我再转给你看。

assets/voice-lines/3ced61e1618f5b308582..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/3ced61e1618f5b308582..text: 珍珠发夹还在。只是你靠近的时候，我总忍不住先笑出来。

assets/voice-lines/f8154de621a72c31c2e9..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/f8154de621a72c31c2e9..text: 手上没有面粉了。现在可以牵得久一点，不用急着放开。

assets/voice-lines/aca44cf5b785b5cc1ce6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/aca44cf5b785b5cc1ce6..text: 项目里的片段已经给客人看过了。现在这一份，想只给你。

assets/voice-lines/d7ff8f280e29b30534ab..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/d7ff8f280e29b30534ab..text: 猜对一半。两块都少糖，只是想让你尝尝不同的香味。

assets/voice-lines/0ccebef27557095399d6..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/0ccebef27557095399d6..text: 本来想留给明早试配方，可它现在正好是最好喝的温度。

assets/voice-lines/1c2f8b2150e9e574494d..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/1c2f8b2150e9e574494d..text: 你说得轻巧，重新煮还要挑花、洗锅、等它慢慢变稠。

assets/voice-lines/c3e0d78e1b58158824d0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c3e0d78e1b58158824d0..text: 这一篇听完了。故事已经珍藏在夜话里，接下来就安心休息吧。

assets/voice-lines/e06de22950a966d64e3a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/e06de22950a966d64e3a..text: 计时开始了。你可以慢慢睡，到了时间再来珍藏这段陪伴。

assets/voice-lines/472d453c34330f596e73..speaker: jiang-yue
