assets/voice-lines/472d453c34330f596e73..text: 时间已经记下来了。今晚不用为了完成目标而勉强自己。

assets/voice-lines/064c73292c3a8a6af98a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/064c73292c3a8a6af98a..text: 也许只是比别的花晚一点。我们给它留个位置，好吗？

assets/voice-lines/7c604450a289808c9316..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/7c604450a289808c9316..text: 那天没有什么特别的事。只是一个人绕温室走了很久。

assets/voice-lines/c75019a1690c97cf2b51..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c75019a1690c97cf2b51..text: 不用为了赶一个日子，就把期待变成任务。你肯等，我已经很开心。

assets/voice-lines/921780511a98d2750648..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/921780511a98d2750648..text: 不用等庆祝才穿。和你见面的日子，也值得认真选一束花。

assets/voice-lines/c2010f85a304bb6f2829..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c2010f85a304bb6f2829..text: 花夹没有歪，只是被你碰过的地方，有点舍不得重新整理了。

assets/voice-lines/c3ceb94465490d8ff5d8..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/c3ceb94465490d8ff5d8..text: 白纱怕被枝叶勾住。不过握着你，我就知道该往哪边走。

assets/voice-lines/be100ad92775456a3754..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/be100ad92775456a3754..text: 原来，植物的成长和喜欢一个人一样，都会悄悄留下痕迹。

assets/voice-lines/44d2604bf4c1cb6fcaad..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/44d2604bf4c1cb6fcaad..text: 这是刚认识你时写的。那时候你每天路过这里，我却总说自己很忙。

assets/voice-lines/39bc702d6b3358ac8135..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/39bc702d6b3358ac8135..text: 嗯。想请你来看看那棵迟迟不开花的树，又怕听起来像工作。

assets/voice-lines/3aa4779667cedd3750b2..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3aa4779667cedd3750b2..text: 这次不是拍摄邀请。明天放映结束以后，想和你一起散步。

assets/voice-lines/3752126fcb5dd07da27c..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3752126fcb5dd07da27c..text: 不是树开花的那一刻。是你没有催我，坐在旁边陪我等的时候。

assets/voice-lines/8241e14e0e32ab01f2a4..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/8241e14e0e32ab01f2a4..text: 我以前总觉得，必须有一个结果，才值得邀请别人来看。

assets/voice-lines/366555b5ef068ffd7a92..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/366555b5ef068ffd7a92..text: 那就一起写吧。以后翻到这里，别只记得我说过的话。

assets/voice-lines/881986af5c9e91dad237..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/881986af5c9e91dad237..text: 花圃里最后一株小苗没有送出去。我想带它去新的温室。

assets/voice-lines/10ee4a27bd8f55dd1cdc..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/10ee4a27bd8f55dd1cdc..text: 够一小段路。根外面包了湿苔藓，到了地方还要慢慢换盆。

assets/voice-lines/e6fdc82cd2ce822c31be..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/e6fdc82cd2ce822c31be..text: 那一站我在想事情。想新温室门口，要不要摆一把给你坐的椅子。

assets/voice-lines/6af0a57ac7efcde06144..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/6af0a57ac7efcde06144..text: 这一篇听完了。故事已经珍藏在夜话里，接下来就安心休息吧。

assets/voice-lines/78e17616a90d43519d49..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/78e17616a90d43519d49..text: 计时开始了。你可以慢慢睡，到了时间再来珍藏这段陪伴。

assets/voice-lines/02bd7e3d2766ea7338c6..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/02bd7e3d2766ea7338c6..text: 时间已经记下来了。今晚不用为了完成目标而勉强自己。

assets/voice-lines/cf95f523abae3cd7ef1b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cf95f523abae3cd7ef1b..text: 你关上最后一串灯的开关，林栀推门走进亲手布置的房间。

assets/voice-lines/39e551aaec9751066bb4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/39e551aaec9751066bb4..text: 你关上最后一串灯的开关，顾清禾推门走进亲手布置的房间。

assets/voice-lines/1dc2d1721663393f3398..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1dc2d1721663393f3398..text: 你关上最后一串灯的开关，许知夏推门走进亲手布置的房间。

assets/voice-lines/e97b2d0830fee91e5f1a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e97b2d0830fee91e5f1a..text: 你关上最后一串灯的开关，苏晚推门走进亲手布置的房间。

assets/voice-lines/367ea7b335f464161e43..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/367ea7b335f464161e43..text: 你重新调了比例。她说等庆祝结束，还想和你喝一杯不加糖的茶。

assets/voice-lines/b551edd7d513e95ad0d9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b551edd7d513e95ad0d9..text: 你关上最后一串灯的开关，江月推门走进亲手布置的房间。

assets/voice-lines/02a5f155b31fc83fee84..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/02a5f155b31fc83fee84..text: 你关上最后一串灯的开关，唐梨推门走进亲手布置的房间。

assets/voice-lines/a06eab31035d8029d309..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a06eab31035d8029d309..text: 你们绕回刚才的街角，发现同一阵风已经有了不同的温度。

assets/voice-lines/00ec2236047ca172c591..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/00ec2236047ca172c591..text: 向导递来一台奶油色相机。有些瞬间不用摆姿势，也值得留下。

assets/voice-lines/6430b89994604d8d5cb8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6430b89994604d8d5cb8..text: 租赁点的阿姨递来车钥匙。不赶时间的话，就沿着有花的路走吧。

assets/voice-lines/f367e202a28f1e681004..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f367e202a28f1e681004..text: 顾清禾关掉了绘图屏幕，把你们的成片投在钟楼的旧墙上。

assets/voice-lines/4ae8455ecb9546e7b40a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4ae8455ecb9546e7b40a..text: 许知夏把最后一条录音拖进工程，城市的喧闹变成了温柔的伴奏。

assets/voice-lines/468911fa4abd8c9e4b95..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/468911fa4abd8c9e4b95..text: 苏晚把报道的打印稿叠好，书店只剩下你们和一盏暖灯。

assets/voice-lines/c5eb08a944c4a933c64a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c5eb08a944c4a933c64a..text: 江月把店里的灯调暗，给你端来今天第一块试做的蛋糕。

assets/voice-lines/8685c839f5ba6dca4c5b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8685c839f5ba6dca4c5b..text: 烤箱停止作响。你们一起洗好盘子，留了一块蛋糕，约好明天也来。

assets/voice-lines/d4cf96be2df1fcd45ac5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d4cf96be2df1fcd45ac5..text: 唐梨关掉直播提示灯，电脑里还停着你们剪好的最后一帧。

assets/voice-lines/6e55e7eadb249c24df55..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6e55e7eadb249c24df55..text: 你把新配的钥匙放在玄关，她用一枚叶脉书签给它做了记号。

assets/voice-lines/8b9774d8aa21825d0a44..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8b9774d8aa21825d0a44..text: “以后就不会拿错了。”她说完，又把记号转向你看得见的那一面。

assets/voice-lines/97702fec49fecbf5f38b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/97702fec49fecbf5f38b..text: “现在这里也有我很喜欢的东西。”她看着你，笑得有点慢。

assets/voice-lines/66c3f50daa392e5325da..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/66c3f50daa392e5325da..text: 你把钥匙收进口袋，第一次觉得，回家是一件可以提前期待的事。

assets/voice-lines/0d18d3474347989d4928..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0d18d3474347989d4928..text: 窗边新来的小绿植没有标签，她问你要不要替它取一个名字。

assets/voice-lines/70735703718976238f1e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/70735703718976238f1e..text: 你认真想了半天，最后说就叫“明天”，因为每天都会长一点。

assets/voice-lines/18c76584a59796c891c4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/18c76584a59796c891c4..text: “如果有一天它长得慢，也不可以嫌弃明天。”她补充。

assets/voice-lines/95d2dc573c3e14240bb6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/95d2dc573c3e14240bb6..text: 你和她一起把小牌插进土里，约好只记录新叶，不催它长大。

assets/voice-lines/ff987698be47b8d59e1e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ff987698be47b8d59e1e..text: 傍晚的风翻动窗帘，你们给这间小屋添了一条很温柔的家规。

assets/voice-lines/3545fd421c92e7b7fa54..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3545fd421c92e7b7fa54..text: 你端着两杯茶坐下，问空白里能不能放进一场旧电影。

assets/voice-lines/658bd120b55c022ddcd4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/658bd120b55c022ddcd4..text: “可以。看到一半睡着也可以。”她把靠垫推到你身边。

assets/voice-lines/d8e4cb08219abcbe441f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d8e4cb08219abcbe441f..text: 电影还没放到片名，你们却先聊起各自小时候的院子。

assets/voice-lines/2498d61922f90243ca01..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2498d61922f90243ca01..text: 你握住她的手，说我们也会记得今天这块没有安排的下午。

assets/voice-lines/f38ab9adfca2493c68c2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f38ab9adfca2493c68c2..text: 一场骤雨让整条街停了电，你在抽屉里翻找备用手电。

assets/voice-lines/69331394828418c10d47..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/69331394828418c10d47..text: “不用把每个房间都照亮。”她把灯往你这里挪了一点。

assets/voice-lines/4df1812db854a1785040..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4df1812db854a1785040..text: 你们一人说一件今天的小事，直到窗外重新亮起街灯。

assets/voice-lines/b1bb5838a82a5d8acc95..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b1bb5838a82a5d8acc95..text: 她没有马上关掉台灯，轻轻说，再让我们的岛多留一会儿吧。

assets/voice-lines/15f4e7c98935c9d7ac14..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/15f4e7c98935c9d7ac14..text: 用了很多年的花盆裂了一条细缝，她抱着它站在阳台发愁。

assets/voice-lines/39a3411201cdb57ca018..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/39a3411201cdb57ca018..text: 她把洗净的花盆放到书桌，第一枚放进去的正是叶脉书签。

assets/voice-lines/baf54b4aa8dbdbda7334..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/baf54b4aa8dbdbda7334..text: “有些东西不用一直做原来的工作。”她摸了摸那条裂纹。

assets/voice-lines/5b56ab3ce27495d092f5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5b56ab3ce27495d092f5..text: 两个差点被丢掉的东西，在你们的小屋里又找到了位置。

assets/voice-lines/9e603346b4ec70fd9207..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9e603346b4ec70fd9207..text: 你问空白是不是留给明年的，她说也可以留给很久以后。

assets/voice-lines/f8c98621d6b7a5b34c3d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f8c98621d6b7a5b34c3d..text: “无论明年在哪儿，先把回家的路记住。”她轻轻合上相册。

assets/voice-lines/0d5f7b1ba93ea443aa53..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0d5f7b1ba93ea443aa53..text: 你们没有再做宏大的约定，只一起给窗边的植物浇了水。

assets/voice-lines/1aac39b155ce11172583..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1aac39b155ce11172583..text: 你穿好走进客厅，发现茶几下也留出了你常放相机包的位置。

assets/voice-lines/0829f954d91a47b95b3d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0829f954d91a47b95b3d..text: “这里本来就有余量。”她拿起图纸，耳尖微微泛红。

assets/voice-lines/456333c33fbdd5f9b529..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/456333c33fbdd5f9b529..text: 房间的设计图上，从这天起，多了一条只有你们懂的动线。

assets/voice-lines/d70e4c430dc23e1b2663..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d70e4c430dc23e1b2663..text: 她把图纸上的隔板擦掉，说留出一点肩膀相碰的空间也好。

assets/voice-lines/d2550060e75401f17506..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d2550060e75401f17506..text: 你们在未到货的书桌位置坐了一会儿，先试用了未来的下午。

assets/voice-lines/482da90583c29b0b2946..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/482da90583c29b0b2946..text: 你想把首映合照挂上墙，又怕破坏她细心选好的墙面。

assets/voice-lines/6f1a95e5a53f5234f7a5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6f1a95e5a53f5234f7a5..text: 第一颗钉子歪了，你们退后看了半天，忍不住一起笑。

assets/voice-lines/8c2da84e0321533a5187..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8c2da84e0321533a5187..text: “现在我一看就知道，是我们挂的。”她轻轻按平照片。

assets/voice-lines/c1c0bda580c9e67bf25e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c1c0bda580c9e67bf25e..text: 那面墙终于不再像展示样板，开始有了两个人生活的痕迹。

assets/voice-lines/7504112b43b87ce32449..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7504112b43b87ce32449..text: 窗户边缘起了薄薄一层雾，她用指尖画出一个小房子的轮廓。

assets/voice-lines/56963674c05bdbc5a5d5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/56963674c05bdbc5a5d5..text: “这里没有壁炉。”她提醒，却又补上一扇明亮的窗。

assets/voice-lines/a149b4cf47b74f87488c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a149b4cf47b74f87488c..text: 你没有立刻替她想办法，只把书桌上的杂物收向一边。

assets/voice-lines/624bf7fcbd126fc9f52a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/624bf7fcbd126fc9f52a..text: “原来计划里，也可以写暂停。”她终于放下那支笔。

assets/voice-lines/d77fb201ca8d17febf98..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d77fb201ca8d17febf98..text: 片尾亮起时，她把图纸放进抽屉，决定明天再给它新的空间。

assets/voice-lines/a32554e80daf75bc5178..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a32554e80daf75bc5178..text: 你们整理旧图纸，发现最早那版房间还没有并排的书桌。

assets/voice-lines/f3751d3f5cfbf1c811c9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f3751d3f5cfbf1c811c9..text: 她把新旧两张叠起来，窗的位置没变，生活却多了很多线条。

assets/voice-lines/08ba308fe0c94a6a2252..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/08ba308fe0c94a6a2252..text: 你替她卷好图纸，明白她说的家，已经不只是一处地址。

assets/voice-lines/5609f18ee2fb12a6ad2d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5609f18ee2fb12a6ad2d..text: 她在客厅试新唱片，看见你回来便摘下一边耳机递过来。

assets/voice-lines/89d613e5de2b297e695b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/89d613e5de2b297e695b..text: 你问这样会不会听不清，她却说正好能听见你哼错的那句。

assets/voice-lines/bd3524684ae27040677e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bd3524684ae27040677e..text: “这一版不错，只在家里发行。”她按下暂停，认真宣布。

assets/voice-lines/e173ac8c43427ed06a9c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e173ac8c43427ed06a9c..text: 窗外车声来来去去，你们给小屋录下了第一首不完整的歌。

assets/voice-lines/4d443f15f85fcbc8eab5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4d443f15f85fcbc8eab5..text: “每个节拍都在告诉我，你在这里。”她轻轻靠过来。

assets/voice-lines/d0fa0643c575f436053e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d0fa0643c575f436053e..text: 你把手机扣在茶几，决定让这首没有名字的合奏继续久一点。

assets/voice-lines/51dfdcf34cf45827c0fe..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/51dfdcf34cf45827c0fe..text: 她把落地灯转向墙面，宣布今晚的演出只有一位观众。

assets/voice-lines/695d75bec42a9ec6348b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/695d75bec42a9ec6348b..text: 你用两个靠垫给自己搭了贵宾席，鼓掌鼓得格外认真。

assets/voice-lines/7d55852d4074456ecca4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7d55852d4074456ecca4..text: 你唱出了完全不同的调子，她索性顺着你重新编了一段。

assets/voice-lines/ffe63ae636ec3dc05ea7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ffe63ae636ec3dc05ea7..text: “今晚这首，以后再也演不出来了。”她笑着放下琴。

assets/voice-lines/e041530a75ce80ae4faf..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e041530a75ce80ae4faf..text: 临近零点，她问要不要把没完成的事写下来，明天再继续。

assets/voice-lines/6b5b0402c6098fbafca2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6b5b0402c6098fbafca2..text: 你们把两张便笺贴在冰箱，旁边是一张上周忘买牛奶的旧纸。

assets/voice-lines/13140c3f42fd5e8cf72b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/13140c3f42fd5e8cf72b..text: 你划掉那条苛刻的期限，在下方补了一句明天一起吃早餐。

assets/voice-lines/a4f82e914264f2e5c64e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a4f82e914264f2e5c64e..text: 午夜没有响起庆祝的音乐，小屋里只有很轻的一声好。

assets/voice-lines/1de5aac4fd76f7ee3357..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1de5aac4fd76f7ee3357..text: “也许以后会修好。今天先让我再认出它一次。”她说。

assets/voice-lines/1fb84a4fb7c77b9cbcc4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1fb84a4fb7c77b9cbcc4..text: 你们等到那个缺失的半拍，一起在空白里轻轻敲了两下。

assets/voice-lines/e06933552ee6e711fb8f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e06933552ee6e711fb8f..text: 从此那处小划痕不再只是损坏，也成了你们共同的节奏。

assets/voice-lines/d0c98e0bf1329c00e91e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d0c98e0bf1329c00e91e..text: 她把你们在客厅录过的零碎声音做成一段很短的音乐。

assets/voice-lines/5987d2b5e9f666eeea61..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5987d2b5e9f666eeea61..text: 开头是钥匙声，中间夹着水壶响，还有一句你以为没录到的晚安。

assets/voice-lines/8ae16373c0874712d146..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8ae16373c0874712d146..text: “因为这首想留的，是可以一直返场的日常。”她把文件保存。

assets/voice-lines/a8486996be02fee0512f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a8486996be02fee0512f..text: 你给它取名“明天见”，她在旁边加了一个小小的音符。

assets/voice-lines/b8bc613171a78befefef..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b8bc613171a78befefef..text: 音乐结束以后，你们依然坐在一起，下一段已经悄悄开始。

assets/voice-lines/62c4468bc1a52a77f851..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/62c4468bc1a52a77f851..text: 你说这是采访的第一个问题吗，她立刻举起双手表示下班。

assets/voice-lines/c1364203f76fb4507467..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c1364203f76fb4507467..text: 你们在冰箱前讨论了十分钟，最后决定一起煮一锅面。

assets/voice-lines/a6f71488b19eff764c0c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a6f71488b19eff764c0c..text: 面条有点软，她却认真说，这是今晚最值得记录的口感。

assets/voice-lines/31d9e3c0af261815982d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/31d9e3c0af261815982d..text: “那就当私人日记。”她接过碗，只写给坐在对面的你。

assets/voice-lines/93cb512e69d31f87bd1c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/93cb512e69d31f87bd1c..text: 那是你们第一次一起去采访的路线，车票已经褪了色。

assets/voice-lines/5f05465473ac69c08fa4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5f05465473ac69c08fa4..text: 你还记得那天车晚点，她记得你把最后一块饼干分给她。

assets/voice-lines/e6fbb950d3325e90054f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e6fbb950d3325e90054f..text: 同一天被两个人记成了不同的细节，放在一起才完整。

assets/voice-lines/3cb9073664e5caaa35b9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3cb9073664e5caaa35b9..text: 小屋的书柜开始有了两层目录，一层是书名，一层是你们。

assets/voice-lines/713d08520c3ee8e4e258..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/713d08520c3ee8e4e258..text: 她递给你一本新日记，说不需要每天写，也不需要写得好看。

assets/voice-lines/c56e0bac071b01c5a3cb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c56e0bac071b01c5a3cb..text: “以后想起什么，再回来补一句。”你们把日记放在触手可及的地方。

assets/voice-lines/14ab787ab0a2f6e729f1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/14ab787ab0a2f6e729f1..text: 出门前突然下起大雨，原定的散步计划只好临时取消。

assets/voice-lines/452ab0c19eb87b9d3542..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/452ab0c19eb87b9d3542..text: 她没有急着把地图收起，还给星星旁边加了你们的名字。

assets/voice-lines/1feb8168a45921ea9bbb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1feb8168a45921ea9bbb..text: 这场只走了几步的旅行，后来成了小屋里最常被提起的一次。

assets/voice-lines/8e068860b8f692af0e47..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8e068860b8f692af0e47..text: 她带回一个没能核实的疑问，坐在窗边很久没有开口。

assets/voice-lines/7cf3a937ee806fe07e85..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7cf3a937ee806fe07e85..text: 你把灯调暗一点，问她愿不愿意先听一件毫无道理的小事。

assets/voice-lines/645f853467a4a129988c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/645f853467a4a129988c..text: 你说阳台的叶子今天正好长成一颗心，她跟着你去看。

assets/voice-lines/a2496f31605ec5e6a9af..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a2496f31605ec5e6a9af..text: “看来有些事情，可以明天再求证。”她终于舒展开眉头。

assets/voice-lines/6d9542acc5ee8587a391..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6d9542acc5ee8587a391..text: 你们没有解决全部问题，却一起找到了一块可以休息的地方。

assets/voice-lines/9d6de547fff3534a1acf..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9d6de547fff3534a1acf..text: 她问如果给这几年的小屋生活写个标题，你会选什么。

assets/voice-lines/40cecf15b1d6bbe02102..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/40cecf15b1d6bbe02102..text: 你想了很多响亮的名字，最后只写下了“回家以后”。

assets/voice-lines/a5f61589197606e2c222..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a5f61589197606e2c222..text: “这四个字后面，可以接很多没有写完的句子。”她说。

assets/voice-lines/2e4390b60eab246425ec..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2e4390b60eab246425ec..text: 你在下面补上：我们一起慢慢写。她轻轻握住你的手。

assets/voice-lines/bf3492eefc02414a9c5a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bf3492eefc02414a9c5a..text: 这一次，没有采访、没有截稿时间，也不需要给谁一个完整结论。

assets/voice-lines/fe2bacbd181d536c537c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fe2bacbd181d536c537c..text: 一只是她用了很久的旧碗，另一只是照着你的手掌大小新挑的。

assets/voice-lines/b9bae52784503ed7cc9c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b9bae52784503ed7cc9c..text: “合适比一样重要呀。”她把勺子朝向你习惯的那一侧。

assets/voice-lines/9870499806d3b37da439..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9870499806d3b37da439..text: 她端出新试做的点心，一排里面有一块明显歪了一点。

assets/voice-lines/45bc3e3bebcb5674087b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/45bc3e3bebcb5674087b..text: 她低头看了看自己的手，终于没有再把那块藏到盘子后面。

assets/voice-lines/9ec6275f32e52e30a5f2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9ec6275f32e52e30a5f2..text: “那下一次，我也给自己留一块。”她把烤箱计时器关掉。

assets/voice-lines/c5163a83f0e20db76755..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c5163a83f0e20db76755..text: 你们边吃边讨论下一次的口味，没有人再计算够不够完美。

assets/voice-lines/893f5397219b44cb6a28..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/893f5397219b44cb6a28..text: 她在冰箱上贴了一张新的采购单，给你留出半张空白。

assets/voice-lines/88b2668a8ca637d4b60a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/88b2668a8ca637d4b60a..text: 你写上她总忘记给自己买的草莓，她写上你偏爱的那种酸奶。

assets/voice-lines/49a8d803bcfa21c543f8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/49a8d803bcfa21c543f8..text: 两张便笺最后合成一张，你们都没把自己的那项划掉。

assets/voice-lines/bb0ffddb52a661a265bd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bb0ffddb52a661a265bd..text: “原来一起过日子，也要记得照顾写单子的人。”她笑着说。

assets/voice-lines/da56230befa4383f5bd8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/da56230befa4383f5bd8..text: 第二天拎回的袋子有点重，但谁也不觉得多了一份麻烦。

assets/voice-lines/1dd74ee87d4f58f41c22..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1dd74ee87d4f58f41c22..text: “今天暂停营业，也算认真过好一天吧？”她轻声问。

assets/voice-lines/9d4810f75a809457eac1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9d4810f75a809457eac1..text: 你替她把靠垫放好，让那张没完成的配方安心留到明天。

assets/voice-lines/befc9ceab5128298f2a8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/befc9ceab5128298f2a8..text: 你们把熟悉的蛋糕配方重新抄了一遍，糖量那栏被改了好几次。

assets/voice-lines/a40b0a22a4cf700633ba..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a40b0a22a4cf700633ba..text: 她问你会不会失去原来的味道，你提议先做一个小小的版本。

assets/voice-lines/dfe6275d207504b407b1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/dfe6275d207504b407b1..text: 试吃时没有客人评分，只有你们分别说自己喜欢哪一口。

assets/voice-lines/458d224d60295cbb5256..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/458d224d60295cbb5256..text: 最后的数字不在任何标准配方里，却正好适合两个人。

assets/voice-lines/d33de69c1f80a842f3d5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d33de69c1f80a842f3d5..text: 你把纸收好，知道这份限定不需要卖出很多份，也值得留下。

assets/voice-lines/ed1d9b78030e61ee87af..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ed1d9b78030e61ee87af..text: 你们回想在这里吃过的早餐、做坏的点心和临时改写的计划。

assets/voice-lines/12bdd6b0ea2c194f8432..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/12bdd6b0ea2c194f8432..text: “再用一阵吧。我还想在这里试很多次新配方。”她说。

assets/voice-lines/33164b8ee636a054c111..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/33164b8ee636a054c111..text: 你答应负责第一位试吃员，也负责把不完美的一块留给她。

assets/voice-lines/71054bedd80a21ca909d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/71054bedd80a21ca909d..text: 晚饭的热气升起来，小屋又多了一天会被记住的味道。

assets/voice-lines/a5c9198e1343c0a31f35..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a5c9198e1343c0a31f35..text: 你问今天不拍素材吗，她说有一块角落想先留给生活。

assets/voice-lines/60e660a78608c51cf7cc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/60e660a78608c51cf7cc..text: “原来不用想画面，也能坐得这么舒服。”她轻轻叹了一口气。

assets/voice-lines/c017049d2a7991f512de..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c017049d2a7991f512de..text: 那天没有上传任何作品，你却记得每一次窗帘被风吹起的样子。

assets/voice-lines/949a8482654eddd16e34..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/949a8482654eddd16e34..text: 只有你们知道，这张不够清晰的照片，留下了最确定的回答。

assets/voice-lines/bb7e01f80165d70796ec..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bb7e01f80165d70796ec..text: 晚饭前，她把手机的提示音关掉，放进玄关的小篮子。

assets/voice-lines/ff84d406d73e69770bac..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ff84d406d73e69770bac..text: 你们原以为会没话说，却从一根歪掉的面条聊到小时候的旅行。

assets/voice-lines/98a8e1bc6f36b5bffe88..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/98a8e1bc6f36b5bffe88..text: 小篮子里的手机安静了一整晚，谁也没觉得错过了重要的东西。

assets/voice-lines/c6f6a728c564d19ae97c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c6f6a728c564d19ae97c..text: “如果拍下来，别人看到的只是一张很普通的地板。”她说。

assets/voice-lines/1b0097a13ea035608d90..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1b0097a13ea035608d90..text: 你回答那就让我们看完整个早晨，慢慢记住它怎么走过去。

assets/voice-lines/24935f6953c9a0f23d15..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/24935f6953c9a0f23d15..text: 直到阳光移开，你们才一起去做早餐，没有给这个清晨加任何滤镜。

assets/voice-lines/88db38b35b0c364ed0a0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/88db38b35b0c364ed0a0..text: 她想删掉，你说先听完，也许这是最准确的家庭录像。

assets/voice-lines/0085dee2e4c28166d5de..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0085dee2e4c28166d5de..text: 她默默给文件换了标题，又备份到“只在家里看”的文件夹。

assets/voice-lines/c5d54bbbef2b894c13de..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c5d54bbbef2b894c13de..text: 你们没有把画面扶正，留下的恰好是生活失手时露出的真实样子。

assets/voice-lines/2ca9a417b4af57362dc5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2ca9a417b4af57362dc5..text: 她给小屋拍了一张没有人的照片，空着的沙发放在画面正中。

assets/voice-lines/682ef1598cd592f087de..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/682ef1598cd592f087de..text: 你问怎么不等两个人都坐好，她说空位也能说明很多事情。

assets/voice-lines/f1c8d5ed83f64502e5bd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f1c8d5ed83f64502e5bd..text: 茶几上有两只杯子，玄关是两双鞋，靠垫留下了刚坐过的凹陷。

assets/voice-lines/c9cc916ad1e5ed029fdf..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c9cc916ad1e5ed029fdf..text: “看到这张，就知道我们很快会回来。”她把相机递给你。

assets/voice-lines/7c2e054e1d141e737e2b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7c2e054e1d141e737e2b..text: 门轻轻合上时，你们已经开始讨论，回家以后想一起做什么。

assets/voice-lines/cd42ed40b330a5e25bef..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cd42ed40b330a5e25bef..text: 那一串迟迟没连起来的音符，最后终于落在同一段节奏里。

assets/voice-lines/816c05d3e0c395a1abae..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/816c05d3e0c395a1abae..text: 两袋种子被放好，明年的故事先有了一个小小的开头。

assets/voice-lines/e895acfcdb70ca55dbd5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e895acfcdb70ca55dbd5..text: 你们争论它究竟该住书房还是客厅，最后各画了一扇门。

assets/voice-lines/ce111e2b3029782653f2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ce111e2b3029782653f2..text: 这张图纸不再用于施工，却被她放进了最里面的文件夹。

assets/voice-lines/8319b297caadf1faba88..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8319b297caadf1faba88..text: 她在书桌旁多量出一小块空间，说可以偶尔招待朋友。

assets/voice-lines/35812c25aca940a4f659..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/35812c25aca940a4f659..text: 你们把一首没学会的歌，聊成了一张没有比例的建筑草图。

assets/voice-lines/50eb5fd0152044be4efb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/50eb5fd0152044be4efb..text: 琴盖合上时，她说下次想给这间房子画一扇真正的门。

assets/voice-lines/c9a2a696211149879005..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c9a2a696211149879005..text: “也好。”她笑着说，“今天多赚了一壶一起喝的茶。”

assets/voice-lines/57d144b4e2dbb84f6dd8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/57d144b4e2dbb84f6dd8..text: “看来重复也不是白费。”她邀请你一起接完这一句。

assets/voice-lines/329ac673568ebb527714..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/329ac673568ebb527714..text: 她买回的点心袋里夹着一张演出票根，差点被一起丢掉。

assets/voice-lines/fb4b6ee4ed748cb8439e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fb4b6ee4ed748cb8439e..text: 那张票从演出的纪念，变成了回家路上的一小段续篇。

assets/voice-lines/8b5e395dbcce7b1b7929..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8b5e395dbcce7b1b7929..text: 结尾只有几个音，你们静静等了一会儿，谁也没有催。

assets/voice-lines/c0024b69b1f5b2de9f9a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c0024b69b1f5b2de9f9a..text: 一本旧书里夹着只有半句话的纸条，后半截已经找不到了。

assets/voice-lines/1b9862b3abf810ea9b92..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1b9862b3abf810ea9b92..text: 她忽然问，如果今天只能记住一件小事，你会选什么。

assets/voice-lines/42493f2b10d19fb5253a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/42493f2b10d19fb5253a..text: 你看了看锅里冒出的热气，说想记住她现在不着急的样子。

assets/voice-lines/824dd9c937b396e59b9e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/824dd9c937b396e59b9e..text: 最后一颗棋子迟迟没有落下，她问能不能把过程写进日记。

assets/voice-lines/dbf968d38607c1104fb4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/dbf968d38607c1104fb4..text: 你提醒她还没分出输赢，她却说过程里已经有很多值得留的事。

assets/voice-lines/8ab381550301a12dc6d9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8ab381550301a12dc6d9..text: 比如两次笑场，一壶新茶，以及你替她捡起掉到地上的棋子。

assets/voice-lines/df02a8b81aa7cf31e380..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/df02a8b81aa7cf31e380..text: 你说它也许只是想换一天工作，她笑着洗净那只小勺。

assets/voice-lines/d24977cb14c160840c90..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d24977cb14c160840c90..text: 今晚的点心没有因此耽误，茶里倒多了一点淡淡的花香。

assets/voice-lines/0a338c45768a206fd1bd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0a338c45768a206fd1bd..text: 你们站在厨房门口，互相指认对方今天最不整齐的地方。

assets/voice-lines/42e81b13deabb7dd9a5f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/42e81b13deabb7dd9a5f..text: 烤箱响起来时，两个人都已经忘了最初是谁先弄脏的。

assets/voice-lines/b5ae8823c458e86e9e59..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b5ae8823c458e86e9e59..text: 你们临时把琴旁的灯调亮，给今晚的演出拍了一张开场照。

assets/voice-lines/365a0776c3f9691f45dc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/365a0776c3f9691f45dc..text: 她说有些演出可以只给一个人看，不需要下一次播放量。

assets/voice-lines/66daf6fae005dcfb4a17..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/66daf6fae005dcfb4a17..text: 棋盘旁的相机自动拍下一张你们同时低头思考的照片。

assets/voice-lines/1a542ba2acf45995677b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1a542ba2acf45995677b..text: 你说这张可以当今天的赛后合照，她却先问你愿不愿意留着。

assets/voice-lines/624dd55595558fa762b6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/624dd55595558fa762b6..text: 林栀在照片背面写下日期，还画了一片只有你看得懂的小叶子。

assets/voice-lines/239b9d13769b5c3373f8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/239b9d13769b5c3373f8..text: 林栀把你落的那一颗圈在便签上，说下次从这里继续。

assets/voice-lines/8e422507da81179de386..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8e422507da81179de386..text: 林栀把散开的发丝别回耳后，约好下一轮也要温柔一点。

assets/voice-lines/d8bf1b4f3c25aa4bae10..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d8bf1b4f3c25aa4bae10..text: 顾清禾认真比了比取景线，最后却最喜欢那张没摆好姿势的。

assets/voice-lines/7f9e87cf70a9efb34ede..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7f9e87cf70a9efb34ede..text: 顾清禾把错拍记成小小的星号，说它也算这次合奏的签名。

assets/voice-lines/962f56111b5921952749..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/962f56111b5921952749..text: 顾清禾指着棋盘说，每次落子都像给房子添一扇新窗。

assets/voice-lines/b87bbddaee2fead9f07e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b87bbddaee2fead9f07e..text: 顾清禾抱着软枕笑，说今天的计划里可以多留一点空白。

assets/voice-lines/a1bc683d7f2f05191a9f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a1bc683d7f2f05191a9f..text: 许知夏看着照片上的你，说今天的笑容比舞台灯光更亮。

assets/voice-lines/c2126a84be89aa882caa..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c2126a84be89aa882caa..text: 许知夏把速度放慢了一半，说两个人听见彼此比弹快更重要。

assets/voice-lines/1be156b8601306909dc0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1be156b8601306909dc0..text: 许知夏在等你想好下一步时，轻轻哼着刚练过的旋律。

assets/voice-lines/09f80fb0f1750cb24e80..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/09f80fb0f1750cb24e80..text: 许知夏数着节拍接住软枕，连笑声都落在熟悉的拍子上。

assets/voice-lines/b7df37f1c03fb6e4e024..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b7df37f1c03fb6e4e024..text: 江月想把照片夹进食谱，让下一次做点心时也能看见你。

assets/voice-lines/ffbe35f8d642bb51f190..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ffbe35f8d642bb51f190..text: 江月说这段像烤箱叮的一声，听见就知道有好事在等。

assets/voice-lines/c5314cdf6a184cb6841c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c5314cdf6a184cb6841c..text: 江月把棋子排整齐，问你下次要不要带两块小饼干来。

assets/voice-lines/ef5278344a5d01a7e4a7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ef5278344a5d01a7e4a7..text: 江月笑着护住旁边的花，说软枕和今天都要轻拿轻放。

assets/voice-lines/5df6ee34966878644d2b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5df6ee34966878644d2b..text: 唐梨想录下最后那几个音，说它们很适合做私藏的片尾。

assets/voice-lines/a6f7d0a18e98f41036ec..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a6f7d0a18e98f41036ec..text: 唐梨把手机翻扣在桌上，说这一局只看你，不看弹幕。

assets/voice-lines/a9ffff7ab87729659094..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a9ffff7ab87729659094..text: 唐梨笑着说，这一段不用剪辑，留在心里就已经很好看。

assets/voice-lines/d20ca6565de0bc1779c7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d20ca6565de0bc1779c7..text: 信纸上的压花已经失去鲜艳的颜色，细小的叶脉却仍然清楚。

assets/voice-lines/67c3fd025af8bf0f0fd6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/67c3fd025af8bf0f0fd6..text: 花香穿过玻璃窗。一个迟到的约定，终于有了可以抵达的人。

assets/voice-lines/78744b960050d455fb42..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/78744b960050d455fb42..text: 放映结束后的清晨，你来取温室里的展板，林栀却先递来一张合照。

assets/voice-lines/bd0432153cfc651bf431..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bd0432153cfc651bf431..text: 照片里你们都没有看镜头。桌上的两杯茶，映着同一片叶影。

assets/voice-lines/1bd4d01075ad8f459503..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1bd4d01075ad8f459503..text: 她在最后添上一朵小花。照片收进日志时，新的枝芽刚好碰到窗沿。

assets/voice-lines/099f0bc63951fb77330b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/099f0bc63951fb77330b..text: 她没有回答，只把拿走的椅子递给你。木头还留着打磨后的温度。

assets/voice-lines/78425767ba032d67e646..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/78425767ba032d67e646..text: 她笑着扶住模型边缘，和你一起把两把椅子调到相同的方向。

assets/voice-lines/4b2452d1e0fecdcc1cff..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4b2452d1e0fecdcc1cff..text: 你把光标退回去。耳机里先是风声，然后才有她重新进入的歌声。

assets/voice-lines/2ed74f86403facd64553..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2ed74f86403facd64553..text: 她在你的手册上画了一个休止符，旁边又添了两把椅子。

assets/voice-lines/6c70000dd03304a1bdd9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6c70000dd03304a1bdd9..text: 她用指尖敲出新的前奏。这一次，你没有急着按下录制键。

assets/voice-lines/bbe08b5801cf4c0e59f5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bbe08b5801cf4c0e59f5..text: 首映的设备收好了，许知夏却抱着吉他留在空荡荡的广场。

assets/voice-lines/e09bcd4e527d2b8be471..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e09bcd4e527d2b8be471..text: 熟悉的副歌在没有扩音器的夜里响起，比舞台上近了很多。

assets/voice-lines/bc69fe288cdfd449319c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bc69fe288cdfd449319c..text: 你没有举起手机。她唱完以后，你们一起把最后两把椅子收进储物间。

assets/voice-lines/3799da2bba655986e783..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3799da2bba655986e783..text: 照片里的她坐在书店门口，手里捧着已经喝完的纸杯。

assets/voice-lines/c614f0656bade355eaf7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c614f0656bade355eaf7..text: 报道发表后的周末，苏晚在书店翻出最初的提纲。标题被划掉了三次。

assets/voice-lines/004f41a57f9e95bb3f1a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/004f41a57f9e95bb3f1a..text: 你拉开她面前的椅子，她却先去拿了两把不同颜色的叉子。

assets/voice-lines/824542de45b9b55002d7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/824542de45b9b55002d7..text: 江月的新菜单多了一小块空白。你以为是忘了排版，她却摇摇头。

assets/voice-lines/0fd5488d0002f221f179..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0fd5488d0002f221f179..text: 你选了不太甜的橙皮。她又拿出一点海盐，把试吃盘摆成两份。

assets/voice-lines/ea730585beea8f614b30..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ea730585beea8f614b30..text: 烤箱计时器还没响。她把围裙松开一点，在你旁边坐下来。

assets/voice-lines/76627c6f1ca695a5ef97..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/76627c6f1ca695a5ef97..text: 阳台上的相纸还在显影，她把最后一格空白递到你面前。

assets/voice-lines/88618dcb7a1e064eae69..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/88618dcb7a1e064eae69..text: 唐梨把最终花絮发给你。视频结束以后，还有十秒钟没有剪掉的夜色。

assets/voice-lines/91b11f5efd1d05618112..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/91b11f5efd1d05618112..text: 她把视频存进不公开的相册，封面选了阳台上的那张合照。

assets/voice-lines/5f13ef8193a27c914448..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5f13ef8193a27c914448..text: 夜间纪录片拍摄结束，林栀抱着一只小纸袋，坐到沈屿身旁的车窗边。

assets/voice-lines/3a364a94936b30ffdaf1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3a364a94936b30ffdaf1..text: 车厢的灯映在叶尖上，窗外一座座陌生的楼向后退去。

assets/voice-lines/2d76d53b26c49e02a069..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2d76d53b26c49e02a069..text: 列车停在一座小站。广播里的站名，被隔壁车厢的笑声盖住了一半。

assets/voice-lines/6ae68ea24531ff698bd6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6ae68ea24531ff698bd6..text: 她翻开笔记本，纸上不只有植物名字，还写着一串歪歪斜斜的站名。

assets/voice-lines/c342d831e851f082845a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c342d831e851f082845a..text: 她在空行旁画了一片小叶子，没有急着补上那个站名。

assets/voice-lines/d100c62ca4e0def07197..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d100c62ca4e0def07197..text: 两人走到桥中央，河对岸的窗口一扇扇亮了起来。顾清禾收起了卷尺。

assets/voice-lines/d6ef15c3485c1b620136..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d6ef15c3485c1b620136..text: 她把卷尺放进包里，空出来的手轻轻搭在沈屿手背旁。

assets/voice-lines/f6a8d488093b3168b50c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f6a8d488093b3168b50c..text: 录音室只剩一盏台灯。许知夏反复听着回放里一小段沙沙声。

assets/voice-lines/cef0215dbd04ad8a5245..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cef0215dbd04ad8a5245..text: 沈屿把耳机接到另一端，听见沙沙声之后，还有一声很轻的笑。

assets/voice-lines/e6c08064a909352bddb2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e6c08064a909352bddb2..text: 她新建了一个文件，把原本标着“待修”的那段录音拖了进去。

assets/voice-lines/e5bc8619be0447101997..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e5bc8619be0447101997..text: 末班车还没有进站。苏晚从大衣口袋里取出一封折得很整齐的信。

assets/voice-lines/189dd19721d45ae13d5f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/189dd19721d45ae13d5f..text: 苏晚的手机亮起一条催稿消息。她看了一眼，停下了正在整理的纸页。

assets/voice-lines/01358c9ade8eca695731..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/01358c9ade8eca695731..text: 列车进站的风翻起纸角，沈屿替她按住了最上面的一页。

assets/voice-lines/ea28bae030cfb681d680..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ea28bae030cfb681d680..text: 沈屿指了指车窗外，那里正好经过一家还亮着灯的早餐铺。

assets/voice-lines/5fd8c2ea04fd062a6dd5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5fd8c2ea04fd062a6dd5..text: 江月把最后两块饼干装进纸袋，关掉了河边小摊的价目灯。

assets/voice-lines/48ec0efc95f8a2c4329e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/48ec0efc95f8a2c4329e..text: 她接过半块饼干，认真咬了一小口，眼睛慢慢弯起来。

assets/voice-lines/d3a358582aa490e899c7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d3a358582aa490e899c7..text: 她笑着拿出两只小碗，桂花在热气里浮成细小的金点。

assets/voice-lines/ae5f788c1d76b9aa5c0f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ae5f788c1d76b9aa5c0f..text: 唐梨拎着一盏纸灯走到河边，直播用的手机安静地放在包里。

assets/voice-lines/7ba3ae4381c6636e812d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7ba3ae4381c6636e812d..text: 她举起纸灯，暖光从薄薄的纸面透出来，照亮了两人的袖口。

assets/voice-lines/868b1aa618058e34e53d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/868b1aa618058e34e53d..text: 她把灯柄往沈屿的方向递了递，两人的手握在了同一处。

assets/voice-lines/a265808e5c6a9c42a6d6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a265808e5c6a9c42a6d6..text: 走过桥下时，唐梨忽然停住，像在等一个不会响起的开场提示。

assets/voice-lines/8a0c62994c869b7b0132..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8a0c62994c869b7b0132..text: 远处的游船转过弯，船尾的灯在水面留下了一条慢慢散开的线。

assets/voice-lines/1b8d54b4f77e8555adfd..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/1b8d54b4f77e8555adfd..text: 我也记得。那天剪辑卡住了，可在这里坐着就不那么着急。

assets/voice-lines/a282a3dd8b8f0fc66c59..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/a282a3dd8b8f0fc66c59..text: 可以先问我今晚想吃什么。这样我就有理由留下来了。

assets/voice-lines/41572912745155b2b8e2..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/41572912745155b2b8e2..text: 那把熟悉的东西带一点过去。比如它，比如你的旧围裙。

assets/voice-lines/d7adc1ca2dc8ac0e3905..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/d7adc1ca2dc8ac0e3905..text: 我现在在想，怎么让它好好亮到你家。不是在等你表演。

assets/voice-lines/3d9f18a72c7915ce408b..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/3d9f18a72c7915ce408b..text: 标题不一定写在最前面。有些故事，要一起走完才知道。

assets/voice-lines/6af0ca82964a69ebde9c..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/6af0ca82964a69ebde9c..text: 沈制作人，现在可以把流程表放下了吗？想和你说些不算素材的话。

assets/voice-lines/91dec5774f7849ad1a77..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/91dec5774f7849ad1a77..text: 写苏晚就好。今天我想先做我自己，再做那个总在追消息的人。

assets/voice-lines/e577d90ddb35af7c254b..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/e577d90ddb35af7c254b..text: 别急着拍照。有些表情，在你面前出现就已经足够了。

assets/voice-lines/7edf132bc687f05c74da..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7edf132bc687f05c74da..text: 没有采访提纲的时候，你倒比我还认真。这样也很好，慢慢靠近吧。

assets/voice-lines/6c30929c8ea1cadd162d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/6c30929c8ea1cadd162d..text: 这次我没有拿录音笔。空出来的这只手，刚好可以交给你。

assets/voice-lines/71929c5349358e08673b..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/71929c5349358e08673b..text: 因为拍的是我在发呆。摄影师说很真实，编辑说和主题无关。

assets/voice-lines/7b13fc5dd43014857711..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7b13fc5dd43014857711..text: 想今天终于可以不再问别人问题了。又想，有没有人愿意问我一句。

assets/voice-lines/d6be87c7d82c08b3043f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/d6be87c7d82c08b3043f..text: 我以前总觉得，写下来就算说出口了。今天才发现不是。

assets/voice-lines/cca8f40fcd39b603ef1a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/cca8f40fcd39b603ef1a..text: 这一篇听完了。故事已经珍藏在夜话里，接下来就安心休息吧。

assets/voice-lines/4f473f90a0a987f34a68..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4f473f90a0a987f34a68..text: 计时开始了。你可以慢慢睡，到了时间再来珍藏这段陪伴。

assets/voice-lines/1b37b329ae373d59f914..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/1b37b329ae373d59f914..text: 时间已经记下来了。今晚不用为了完成目标而勉强自己。

assets/voice-lines/29e26bc3e910f21d9246..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/29e26bc3e910f21d9246..text: 今晚可以一直这样看着，不需要我给你一个标准答案。

assets/voice-lines/1a659053a471e040f260..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/1a659053a471e040f260..text: 这次不用做开场白吗？……好，那我就先当收到邀请的人。

assets/voice-lines/080cea69c5e6cb258a17..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/080cea69c5e6cb258a17..text: 生日那天，我已经把下播时间提前了。这一段不需要任何人来打赏。

assets/voice-lines/ed8ca58a8880024295bd..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/ed8ca58a8880024295bd..text: 总追着最热闹的光，就会漏掉这种颜色。晚一点也很好。

assets/voice-lines/49a2c442304c9120bf7a..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/49a2c442304c9120bf7a..text: 有一点停顿也没关系。我听得出来，这不是给镜头练好的台词。

assets/voice-lines/0533165be6f66bcf35f3..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0533165be6f66bcf35f3..text: 补光灯已经关好了。今天这条玫瑰色裙子，想先给镜头外的你看看。

assets/voice-lines/392fb8df7021e3667796..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/392fb8df7021e3667796..text: 封面留给大家，这一张不拍。我想记住你现在看着我的眼神。

assets/voice-lines/87d390d39c776a7ce12c..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/87d390d39c776a7ce12c..text: 头发会勾到耳环，帮我慢一点拨开。嗯，这样就很好。

assets/voice-lines/022033e2c3215f47c4dd..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/022033e2c3215f47c4dd..text: 今天不安排直播倒计时。只要你还想牵着，我们就再多待一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/2b9f4feaf2f4d988ccbf..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/2b9f4feaf2f4d988ccbf..text: 那我现在说：下次站到台上，还是让我帮你别麦克风。

assets/voice-lines/7f9ceb08fb047a1d41be..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/7f9ceb08fb047a1d41be..text: 对观众来说可能没有内容。对我来说，是那天最想留下的一句。

assets/voice-lines/719cd124af55451eaeb9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/719cd124af55451eaeb9..text: 不放进河里。纸和灯架留在水里，就不是好看的故事了。

assets/voice-lines/a4de1345c885d69841d9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/a4de1345c885d69841d9..text: 先陪我们走一段，再带回家。我给它找了一个靠窗的位置。

assets/voice-lines/6af6603c947da7243746..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6af6603c947da7243746..text: 没开播的时候，我有时反而不知道第一句话该说什么。

assets/voice-lines/9d850d88f3a426494725..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/9d850d88f3a426494725..text: 你不会觉得无聊吗？直播间里只要安静几秒，我就想赶快接一句。

assets/voice-lines/f2d6bbfe6b7e3a87d7d2..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f2d6bbfe6b7e3a87d7d2..text: 是一个让我不用害怕冷场的人。下播之后，还想和他聊一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/24f7ab8340924add1e86..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/24f7ab8340924add1e86..text: 这一篇听完了。故事已经珍藏在夜话里，接下来就安心休息吧。

assets/voice-lines/f5da7ead62e166ec984f..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f5da7ead62e166ec984f..text: 计时开始了。你可以慢慢睡，到了时间再来珍藏这段陪伴。

assets/voice-lines/62e53b9eeee194113293..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/62e53b9eeee194113293..text: 时间已经记下来了。今晚不用为了完成目标而勉强自己。

assets/voice-lines/362e3bc7cb036ca38257..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/362e3bc7cb036ca38257..text: 你看见了吧？没有镜头的时候，我也是这样喜欢看你。

assets/voice-lines/d3f3d0b53ff9025d3b2e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/d3f3d0b53ff9025d3b2e..text: 手机已经放好了。被子这里，是今晚可以靠近的距离。

assets/voice-lines/211e450b7fcc0bade818..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/211e450b7fcc0bade818..text: 盖好了。相册可以先关上，今天已经被我们好好过完。

assets/voice-lines/b2548dc1660da1804d2f..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/b2548dc1660da1804d2f..text: 不用像播音一样标准。按你平时叫我名字的速度就好。

assets/voice-lines/ddf5ba7e5826dd9aa77d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/ddf5ba7e5826dd9aa77d..text: 夸奖可以再具体一点吗？比如你最喜欢的，其实是我笑起来的样子。

assets/voice-lines/7e5160f6d0c2759dccbb..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/7e5160f6d0c2759dccbb..text: 发带是你帮我系的。松一点就松一点，今天不需要那么标准。

assets/voice-lines/07e5ea366cd98d0df48c..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/07e5ea366cd98d0df48c..text: 这次不数拍子啦。跟着你的步子，把剩下的路慢慢走完。

assets/voice-lines/65ebc5d318ca1263f9a9..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/65ebc5d318ca1263f9a9..text: 音乐也不是每一秒都要填满。那一下，我听见你还在旁边。

assets/voice-lines/efd3a31393e76c606b75..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/efd3a31393e76c606b75..text: 刚才有很多人，我一直在想有没有唱错。现在想试试不用证明什么。

assets/voice-lines/c487bc7bee9ad700fbc0..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c487bc7bee9ad700fbc0..text: 这一篇听完了。故事已经珍藏在夜话里，接下来就安心休息吧。

assets/voice-lines/513c07ac6fde5d0233af..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/513c07ac6fde5d0233af..text: 计时开始了。你可以慢慢睡，到了时间再来珍藏这段陪伴。

assets/voice-lines/86f963ca1d1407b783bf..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/86f963ca1d1407b783bf..text: 时间已经记下来了。今晚不用为了完成目标而勉强自己。

assets/voice-lines/64515be00c998bb2e482..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/64515be00c998bb2e482..text: 好了，线放床头，被子留给我们。今晚先不听播放列表。

assets/voice-lines/b656bcf26e4c2e5f206d..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/b656bcf26e4c2e5f206d..text: 原来你说的那个小小计划，是为我准备了这么多。谢谢你，让我期待今天。

assets/voice-lines/5c8679de6868d8215630..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/5c8679de6868d8215630..text: 今天没有改图纸。我把空出来的晚上留好了，想和你把这条裙子的第一段回忆走完。

assets/voice-lines/23e48dc68074677ae141..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/23e48dc68074677ae141..text: 图纸会规定每扇窗的位置。可是你来了以后，我才知道光应该落在哪里。

assets/voice-lines/c08b07684c56f9039418..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c08b07684c56f9039418..text: 原来你说的那个小小计划，是为我准备了这么多。谢谢你，让我期待今天。

assets/voice-lines/7767d39887c767a50c7b..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/7767d39887c767a50c7b..text: 围裙收起来了，奶油也没有沾到裙摆。今天的最后一份甜点，想和你坐下来一起吃。

assets/voice-lines/92cb69426dbdfb993c77..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/92cb69426dbdfb993c77..text: 想给还没做出来的口味留个位置。以前总觉得不能让别人看见没准备好的东西。

assets/voice-lines/bd779f4b40824179bd61..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/bd779f4b40824179bd61..text: 原来你说的那个小小计划，是为我准备了这么多。谢谢你，让我期待今天。

assets/voice-lines/d9611127856f28c82f48..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/d9611127856f28c82f48..text: 裙子上的小花，和温室里新开的那一丛很像。你挑选的时候，是不是也想到了它们？

assets/voice-lines/b863c62657940575338e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b863c62657940575338e..text: 温室清点时，你发现一包落了日期的种子。林栀没有把它扔掉，而是取来两个小花盆。

assets/voice-lines/9313698dc3c9eeec4c73..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9313698dc3c9eeec4c73..text: 你把自己的名字写在花盆背面，决定把她生日那天的第一份观察记录留在这里。

assets/voice-lines/8aa8841a8698013d6ed5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8aa8841a8698013d6ed5..text: 她把植物手册借给你，书页却被风吹开，露出去年生日那天贴的一片干叶。

assets/voice-lines/7c91aeebc941e4202998..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7c91aeebc941e4202998..text: 你没有急着许诺热闹，只把纸页扶好。她说，今年想把日期旁边的空白留给你。

assets/voice-lines/be921b2c47a1d12bb928..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/be921b2c47a1d12bb928..text: 插花课结束，桌上还剩一只玻璃瓶。你试着把三枝白花摆进去，花枝却总往一边倒。

assets/voice-lines/882b0d84f52b867fe84b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/882b0d84f52b867fe84b..text: 她扶着你的手调整瓶口。你发现自己准备生日时太用力，忘了她喜欢的是自然生长。

assets/voice-lines/fce5b0015b87589e4eba..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fce5b0015b87589e4eba..text: 你选的园艺手套大了一号。林栀戴上试了试，指尖空出一截，笑着把另一副递给你。

assets/voice-lines/a4f006ac449138baaeca..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a4f006ac449138baaeca..text: 礼物没有被退回，反而多了一个一起使用的理由。你们把两副手套挂在同一个钩子上。

assets/voice-lines/28acdeac93d164b0fcdf..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/28acdeac93d164b0fcdf..text: 你想提前拍下花开的过程，可花苞直到日落都没有动静。林栀给相机换了一块电池。

assets/voice-lines/bd19fbdb102d20076f69..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bd19fbdb102d20076f69..text: 最后一页观察册还空着。你问她生日愿望，她在纸上画了两片很小的叶子。

assets/voice-lines/1a195495afefe5c5bb5f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1a195495afefe5c5bb5f..text: 庆祝结束以后，林栀没有急着离开。她带你回到温室，把收好的生日礼盒又轻轻打开。

assets/voice-lines/ef34599843b450c19023..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ef34599843b450c19023..text: 你照着顾清禾的草图做了一扇小木窗，窗框却比底座宽了两毫米。她没有拿出尺子。

assets/voice-lines/000c9d1fbc2e71090f3f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/000c9d1fbc2e71090f3f..text: 你告诉她，想留下她收工时终于放松的神情。她把木窗转向夕阳，认真点了一下头。

assets/voice-lines/f9d59db3c7194acca8af..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f9d59db3c7194acca8af..text: 你用卡纸搭生日会的场地模型，屋顶刚放上去就塌了。她坐下来帮你折了一道支撑。

assets/voice-lines/be219ce6c06bdc882c49..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/be219ce6c06bdc882c49..text: 你们把两张椅子一起放进模型里。她说，今后再忙，也会给这两张椅子留位置。

assets/voice-lines/a09ca28c043eb3f76a0c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a09ca28c043eb3f76a0c..text: 她生日那周还有验收。你把邀请卡夹在图纸里，发现背面密密麻麻写着住户的名字。

assets/voice-lines/9567be55a9a387782dcb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9567be55a9a387782dcb..text: 她在当天傍晚圈出半个小时，又把圈画大了一点。你们决定把庆祝做得简单一些。

assets/voice-lines/aa6e54981dd1ea84d0c8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/aa6e54981dd1ea84d0c8..text: 顾清禾带你去配一把旧钥匙。店主问是不是新家，她看了你一眼，没有马上解释。

assets/voice-lines/9c3477054cac4ea568d0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9c3477054cac4ea568d0..text: 你握着刚磨好的钥匙，听见街上的钟声。礼盒里的黄铜小钥匙突然有了具体的含义。

assets/voice-lines/4333692a61d992df9de3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4333692a61d992df9de3..text: 测试庆生灯串时，你把灯全开了，房间像还没结束的会议室。她只留下窗边的一串。

assets/voice-lines/8732da1a6310125b21bd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8732da1a6310125b21bd..text: 你把开关放进她手里。那晚你们没有谈效果图，只一起等天空从橙色变成蓝色。

assets/voice-lines/a3983c77379f582c5ddc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a3983c77379f582c5ddc..text: 你写祝福卡，写到事业顺利时停了下来。她拿过铅笔，在后面添了一个很小的逗号。

assets/voice-lines/8ca6ddb7527b61c8475c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8ca6ddb7527b61c8475c..text: 你接着写：有空吃饭，有人等你。她把卡片收进模型的窗后，说这是最合适的尺寸。

assets/voice-lines/ee07010162fb32eddaa6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ee07010162fb32eddaa6..text: 许知夏发现你买了一张没有灌录的唱片。她用指腹敲了敲封套，听见空空的回响。

assets/voice-lines/1fa6ebefcfa247c449a8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1fa6ebefcfa247c449a8..text: 你请她先保密，生日时再打开。她答应了，却在封面画下两个人都认得的小橘子。

assets/voice-lines/b0cb7e21dd9745fe8d22..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b0cb7e21dd9745fe8d22..text: 录生日祝福时，节拍器突然没电。你越念越快，许知夏干脆在桌上轻轻拍起节奏。

assets/voice-lines/46a892d7cb262ec0d9c0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/46a892d7cb262ec0d9c0..text: 生日当天的演出取消了。她看着印好的通行证，把其中一张折起来放进你的手心。

assets/voice-lines/cb0839ac8f993ff09d64..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cb0839ac8f993ff09d64..text: 你们把天台角落收拾出两张坐垫。她没有觉得遗憾，只认真问你想坐在左边还是右边。

assets/voice-lines/0a41c4ba4350e4a657f1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0a41c4ba4350e4a657f1..text: 你找到一段旧磁带，背景里全是风声。她戴上耳机，突然认出了那天楼下卖橘子的吆喝。

assets/voice-lines/4b6901339f62ad6b03da..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4b6901339f62ad6b03da..text: 你保留了风声，也保留她转头叫你的那一声。礼盒里不再只装着一首完美的歌。

assets/voice-lines/b1001c2f1a7ac08c4625..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b1001c2f1a7ac08c4625..text: 她弹了一段没有名字的旋律，问你觉得像什么。你说，像回家路上最后一盏还亮着的灯。

assets/voice-lines/e2d7ee336e537a3bfe86..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e2d7ee336e537a3bfe86..text: 她把曲谱折成小小的一页。你在背面写下生日日期，决定以后每年都添一句新的歌词。

assets/voice-lines/0a5743ff8d673f3dafd7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0a5743ff8d673f3dafd7..text: 练习结束，你鼓掌说再来一首。她却把吉他放下，向你伸出手，让你坐到她身边。

assets/voice-lines/6aa41405aee9b34c97bd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6aa41405aee9b34c97bd..text: 你告诉她为什么准备这个生日。她听完，把录音键按下，说这一次换她保存你的声音。

assets/voice-lines/32e444cfc6d4b8abf19c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/32e444cfc6d4b8abf19c..text: 庆祝结束以后，许知夏没有急着离开。她带你回到天台，把收好的生日礼盒又轻轻打开。

assets/voice-lines/fc3722fd547f05f60e04..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fc3722fd547f05f60e04..text: 苏晚送你一本旧笔记本，首页没有标题。你问她是不是忘了，她把笔放到你面前。

assets/voice-lines/a3eb69f1ff75d2eb43e9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a3eb69f1ff75d2eb43e9..text: 你把生日邀请写在那一页。她没有点评措辞，只在日期旁画了一颗很小的星星。

assets/voice-lines/9e589091537ae46d048f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9e589091537ae46d048f..text: 你在旧报纸里找到她第一次署名的报道。她读了一遍，承认那时有一句话写得太着急。

assets/voice-lines/cd9a98354c9e366878be..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/cd9a98354c9e366878be..text: 你说礼物不是履历展示，是想认识走到今天的她。她把剪报折好，放在笔记本的第二页。

assets/voice-lines/5adb40e79d5ed5bb3767..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5adb40e79d5ed5bb3767..text: 你试着采访她的生日愿望。第三个问题还没问完，她把录音笔关掉，给你推来一杯茶。

assets/voice-lines/957b84db61e329114a5f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/957b84db61e329114a5f..text: 祝福卡上，你写了苏老师，又划掉了。她看着墨迹笑起来，问最终版本准备叫什么。

assets/voice-lines/0d4a87d7252b039a8edb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0d4a87d7252b039a8edb..text: 你在新卡上认真写下她的名字。她把旧卡也收了起来，说犹豫的痕迹不用扔掉。

assets/voice-lines/a30da4c68f6fa3ee505c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a30da4c68f6fa3ee505c..text: 她借走你的相机，说要拍一张生日准备的花絮。你忙着调整桌布，却被她叫住抬头。

assets/voice-lines/d3ee3ffb5d5e1f0847d1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d3ee3ffb5d5e1f0847d1..text: 照片里你的袖口还沾着胶带。她没有裁掉，说这个细节比摆得整齐的桌面更让人安心。

assets/voice-lines/4ddd0d5417c50e6890cc..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4ddd0d5417c50e6890cc..text: 你把写好的信交给她，准备封蜡。她却先在信封背面添了一行只有两个人看得见的字。

assets/voice-lines/9f4853a9ed7dc4da38c9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9f4853a9ed7dc4da38c9..text: 蜡印凝固时，街角书店正要关门。你们一起把最后一盏灯留下，让祝福有了安静的落款。

assets/voice-lines/effb7477b1162d23a07d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/effb7477b1162d23a07d..text: 你照着江月的配方烤星形饼干，五个角长得都不一样。她挑出最歪的一块尝了尝。

assets/voice-lines/a0e9d70bd287ea04a846..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a0e9d70bd287ea04a846..text: 你把饼干放进礼盒最上面。她用一张小纸写下口味，说下次还想吃到同样的认真。

assets/voice-lines/9ba073cd21d178c96394..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9ba073cd21d178c96394..text: 你想做一只很甜的生日蛋糕。江月让你先尝奶油，又递来一勺略带酸味的莓果酱。

assets/voice-lines/d35e4bc9f9f5870762a2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d35e4bc9f9f5870762a2..text: 你在旧货店找到一只月纹杯，杯沿有个细小的缺口。她用指尖摸了摸，问能否买成一对。

assets/voice-lines/bb3f399fa464f850edd3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bb3f399fa464f850edd3..text: 生日那天的预订单排得很满。你想劝她休息，她却先把最后一份给邻居的点心装好。

assets/voice-lines/7931e873d3937105211d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7931e873d3937105211d..text: 你把试做蛋糕递给她，她又把第一勺转向你。两人推让了半天，奶油差点掉在桌上。

assets/voice-lines/452ce88b1dd5ee3ae702..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/452ce88b1dd5ee3ae702..text: 你们各拿一只勺子，终于同时笑起来。你在食谱边上写：两人份，试吃也要两人份。

assets/voice-lines/b324160845b11f7d63dd..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b324160845b11f7d63dd..text: 你答应她下次来帮忙刷烤盘。她把生日卡放进月亮糖罐，说这份愿望已经有了第一步。

assets/voice-lines/0723c61c284737793a8b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0723c61c284737793a8b..text: 庆祝结束以后，江月没有急着离开。她带你回到烘焙店，把收好的生日礼盒又轻轻打开。

assets/voice-lines/03e8afe3a61c6dec792d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/03e8afe3a61c6dec792d..text: 唐梨把相机放在窗边，问你今天想拍什么。你递给她一张邀请卡，却没有按下录制键。

assets/voice-lines/df977fa85ef73834b662..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/df977fa85ef73834b662..text: 她把卡收进相机包最里层。你们约好，这个生日有些片段只在两个人的记忆里播放。

assets/voice-lines/0c15b5072f9233f74479..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0c15b5072f9233f74479..text: 你整理两人拍过的相纸，发现她常常站在边缘。她说这样方便把景物完整留给观众。

assets/voice-lines/1e9ee2f26ce0b5760a67..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/1e9ee2f26ce0b5760a67..text: 新相机带的结系得太紧，唐梨怎么也解不开。你接过去，一边松结一边听她念直播计划。

assets/voice-lines/f7bd96c4fd2fabd869ae..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f7bd96c4fd2fabd869ae..text: 外景临时取消，你们错过了金色夕阳。唐梨没有急着离开，指着渐渐变蓝的天空让你看。

assets/voice-lines/037066fdf4bfa950ca14..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/037066fdf4bfa950ca14..text: 庆祝结束以后，唐梨没有急着离开。她带你回到阳台，把收好的生日礼盒又轻轻打开。

assets/voice-lines/6bb65eb102d914cb44b6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6bb65eb102d914cb44b6..text: 林栀把项目照片夹进一本植物手册。窗台上的小芽，恰好长出了第二片叶子。

assets/voice-lines/29be96cf6a9db54035d8..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/29be96cf6a9db54035d8..text: 天色变暖，你们给每盆植物写上新的名字。最后一张标签，是你们一起写的“明天”。

assets/voice-lines/944adee3c3a26b0f2658..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/944adee3c3a26b0f2658..text: 窗外的灯亮起来。今天，你们没有急着确定尺寸，只认真讨论了以后要在哪里吃晚饭。

assets/voice-lines/327b7f43d05a6db86370..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/327b7f43d05a6db86370..text: 晚风绕过天台。你们用脚尖打着同样的节拍，下一首歌的开头，已经有了。

assets/voice-lines/70f2d1e6139d342b9255..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/70f2d1e6139d342b9255..text: 你们并肩校对最后一行。窗外一辆公交缓缓经过，而这一段时间，不需要赶路。

assets/voice-lines/83390bf057679c5f84c0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/83390bf057679c5f84c0..text: 照片没有再上传。她把它放进桌上的相框，背后写着：下播以后的时间，也想与你一起。

assets/voice-lines/4b81aeca8b6bc226d2d7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4b81aeca8b6bc226d2d7..text: 首映前一晚，林栀在温室整理展览用的标本。一本旧日志里，落出一封没有邮票的信。

assets/voice-lines/4b7999b1e82fc3f2af68..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4b7999b1e82fc3f2af68..text: 钟楼展览用的模型快完成了。顾清禾把两把很小的木椅放到窗前，又拿走一把。

assets/voice-lines/4f08a02db73366e108de..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4f08a02db73366e108de..text: 窗里的两道小小影子并肩落下。你第一次在她的图纸里，看见了自己的位置。

assets/voice-lines/a34fc1db4923b0addecb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a34fc1db4923b0addecb..text: 修缮验收结束后，顾清禾带你回到钟楼。她没有带图纸，只带了一把钥匙。

assets/voice-lines/e195224aac8ecaf955f9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e195224aac8ecaf955f9..text: 楼下有人推着自行车回家。晚风从保留下来的旧窗穿过，吹动她的发梢。

assets/voice-lines/da964f6340f6917008fe..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/da964f6340f6917008fe..text: 她轻轻点头。城市的灯比方案里的效果图柔和，却比任何一次设想都更接近明天。

assets/voice-lines/230d28333a7562b81374..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/230d28333a7562b81374..text: 主题曲的最终母带里，有一处很短的停顿。许知夏听完，按住你准备剪掉它的手。

assets/voice-lines/70e50568e7c323b7787c..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/70e50568e7c323b7787c..text: 苏晚把首映报道的剪报夹进文件袋。你注意到角落里，还有一张没有刊出的照片。

assets/voice-lines/f667667548b66b3c6c8f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f667667548b66b3c6c8f..text: 你把采访本合上。她名字之外的那个普通夜晚，终于有人愿意认真听完。

assets/voice-lines/7d129921f6a577349b3b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7d129921f6a577349b3b..text: 她把提纲收好，便签却留在桌上。书店的灯亮起来时，一个没有刊出的标题终于完成。

assets/voice-lines/502b98949ae9c985300d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/502b98949ae9c985300d..text: 放映后的柜台只剩两份甜点。江月把其中一份放进盒子，另一份摆到靠窗的桌上。

assets/voice-lines/f399ffe859e9e357f929..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f399ffe859e9e357f929..text: 她尝了一口，认真分辨着坚果的香味，像第一次以客人的身份坐在自己的店里。

assets/voice-lines/c268695d72c4bea20a21..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c268695d72c4bea20a21..text: 街上的人渐渐散去。她把写着“售罄”的木牌翻过来，店里却还留着一桌暖光。

assets/voice-lines/d7d9db08e469b037fc5e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/d7d9db08e469b037fc5e..text: 橙香慢慢充满小店。还没有答案的菜单，也已经是一份可以期待的约定。

assets/voice-lines/5d89f1d3939cc20d876a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/5d89f1d3939cc20d876a..text: 首映当天的花絮里，开场前有一段黑屏。唐梨反复确认，终于把手机放下。

assets/voice-lines/a6cfe9b6bc6e7545f89b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a6cfe9b6bc6e7545f89b..text: 相纸上渐渐出现两个人的影子。没有录下的开场，被接下来的约定轻轻接住。

assets/voice-lines/2f446e1cd569c71438e6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2f446e1cd569c71438e6..text: 收设备的轻响过后，画外传来你的声音：“东西先放着，你今天也辛苦了。”

assets/voice-lines/c5bbcdaaa83768ccaad0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c5bbcdaaa83768ccaad0..text: 屏幕暗下去，阳台的小灯还亮着。属于两个人的片尾，没有人急着关掉。

assets/voice-lines/c851d683aed57dec1380..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c851d683aed57dec1380..text: 顾清禾把地图铺在桥栏上，旧街改造区域被铅笔圈成了一个不规则的环。

assets/voice-lines/554e8445e653bafec666..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/554e8445e653bafec666..text: 许知夏的夜间音乐节目只剩最后三分钟，桌上却多了一张没有署名的点歌纸。

assets/voice-lines/c19ba989f4b164d6b158..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c19ba989f4b164d6b158..text: 收摊前，江月发现保温锅里还有一点桂花甜汤。她没有急着倒进打包盒。

assets/voice-lines/54ddf5ef03147fb8a77e..speaker: shen-yu
assets/voice-lines/54ddf5ef03147fb8a77e..text: 准备的时候总担心不够好。现在看见你笑，觉得那些小小的失误也可以留下。

assets/voice-lines/33da8642ed24be3e5ea5..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/33da8642ed24be3e5ea5..text: 原来你说的那个小小计划，是为我准备了这么多。谢谢你，让我期待今天。

assets/voice-lines/251358b31f3db6e6c5b6..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/251358b31f3db6e6c5b6..text: 信已经写好了，今天却不急着交出去。我穿着这条裙子，想先听你讲讲普通的一天。

assets/voice-lines/30bb26275c667d1d190d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/30bb26275c667d1d190d..text: 原来你说的那个小小计划，是为我准备了这么多。谢谢你，让我期待今天。

assets/voice-lines/2bd66cf9213b2375eed3..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/2bd66cf9213b2375eed3..text: 原来你说的那个小小计划，是为我准备了这么多。谢谢你，让我期待今天。

assets/voice-lines/71e23437228d11cb93ff..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/71e23437228d11cb93ff..text: 这条裙子像一小段蜜桃味的副歌。观众只有你，今天的返场也只唱给你听。

assets/voice-lines/2864d2be294ee58d104a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2864d2be294ee58d104a..text: 你把设备收好，和她坐在台阶上。第一次觉得，没发生什么的一天，也能成为庆生的准备。

assets/voice-lines/216c4ceb38f133770dfa..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/216c4ceb38f133770dfa..text: 你在旁边画了一个歪歪的花盆。她把这一页夹进生日礼盒，说这幅画比标准图鉴更值得保存。

assets/voice-lines/3fedd4627831e1a70f3e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3fedd4627831e1a70f3e..text: 你们把盒盖合上，却没有把故事结束。窗外的灯光慢慢亮起来，明年的愿望，还有很长的时间可以一起写。

assets/voice-lines/9586190723b69b71d877..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9586190723b69b71d877..text: 庆祝结束以后，顾清禾没有急着离开。她带你回到钟楼窗边，把收好的生日礼盒又轻轻打开。

assets/voice-lines/dde05b90ef1ea63bdaee..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/dde05b90ef1ea63bdaee..text: 你重新录了一遍，保留了中间的笑声。她说，那半拍停顿，才是这段录音最想听见的地方。

assets/voice-lines/7ee705b82ac567e21e87..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7ee705b82ac567e21e87..text: 你合上提纲，听她讲起小时候忘带蜡烛的生日。那一刻，准备清单少了一项，故事却多了一页。

assets/voice-lines/136bf1bcd18e70f5d29d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/136bf1bcd18e70f5d29d..text: 庆祝结束以后，苏晚没有急着离开。她带你回到街角书店，把收好的生日礼盒又轻轻打开。

assets/voice-lines/a5d1395d443d64a7ba9e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a5d1395d443d64a7ba9e..text: 你们没有把不完美藏起来，而是给它换了用途。礼盒里多出一张花瓶使用说明，落款是两个人。

assets/voice-lines/ae90d09a6e2867086026..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ae90d09a6e2867086026..text: 你把庆生时间写成关店以后。她松了口气，说终于不用在喜欢的工作和喜欢的人之间赶路。

assets/voice-lines/e326f981bef9431f9002..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/e326f981bef9431f9002..text: 收拾厨房时，她把大灯关了，只留柜台的暖灯。你问生日愿望，她把围裙挂在另一副旁边。

assets/voice-lines/762f1bb2aeb5aee7d1d0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/762f1bb2aeb5aee7d1d0..text: 你把准备好的空白相纸放进礼盒，背面写着双人照。她认真检查了相机电量，像接到一份特别的任务。

assets/voice-lines/46c50808df4e119a2a58..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/46c50808df4e119a2a58..text: 你把带子长度调到她惯用的位置。她试着背好，说原来有人记得这种小习惯，也会让人心跳加快。

assets/voice-lines/9777a2fc1b04c2b29c46..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9777a2fc1b04c2b29c46..text: 你们决定把庆生现场留一扇朝向夜色的窗。她说不用刻意安排，能一起等天黑就已经很好。

assets/voice-lines/3e7ffa804aee56d9bef1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3e7ffa804aee56d9bef1..text: 你想录一段祝福，收音麦却把冰箱的嗡鸣录了进去。唐梨听完没有删除，先问你紧不紧张。

assets/voice-lines/f3dcbdbe30326fe29274..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f3dcbdbe30326fe29274..text: 你关掉监听，直接把剩下的话说给她听。她把麦克风收进盒子，说真正重要的部分已经收到了。

assets/voice-lines/7ce90071195f6b156be5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7ce90071195f6b156be5..text: 礼盒的最后一格还空着。唐梨拿出两张电影票，问你能不能把生日后的一个晚上也留给她。

assets/voice-lines/3b4b8c348ab323de39ae..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3b4b8c348ab323de39ae..text: 你在祝福卡末尾写好这个约定。她把镜头盖扣上，轻轻说：好，接下来轮到我们自己的故事了。

assets/voice-lines/82089363c65011332436..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/82089363c65011332436..text: 她打开礼盒，仔细读完你的祝福，又把盒盖轻轻合上。灯光落在两人的手上，这一页生日回忆，终于有了完整的落款。

assets/voice-lines/ed22eb82aa0d54322d75..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ed22eb82aa0d54322d75..text: 这段日常，我想只写给我们。

assets/voice-lines/b3a2971a304e07ff732e..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/b3a2971a304e07ff732e..text: 今天想拍一点，我们三个的生活。

assets/voice-lines/50a1eb2fc1be80c035d6..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/50a1eb2fc1be80c035d6..text: 这里多了一个小伙伴，图纸也变得有温度了。

assets/voice-lines/dfba93817b052effdd3b..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/dfba93817b052effdd3b..text: 我想把这里的每一处，都变成舒服的样子。

assets/voice-lines/9272d24a70e5b34abbd1..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/9272d24a70e5b34abbd1..text: 今天有你和它在，回家就变成了最期待的事。

assets/voice-lines/cb48b52cbfddf57ea404..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/cb48b52cbfddf57ea404..text: 这里留出来，不打磨。图纸上也该给过去一个位置。

assets/voice-lines/8130e17643fa1b6069c6..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/8130e17643fa1b6069c6..text: 就在那块砖上。别动……好了，和我想的一样合适。

assets/voice-lines/12b541841818a738b91c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/12b541841818a738b91c..text: 从门口开始吧。你每次来，我都想让这段路更好走。

assets/voice-lines/4c84f624d90b31168f8a..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/4c84f624d90b31168f8a..text: 给那个总会问我有没有吃饭的人。你认识他吗？

assets/voice-lines/26f4a0a8fb375fca1f4c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/26f4a0a8fb375fca1f4c..text: 这样更好了。等修缮结束，我们真的去坐一次。

assets/voice-lines/458e1575ca67021c438c..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/458e1575ca67021c438c..text: 终于又听见了。还好今天不是我一个人在这里。

assets/voice-lines/bdf545d1e19b97d53510..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/bdf545d1e19b97d53510..text: 嗯。城市里有一扇等你的窗，回家的路就不会太长。

assets/voice-lines/056e3a31eaafd5becf16..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/056e3a31eaafd5becf16..text: 说好了。下次带两杯热饮，我来选靠窗的位置。

assets/voice-lines/092f2c3815529776f239..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/092f2c3815529776f239..text: 小点心准备好了，晚饭也等你一起。

assets/voice-lines/f53b509723e8de9a0c05..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/f53b509723e8de9a0c05..text: 给它准备了小点心，给你留了晚饭。

assets/voice-lines/5a23b561a90c2de2d51a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/5a23b561a90c2de2d51a..text: 今天有你和它在，回家就变成了最期待的事。

assets/voice-lines/3e5eabbd66718b8bea73..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/3e5eabbd66718b8bea73..text: 下次少烤半分钟。你要继续做我的试吃员吗？

assets/voice-lines/571cf4b5d9e690601913..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/571cf4b5d9e690601913..text: 刚刚好。你来以后，好像连这点小事都顺手了。

assets/voice-lines/7c8d097377b71281354f..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/7c8d097377b71281354f..text: 月亮不是一个人了。这个蛋糕，忽然有点舍不得卖。

assets/voice-lines/ec053e67b3d0e8b81af0..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/ec053e67b3d0e8b81af0..text: 谢谢。这样他下次来，就不用那么用力踮脚了。

assets/voice-lines/1c15e6f3e32e7e179d1f..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/1c15e6f3e32e7e179d1f..text: 窗边新长出的叶子，好像也在和它打招呼。

assets/voice-lines/26a239432e1cae40e8cf..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/26a239432e1cae40e8cf..text: 我带了新的猫草。今晚，一起看看它喜欢什么吧。

assets/voice-lines/7b14501834c81b855691..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/7b14501834c81b855691..text: 今天有你和它在，回家就变成了最期待的事。

assets/voice-lines/a0fda5856b3052c1c88b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a0fda5856b3052c1c88b..text: 谢谢。你扶得很稳，我连手都舍不得松开了。

assets/voice-lines/10592e40aa5f1e0d053d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/10592e40aa5f1e0d053d..text: 在这儿。嘘，它好像睡着了……我们小声一点。

assets/voice-lines/0c43b453424506469a44..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0c43b453424506469a44..text: 你总能记得这些小事。猫也是，花也是。还有我。

assets/voice-lines/0497dd7d9be05f8f58ae..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/0497dd7d9be05f8f58ae..text: 是耧斗菜。下次它开花，我想先叫你来看。

assets/voice-lines/07e779094ee84de2c7e9..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/07e779094ee84de2c7e9..text: 这样就不会再弄错了。你打的结，倒像一只小蝴蝶。

assets/voice-lines/1faaeb6e77ea68ad548d..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/1faaeb6e77ea68ad548d..text: 它现在这样也很好。你愿意陪着，我就更不着急了。

assets/voice-lines/fe2a074ec8316531a7fd..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/fe2a074ec8316531a7fd..text: 嗯。有时候等的不是花开，是想把这段时间也过好。

assets/voice-lines/4abbab02ac286d05510a..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/4abbab02ac286d05510a..text: 那值得庆祝。热茶给你，等会儿我想看看那一小段。

assets/voice-lines/3078423b5ef5f9311211..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/3078423b5ef5f9311211..text: 先不想片子了。喝完这杯，我们去长椅上歇一会儿。

assets/voice-lines/a2aba644b3811141bf26..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/a2aba644b3811141bf26..text: 另一只手空出来了。要不要……一起走到路口？

assets/voice-lines/b29ae8978abcdeac920b..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/b29ae8978abcdeac920b..text: 那就一人一枝。等它们开得最好时，我们互相拍照。

assets/voice-lines/3b6f25268bdf3810ea25..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3b6f25268bdf3810ea25..text: 温室后的小路还有积水，她在一串小脚印前停下来。

assets/voice-lines/b4596921e1330bcecff9..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b4596921e1330bcecff9..text: 有一盆花迟迟没有花苞。林栀却仍替它擦净了叶片。

assets/voice-lines/6f0333f4ac331ce746e0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/6f0333f4ac331ce746e0..text: 路过熟悉的茶摊，她问你今天的剪辑顺不顺利。

assets/voice-lines/13adcd4db29036214136..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/13adcd4db29036214136..text: 她的卷尺恰好差一只手才能拉直，抬头便看见了你。

assets/voice-lines/b453e655a51f74d667db..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/b453e655a51f74d667db..text: 阵雨忽然落下，你们躲在还没拆掉的旧屋檐下。

assets/voice-lines/09176fbe08cf466bf383..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/09176fbe08cf466bf383..text: 休息时，她在草图边缘画了一张靠窗的双人长椅。

assets/voice-lines/2813bab04c8efb7f284e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2813bab04c8efb7f284e..text: 维修师傅试响钟机。顾清禾下意识拉住你的袖口。

assets/voice-lines/714182ee518b035237bb..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/714182ee518b035237bb..text: 晚班结束，楼上的窗亮起来，她回头看了很久。

assets/voice-lines/30e8643ae98d0de03786..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/30e8643ae98d0de03786..text: 许知夏弹了四个音，忽然把吉他轻轻按住。

assets/voice-lines/931133dd6f16b719f884..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/931133dd6f16b719f884..text: 天台的风突然大起来，几张乐谱滑过你们脚边。

assets/voice-lines/976e0e395cba13761b63..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/976e0e395cba13761b63..text: 街角的孩子敲着空饼干盒，她停下脚步给他和弦。

assets/voice-lines/24daa3ec312a6995573f..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/24daa3ec312a6995573f..text: 天空只剩一小片金色，她问今天要把什么留下来。

assets/voice-lines/3a64871d68fe4cc3fb06..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3a64871d68fe4cc3fb06..text: 苏晚翻到一张旧车票，背面只有一句没有写完的话。

assets/voice-lines/35b580ce7a411dd94269..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/35b580ce7a411dd94269..text: 老人把椅子搬到街边，她却先收起了录音笔。

assets/voice-lines/21295ca1cfdb05e4ab47..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/21295ca1cfdb05e4ab47..text: 她把两个标题划掉，把采访本推到你面前。

assets/voice-lines/aeafcea846dbc2f31ed5..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/aeafcea846dbc2f31ed5..text: 店里的留言本翻到最后一页，苏晚把笔递过来。

assets/voice-lines/7c5e2c5819b6b9413b80..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7c5e2c5819b6b9413b80..text: 她反复读着一段没有刊登的采访，眉头微微皱着。

assets/voice-lines/be1bfc299aa5ffe41e79..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/be1bfc299aa5ffe41e79..text: 走出书店，她关掉录音笔，笑着朝你转过身。

assets/voice-lines/fb6b73139d1d50c9b232..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fb6b73139d1d50c9b232..text: 她正给蛋糕画月亮，手腕停在最后一笔上。

assets/voice-lines/7e6fd6647c349e3d811e..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7e6fd6647c349e3d811e..text: 刚出炉的面包香飘到门外，放学的孩子踮着脚看。

assets/voice-lines/590c47c61c32cb697afa..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/590c47c61c32cb697afa..text: 江月拿出写满修改的配方纸，问你要不要冒一点险。

assets/voice-lines/612f74bbb18268c9ff8a..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/612f74bbb18268c9ff8a..text: 最后一位客人离开，她终于在靠窗的小桌前坐下。

assets/voice-lines/c56306ada5031b2df5c3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/c56306ada5031b2df5c3..text: 唐梨把手机放进口袋，举起一台旧相机向你示意。

assets/voice-lines/8a92e00001674c60aea7..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/8a92e00001674c60aea7..text: 窗边的光刚好落在你的肩头，她调整了一下镜头。

assets/voice-lines/ad5752024c380c01bac6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/ad5752024c380c01bac6..text: 路过钟楼，她拿出小录音机，却没立刻按下开关。

assets/voice-lines/3124b4393185160fe6ed..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/3124b4393185160fe6ed..text: 她翻出一张有点虚焦的旧照片，说一直舍不得删除。

assets/voice-lines/9cd1a6d5fc0b898d9dd6..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/9cd1a6d5fc0b898d9dd6..text: 回到路口，唐梨问今天的照片最后要放哪一张。

assets/voice-lines/86d330e9034de5cd6de0..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/86d330e9034de5cd6de0..text: 她回过头，说明天见面也不一定要找理由。

assets/voice-lines/bcff006fadce8ce71ea4..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/bcff006fadce8ce71ea4..text: 下一段街角，还有想和你一起看的风景。

assets/voice-lines/22b182209bd936dd34e9..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/22b182209bd936dd34e9..text: 今天的新闻已经交稿了。现在的时间，留给你们。

assets/voice-lines/ca01401f0cf9224c7e36..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ca01401f0cf9224c7e36..text: 今天有你和它在，回家就变成了最期待的事。

assets/voice-lines/ee7cd7a6f2066cad0af0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/ee7cd7a6f2066cad0af0..text: 谢谢你。先让他坐舒服，再谈采访，时间还很长。

assets/voice-lines/8c25a12b110b32b363d6..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/8c25a12b110b32b363d6..text: 直播结束啦。今天的镜头，就留在我们家。

assets/voice-lines/8e1dbcbe9414a83d4af9..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/8e1dbcbe9414a83d4af9..text: 今天有你和它在，回家就变成了最期待的事。

assets/voice-lines/34cc07c25240bdb5855d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/34cc07c25240bdb5855d..text: 别太用力看镜头，看我就好。对，就是这样。

assets/voice-lines/c261024c01de92fdff49..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/c261024c01de92fdff49..text: 好。这张不用露脸，也能看出来我们走在一起。

assets/voice-lines/cea19415bcb57b0459db..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/cea19415bcb57b0459db..text: 那就这张。你没有看镜头，却刚好在等我跟上。

assets/voice-lines/8d717c8a4e80a88ba4f5..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/8d717c8a4e80a88ba4f5..text: 它的小呼噜声，刚好可以当今天的伴奏。

assets/voice-lines/514765de0b231c98fc4b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/514765de0b231c98fc4b..text: 刚刚在路上，忽然想到了我们三个的小调。

assets/voice-lines/16c2edca2be68308d533..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/16c2edca2be68308d533..text: 今天有你和它在，回家就变成了最期待的事。

assets/voice-lines/1c4ed79f69bb55b3357b..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/1c4ed79f69bb55b3357b..text: 只再弹给你听。要是忘了，你明天还得来。

assets/voice-lines/24dbc5e9c0bfddfd2ff8..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/24dbc5e9c0bfddfd2ff8..text: 好，找到我的鼓手了。下次演出，第一排给你留着。

assets/voice-lines/0ab3664bf6d538919ddc..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/0ab3664bf6d538919ddc..text: 抓到了。你在旁边，好像连风都没那么捣乱了。

assets/voice-lines/cfc449be7910473e75a6..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/cfc449be7910473e75a6..text: 慢一点，小心台阶！谱子丢了能重写，你可不行。

assets/voice-lines/c0c28ca9fdf2a8fb3ae0..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/c0c28ca9fdf2a8fb3ae0..text: 咦，你居然记得。那这首歌，算我们一起完成的。

assets/voice-lines/24052cd07c14c104572d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/24052cd07c14c104572d..text: 这一次不会错了。因为最想唱给的人，就坐在这里。

assets/voice-lines/11c8fee331953da88855..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/11c8fee331953da88855..text: 你的节拍很准嘛。今天这场小演出，谁都不能缺席。

assets/voice-lines/374e5c8eed557a1cae0d..speaker: xu-zhixia
assets/voice-lines/374e5c8eed557a1cae0d..text: 镜头拿稳哦。这个笑，是知道你会来才有的。

assets/voice-lines/5afc84a971949f66197a..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/5afc84a971949f66197a..text: 记得带上整扇窗。我想让人看见，回忆原来有这样的尺寸。

assets/voice-lines/ee8cb6f1d14f3e107983..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/ee8cb6f1d14f3e107983..text: 你自己也过来一点。这么小的屋檐，正好够我们两个。

assets/voice-lines/555b707c7a03fee8b3cc..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/555b707c7a03fee8b3cc..text: 这屋檐替很多人挡过雨。今天，我会把你也记进故事里。

assets/voice-lines/227dc84ba7b74e116d43..speaker: gu-qinghe
assets/voice-lines/227dc84ba7b74e116d43..text: 别只拍我，钟楼也拍进去。我要记得是谁陪我等到了今天。

assets/voice-lines/c65d134b12f995befdf5..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/c65d134b12f995befdf5..text: 真的不苦吗？那这块不太完美的，今天就有专属客人了。

assets/voice-lines/992ab5e60b13c1347e1a..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/992ab5e60b13c1347e1a..text: 给他挑最软的一只吧。小时候，我也这样站在橱窗外。

assets/voice-lines/805cd16a2e22286ab7b4..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/805cd16a2e22286ab7b4..text: 有点像今天的风。酸一点，但结尾是甜的，你也是这样想吗？

assets/voice-lines/620ec0211a258fdf4194..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/620ec0211a258fdf4194..text: 那就做只够我们吃的量。失败了，也算一个共同的小秘密。

assets/voice-lines/53153cc07b0cd91ff915..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/53153cc07b0cd91ff915..text: 先歇一会儿吧。以前总想着做完再休息，现在想和你一起坐坐。

assets/voice-lines/672bd6a8f5cd4d328755..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/672bd6a8f5cd4d328755..text: 明天再继续。今天剩下的这点时间，我想留给自己，也留给你。

assets/voice-lines/89d4ab3f53055f0027be..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/89d4ab3f53055f0027be..text: 我就知道你会这么说。叉子也准备了两把，不是碰巧。

assets/voice-lines/56ecfac456438af6d48c..speaker: jiang-yue
assets/voice-lines/56ecfac456438af6d48c..text: 明天的事明天再想。现在，把你喜欢的那半块先挑走。

assets/voice-lines/02f49875d21c5827ef40..speaker: lin-zhi
assets/voice-lines/02f49875d21c5827ef40..text: 昨天它还卷着呢。原来有人一起看，连长大都变得明显了。

assets/voice-lines/71abc827aff370b1af54..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/71abc827aff370b1af54..text: 林栀把一盆薄荷移到窗边。最小的那片叶子，正好接住阳光。

assets/voice-lines/0d95ac660331a3ee81a3..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/0d95ac660331a3ee81a3..text: 她捡起一张被风吹落的标签，上面写着你不认识的花名。

assets/voice-lines/fc53b75eee68b03ecae1..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/fc53b75eee68b03ecae1..text: 关门前，她挑出两枝修剪下来的白桔梗，递到你面前。

assets/voice-lines/a684b3f9da5eaa016e6d..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/a684b3f9da5eaa016e6d..text: 顾清禾用手电照着旧窗框，发现一排很小的身高刻线。

assets/voice-lines/2d9e70a53a19d2b63813..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/2d9e70a53a19d2b63813..text: 旧唱片店门口，她把一侧耳机递给你，另一侧自己戴上。

assets/voice-lines/4b117eb1f9b6e582a52b..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/4b117eb1f9b6e582a52b..text: 排练到熟悉的副歌，她偏偏唱错了一个音，自己先笑了。

assets/voice-lines/7368bcc378b88c6b0134..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/7368bcc378b88c6b0134..text: 江月把一块边缘烤深的曲奇留在盘边，自己有些不好意思。

assets/voice-lines/f155ac1972601d35bd76..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/f155ac1972601d35bd76..text: 打烊时，纸盒里恰好还剩两块蛋糕，她把盒子推给你。

assets/voice-lines/824335027bebc10932b2..speaker: narrator
assets/voice-lines/824335027bebc10932b2..text: 小桥上有人请她帮忙合影，她很自然地往旁边挪出位置。

assets/voice-lines/7e5cd8ee8268e1487e9a..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/7e5cd8ee8268e1487e9a..text: 我来写一张认领告示。故事还没讲完，不能替人草草收尾。

assets/voice-lines/bf9c7c5462f77c6514a8..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/bf9c7c5462f77c6514a8..text: 先替它找个安全的地方。等它的主人回来，我们再听。

assets/voice-lines/505737d6e48d1c170841..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/505737d6e48d1c170841..text: 他刚才看了三次门口。也许今天最想聊的，是等谁回来。

assets/voice-lines/63f5ee33bd0009aa0f69..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/63f5ee33bd0009aa0f69..text: 这个说法更像人说的话。好，就从最普通的一句开始。

assets/voice-lines/2c1f678adbeb8dd37b4d..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/2c1f678adbeb8dd37b4d..text: 你看，答案其实已经在这里了。谢谢你肯陪我慢慢找。

assets/voice-lines/f923ed1733dd30c96a0e..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/f923ed1733dd30c96a0e..text: 不用写得漂亮。让以后翻到的人知道，今天有人很开心。

assets/voice-lines/eb3db324d20e2c39bf67..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/eb3db324d20e2c39bf67..text: 那你写开头，我接一句。这样我们谁也不能偷偷改结局。

assets/voice-lines/4850e24f2515342cc20f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/4850e24f2515342cc20f..text: 不是每个故事都该立刻发表。有些信任，值得先好好收着。

assets/voice-lines/20583b6670b04b682be0..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/20583b6670b04b682be0..text: 这份另存起来吧。即使暂时不发表，我也不想让它消失。

assets/voice-lines/def436f5e7f8126ec365..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/def436f5e7f8126ec365..text: 终于轮到我回答了。今天最好的事，大概就是一起走这段路。

assets/voice-lines/fad201fdef20856fd58f..speaker: su-wan
assets/voice-lines/fad201fdef20856fd58f..text: 我听着。这个问题没有截稿时间，也不会出现在任何报道里。

assets/voice-lines/6264a40714fb82692e1d..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6264a40714fb82692e1d..text: 那今天听你的。难得不用想着让大家都满意，我想看看你的晴川。

assets/voice-lines/f8a35065b963105ad7e5..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/f8a35065b963105ad7e5..text: 想拍不用解释给别人听的照片。比如现在，你刚刚笑的样子。

assets/voice-lines/8b62b4a01a763fc287d2..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/8b62b4a01a763fc287d2..text: 那你得教我怎么站。我站到镜头前，居然比开播还紧张。

assets/voice-lines/0a692777c98f2f9309f8..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0a692777c98f2f9309f8..text: 现在可以了。你看，等一等，也能等到很好听的片段。

assets/voice-lines/267cb51c76c7af3eff46..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/267cb51c76c7af3eff46..text: 想留下没有弹幕的时候。风声里还有脚步声，我知道哪一个是你。

assets/voice-lines/0346048959ca13090471..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/0346048959ca13090471..text: 那天我拍得很糟，却有人一直夸我认真。我现在还记得。

assets/voice-lines/6e4fc4f95feb116ba7bc..speaker: tang-li
assets/voice-lines/6e4fc4f95feb116ba7bc..text: 嗯。有些照片不需要很多人点赞。知道有人愿意看，就够了。
